highlights.summary:
MANIT Bhopal is ranked 81st by NIRF 2025 under the Engineering category. MANIT, through five departments, offers PhD, UG, and PG courses to students. These courses are provided across the Humanities, Engineering, Science, and various other streams. The flagship courses offered by the MANIT Bhopal are BTech and B.Arch.
NIT Bhopal is a Deemed University. It is one of the national importance institutes. The institute is approved by AICTE. The Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology Bhopal is recognised by NBA and ARIIA. The college was established in 1960. It is one of the first eight Regional Engineering Colleges present in the country. Bhopal NIT has hostels for boys and girls. NIT Bhopal has a well-maintained campus that includes an Energy Centre, Administrative buildings, Institutional buildings, Computer Centre, Library and Learning Resource Centre.
The highest package offered during BTech MME placements for 2024 stood at INR 24 LPA. The average package received by students was INR 9.73 LPA. 88% of the BTech MME batch was placed during placements 2024. It has collaborations with several companies and organisations such as Jyotikiran Energy Mumbai Pvt. Ltd and AMP Energy Distributed Generation Pvt. Ltd.

college_info_program.intro:
MANIT Bhopal popular programmes are BTech and B.Arch. The popularity of these programmes is attributed to their curriculum, which has been developed and upgraded to enhance the knowledge of students in various branches of Engineering and Technology. NIT Bhopal aims at the holistic development of students and helps them to develop technical competencies as well as various soft skills required to target core-industry roles. The industry-institute relations established by NIT Bhopal provide students with the opportunity to undergo various training programmes organised by industry partners.
NIT Bhopal also offers placement assistance to students and helps them get placed in top companies. The notable NIT Bhopal recruiters include Zomato, Amazon, Microsoft, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, and Google, among others. MANIT Bhopal Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Choose this NIT if you get a good branch.

detailed_review.Placements: Above 90% of students in my branch get placed. You can also join various clubs related to your branch, which definitely help with placements. I even heard from my seniors that in a CSE club, the placement percentage was 100% last year, with an average package of 35 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is decent but not at the level of IITs. Some new buildings have good facilities, but most of the campus is older since the institute was established in 1960. Overall, the institute is worth it.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some faculty members are very good, while others are not. At last, you need to study on your own to get good marks.
detailed_review.Other: If you don’t get an IIT but get a good branch here, this is a great option.

reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA)
reviews.review_title: Best college for placements and knowledge.

detailed_review.Placements: My batch is 2024, and my course is civil engineering. In civil engineering, placement is moderate. The maximum package in civil engineering is 24 LPA. The percentage of placement is 70, and the remaining 30 students want to work in a core company, so in my course, placement is best.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is the best in Bhopal, and Wi-Fi is also the best with high speed. Classrooms are the best, and a library is provided. Different labs are available in my courses. Hostel facilities are moderate, and food quality is the best. Hostel and mess fees are also moderate. Medical facilities are very good. Sports are also provided here. There is a sports complex, and different schemes are being held here.
detailed_review.Faculty: In Maulana Azad National Stock Technology, teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. All teachers are experienced in the field of study, and teaching quality is the best. They are also providing notes and books. Teachers also provide industry and industry information. Semester exams are more difficult.

reviews.course: Bachelor of Planning (B.Plan)
reviews.review_title: Dissatisfied due to the placement percentage last year, which was very low.

detailed_review.Placements: Last year, the placement record was around 86% of students got placed in our course. The highest salary package offered is 30.5 LPA. The average is 13 LPA. Students from the chemical department got placed in teach, non-teach, and core fields. Very few members are pursuing this course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Almost all hostels are in good condition, with all facilities like a common room, Wi-Fi, sports facilities, and other things. The sports complex is very good with all the required facilities. Cricket, football, badminton, volleyball, basketball, handball, table tennis, yoga, and kabaddi are available. Labs are well-equipped, and classrooms are good with a projector and all.
detailed_review.Faculty: You need to study from YouTube for a few subjects. Few teachers teach well, but for a few of them, you will not get. The first-year courses are the same for all students. From the second year, you get to know about your relevant courses and branch structure. The semester exams are based on the mood of professors, and almost all of them pass students, except for about 4-5.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placements but not the infrastructure as we expected.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 95 percent of students were placed last year, with the highest package being 80 LPA and the median package 17 LPA in Electronics and Communication. The top recruiting companies are NVIDIA, Qualcomm, Google, Microsoft, Intel, and more. Most students not only go for core jobs but also choose the software side.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Every alternate room has a balcony for better air and an open environment. Every room has Wi-Fi and LAN connection. Every hostel has a common hall consisting of a television. The infrastructure is vast but not as expected. Food is good for those who are from Bhopal, and it is generally satisfactory.
detailed_review.Faculty: The professors are highly educated and helpful. Exams are moderate to tough to build strong conceptual knowledge for a better future. Practicals are also conducted with correct observation from the faculty.
detailed_review.Other: We can enjoy campus life here with friends. The campus is big and easily accessible from the city.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: The college has good placements but not the infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 95 percent of students were placed last year. The highest package is 80 LPA, and the median package is 17 LPA. The top recruiting companies are NVIDIA, Qualcomm, Google, Microsoft, Intel, and more. Most of the students not only do core jobs but are also interested in non-core jobs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Every alternate room has a balcony and very clean bathrooms. Every room has Wi-Fi and LAN connection. There is a common hall for every hostel. The library has 30,000 books and is very peaceful. The food in the mess is tasty and hygienic. The infrastructure is very vast and good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are highly educated and helpful. The exams are very tough and practical. The course teaches us about communication systems, embedded systems, VLSI, optoelectronic devices, etc. It makes the students very proficient in the curriculum and helps them achieve perfection.
detailed_review.Other: I enjoy campus life.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placements, but bad for ECE.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement percentage is impressive, with about 85 percent of the eligible students from the ECE course getting placed. Regarding the salaries, the range is quite wide, with the absolute highest package hitting 52.09 LPA. The most representative figure for the majority is the average package at 15.05 LPA, with the median package being very close to that, at 14.00 LPA. The lowest packages seen across the engineering stream typically start around 7.5 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for the ECE course is not so good as the department doesn't have its own building. We use shared labs, and Wi-Fi is often slow. In contrast, the hostel facilities are quite good. The mess food is okay-okay, but the canteen is decent. The campus has excellent sports facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty quality is mixed. Some are good, but some are not good teachers, though all are highly qualified. The biggest problem is that our course is so outdated. It focuses too much on old theory and does not make us industry-ready for today's market. We have to learn modern skills like competitive coding and AI independence. Semester exams are moderately difficult, and the pass percentage is generally high.
detailed_review.Other: I chose ECE mainly because I am getting this one, even though I originally wanted CS. Since Bhopal is close to my house, it was the best option available.

reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA)
reviews.review_title: Not up to expectations, but still the best available.

detailed_review.Placements: Honestly, placements for MCA students have gone down drastically this year. It has been three months since the placement season started, and barely 15 out of 115 students have been placed. Many are happy even with a 5 LPA offer, which shows how low the expectations have become. We all worked hard and cracked a tough exam to get into this college. They hope to earn at least 1 LPA after a master’s degree, but the reality has been quite disappointing.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The MCA department does not have dedicated classrooms. Classes are conducted wherever an empty room is available. Sometimes one lecture happens in one building, and the next is scheduled in a completely different building. We end up wasting a lot of time just moving from one building to another. The hostels are excellent, honestly the best part of the college. Rooms are well maintained, and the mess food is really good considering the price we pay.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty is very good, well qualified, knowledgeable, and truly dedicated. The curriculum is well designed and updated, and exams are conducted smoothly. There are many invigilators in a room. Apart from the professors, their PhDs also come for invigilation duty.
detailed_review.Other: We have fests like other colleges, but they happen only once a year.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placements in 2024 to 2025.

detailed_review.Placements: In B.Tech electrical engineering in 2024 to 2025, out of 129 registered candidates, all 129 got placed. The highest package is 55LPA, the lowest package offered is 7.5LPA, and the average package offered is 9.5LPA to 11.13LPA. In the core sector, the top recruiting company is Bharat Heavy Electrical Ltd.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is a Central library on the campus which has about 1.5 Lacs books,1627 thesis/dissertations. There are digital resources about 7000 books and 5000 journals. Hostel has good facilities, and there is a LAN facility for the internet. There is no Wi-Fi in hostels. Sports facilities are decent, there is a sports complex with equipment for most sports. There is no AC in most of the classrooms except for a few.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most professors are knowledgeable and open to discussion of doubts even after class hours. The quality of teaching is pretty good. The course provides specialized knowledge that can be used in multidisciplinary problems in the field of electrical engineering. Semester exams are not too difficult, their difficulty is above average. 75% attendance is mandatory to pass the semester.

reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA)
reviews.review_title: Good campus life, but concerning placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Record low placements this year, only around 10-15% placed till now, around 18- 19 LPA is the highest till now and 8-9 LPA is the lowest, around 13 LPA being avg. The top recruitment companies are Texas, Adobe (PPO through summer intern), MSCI, and 4 students got summer internships in Adobe. The top roles being offered are SDE1, ML engineering and data analyst.
detailed_review.Infrastructure:
Wi-Fi in classroom and labs works fine (around 60mbps).
Labs are in good condition, but mostly, we use our own laptops as the system over there is just not capable of handling the tasks.
Okayish classrooms (no AC).
Library is good, though timings are fixed 9-5.
Hostel room is good enough, but the cleaning is an issue in the hostel, hostel food is below average.
Sports facilities like football, badminton, TT, chess, kabaddi, basketball, volleyball and even a gym are available.
Multiple canteens, but small ones, don't expect too much.
Dispensary available for medical needs, free for all students.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most faculty members are at their best in their work and are helpful in all ways, including studies. The course curriculum is very relevant and according to industry needs only. Exams aren't difficult at all, just study in class carefully, you don't even need to study for it later, in our course, 95%-100% students pass.
detailed_review.Other: Whether the career is made or not, the experience is already made, a crazy experience.

reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA)
reviews.review_title: Good second option, scope for improvement.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements were good in the past, but right now, many people are getting only mass hiring, while only 15% are getting good packages. So far, 18.5 LPA is the highest and 6 LPA is the lowest package for the 2026 batch. Top recruiters include Adobe, Cisco, Texas Instruments, MSCI, Quantiphi, etc. Only 5% have got an internship from the 2027 batch, roles being SDE and Technical Consultant.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college has good infrastructure, and hostels are available to all. LAN is available in all rooms of the hostel, and Wi-Fi works in the college academic buildings. Classrooms are good and spacious, but lack air conditioning, otherwise, they are great. Labs are also equipped with good systems. Food would be a good 6/10, not very poor but not that great either.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-qualified and supportive, but the course lacks the latest industry standards and is mostly outdated. You'll have to learn new technologies on your own. Semester exams are moderately difficult, but you can get a good idea from past 5-year question papers. Pattern repeats, questions vary.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because a B.Sc. degree doesn't hold much value in the industry, and you would probably have to go for a master's to get a good job. The best thing is we don't have to study very hard to clear our academic loads, so we have ample time to explore new technology and things. If the industry-related knowledge were inculcated in the syllabus, students who have to deal with two different sets of things will be better. There are a lot of active societies running in the college, and fests are organised with full enthusiasm.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence
reviews.review_title: Good placements and facilities. Well-qualified and supportive faculty members.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are good. In the 2024-26 batch, more than 50% of students get internships in good companies like Dell, Intel, SapLabs, KPIT, GE Verona, and many more. They provide an average package of 15-18 LPA. Roles offered include software engineer roles, AI engineer roles, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus is very large, covering 650 acres. There are two girls' hostels with double rooms. Labs and classrooms are good. The library is average, with few seats and many books, but it is not very useful. Labs are very good for research. Hostel food is too spicy, does not taste good, and the menu is not very appropriate.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are good and knowledgeable. They are supportive and encouraging. They always encourage M.Tech students to do research and publish papers. The course curriculum is good and relevant to the industry. Semester exams are quite difficult, but as it is an autonomous university, it is easy to score well by attending classes seriously.

Many recruiting companies are coming here for internships and placements. 80% of students got internships here.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of the college is the best. Many presidents are provided here. Wi-Fi is provided, and library also provides different labs. Classrooms are available. Hostel facilities are good. Mess is good. We also have a canteen. Medical facilities are very good. Different sports are provided here.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. Course curriculum is semester-wise, and exams are provided semester-wise. Exams are more difficult, and every year, 2 semesters are completed. Students are ready for industries, placement, and other companies.
detailed_review.Other: I chose civil engineering because of my interest in field work. I want to improve civil independence.

Different labs are available in my courses. Hostel facilities are moderate, and food quality is the best. Hostel and mess fees are also moderate. Medical facilities are very good. reviews.course: B.Tech. in Chemical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Honest review by a second-year chemical engineering student.

detailed_review.Placements: 71% of students who graduated last year were placed. The highest package was 30.1 LPA, and the average package is 11 LPA offered to chemical engineering students. Top recruiting companies that offer placement to the chemical branch are BPCL, HPCL, and ONGC. Internship opportunities are decent, but you have to apply off-campus.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are pretty good. Wi-Fi facilities are very good all over the campus. The library is also good. Classrooms and labs are well-designed. Hostels are also very good, and the quality of food is nice. A canteen is available on the college campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors and seniors are very helpful, knowledgeable, and qualified. The course curriculum is the same as in other universities. Teaching quality is pretty good, it makes you industry-ready. Semester exams are decent, you can pass them easily. The pass percentage is above 90%.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: My college is good for achieving the life's goal.

detailed_review.Placements: College has a good placement percentage in my branch, like around 90% with 80 LPA being the highest and 25 as an average package in the CSE branch. Many top companies like Microsoft, Infosys, Wipro, and many more have done recruitment from this college, and also there are internship facilities available.

A sports complex is also there, having a variety of different equipment for different games. The hostel is also good, but some hostel has small rooms.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very good and supportive in this college and also have great knowledge, and the course curriculum is also not too difficult to understand, and the semester exams are also easy if periodic study is done in around some days and weeks by attending the classes.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering
reviews.review_title: MANIT is a premier engineering institute in India. It is a institute of national importance.

detailed_review.Placements: Roles are offered in core and also in the IT sector. Students have opportunities to explore various fields of their interests.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Excellent infrastructure and cooperative mess are run in MANIT College, Bhopal. Well-maintained hostels are provided to students of different branches. Bus services are also available to maintain the green environment of the lush campus of 650 acres, and it also has a lake. Here we have well-organized and maintained civil labs.
detailed_review.Faculty: Ph.D. professors and the best curriculum are followed in MANIT. There is relatively little marking in subjects and semesters. Papers are scheduled as a mini test, then a mid exam, and then end-exam. Lab experiments and exams are also conducted regularly. To maintain a CGPA, you have to work hard. Teachers give exposure to all the fields that can be explored.
detailed_review.Other: Green and healthy environment is provided by MANIT.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Point of view of second year CSE student.

detailed_review.Placements: Above 90% of students were placed in the last 2 years of the placement in my branch. The highest package offered was 84 LPA, and the average for CSE was 25 LPA, which is pretty good, making it a very good choice over other comparable options. Top MNCs also arrived at our college, like Google, Microsoft, DE Shaw, and Goldman Sachs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostels are pretty good if we compare them with the general government college hostels. Hostel mess is also very good, best in my opinion, because in other colleges, the food provided is not edible. Also, Wi-Fi facility is provided all over the campus with good speed. Labs, classrooms, and the library are all very good. The sports complex is the best among NITs.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are very helpful. Everyone is well qualified, has done a Ph.D. from a top IIT, very knowledgeable, and not very strict. The course is the same as other universities. The semester exams are not very tough, they are at a normal level. Practically, there is no minimum attendance criterion.
detailed_review.Other: The college was near my home, CSE was the best option available, and placement is very good. Events, fest, campus crowd is very good, connectivity to the city is good.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering
reviews.review_title: The college values your efforts, offers great support, and is growing in exciting ways.

detailed_review.Placements: Till now, 65%-70% of seniors from my batch have been placed. The highest being 52 LPA and the median is about 10 LPA, majorly of the students get internships during their 3rd year, there's no such major role being favored by the companies for recruitment, majorly they hire for all the preferred domains students can offer them, majority of which is tech, core, management, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostels allotted to first-year students are nice, and the rooms are spacious as well. Wi-Fi and LAN facilities are good, and so are the electrical supply facilities. The food being adorable as it's a student-owned mess, we can't expect much great quality in the first year.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is great, a nice professor with great achievements and degrees in hand. The course curriculum is relevant to me as it fulfills the aspect and the domain I was searching for, the semester exams are not that tough, one can pass them easily by studying from zero one day before the exams. The passing percentage is about 4-5 CGPA, I think.
detailed_review.Other: I chose the course to explore throughout my degree, now I am doing that at my best, being secured by the placements also being provided by my college.

reviews.course: B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Mathematics and Data Science
reviews.review_title: The college has good placements and campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: I'm a student at MANIT Bhopal pursuing a dual degree in B.Teach and M.Teach in mathematics and data science. This program was introduced in 2021. The placements here are really good, with an average salary of up to 18-20 LPA. Seniors are supportive, and you'll experience a hill environment here. The campus spans about 650 acres with greenery all around. The college is located within the city, with a market nearby, so you can visit for resources. Overall, it's worth it.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All kinds of resources are available, but MS doesn't have its department building since it has only 30 students per batch. Hostels are available, and generally, you will get double occupancy. The hostel is inside the campus. Mess food is average compared to what we get at home.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified and always support the students. Students can ask their doubts anytime by visiting faculty cabins or via WhatsApp. In MANIT or any NIT, the grading system is relative, meaning grades are awarded comparatively.

reviews.course: Bachelor of Planning (B.Plan)
reviews.review_title: Overall, placements are good. Facilities, faculty members and infrastructure are also good.

detailed_review.Placements: If we talk about placement in planning department, many companies like construction companies, planning support, and many other companies have come. The starting packages are 10 LPA - 12 LPA but mostly students left the packages for their startups. The highest package was 85 LPA in 2023. Students also prepare for government services like Niti Aayog and other planning boards.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: At Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology planning and architecture department is the biggest one. There are facilities for 3D printing, CAD CAM lab, and survey labs to give practical knowledge of planning. Hostels are so big and properly maintained with double-sharing rooms and free unlimited Wi-Fi, water cooler facility, geyser facility, laundry facility, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members in planning department are so calm and caring about their students, you can go anytime to their cabins to ask your doubts. They also help with your internships and placements. The curriculum is best in the department. There are 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM classes but on Friday there is sports class for 3 hours, and Saturday and Sunday are off days. If we talk about exams for this course, they are taken with other bachelor's degree courses like B.Tech. There is an exam schedule that comes in starting of the session and is followed properly by departments.
detailed_review.Other: As I am a 2nd-year student now, I have completed my 1st internship as nodal officer in PMAY Yojana, which gave me superb experience. These courses are so amazing and more interesting than tech courses. Now, my group and I are working on a startup. The campus life is so good. If someone is interested in the defence field, then they can join NCC to get proper forces practical knowledge and get edge in CDS and other officer-level exams SSBs.

admission.title: NIT Bhopal Admission Overview 2026
admission.overview_text: NIT Bhopal admission 2026 is primarily entrance-based. The college offers UG, PG and Doctoral degree courses in Engineering , Management and Computer Applications across various specialisations. The flagship courses of NIT Bhopal are BTech, MTech and MBA. These courses are offered under 11 departments and 4 schools . At NIT Bhopal , candidates are selected through national-level tests like JEE Main, GATE, NIMCET, CAT , etc. After qualifying for the respective entrance exams, students need to appear for the relevant counselling sessions including JoSAA , CSAB , and CCMT

faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

faqs.question: What is the category-wise CSE cutoff at NIT Bhopal?
faqs.answer: NIT Bhopal cutoff 2024 are based on JEE Main 2024 ranks followed by JoSAA Counselling and further, followed by CSAB Counselling . highlights.summary:
NIT JSR is ranked as 82nd in NIRF Ranking 2025 as one of the top Engineering institutes in India. One of the most popular institutes of Engineering in Jharkhand is NIT Jamshedpur or National Institute of Technology Jamshedpur. What is currently referred to as the National Institute of Technology, Jamshedpur was once the Regional Institute of Technology. In 1960, there was the establishment of the institution in partnership between the Government of Bihar and the Government of India. NIT Jamshedpur cut- off has a declining trend over the past three years.
The Institute has 200 faculty members, 4, 000 students, 150 administrative and support staff and is a self-sustaining campus. The campus is situated throughout the Main building, the Library, the Computer center, 13 hostels (7 Institute male hostels, 6 female hostels), staff quarters, Guest house, a Students Gymkhana, a post office, a State Bank of India branch, two ATM, central store and a dispensary. reviews.course: B.Tech. in Production and Industrial Engineering
reviews.review_title: Real review from NITian.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 95% above are placed in the PIE branch. Overall, there is 92% placement percentage at NIT Jamshedpur. In this course, the highest would be around 18-20 LPA and above, the average would be around 10 LPA, and the lowest would be around 5 LPA. Eaton, JSW Steel, Flipkart (supply management roles), etc. Top roles include Data Analyst, supply chain roles, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel, I would rate 5 above and more especially, the hostel is at the level of IITs and above any NITs hostel. Cleanliness in the hostel is also top-level, sweeping machines are used. Mess food, I would rate 4.5. Non-Veg is very good. Veg students have to suffer a little bit. Medical, I would rate 5. There is always an ambulance available 24/7, and there are doctors for stress and anxiety. Also, one of my classmates has anxiety problems, so the college authority takes it seriously. Sports, Iwould rate 4. Mostly, all sports are available, so overall 4. You can check out my Instagram profile (raja_kumar.018), don't forget to follow me.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are helpful. All course curricula are relevant as they have recently been renewed. Here, branch-specific subjects are being taught by professors who are important for the future, such as C++, Java, CSS, and DSA, which are included in the CSE branch. PIE branch includes Supply management subjects, and Data Analysis subjects are market-ready subjects. Semester exams are of a moderate level, except for 1-2 subjects, depending on proof.

reviews.course: B.Tech. (Hons.) in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Reasons why not to leave the admission here, NIT Jamshedpur.

detailed_review.Placements: Talking of students placed in 2024, the number of offers represented was 725 plus. Companies visited were more than 260. The highest package was 82 LPA, and the average was 12.63 LPA. Overall, 93.76 percent of students were placed. Prominent recruiters were Atlassian, Flipkart, and Accenture. In the Mechanical department, the placement percentage was 91.5 percent. The batch size of the 2024 passout was 673.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Speaking of academic facilities and infrastructure, lectures are taken in a new lecture hall, which has all facilities, Wi-Fi, LAN, a projector, and a library is near the lecture hall, so you can study after attending lectures. Labs of all subjects are in the old academic building, the labs' infrastructure is a bit old, fans are there, but in peak summers, they're of no use. The equipment and machinery of some labs are new, but some are of the old kind, but good if you're in robotics, electronics, and computer labs. Wi-Fi is present on the entire campus, and LAN is also in every hostel room.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professor and PhD scholars are very helpful, though a couple of them might be tough or strict, but still, they understand their students and are always available. The course is very good and bifurcation in every semester is done in a good way, students also get practical knowledge through labs, making students ready for the real world. Semester exam toughness varies with the professor. But with relatively grading it doesn't matter a lot now. To pass, a student must get marks higher than 35 in theory and 40 in labs.
detailed_review.Other: This college is the best option for college life and placement offers. With many cultural teams and technical teams, fests and events, you will never feel left out and will always learn.

reviews.course: B.Tech. (Hons.) in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placements, strong academics, and a vibrant campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: So, the placement of the Mechanical Engineering department is 97-99%. The highest package was around 20.5 LPA, the lowest was 5.5 LPA, and the average package is 7-8.5 LPA. Top companies like Tata Steel, JSW, JSL, JSPL, L&T, Vedanta, RIL, ABG, etc., visit our college. They provide various roles such as GET, Management Role, Design Role, Sales Role, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The Mechanical Engineering department has good infrastructure, including well-equipped labs and smart classrooms with projectors. The high-speed Wi-Fi is available across the campus. The central library is large, air-conditioned, and has enough books and journals. Hostels are very good but less maintained, with issues like water problems and Wi-Fi issues. The food quality is average, but you can eat. The grounds for sports are very good, and the sports infrastructure is good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are experienced, supportive, and knowledgeable, especially in core subjects; however, some professors are less experienced and knowledgeable. Exams are moderately difficult, and you can score very well with one week of study before the exam. The passing percentage is 95-97%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose Mechanical at NIT Jamshedpur because the placement is very good, and this is the oldest branch with strong fundamentals and good industry exposure. The campus life is vibrant, with events like OJASS (tech fest) and CulFest (cultural fest).

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Placements are great. Infrastructure is decent. Mess food is average. Fests are below average.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are great on paper, but the records include off-campus placements. As per the 4th-year seniors, the placements are much better than at other NITs. You will get to this rank. So if you are focused on placements, then you can join this college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The first-year hostel is great. It is newly built. It is a 2-seater hostel. The hostels for other years might feel old and in poor condition, but they are the same as other hostels in India, and they are single-seater. The lecture hall is great. The mess food is bad. For girls, they have built a new hostel, which we do not know if they will allot to first years or not.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are qualified, but you will not understand anything in class. The exams are of decent difficulty, but the checking of copies is lenient. The branch is a hill. You will get Alok sir, who does not take more than 5 classes in the entire semester.
detailed_review.Other: Electrical Engineering is the most popular branch in this college. You have to address seniors as Sir and Ma'am. There is no ragging culture here, but they ask you to give your introduction in the correct format. If you are not able to give it in the correct format, they make you repeat your intro. So some people might find this culture toxic. Many fests are organised here, but do not keep your expectations too high, since they are not great. The college lacks a few facilities, such as a good gym, auditorium, hockey ground, etc.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering
reviews.review_title: Absolutely good placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement of our college is very good, and Jamshedpur is famous for placement. In our branches, the maximum package is 20 LPA, and the average package is approximately 8 LPA. Approximately, the percentage of placement is above 95 percent. Many of the student goes for further studies and government job preparation. Internship opportunities are available to students from their second or third year. Many of the companies provide internships to the students according to their branches. Many students get internships in our colleges, and also many students get internships off campus.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In our college, there is only one gym, which is very small in size. The gym in our college just opened this year in August. Also, there is one cafeteria in our college, and the price is reasonable for the food. The library in our college is the only one. The library opens at 10:00 AM and closes at 9:00 PM. The hostel timing for boys is approximately 11:00 PM, and for girls is 9:00 PM. Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty-to-student ratio is good, it is nearly up to 8:1. Approaching the faculty members is very easy, as they are supportive. All the faculty members are good, so we cannot take the names. There are two exams, mid-semester and the end-semester. They are a little bit tough, the curriculum is also relevant when it comes to the core branches, and it is somewhat non-relevant for the tech branches.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering
reviews.review_title: Very good college, infrastructure, and placements.

detailed_review.Placements: From the 7th semester, only top companies start visiting the campus. All top IT companies visit the college. The CSE branch has an average of 27 LPA with around 95 percent placements. The core branch also has very good placements. The MME branch and the PIE branch have the best placements compared to all NITs. I am preparing for UPSC ESE. On average, around 97 percent of students get placed. The lowest package is 6.5 LPA and the highest is 82.5 LPA, which Atlassian offered to 5 students of CSE, ECE, and EE.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostels are allotted to each student in the college. For the first year, a single room is shared with 2 students, while in the second year onward, a single room is allotted to single students. The mess food quality is not so good. The library is full of books and books. You'll get newspapers and magazines too, and there is a Hindi sahitya section in the library which is full of golden Hindi literature books. The classroom is very high-tech and air-conditioned. They have whiteboards and a green board, projectors, and a podium equipped with a mic. Many sports events here, like cricket, football, Premier League, badminton, etc., are conducted.
detailed_review.Faculty: There are literally many faculty members. I don't exactly know the faculty-to-student ratio, but I have heard it's around 1:15 or something like that. All faculty members are friendly here and not that strict. Proff. A. K Choudhary sir is a superb faculty member of Geotechnical Engineering. The curriculum and the textbooks are just the same as those followed in all top IITs and NITs. The teaching style is the same, but it's more on the older way of teaching side. Exams happen twice each semester, named mid-semester examination carrying 30 marks, then end-semester exams carrying 50 marks.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering
reviews.review_title: NIT Jamshedpur College review.

detailed_review.Placements: In the institute, almost 90% of students get placed in four companies and nearly 100% in non-teaching roles. The highest package is 82 LPA, the average is 22 LPA, and the lowest is 10 LPA. Top recruiters include Google, Microsoft, and L&T. Around 72–80% of the jobs offered are sales roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our department has very good facilities. There is Wi-Fi, the lab equipment is in great condition, and classrooms are clean, spacious, and have projectors. The library is huge with over 2 lakh books. The medical and sports facilities are excellent. The hostels may be a bit old and not ideal for second-year students, but they are fine for others. The only drawback is the food in the mess, which I would rate 2 out of 5.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are qualified and always willing to help. They communicate well. The curriculum focuses on preparing students for jobs. The semester exams can be a little tough, but the high pass rate shows that the course is well-structured. Overall, faculty members are good and approachable.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering
reviews.review_title: NIT Jamshedpur College review.

detailed_review.Placements: In the college, almost 90% of students are placed in four companies, and nearly 100% in non-teaching roles. The highest salary offered is 82 LPA, the average is around 22 LPA, and the lowest is 10 LPA. Major recruiters include Google, Microsoft, and L&T. About 72–80% of the placements are for sales roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Even though the overall infrastructure is just average, the campus Wi-Fi, well-maintained labs, comfortable classrooms, and large library make a big difference. Since the library has so many books, students don’t need to spend much on outside materials. There are transport facilities and on-campus housing too. The mess is clean, and the food is decent, but it could use a few more favourites.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty and staff do their jobs well. First-year classes feel similar to high school, which makes shifting to college easier. The yearly tests are not very difficult. The college also appreciates top performers and recognizes their achievements.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering
reviews.review_title: National Institute of Technology, Civil Engineering

detailed_review.Placements: The best thing about this college is placement. Metallurgy and Production is having almost 100 percent placement. Civil's placement is also good as compared to other NITs. Core branches here are too strong. If your priority is placement, then go for this college blindly.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The lecture hall is good, and each classroom is equipped with air conditioning. Other buildings are not that great, but the boys' hostel for 1st year is the best, newly built, and can be considered as one of the best hostels among NITs.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty at NIT Jamshedpur are well-qualified and helpful, with strong academic and research backgrounds. Teaching quality is good and focuses on practical understanding. The curriculum is industry-relevant, updated regularly, and promotes technical skills. Exams are moderate, and the pass percentage is around 85–90 percent.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of NIT Jamshedpur College.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements here were pretty solid. Placement cell did its job well. This college stands out when it comes to core placements, much better than any other NITs on the list, to be honest. It's got a reputation for being one of the best for placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: College had some pretty solid infrastructure and decent amenities. The campus housing it's actually quite comfy and pretty well-managed. A lot of students prefer living there. As for the food service, it's alright, it gets the job done, nothing too fancy.
detailed_review.Faculty: I had to say, the faculty here was just amazing. Every single person really knows their stuff. You could tell they were passionate about their fields. They were super approachable, and always ready to blend a hand when students needed it. The teaching really helped students get a good grip on the material. The curriculum was pretty up to date. They have got that sweet spot, not too easy, not too hard.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering
reviews.review_title: Best NIT in India. Placement is good.

detailed_review.Placements: 96% of students are placed. The highest package is 17LPA. Top recruiting companies are LNT, Tata Steel, Jusco, etc. They get internship in Jusco about 50% and many more companies like ICICI Bank, all the students did a great job in placement also.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All the classrooms are neat and clean. The diamond jubilee lecture hall is the best, the hostel is also good, and the mess food is also okay. The gym section is good, football, basketball, volleyball court, lawn tennis court, badminton court, chess area, everything is nice.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well qualified from good IITs and NITs. They help us in very difficult situations. The semester exam is not so tough, almost all the students pass. All the teachers are well educated, and they are also doing research work and teaching M.Teach and Ph.D. students.
detailed_review.Other: I love civil engineering, thats why I chose civil and wanted to be in the core. In NIT, JSR events are the best, including cultural night, branch fest, tech fest, sports fest, and many more things.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering
reviews.review_title: Satisfied with college. Actually, I started preparation for JEE in a drop year.

detailed_review.Placements: In general, our branch almost every student got placed. Generally, civil engineering branch students prefer to go for government jobs rather than any corporate jobs. Besides all that, people got good placements from many companies like L&T.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is working regularly, but during exam time, it gets stuck and does not work properly. After paying money, we have to recharge the phones to use data. LAN is working properly. Hostel quality is good, but I got the top floor. We know the college is behind the industrial area, and it gets too hot.
detailed_review.Faculty: It is too difficult to pass the examination. All the teachers present here are almost from the Indian Institutes of Technology. They have too much knowledge, but the knowledge and teaching methods are totally different. Some teachers know everything but are not able to describe it properly.
detailed_review.Other: I love to build new infrastructure.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering
reviews.review_title: The infrastructure is okay, but the placements are good.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements are good, and the placement cell is also supportive. It is one of the best colleges for core placements, having much better core placements and percentage than any other NITs in the list. The college is known for this placement more than any other.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is average, and the labs are old but pretty enough so you don't face any problem with learning. It's also one of the developing NITs, and definitely, it will grow more in research and also in infrastructure. Its NIRF ranking has also increased. It has now moved to the 82nd position from 100-150.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum is very poor. They have to update it to the new curriculum that most of the colleges are following, making students industry-ready from the very start of their course. They also took the initiative this year; they have started core subjects in many branches.
detailed_review.Other: My batch is pretty good, and the batchmates are also good and competitive, getting a good environment here to grow.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Pretty good, not so bad, better than good! Can opt!

detailed_review.Placements: 90-30% of students got placed. The highest package is 82 LPA. The average package is 22 LPA. Over 725 job offers were made. More than 260 companies visited the campus. Over 100 new companies participated for the first time. Placements are less than last time, but maybe now it'll pick up due to the increased NIRF ranking.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Old hostels are bad. New hostels are top-notch. Canteens, etc., are good. Mess food is bad. Classrooms are good. Wi-Fi has a hard setup. It's hard to connect, and the process lags. The library has AC, and it's average, not top-class, though. There's a computer center to use for our work with a good AC setup.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are qualified with many degrees and gold medals from top IITs and all. They teach and cover the syllabus well. Some of them are strict. The curriculum is updated for the 2025 batch. It upgrades to today's time, which is good. But all drawbacks are for batches from 2024 to 2028 only. Exams are hard for real.
detailed_review.Other: I was not getting CSE, so I chose ECE. Relatively, grading should start. Fests and events are at the top-notch! There is an event every other weekend. Fests are top-notch for real. Scholarships, refunds, and everything work well. Sports and tournaments are good too.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering
reviews.review_title: Best placement, good coding culture, good faculty, and helpful seniors available 24/7.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 90% of the students get placed in four companies, and in non-tech almost 100%. Highest package was 82 LPA, average package for 22 LPA, and the lowest package was 10 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Google, Microsoft, LNT, etc. Almost 72-80% for Sales roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Overall the facilities are average, but in terms of infrastructure, they are a little bit old. Classrooms are good. Wi-Fi is not good. Library is average. Facility of postal is good for the first year, but after 1st year it is average. Medical facilities are good. Mess average. Canteen has good sports and games.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some teachers are helpful, but not all are. Some teachers are well-qualified. They have a good background in studies. Teaching quality is average. Course is not relevant for the text students, but it is relevant for the course students. It makes the student industrial-ready. Semester exams are very easy, you can easily pass, but if you have to score a good CGPA, you need to work hard.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because, according to my rank, this was the best thing that I got. Also, this branch is evergreen, so in future, you do not have to worry about this. Improvement I want to see on our campus is crowd control. Fests and events are very good, they happen almost all over the year, there are three main ones, Tech First, cultural fest, and sports, with cultural activities also good to engage in.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering
reviews.review_title: I give excellent to this college.

detailed_review.Placements: 90% of students are placed. The highest package is about 80 LPA, average package is about 20 LPA, and the lowest is about 8 LPA. LNT, Godrej, Messho, Tata, and Flipkart are the recruiting companies. NIT Jamshedpur has a strong placement record with around 90-95% students getting placed every year. The average package is about 12 LPA to 13 LPA, while top offers go above 80 LPA. Many reputed companies like Amazon, Microsoft, Adobe, and Tata recruit from campus.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Campus has 325 to 350 acres with greenery and an urban setting. It has modern lecture hall, lifts, open air- theater, labs, and extensive labs. Around 11-12 hostels for boys and 6 hostels for girls are available. Each hostel has its own mess. Wi-Fi is available. There is a common room and proper hygiene is maintained.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our college has well-educated IIT professors. Curriculum is relevant. This industry helps and educates at that level to work in corporate life. Actually, examination or semester exams are tough. Pass percentage is about 33%. Exams are conducted in a very fair manner with no cheating.
detailed_review.Other: I chose civil engineering course because I am interested in it. In this college, this branch is the best. There are many fests, activities, and celebrations at this college like Culfest is cultural fest, Ojass is technical fest, and also branch-wise sports competitions in sports.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Production and Industrial Engineering
reviews.review_title: I am satisfied with facilities and faculty members of this college. Placements are decent.

detailed_review.Placements: About 90% is the average placement rate of our college. The highest package of last year was 16 LPA, and the lowest was 5 LPA. Average package offered is 9 LPA. Flipkart is the recruiting company, and the salary pacakge is 16 LPA. About 40% of students got internships, not sure about the companies. From our branch, supply chain management has a good scope, also core jobs and MBA for future studies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of the college is really good especially the classrooms. There is projector in every room of the college, and the benches are really good. Talking about library, it's pretty decent. Some room has ACs, some don't. But labs are old. The hostel experience is pretty average. The mess food is not that great, to be honest. The sports and games culture is pretty good. There are basketball courts and grounds to play on.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are pretty decent, except for some of them, most of the faculty are good. They teach good and give marks also. Teacher quality is not that great as due to some teachers. The average score of class decreases. I am in second year right now and studying manufacturing and industries and it feels like it is relevant. Not sure if I will be industry-ready but surely they are teaching us many practical things in labs too. Semester exams are not that difficult. One can make good marks in subjects by studying for at least 1 or 2 weeks before exams.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because of my interest in it. The events are pretty decent like the fest and all. All is good, to be honest.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Production and Industrial Engineering
reviews.review_title: I was dissatisfied at first, but college turned out to be just right.

detailed_review.Placements: Last year, 90% of students were placed. Top recruiting company is Black Rock with 22 LPA package. Roles offered are SDE, core supply chain, data analytics, and data science. Highest package is 22 LPA, the lowest is 6 LPA, and average is 9 LPA. The percentage of students who get internships is above 50%.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college has a top-class lecture hall complex where most of the classes take place. It is fully air-conditioned, and classrooms are very good. It has 24-hour Wi-Fi and LAN facilities in hostels and whole campus. Wi-Fi doesn't work sometimes. Hostel quality remains good throughout the year, except in some cases where some problems occur but they are resolved soon. Food quality is average.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some teachers are very good, some just average, and some are very bad. The course is enough for a core branch, covering all the core concepts along with some non-core concepts. Semester exams are just right, not so hard not so easy. One has to study everything that is taught in class.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering
reviews.review_title: Campus is mediocre with boring campus life. But hostels and placement are top-notch.

detailed_review.Placements: If you compare NIT JSR with other top NITs, in terms of placement, it is best among them. This year's placement is not that good still 94% of students are placed. The average salary is 6 LPA - 7 LPA (L&T hires 50% of them), whereas in the other branch MS, it is pretty well. Overall, more than 90% of students get placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: If you talk about campus, it is very mid. There is no proper maintenance, as campus is open, you can see strangers roaming around. But the hostels are pretty good, and new hostel (for first year) is big enough with 2 students. You will be getting your single room from 2nd year onwards.
detailed_review.Faculty: I am somehow satisfied with faculty members. Few are good but mostly they don't teach well. You have to learn some skills on your own. There's still an old curriculum that has been followed. In civil, it is tough to score a good CGPA as professors don't give good marks.
detailed_review.Other: You will get a good return on investment, if you don't want to go to private college. Fee is affordable. Fests are pretty good. There are 3 major fests Urja, Culfest, and Ojass, which are sports fest, cultural fest, and technical fest.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering
reviews.review_title: The placement rate is very decent, and campus life is okay.

detailed_review.Placements: In my course this year, the placement percentage is 90%. The highest package received is 20 LPA, and the lowest is 4.5 LPA. Top companies like Tata Motors, JSW, L&T, ICICI, Tata Steel, etc. The internship percentage was about 70%. The roles offered in my college are site engineer, structural engineer, and many more.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities for my course are okay, like separate labs and departments for civil engineering. Classrooms are highly appreciated, being fully air-conditioned and equipped with a projector and podium. The LAN issue is a major issue, except for that, the library is excellent. The sports facilities are highly appreciable. The medical facilities are also good, and the canteen service is also good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the professors are from South India and are highly educated and helpful. Their teaching quality is unique and understandable. The course curriculum is excellent and very effective for the future. Talking about exams, this is going to be very hard and very strict. The pass percentage is 33%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this because I want to do a government job, as there are lots of opportunities in this course. The events are excellent.

admission.title: NIT Jamshedpur Admission Overview 2025
admission.overview_text: NIT Jamshedpur admission 2025 is primarily entrance-based. The institute offers admission to its flagship course i.e. BTech based on JEE Main scores. NIT Jamshedpur considers entrance exams such as GATE, IIT JAM, NIMCET, etc. for admission to specific courses. The institute offers courses at UG, PG and doctoral levels in the Engineering and Computer Application streams.

faqs.question: Which courses are offered by NIT Jamshedpur?
faqs.answer: NIT Jamshedpur has 12 departments through which it offers BTech courses at the undergraduate level. At the postgraduate level, the National Institute of Technology, Jamshedpur offers two-year full-time MTech, MCA and MSc courses. Apart from the UG and PG programmes, NIT Jamshedpur also offers PhD courses covering several specialisations. NIT JSR offers courses in the fields of Engineering, Science, and Computer.

faqs.question: Does NIT Jamshedpur accept JEE Mains score?
faqs.answer: Yes, the National Institute of Technology, Jamshedpur accepts the Joint Entrance Examination (JEE Main) entrance test scores, conducted by the National Testing Agency. NIT Jamshedpur accepts JEE Main score for admission to the BTech course. After qualifying JEE Main, selected aspirants have to participate in JoSAA Counselling. JoSAA allocates seats to candidates based on their rank. In case of vacany, seats are offered through CSAB Counselling.

faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

faqs.question: Is cracking NIMCET easy?
faqs.answer: As it is an entrance examination conducted for the MCA course, Analytical Ability & Logical Reasoning, Computer Awareness, General English and Mathematics are compulsory subjects or sections in the NIMCET exam pattern. So, if a candidate is good in mathematics, then it is easy to crack the National Institute of Technology Master of Computer Applications Common Entrance Test (NIMCET). Around 25,000 students register for NIMCET each year and approximately 805 seats are offered in 11 NITs across India. For more details regarding NIMCET, click here.

faqs.question: How much percentile is required for admission to various courses at NIT Jamshedpur?
faqs.answer: NIT Jamshedpur specifies the minimum aggregate and qualification required to apply for a course. The basic eligibility for UG coures is Class 12 whereas graduation is required for PG programmes. Below is course-wise NIT Jamshedpur eligibility criteria: Class 12 with at least 60% aggregate or 6.5 CGPA (55% aggregate or 6.0 CGPA for SC/ ST) and BTech in relevant discipline BSc in relevant discipline with at least 60% aggregate or 6.5 CGPA (55% aggregate or 6.0 CGPA for SC/ ST) Master's Degree in a relevant branch of Engineering/ Technology wth at least 60% aggregate or 6.5 CGPA

faqs.question: How much rank should I score to get NIT Jamshedpur?
faqs.answer: NIT Jamshedpur cutoff 2025 has been released for the third round. For candidates seeking admission to the college via JEE Main, it is neccessary to obtain a rank as per the category-wise cutoff list. The cutoff among the General AI category, the cutoff ranks varied between 8130 and 43082 . Therefore, candidates belonging to the General AI category must obtain a score of 43082 or less to get admission to the college. For more information such as quota-wise, category-wise and round-wise cutoff, click here .

faqs.question: What is the JEE Mains cut-off for BTech in Engineering and Computational Mechanics at NIT Jamshedpur?

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission at NIT Jamshedpur?
faqs.answer: NIT Jamshedpur does not offers direct admission. Candidates are shortlisted for BTech based on JEE Main score. BTech is the flagship programme of NIT Jamshedpur. Selected candidates are further allocated seat via JoSAA Counselling. Besides, admission to M.Tech and MSc courses is based on GATE and IIT JAM, respectively. Aspirants applying for MCA need to pass NIMCET for admission.

faqs.question: What is the required score in JEE Mains to get admission in NIT Jamshedpur for CSE course?
faqs.answer: In 2024, CSE was the most competitive specialisation. The rank for BTech CSE in Round 5 was 7944. Analysing the NIT Jamshedpur CSE cutoff 2024 with the last two years, BTech in CSE has shown a fluctuating trend in its Round 5 closing ranks.  Looking at the past three-year trend, the rank is ranging between 7944 and 9277. Aspirants securing rank between 7000 and 9000 have a chance of getting admission in the CSE course.

faqs.question: Can I get into BTech at NIT Jamshedpur without JEE?
faqs.answer: No, NIT Jamshedpur BTech course admission is through JEE Main only. Candidates seeking admission must have a valid score in the national-level exam. The counselling body releases cutoff mark as well. Students who meet the NIT Jamshedpur BTech cutoff can take part in counselling for seat allotment. There is no other provision for admission in a BTech at NIT Jamshedpur.

faqs.question: What is the lowest percentile to get into NIT Jamshedpur?
faqs.answer: To get admission to NIT Jamshedpur, candidate must have a rank as per the cutoff list according to the category they belong to. faqs.answer: NIT Jamshedpur BTech total tuition fee is INR 5 lakh. Apart from the tuition fee, candidates are also required to pay the hostel fee (if opted) of INR 1.28 lakh. The meal plan is also included in the hostel fee. For a detailed NIT Jamshedpur BTech fee structure, candidates are advised to contact the admission department of the institute. faqs.question: How can a student get admission to BTech at NIT Jamshedpur?
faqs.answer: Admission to the BTech programme at NIT Jamshedpur is entirely competitive and is determined by students JEE Mains results. The Joint Seat Allocation Authority (JoSAA)/Central Seat Allocation Board (CSAB) distributes seats for Undergraduate programmes through the Common Counselling procedure based on JEE Main results. There are 8 specialisations available in the BTech programme. Given below are the eligibility and selection criteria: Eligibility: Class 12 with a minimum 75% aggregate Selection Criteria: JEE Main + JoSAA/ CSAB Counselling

For female candidates in the general category under All India quota, 64054 was the closing rank. BTech cut-off varies depending on the category and domicile/quota of the applicant.

faqs.question: What is the minimum eligibility requirement for the NIT Jamshedpur BTech course?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission to the National Institute of Technology, Jamshedpur BTech course must have passed Class 12 ( Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects and Chemistry / Biology/ Biotechnology as an optional subject) with a minimum aggregate of 75%. Apart from fulfilling the minimum eligibility requirements, candidates also need to submit valid JEE Main scores.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for admission to MCA at NIT Jamshedpur?
faqs.answer: Candidates need to pass BSc or BCA from a recognised university with Mathematics or Statistics as one of the papers with at least 60% aggregate or 6.5 CGPA (55% aggregate or 6.0 CGPA for SC/ ST/ PwD candidates). Aspirants must hold the documents proving their eligibility for verification at the time of admission. Besides, aspirants also need to pass NIMCET for MCA admission.

faqs.question: Is MCA available at NIT Jamshedpur?
faqs.answer: Yes, MCA programme at NIT Jamshedpur is a three-year (six-semester) full-time programme. National Institute of Technology Master of Computer Applications Common Entrance Test (NIMCET), which is followed by central counselling is conducted for admission to MCA course. Aspirants who have passed graduation can apply for NIT Jamshedpur MCA programme.

faqs.question: Is NIMCET required for MCA at NIT Jamshedpur?
faqs.answer: Yes, admission to NIT Jamshedpur MCA programme is based on NIMCET score jointly conducted by NITs and through centralised common counseling. NIMCET is conducted once in a year in computer-based mode. It is a two hour test comprising 120 questions. Candidates are alloted seats based on their NIMCET rank through counselling.

faqs.question: What is the cutoff for MCA in NIT Jamshedpur?

The National Institute of Technology, Jamshedpur offers admission to BTech courses on the basis of JEE Main entrance test scores. For M.Tech admission, candidates need to apply for the Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE).

admission_eligibility.title: NIT Jamshedpur Eligibility & Selection 2025
admission_eligibility.intro_text: The institute offers a list of courses at the UG, PG and doctoral levels. Candidates are selected through national-level tests such as JEE Main, GATE, etc, conducted by various authorities. Admission to the flagship course NIT Jamshedpur i.e. BTech is based on JEE Main score of the aspirants. Below are NIT Jamshedpur courses along with their eligibility and selection criteria:

faqs.question: Which courses are offered by NIT Jamshedpur?
faqs.answer: NIT Jamshedpur has 12 departments through which it offers BTech courses at the undergraduate level. At the postgraduate level, the National Institute of Technology, Jamshedpur offers two-year full-time MTech, MCA and MSc courses. Apart from the UG and PG programmes, NIT Jamshedpur also offers PhD courses covering several specialisations. NIT JSR offers courses in the fields of Engineering, Science, and Computer. Not satisfied with answer? Ask Shiksha GPT

faqs.question: Does NIT Jamshedpur accept JEE Mains score?
faqs.answer: Yes, the National Institute of Technology, Jamshedpur accepts the Joint Entrance Examination (JEE Main) entrance test scores, conducted by the National Testing Agency. NIT Jamshedpur accepts JEE Main score for admission to the BTech course. After qualifying JEE Main, selected aspirants have to participate in JoSAA Counselling. JoSAA allocates seats to candidates based on their rank. In case of vacany, seats are offered through CSAB Counselling. Not satisfied with answer? Ask Shiksha GPT

faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced Not satisfied with answer? Ask Shiksha GPT

faqs.question: Is cracking NIMCET easy?
faqs.answer: As it is an entrance examination conducted for the MCA course, Analytical Ability & Logical Reasoning, Computer Awareness, General English and Mathematics are compulsory subjects or sections in the NIMCET exam pattern. So, if a candidate is good in mathematics, then it is easy to crack the National Institute of Technology Master of Computer Applications Common Entrance Test (NIMCET). Around 25,000 students register for NIMCET each year and approximately 805 seats are offered in 11 NITs across India. For more details regarding NIMCET, click here. Not satisfied with answer? Ask Shiksha GPT

faqs.question: How much percentile is required for admission to various courses at NIT Jamshedpur?
faqs.answer: NIT Jamshedpur specifies the minimum aggregate and qualification required to apply for a course. The basic eligibility for UG coures is Class 12 whereas graduation is required for PG programmes. Below is course-wise NIT Jamshedpur eligibility criteria: Courses Common Eligibility BTech Class 12 with a minimum 75% aggregate MTech Class 12 with at least 60% aggregate or 6.5 CGPA (55% aggregate or 6.0 CGPA for SC/ ST) and BTech in relevant discipline MCA BSc/ BSc (Hons)/ BCA of a minimum of 3 years with Mathematics/ Statistics or equivalent subjects with at least 60% aggregate or 6.5 CGPA (55% aggregate or 6.0 CGPA) MSc BSc in relevant discipline with at least 60% aggregate or 6.5 CGPA (55% aggregate or 6.0 CGPA for SC/ ST) PhD Master's Degree in a relevant branch of Engineering/ Technology wth at least 60% aggregate or 6.5 CGPA Not satisfied with answer? sections.heading: Introduction
text: NIT Jamshedpur campus is located on the outskirts of Jamshedpur on 341.3 acres of land. The institute has a central library and also provides medical facilities to students, teachers, and other staff members. The deemed university has a book bank, acquisition and processing unit, and stack room consisting of 5,5144 books. The library has already subscribed for J-Gate, and in the future, it will subscribe to IEEE journals very soon. The other facilities include a computer centre, a central workshop, safety and security system, and boys' and girls' hostel .
Check out more on NIT Jamshedpur Infrastructure in the below videos:

facilities.name: Library
facilities.description:
NIT Jamshedpur library subscribes to a sizeable number of technical, scientific & general periodicals journal & newspapers. The central library has also procured JGATE of NIT Library Consortium resource specifically for research purposes. The library has online service through INDEST CONSORTIUM on the subjects for the following: IEEE (IEL ONLINE), ASCE, ASME, Springer - Verlag, SCIENCE-DIRECT. The library has open access system to its users. It operates in two shifts from Monday through Saturday:
8:00 AM to 3:00 PM
3:00 PM to 10:00 PM

highlights.summary:
NIT Meghalaya is one of the 31 NITs established under the NIT Act 2007. The college has been categorised as the 'Institutes of National Importance'. It is funded by the Government of India. NIT Meghalya has been placed at the 83rd position in the "Engineering" category by NIRF 2025. NIT Meghalaya offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes across Engineering and Science streams. BTech is the flagship course offered at this college in various Engineering disciplines. NIT Meghalaya also offers well-equipped campus facilities to students, including modern classrooms, well-stocked library and medical and sports facilities, among others. NIT Meghalaya accepts JEE Main scores for admission to BTech. The GATE scores are accepted for admission to MTech, and PhD. These are followed by different counselling rounds for the respective courses.
NIT Meghalaya placements 2023 highest package was INR 32 LPA. The average package was INR 11.10 LPA, respectively. Top recruiters include
Amazon,
Air India,
alstom,
Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited,
Samsung,
Deloitte,
HCL, Info Edge, Oracle, etc. The Placement Cell at NIT Meghalaya prepares the students for career with various events, seminars, workshops, trainings, guest lectures, etc.
