reviews.course: M.Sc. in Physics
reviews.review_title: My Review About This College .

detailed_review.Placements: Placement Process was good. 90% of eligible student got placed. Major companies visited here are Goldman Sachs, direct, medlife, well fargo, Mahindra and Mahindra, maruti suzuki, john deere, ashok leyland, mu sigma, l&t, vedanta, tata motors etc. The average package is around 5 Lacs. The college also provides skill development programmes for the students to enhance their skills. College provides internship opportunities to students who are interested in it. Cosmology, relatively gravitation, nuclear Physics surface study, semiconductor technologies are some topics in which a student can intern. There is a criteria of having minimum 7.5 CGPA for sitting in campus placement and then there was a skill test.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I have an interest in space, so I chose Physics. Our class strength was 46 and the class was quite good to hold enough the students. Staff are good and everyone had finished there Ph.D. They were helpful for us in every one. The Hostel facilities of my college is good. There are two students in a Room both have there own almirah table chair and B.Ed. Enough Hostel seats that means all the students can easily get the Hostel Room and it is less expensive than PGs or Rentals. The mess of the Hostel is very Good.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty of the college is highly qualified and dedicated. They teach in a very lucid manner and try to clear the concepts of the students as much as possible. They give more emphasis to student response time and are very helpful and were always available for the help of students and were too good. University exam. Internal exams have 2 cycle test which constitutes 10 internal marks each and model exam carries 20 internal marks. Then 5 marks for assignments and 5 marks for attendance of particular subjects. We will have major courses and non major electives courses.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering
reviews.review_title: I am extremely happy after getting admission to this prestigious and esteemed university.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 80% of students get placed in my college. The highest package offered is 32 LPA, and the average package is 12 LPA. The lowest package is 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies like Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Wipro, TCS, and Deloitte visit the college for placements. 95% of students got internships from my course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is super clean and hygienic. Rooms in my hostel are fully furnished and super clean. The food quality is good. There is no repetition of food. The mess and canteen area is also clean. There are several sports facilities in my college including indoor and outdoor games.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers and professors in my college are super helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. They have good knowledge of their particular subject. The teaching quality is also very good. The course curriculum is so much related to the industry requirements, which makes students unveil their talent in this competitive industry.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I am very much interested in building things and searching for things. Several fests and small events are organised in my college. The campus crowd is not too much as we have a very big campus.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Average placements, new campus, average mess food, overall a very average college.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements at NIT Meghalaya have been very average, or even below average, for the last two to three years. This year's placements were rather dull, and no big IT companies participated in the on-campus hiring session. Most of the students who got good packages either got them off-campus or had PPOs from their internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college is moving to a new campus in February 2025. The new campus is in Sohra, Cherapunji, and is in a beautiful setting. The campus is newly built and has new furniture and amenities. The mess food is average, but I expect it to improve once the new campus opens.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty were good and very helpful. However, we don't expect them to make us industry-ready, and we will have to learn on our own. The curriculum was recently updated to align with the New Education Policy, so there should be some improvement there. The semester exams are very easy, and we can easily maintain a CGPA above 8.5 just by attending lectures regularly and studying a few nights ahead of time.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: New campus life starts, but we'll enjoy yourself.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements at NIT Meghalaya are not so good these days, but they are better than last year. Most of the good placements were recorded in the mechanical section, which were on campus. The good placements in the IT sector were grabbed off campus. So, our placements depend on our performance.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel has good facilities, but the three-seater rooms require some adjustment. The vegetarian food is average, but the non-veg food is better. There are a few canteens, but they are expanding. For medical care, we depend on the Ramkrishna School and a medical emergency building on campus. There are also two ambulances always on campus. Sports facilities are growing, and we have some indoor sports tables, a badminton court, and a cricket ground for now.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty at NIT Meghalaya are nice and friendly. The curriculum is good for branches like EE, ECE, and ME. However, the CSE curriculum is not up to date, and the exams are easier for CSE students than for students in the latest syllabus branches. Overall, academics are not a problem, and students can do well with moderate effort.
detailed_review.Other: I'm a student at NIT Meghalaya. Life here is great, but it can be a struggle for CSE students. You have to work hard to earn your grades, but you'll have a good time here. The seniors are great and they try to help you in every way they can, including providing guidance.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: We are shifting to our permanent campus.

detailed_review.Placements: Over 90% of students got placed. The highest salary package offered is 51 LPA. The lowest salary package offered is 12 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Microsoft, Amazon, Flipkart, Infosys, and Nvidia. Many students got internships in these top companies before their final year. The average salary package offered is 17 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are computer labs with Mac operation systems. It is well-equipped with high-speed Wi-Fi connections and dehumidifiers for projecting the systems from moisture. There is a building with a big library consisting of all the important books for every course.
detailed_review.Faculty: Every faculty on campus is very experienced and educated from IITs. They are post-graduates who teach students the best of topics. Our course curriculum is updated and is very relevant for students. Semester exams are not very difficult to pass, but previous year's papers are very helpful in understanding the type of questions asked.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: An average college with natural beauty.

detailed_review.Placements: There are not many good placements in the ECE department. There are very few placements. I think the highest package is around 40 LPA, and the average package is around 10–12 LPA. I don't know about the companies that recruit. The chance of getting an internship is also low.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the labs, classrooms, and lecture halls is good. This is also true of the hostels, but if you are looking for food, it is not good if you are from the north or west of India. There is mostly non-vegetarian food. No nearby restaurants are available; in fact, there are no shops.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers and faculty are supportive, and the teaching quality is good, but if you are aiming for GATE, you have to take courses online, because the level of teaching is not good enough for the GATE exam. Semester exams are not very hard; if you study a bit, it is okay. Passing marks are decided according to student performance.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Dissatisfied by the food in the mess & transportation facilities, placements are not up to the mark.

detailed_review.Placements: 70 percentage of the students were placed. In NIT Meghalaya, the highest package was 19.45 Lacs per annum, the lowest was 6 Lacs per annum, and the average was 8 Lacs per annum. Top companies like BPCL, HPCL, Vedanta, and Tata do visit for placements. 90 percentage of students get internships from respective companies. Manufacturing engineer, thermal engineer, and designer roles are offered in our course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Campus shifting will take place this December as it’s confirmed officially now. Wi-Fi is good, labs and classrooms are so nice in the permanent campus. Hostel rooms in our new campus are nice. The library is too small but enough for the students count here. Food is bad, and sports and games are fine.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty are helpful, but not everyone is knowledgeable. The teaching quality is not up to the mark; it’s not enough for higher studies entrance examinations. No, they won’t give you everything, and the course curriculum doesn’t include everything from GATE and all entrance examinations. Semester exams are of medium level, and the pass percentage is 90 percent. They mostly give 60 percent from the teaching lectures and modules.
detailed_review.Other: You can get central jobs, PSUs, and core jobs from this course. Real-time experience would be nice. A fest happens for every sem, but the crowd is too less.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering
reviews.review_title: Any way NIT is a NIT.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are good here. Almost 90 percent of the students were placed. The main recruiters are KEC International and Narayana. Last year, some of the students were placed in BPCL with an 18 LPA CTC, which was the highest package, and the lowest was 6 LPA in the civil engineering branch. Students did their internships in PWD, AAI, some private companies, and AIT Thailand.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Currently, our campus is working in a temporary campus, so it doesn't have advanced facilities. Labs are equipped with all the necessary equipment that is needed, but slowly the labs are being shifted to the permanent campus, which has all the advanced machines and laboratories. Hostels are quite good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-qualified, helpful, and knowledgeable. Some teachers teach according to competitive examinations and prepare questions accordingly, while some follow the syllabus, which is still helpful for competitive examinations. The course is relevant, and if you study regularly and pay attention in class, then you can easily get a good score in the examination.
detailed_review.Other: I like this course so I choose it and lab facilities should be improved .

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good faculty, infrastructure, and facilities as well as a good senior junior bonding.

detailed_review.Placements: This year, i.e., 2024, 80% of the batch has been placed with the highest package of 46 LPA and an average package of 13 LPA from CSE. Apart from this, from my department, the highest package of 12 LPA and an average package of 5.2 LPA have been placed. Top recruiting companies include Amazon, Winjeet, KEC, Bajaj, Narayana Groups, L&T, Vedanta, Infosys, etc. From civil engineering department, many students got internships at Aditya Birla, SAIL, GAIL, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: For Civil Engineering department, there are separate labs for different courses, e.g., structural engineering, geotechnical engineering, Transportation Engineering, Hydrology and Water Resources Engineering, Engineering Drawing lab, etc. Library facilities are also available for students. As NIT Meghalaya is being operated from its temporary campus, some apartments have been rented as hostels. In hostels, Wi-Fi and mess gym facilities are available and for transportation from hostel to college and vice versa, buses are available.
detailed_review.Faculty: In NIT Meghalaya, faculty members are helpful and also highly qualified. They are always ready to help students in every field. In NIT Meghalaya, the 50+50+100 rule is being followed for semester exams; from that,  50 marks are from internal evaluation, e.g., class tests, assignments, and viva. 50 marks are for the midterm, and 100 marks are for the endterm examination. Overall, out of 200, the semester has been evaluated.
detailed_review.Other: As NIT Meghalaya is being operated from its temporary campus, the student capacity for each branch is less than that of other NITs. Apart from B.Tech, masters in technology (M.Tech) in some special categories and masters of science in physics, chemistry and mathematics are available at NIT Meghalaya.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of Bachelors of technology in Computer Science from the NIT Meghalaya.

detailed_review.Placements: NIT's have a good record for on-campus placements. Around 60–65% of the students gets successfully placed at NIT Meghalaya in the CSE course. The average package offered at the college for computer science was between 3 and 8 LPA. Top recruiters at the college were Wipro, TCS, Tech Mahindra, Infosys, Deloitte, Accenture, GAP, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: NIT Meghalaya has a very good infrastructure for computer science courses. The campus of the college is pretty big and beautiful. The campus of the college is lush with greenery. College management offers facilities such as computer labs, libraries, canteens, Wi-Fi, sports, etc. that are properly maintained. The quality of these facilities is also good. A hostel facility is also available for college students. The food in the mess and canteen is also good to eat.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers at NIT Meghalaya are highly qualified and knowledgeable. All the teachers have good experience in the teaching field. They are giving their best for the students. The course curriculum at NIT Meghalaya is relevant and it makes the students industry-ready. Teachers were also helpful and supportive of the students during placements. Exams were of a medium-difficult level in our course.

reviews.course: M.Sc. in Physics
reviews.review_title: A good college environment.

detailed_review.Placements: Some of the top recruiting companies in our batch were IBM, Power Grind, Microsoft, Tata, and Bosch. Most of the job roles offered to us were those of developers and testers. The highest package was by TRC of INR 45 lacs per annum. The average package in our batch was around INR 650000.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus was well-developed with Wi-Fi connectivity, spacious rooms, washrooms, a stocked library, an auditorium, and a hospital facility in case of need. A hostel facility is also available and the mess and canteen both have good, hygiene-quality food. We do have football, cricket, basketball, volleyball and badminton courts available.
detailed_review.Faculty: The quality of teaching is good and the faculty members are quite qualified and, at the same time, quite helpful. They are ready to help and guide the students whenever required. The courses are quite relevant and interesting. The passing percent is 90% and semester-wise exams are held.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good college because of the study level. As compared to IIITs and GFTIs, this NIT is very good.

detailed_review.Placements: 20% to 40% of students were placed, and the highest and lowest packages were INR 12 lac/annum and INR 7 lac/annum, respectively. The average package is INR 10 lacs per year. Some students get internships in different fields during the course duration. For the ECE branch, several things are in this college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are not so good, but professors are very good. We have Wi-Fi, labs, a library, and separate classrooms. The quality of food is not good in hostels, but in college it is good. Medical facilities are very good; colleges have a separate department for them.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, qualified, and have great knowledge. They try to make students industry-ready. Semester exams have a difficult level. Previously, it had 30% criteria from the 2nd semester; now it has been removed, but 75% attendance criteria are in.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: I would recommend students to join this college.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are quite good. If I talk about percentage, nearly 90-95% of students get placed branch-wise. The highest placement record is in the CSE department. The maximum salary package offered is 50 LPA, and the minimum salary package offered is around 7 LPA - 8 LPA. The average salary package offered ranges between 10 LPA and 11 LPA. In case of mechanical, all students are placed here. The average salary package offered varies from 7 LPA to 7.5 LPA, and the highest salary package you can get in PSU is 20 LPA. There are 5-6 seats in PSU.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Currently, we are operating from Shillong, and it is a temporary campus. Our campus is average so the college life is not that good. Hostels are far from college and are average. All the hostels are at different places and are not good. Even the quality of food served is the worst. You can't enjoy hostel life but from batch'23 we are shifting to permanent campus, so then it will be good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are very good and helpful. You can contact them at any point. The curriculum is not that hard and one can pass even by studying for one day grading is relative so it's easy to pass. Easily you can get good marks of 8 CGPA which is enough from a NIT.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Best of returns, good placement records, and a good coding environment.

detailed_review.Placements:
80 to 90% of students get placements.
The highest package offered is INR 52 LPA by Microsoft.
The lowest is INR 5.2 LPA, and the average is INR 12.8 LPA.
Microsoft, Infosys, L&T, BPCL, and TVS are the top recruiting companies.
The major research areas are high-speed, low-power VLSI, computer algebra, cognitive radio, antenna design, wireless sensor networks, and sensor processing.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The best hostel compared to other NITs has all-time free Wi-Fi and good mess food. Gym equipment in the hostel, a 24*7 medical facility in the eye-distance hospital, and indoor as well as outdoor game facilities. They also provide all types of game equipment. The playground is so near to the hostel.
detailed_review.Faculty:
Faculty are helpful, knowledgeable, and friendly; some faculty members are from abroad. There are so many options in electronics and communication engineering, like VLSI, microwave, computer algebra, wireless system networks, government jobs, etc.
Exams are moderately tough; you just have to go through the daily class notes.
detailed_review.Other:
The best thing about ECE is that we can apply both for government jobs and in the IT sector. Cultural Fest Shishir, Tech Fest C, etc. are the fests conducted in the college.
You can apply for various types of scholarships offered by NSP.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: In our college, placements are very good but facilities are not up to the mark.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are very good. The highest salary package offered was 52 LPA by Microsoft. The average salary package offered was 21 LPA. The minimum salary package offered was 17.5 LPA. The maximum salary package offered ranges between 11 LPA - 14 LPA. The lowest salary package offered was 8.5 LPA. All students got selected in the placement drive.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Since this college is operating from a temporary campus so it lacks certain facilities like sports and Wi-Fi. Laboratory is small. Classrooms are also not spacious. The library is not huge but several books are available. There are 3 canteens on our campus. Medical facilities are available. The food served in the mess is average.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified, helpful, and supportive. The course curriculum is relevant. The exam pattern is designed in such a manner that it is not hectic for students. Semester exams are moderate. The pass criterion is 5 CGPA.
detailed_review.Other: This college will surely improve in the coming days as we will soon shift to our permanent campus in Sohra. This will surely improve some basic facilities such as sports, Wi-Fi, library, laboratory, etc. Our campus crowd is average. We can also participate in events to showcase our talents. We also get a chance to perform in competitions organised by other colleges.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: The salary packages are great but facilities are not good.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are better. The highest salary package offered was 52 LPA by Microsoft. The average salary package offered was 20 LPA. The minimum salary package offered varies between 14 LPA to 17 LPA. The minimum salary package offered was 10 LPA. The lowest salary package offered was 8 LPA. All students got placed through the placement drive.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Since this college is operating from its temporary campus so the infrastructure is not up to the mark. It lacks some basic facilities. Wi-Fi speed is not good. Classrooms are not spacious. Laboratory is small. The library is also small but several books are available. Hostel facilities are better. There is a gym facility in this college. Games are conducted in this college.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are excellent and helpful. The teaching quality is better. Few of them are Ph.D. scholars. The course curriculum is relevant but does not make students ready for the industry. The syllabus is hectic. Semester exams are moderate. The pass criterion is 5 CGPA.
detailed_review.Other: Our campus is going to shift to Sohra, and it will surely increase some basic facilities for students like sports, library, laboratory, etc. The student strength will also increase, and the competition is better. Our campus crowd is not huge. Students can showcase their talents and get selected to perform in other colleges easily. I chose this course because of my interest in it. AI and ML fields are majorly dominated by the ECE department. This college can add industry-ready courses and remove some unnecessary courses. Annual cultural fests are conducted named Shishir in April, and the annual tech fest is held in October.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placement and a good institute that is ranked in top 60 without its permanent campus .

detailed_review.Placements: The placement is quite good with about 90% students getting placed in good companies. The highest package in EEE dep is around 20lac/annum and average package is 6 lac/annum. The top recruiters are from mivr, Amaz, Deloitte, TCS etc. More than 80% students are given good internships and the roles offered are of consultant, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infra of the college is not good since it's the temporary campus. Although good facil are provided to the students with transport service also available. Wi-Fi is present in whole campus and hostels. With lab facilities also present the library is somewhat small, but important books are available. Hostel facilities are also good with good food, Wi-Fi and television. Good accommodation is provided to students with clean environment. Although the hostel is lacking in sports and games because of being temporary.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are all well educated and highly qualified. The education quality is good with the teachers being helpful and supportive. The course curriculum is relavant and makes the students industry ready with good practical knowledge. The semester exams are well prepared with all well balanced papers. The minimum passing marks are to score 30 /100 in endterm exams and overall 70/200 marks.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good academic performance, better placements, enjoy clubs and fests but on a small level.

detailed_review.Placements: All the students who secured a CGPA of 7 and above are placed. In the 7th semester, 50% of students were placed. The highest package is 12 lakh and the lowest is 5 lakh. Companies hiring are Jindal, Cairn, Vedanta and Psu like BEL BPCL and IGL and there are several others.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: If you want to build your academic career, this place is for you. If you want to have a big campus where you want to do all other things, you may not like it. Every lab equipment is available. Hostels are not inside the campus however a new campus is being built which will be functional in 2025. Hostels are owned by the college.

highlights.summary:
Jain University Bangalore Jayanagar was established by Dr. Chenraj Roychand under the Sri Bhagwan Mahaveer Jain Educational and Cultural Trust in 1990 in Bangalore as a private university. It is recognised as a Deemed-to-be University by UGC. Jain University Bangalore Karnataka is approved by the UGC. It is also a member of several national and international organisations, including the AIU, AUAP, NIBES, and the Association of Commonwealth Universities and with an A++ grade by NAAC. NIRF 2025 ranked Jain Bangalore 62 in the 'University', 73 in 'Management', and '84' in the 'Engineering' category, respectively.
Jain University Bangalore features several programmes taught by over 12 schools of study and 25 departments. JU Bangalore specialises in Engineering, Design and Management streams, with the Management school known as Jain Bangalore. Jain University Bangalore Jayanagar also features distance learning programmes through the Center for Distance & Online Education. The flagship course of Jain Bangalore is their MBA programme, with other courses offered such as BTech, BBA, BSc, MSc, MCA, MCom, MTech, etc.
Jain University Bangalore admissions are offered on an entrance basis. The university conducts its own entrance test in the form of the Jain University Test (JET). National-level exams such as CAT and JEE Mains are also accepted by the university. Leading recruiters at JU Bangalore were Samsung, Siemens, Schneider Electric, Silicon Labs, TATA Steel, TCS, TATA Technologies, etc. The university has collabed and signed MoUs with several industry giants that offer valuable internship opportunities to students to help them fulfil various career and academic goals.
The university has a 298-acre campus with various facilities like library, seminar halls, IT services, technology-enabled classrooms, an auditorium, a multi-cuisine cafeteria, sports facilities, a gym, and hostel facilities for both boys and girls. Jain University Bangalore campus accommodations for the admitted students. There are separate accommodation facilities for boys and girls. JAIN (Deemed-to-be University) has expanded its presence with multiple campuses in Bangalore and an off-campus center in Kochi, Kerala.
Jain University offers scholarships to its students based on six different categories. These scholarships are offered by the Jain University Scholarship Committee (JUSC) and are classified in various areas ranging from academic to extra-curricular categories. Apart from its regular students, the university also provides opportunities to candidates who are differently abled.

reviews.review_title: Overall, college is good.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement rates are good. 80-90% placement rate is there. The average package is 5 LPA - 7 LPA. The placement rate is not as expected as we are investing such amount but its depend on our skills. If we have good skills, it will be a chance that we can get a high-paying job outside campus.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostels are good but food quality is average. Campus is not such big, it's just a building not such physical activity. Study is good. College does not provide Wi-Fi. Hostels are good. Wi-Fi is there but hostels are not on campus, it is 3-5 KM away. But bus facility is included in hostel fees.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers here are knowledgeable and well-qualified. The course is good and focuses on developing skills in marketing. It will be better to choose the course if we are a commerce student. The semester exams are quite difficult. Overall, it is good.
detailed_review.Other: All things are good here.

reviews.review_title: The college is very good in the end.

detailed_review.Placements: 99.8% are placed by choosing this course. The highest package is 22 LPA, and the top company is Deloitte. 99% of the students got internships from this course and from very big companies. The college is very perfect, and the crowd and networking are very excellent.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our classrooms and library are very clean. Wi-Fi is working very nicely. The facilities, like medical and sports, are very nice. I'm very happy to join this college.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are very helpful and well-qualified. The curriculum is very relevant so that the students can score well and get better placements. The college semester exams are not as tough as I thought, they are nice and good for scoring well. The staff are very good.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I have to do both BBA and MBA. No improvement is needed in the scores, and the crowd is very good in our college, and all the things are very good. The fest and everything are perfect.

reviews.course: M.Sc. in Psychology (Clinical)

reviews.course: B.Sc. in Forensic Science (Professional)

reviews.course: M.Sc. in Psychology (Clinical)
reviews.review_title: I am satisfied till now, faculty is good and well qualified. It has good environment.

Internship is for only one month which is very less for a two year master's program. Exams are not very difficult. One can score well if they read the PPTs given by the faculty.
detailed_review.Other: The course is exactly what I wanted to do. This is a quite lenient college where you can engage in other activities alongside your college hours. College hours are very long which can be reduced. Campus surroundings are very local as the area is out of main happening side of Bangalore. Campus crowd is very inclusive and people here are from all over India. Students should participate in events on their own choice, it's not compulsory from college side.

reviews.course: BMS in Strategy and Leadership with Harvard Manage Mentor Certification

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering

reviews.course: M.Sc. in Chemistry

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering

reviews.course: Corporate BBA
reviews.review_title: Center for management studies: the honest review.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 90% of the students who apply for placements get selected, as it is a reputable university. The highest package was 30 LPA, and the average is 8.5 LPA. CMS has a lot of companies recruiting, such as Google, Dell, Mahindra, HDFC Bank, Facebook, Bosch, etc. Roles offered for my course include business analyst, financial analyst, product manager, data analyst, HR consultant, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: For the amount I am paying, I am not satisfied with the university's infrastructure, as I am paying almost five lacs, and I am not getting into a classroom with proper ventilation; there is no air conditioning or anything in the classrooms; only fans are present. Bangalore nowadays is getting too hot, and it is becoming very suffocating inside the classrooms. The hostel food is very bad, and I don't recommend going there.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very good; they are skilled and really helpful to the students. They take good care of the students, and the curriculum is also pretty good. It teaches us a lot about the industry. The semester exams are not hard at all; they are easy, and if you understand the material, you can ace the exam.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course due to my family background. The campus should be bigger and better; it looks more like an office building than a university. Air conditioning should be present in all the classrooms. The crowd is good, and the events are enjoyable as well, but due to the small campus, the events are quite limited.

admission.title: Jain Deemed-to-be University, Bangalore Admission Overview 2026
admission.overview_text: Jain Deemed to be University admission 2026 is primarily entrance-based. The admission process begins with the registration of the candidates online on the official website. Candidates must qualify for the JET exam for admission. JET or Jain Entrance Test is a university-level exam conducted in online mode for admission to UG, PG and MBA courses. While for the MBA course, certain other entrance exams such as CAT, XAT, MAT, CMAT, GMAT, etc. are also accepted. The final selection of candidates is done on the basis of Essay Writing, Presentation, and Personal Interview, along with the entrance exam scores.

faqs.question: What are the various components included in the fee structure of BA at Jain University?
faqs.answer: Jain University BA fee has multiple components. During admission, a one-time fee between 500 and 30 K must be paid by applicants. Total BA tuition fee at Jain University ranges between 27 K and 13 L. The fee mentioned is sourced from official website of the institute/ sanctioning body. It is subject to change and hence, is indicative. Additionally, a non-refundable application fee for JET is also payable by the applicants.

faqs.question: Does Jain University have an entrance exam for BA admission?
faqs.answer: Yes, the admission to BA programmes of Jain College is entrance-based. The university conducts its own entrance exam called the Jain Entrance Test (JET) for admitting students to the various courses offered at UG and PG level at the university. The selection process of the exam includes a written test, a GD and a PI. The written test is an online proctored exam, consisting of MCQ questions. The application for the entrance exam can be made online on the official website of the university.

faqs.question: What is the cost of MCA at Jain University?
faqs.answer: Jain University MCA course tuition fee is between 50,000 - 2.2 lakh rupees. This is taken from unofficial sources and it is indicative. Visit the official website to get more details on the Jain University MCA fees. There are other fee components that students need to pay at the time of admission. Candidates are also required to pay the application fee of INR 600.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for admission to B.Sc at Jain University?
faqs.answer: Jain University BSc eligibility is different based on specialisations. Students must have cleared their 12th standard. For most courses, 50% is the minimum criteria. For BSc Cardiac Technology, students are to pass 12th with minimum 50% in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics and Biology, and a pass in English. The minimum score required in 12th to be eligible for a BSc in Brand Identity and Visual Communication is 65%.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission in Jain University?
faqs.answer: Yes, Jain (Deemed-to-be-University) offers direct (lateral) admission to Engineering courses. The university's direct admission is based on the marks secured by the candidate in the qualifying examination. Admission to Lateral Entry is done entirely merit-based. There is no entrance exam required for the selection of candidates. Admissions are done based on the merit of candidates in the previous qualifying exam. In BTech Lateral Entry course, admission is given on the valid percentage of candidates acquired in a Diploma course. Once candidates fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria and qualify the selection process, they are called for a counselling process.

faqs.question: How to get admission to Jain University MBA course?
faqs.answer: To get admission to a two-year PG course of MBA at Jain University, candidates are required to fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria in the first place. Those who pass graduation are eligible to apply for this course. Admissions to MBA at Jain University is entrance-based. Candidates either need to appear Jain Entrance Test (JET), which is a written test conducted by Jain University. Another option is to apply via valid scores of either CAT/ MAT/ CMAT/ XAT/ NMAT/ GMAT entrance exams. The final selection is done based on the scores of candidates in any one of the respective entrance exams, followed by a performance in Group Discussion, Personal Interview and Extempore.

faqs.question: How much percentile should I score to get a seat at Jain University?
faqs.answer: With a mere 70 percentile in CAT exam, a candidates can get admission at Jain University. As per the Jain University MBA cutoff 2024 , the cutoff for all the MBA specialisations stood at a common percentil which is 70 for the General AI category candidates.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission for BBA at Jain University?
faqs.answer: No, direct admission to a three-year BBA course at Jain University is not possible. The university's offers dmission is based on the marks secured by the candidate in the qualifying examination. The university conducts an entrance test called Jain Entrance Test (JET) for admission to several undergraduate and postgraduate courses. Those who want to get admission to BBA course must qualify for JET with a valid score and submit the scores at the time of filling the application form. The application process for admission to Jain University admission process for UG & PG courses starts with applying to Jain Entrance Test (JET).

faqs.question: How can I get admission in Jain University?

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for admission to BCA at Jain University?
faqs.answer: In order to get admission to a BCA course at Jain University, candidates are required to fulfill the minimum eligibility criteria as prescribed by the university. faqs.question: What is the admission process at Jain University Bangalore for BCA course?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission to BCA course must visit the official website of the University to apply online. Jain University BCA admission is based on candidates' performance in Jain Entrance Test (JET), conducted by the University. The written test is followed by a GD/PI (whichever is applicable). In order to get admission, candidates need to fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria in the first place and then appear for JET. Students awaiting the Class 12 results can also apply for the BCA programme at Jain University Bangalore. Candidates who secure good scores in the respective entrance exam will get admission in this course.

faqs.question: Which documents are required to fill BCA application form at Jain University?
faqs.answer: At the time of filling the online application form at Jain University, candidates must upload supporting documents in the prescribed format. Find below the list of all the essential documents required for Jain University BCA application process: Class 10 marks card (Original + 2 copies) Class 12 / PUC marks card* (Original + 2 copies) Diploma marks cards (all Semester) (If applicable) Diploma degree certificate (If applicable) Transfer certificate (Original + 2 copies) Migration certificate (Original + 2 copies) (If applicable) 5 passport size and 5 stamp size photographs Caste certificate and income certificate (Original + 2 copies) (If applicable) Parent’s PAN card photocopy Student’s Adhaar card photocopy Provisional Admission Offer letter (Original) * Candidates awaiting the original 12th/PUC marks card may submit it later

Apart from its regular students, the University also provides opportunities to candidates who are differently abled. To be eligible for Jain University Scholarship program students need to fulfill minimum educational qualifications with other requirements specified for each category.

highlights.summary:
National Institute of Technology, also known as NIT Kurukshetra or NIT KKR, is a public institute located in Kurukshetra, Haryana. The institute was established in 1963, and is recognised as an Institute of National Importance by the Governent of India. NIT Kurukshetra ranks 85th under the 'Engineering' category in the NIRF Rankings 2025.
NIT KKR offers a numeber of UG, PG, and PhD level programmes through 11 departments and 2 schools. The progammes are offered across multiple specialisations in the stream of engineering. Admissions to the institute are offered on the basis of the scores in the national-level entrance exams such as JEE Main, GATE, NIMCET, and CAT.
NIT Kurukshetra is known for its well-structured course curriculum, industry ties, and national and international collaborations. The institute has signed MoUs with various national and international institutes and organisations which facilitate research and academic development. The institute has a strong placement record with the highest package standing at INR 63.12 LPA and the average package at INR 14.84 LPA,

admission.title: NIT Kurukshetra Admission Overview 2025
admission.overview_text: NIT Kurukshetra admission is strictly entrance-based. The college offers UG, PG, and PhD degree courses in the streams of Engineering, Management, and CS with various specialisations. The flagship courses of NITK are BTech, MTech, and MBA. These courses are offered under 11 departments and 4 schools. At NIT Kurukshetra, selection criteria is based on scores of national-level tests like JEE Main , NIMCET , CAT , etc. After qualifying for the respective entrance exams, counselling sessions by JoSAA , CSAB , and CCMT are held for which appearance is mandatory.

faqs.question: Can I join NIT Kurukshetra after Class 12?
faqs.answer: Yes, the students may come to NIT Kurukshetra after completion of Class 12 by passing JEE Main. Applicants should have studied PCM or PBM at 12 th grade. The seats are accessed using JEE Main rank by the process of JoSAA counselling. There will be only the entrance test to take admission and not according to the Marks obtained in Class 12.

faqs.question: What is the last date for NIT Kurukshetra admission 2025?
faqs.answer: The deadline to NIT Kurukshetra admission 2025 varies with that of the individual entrance exam and counselling dates. CCMT and JoSAA announce BTech and M.Tech Dates respectively. In the case of MBA and MCA, there are different deadlines that are declared. Ensure that you visit the official site frequently.

faqs.question: How can I prepare for BTech admission at NIT Kurukshetra?
faqs.answer: The right approach and a preparation plan for admission to BTech at NIT Kurukshetra is all that is needed to ace JEE Main. paragraphs: NIT Kurukshetra offers various scholarships to its students. NIT Kurukshetra students can avail of Merit-cum-Means Scholarships, the Central Sector Scholarship Scheme for SC students, and Alumni Association Scholarships.

There are various scholarships under Merit-cum-Means Scholarships, such as the OP Jindal Engineering and Management Scholarship, which is given to the first three toppers (Engineering) and the first ten (Management) on the basis of performance during the whole course.

The Central Sector Scholarship Scheme for SC students offers 26 merit scholarships and 52 merit-cum-means scholarships are awarded by the institute for each year of BTech degree courses. In addition to these, National Scholarships, Post-metric Scholarship, and many other stipends are awarded by various Government institutions and other agencies.

NITK also offers Alumni Association awards. There are 5 scholarships (one each in the disciplines of Civil, Computer, Electronics Electrical, and Mechanical Engineering) of the value of INR 2400 per annum that are open to all regular BTech students of the institute.

highlights.summary:
NIT Raipur was earlier known as the Government Engineering College Raipur. It was founded in 1956. It has 58+ courses, few of them are accredited by the NBA and approved by AICTE. Ranked 86th by NIRF 2025 among all the NITs in the Engineering category. It has signed MoUs with various companies and organisations. The collaborations of the institute include Cold Forge, Faridabad, and Jayaswal Neco Industries Limited, etc.
Theinstitute offers BTech, BArch, BPlan and dual degree courses include at the UG level. MPlan, MTech, MBA, MCA and MSc programmes at the PG level. The BTech branches include several branches such as Computer Science & Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering and Chemical Engineering, among others. The Institute also offers a PhD programme through its various departments. The last closing rank during the NIT Raipur Cut off 2024 ranged between 15358 and 88544 for the BTech programmes.
NIT Raipur placement cell assures placement assistance to all students. The overall average package offered to students in 2022 was INR 10.12 LPA. The institute is visited by top companies such as Deloitte, Wipro Limited, and others. The placement-related aspects are hence taken care of by the Department of Training & Placement. The institute provides consultancy, testing, and other extension services, including continuing education, to the industry through the Industry Institute Interaction cell. reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mining Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good enough if we don't have other option.

detailed_review.Placements: Mining at NIT Raipur has decent but limited placements. Top recruiting companies are Coal India, SECL/WCL, CMPDI, NMDC, SAIL, and Vedanta. Packages are moderate. Most of the students prefer GATE exam for the job, and some for master of technology.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are good. But the only problem is that it has only few seats in the hostel. Rest have to find PG (paying guest) or flat for them which is available around the college within a 1 km range. It has 2 canteens, and they are actually good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. As I am in first year, I can't say about the industry level. But the semester exams are tough enough to get fails. In every semester, there is at least one difficult subject that we have to study carefully.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology
reviews.review_title: Satisfied with placements, but needs more improvement in infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: In Information technology, about 80% are placed on campus, the rest are pursuing higher education, and some are placed off campus. The highest package is around 55 LPA, the average is around 17-18 LPA, and the lowest is 8 LPA in IT. You can get a job opportunity in any field in web development or software engineering.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The course department is good. Good classrooms and Wi-Fi are available. There is a fully functional and furnished library. There is one problem in the hostel that not everyone is allotted a hostel in the 1st, 2nd or 3rd year it's allotted on merit (rank), gender and category. Wi-Fi is present in the hostel premises.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty are generally good, and all are quite supportive. In college, the faculty will only teach you the course, but you yourself have to focus on yourself. The course curriculum is outdated, like any other NIT. Semester exam difficulties depend upon the semester and the paper prepared by teachers, generally, the first semester is easy-going. But it starts to get tough after 2 years. All professors in the IT areas are very supportive.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good at placement for the core branch.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are moderate, with core roles like site and project engineer. Average packages are decent, but internships and top offers depend largely on student initiative and skills.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Truly talking about the hostel. There are less hostel rooms than required by the students. Major problem with my college is that main college and campus area is only 100 acres. Hostels that are available are also not that good to stay.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members as you know are average at NIT/IIT. They are well qualified but we can't understand their English accent. Talking about the exams, NIT Raipur is very particular about exams, they are very punctual and level of the questions is good enough that's all. NIT Raipur civil engineering program offers strong fundamentals with experienced faculty and a structured curriculum.
detailed_review.Other: The only thing about NITs I like is their fee structure. As it is very low compared to the other private colleges which don't even have remarkable placements.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Four years of ventures at NIT Raipur.

detailed_review.Placements:
Many students were placed this year. 18 LPA is the average package offered. De Shaw is the top recruiting company. 4-5 students were getting an internship. Recruiting companies are Zscaler, Cisco, 
Trilogy, Visa, HSBC, GE Healthcare, Fanatics. 
Software developer and data analyst roles are offered by many core companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure:
Wi-Fi is available on the campus and in the hostel. 
Two canteens are there, Vachan and Vihana, inside the campus. 
Regular lab classes are there. 
Separate labs are available for each branch. 
The hostel is also good. 
The room is very spacious. 
Triple sharing is for the 2nd, 3rd, and 4th years.
detailed_review.Faculty:
Faculty members and the curriculum are also good. 
Two exams, mid sem and end-of-semester exams, are there. 
4 units for each subject, 20marks from each unit. 
Mid sem is of 30 marks. 
The end-of-semester is of 50 marks, and the teacher assignment is of 20 marks. 
A very old faculty full of knowledge is here.
detailed_review.Other:
The campus is also good. 
The environment is also good. Nature is also good. 
Small campus, which I like. 
Scholarship is also available for students.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: They provide good placements in the mechanical ongoing session.

detailed_review.Placements: I am from the mechanical engineering branch. The placement percentage is about 90 percent. The highest package is 21 LPA, the lowest is 8 LPA, and the average package is 10 LPA. In my course, the top recruiting companies are Dassault Systèmes, JSPL, JSW, Reliance, and Caterpillar. In my course role, I offer data analytics, GET evt.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In my course, a lot of labs are available, like the material testing lab, the engineering mechanics lab, the Rac lab, the measurement and control lab, the heat engine lab, Wi-Fi, and the library. In my hostel, everything is good, but one disadvantage is that there is a shortage of hostel space, so most of the students live outside. Medical facilities, sports, and games are available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful and friendly, and the teaching quality is good. This course curriculum is relevant, and it makes the students industry-ready. The difficulty level is moderate. The two exams are conducted mid sem and end-of-semester sem The passing percentage is 90 percent.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this because of my interest in automobiles. I want to improve in the field of autonomous vehicles. The main event in my college is Eklectika. The main scholarship is NSP 5.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Life of a mechanical engineer at NIT Raipur.

detailed_review.Placements: In our branch, about 90 Mechanical students were placed. The highest package was around 19 LPA, the average stood near 10 LPA, and the lowest was about 6 LPA. Top recruiters included Tata Motors, Mahindra, L&T, JSW, etc. Overall, good maximums are placed for those who are eligible.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel facilities at NIT Raipur are manageable but not the best. Since rooms are limited, not every student gets hostel accommodation. The essentials like mess, Wi-Fi, and common areas are there, but the overall infrastructure could definitely be better.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is helpful, the curriculum covers the important subjects well, and exams are mostly mid-seems and end-seems with a mix of theory and numericals. So, the overall difficulty level is around 80 per cent. Bit copy checking is strict, so it is difficult to score.
detailed_review.Other: It's a better college than some colleges. If the student is good, then there is no problem for their career.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering
reviews.review_title: They should improve hostel facilities and make hotel accommodations available for all students.

detailed_review.Placements: In NIT Raipur, Civil Branch, the placement percentage increased from 63 percent in 2024 to 67 percent in 2025. The highest package is 19.5 LPA, the lowest is around 4 LPA, and the average is 9 LPA. Some of the top recruiters are Vedanta, Reliance Industries, Wipro, Infosys, Capgemini, and many more. Around 30 percent of students got internships but they are not paid and 5–10 percent of students got paid internships here in Raipur itself. The roles offered include site engineer, civil engineer, project manager, structural engineer, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are AC-equipped classrooms but only from the 2nd year. 1st-year classrooms don’t have AC installed. Anyone can use the Academic Building Wi-Fi, they are provided with an ID and password. A big library hall is present with various categories from fiction and science to storylines. Classrooms have good bench capacity. NIT Raipur doesn’t have hostels for everyone. There are limited seats in the hostel so a form has to be filled out if anyone wants to apply to live in the hostel on the campus. Many people live near the campus either in PGs or rented rooms, etc. Food available is decent and sports are available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Great teachers are present here, well-qualified from different universities of India as well as the world. Teaching quality is good as well but in college students need to give more time to study on their own and not only depend on the teachers. The topics that they teach are very much relevant to the branch and students learn to apply engineering in daily life. Semester exams are pretty difficult here. Students need to pay attention to their studies. Some data about the passing percentage is not known to me at this time.
detailed_review.Other: I wanted to craft the world as other civil engineers do. I want to manufacture good buildings and infrastructure that’s why I have taken this course. I’m in the first year, and there are many more things to learn and explore, so I cannot give advice for improvement currently. About fests and activities. NIT Raipur has a great atmosphere for these things. They conduct various competitions like dance, singing, essay writing, speech, drama, and many events to showcase skills. This part is really great.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering
reviews.review_title: Facilities are good, but they should improve with time

detailed_review.Placements: 65% are placed last year, which has improved this year. Till now, 20% is placed without core companies having visited. The highest package last year is 20 LPA, and the average is 8 to 9 LPA.  7 to 8 students got internships last year in my batch, and many of them got PPO as well.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostels like Mainpat and Kutumsar are for first year students. Facilities are good for the first year. There is no lift there, but overall, the food is good. However, the food from the second to 4th year hostel is allotted, whose food is not up to the mark, and I will rate it as 7/10. The canteen food is average, and the medical practitioners are very bad, not good at all. The building is okay.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are qualified from IITS and NITs, but their teaching quality is not at all good. They are either too old or aggressive, the curriculum is the same as other colleges, but its not interesting at all. Semester exams are moderate to easy. Passing percentage is 35%.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology
reviews.review_title: NIT Raipur is slightly equal to some IITs in India.

detailed_review.Placements: I secured an information technology branch in NIT Raipur, the second most top branch which is equally to CSE branch and consists of 114 students. As per 2024 data, nearly 87% of students are placed in top most companies. Average package is 18.5 LPA, and the highest is 60 LPA. Most students get internships in their 3rd and 4th years while studying.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It is an old campus that has nearly 60 years of great history. But old infrastructure with greenish campus. There is a big cricket ground, and new built sports complex that consist of all indoor games we can play inside it. Every year, they will conduct a sports meet like a Shourya club. In IITs, there are smart class, lab, and workshop in their branches. There is a big library, and book store is available on campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teaching qualities are too good because all have done their Ph.D. Semester exams are moderate and easy. Pass percentage is nearly 94 to 99%.
detailed_review.Other: My course is information technology which is related to computer science and teaching related. Every year they celebrate many fests and events in months, like electrical is big mega event which is conducted in February. Most people enjoy it a lot.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with college.

detailed_review.Placements: If you have a decent CGPA and good skills, you can get a very good package. The average package was around 14 LPA, and the highest was 52 LPA. Seniors have been helping very nicely, and the guidance you receive is very good. The course and curriculum are very nice.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi connection is really good in both college and hostels. Food facilities and security are very good for both boys and girls. There are a lot of places to have fun with friends, like the Gym, Amul, Vachan, etc. A lot of memories can be created here.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty is a little bit strict, just like everywhere, but at the end of the day, they help really well. Attendance is mandatory, with at least 75% required. Study well before the exams for a good CGPA, I would recommend. Apart from that, it's good. Professors are also great.
detailed_review.Other: It's good.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placement of metallurgical and materials engineering at NIT Raipur.

detailed_review.Placements: According to the data of 2025 placement, around 90% of students are being placed through on-campus placement which is somehow less than the data of 2024. Top recruiting company is JSW. Getting an internship in this course is quite easy, as the nearest steel plant is just 40 KM from Raipur.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Talking about the infrastructure, it is not too wow as many less lecture halls are present. The class is not so advanced. Talking about hostel, only 20-30% of students get the hostel on the basis of merit and categories because of poor availability of hostel on campus. Newly built sports complex is well-equipped. Medical facilities are provided 24X7.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are highly qualified and knowledgeable. They use good techniques for a better understanding of students. Discussing my course, it is fully relevant and makes us fit for industry work. Though the semester exams are not so difficult but also studying before one night will not work. The grading is relatively. Faculty members are Ph.D. holders and working on some many projects.
detailed_review.Other: My course i.e., metallography is quite interesting more towards field work. But according to me, the tuition fee is little bit high.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mining Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is an affordable and well-connected campus with strong core placements and modern labs.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 52.8% of students from Mining are placed. The highest package is 13.66 LPA, the lowest package is 6.50 LPA, and the average package is 9.16 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Adobe (55 LPA), PhonePe, Hindustan Copper, Dassault Systems, Coal India, PSUs, etc. 70-80% of students got internships. Top roles offered are mine planner engineers, site engineers, mining operations engineers, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Everything is good. We have a good number of labs for Applied Chemistry, Coding, etc. High-speed Wi-Fi is available. There is an air-conditioned and digital library. There are 6 hostels for boys and 2 for girls, each with Wi-Fi-enabled rooms, mess services, and basic furnishings including a bed, desk, chair, storage, and sometimes Ethernet ports.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most professors are well-qualified, holding M.Tech or PhDs from IITs/NITs. They are supportive, especially if you show interest and attend regularly. Exams are moderate in difficulty, not too tough if you attend classes and revise regularly. About 70-80% students pass.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology
reviews.review_title: Good placement rates, but disappointed with the infrastructure. Crazy events happen on campus.

detailed_review.Placements: 90% of students get placed in our college, with the highest being 52 LPA in my course and the lowest 7 LPA. Major companies like Google, Microsoft, Adobe, Amazon, TCS, and Infosys are prominent in our college; about 70% of students got internships in their third year. Most of these companies are tech firms.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is not very good. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. Wi-Fi passwords are provided. Hostels are not available for every student, so students need to study hard. The cafeteria is closed on weekends, but there are good options elsewhere. The sports department is good. The college has a reputable sports program. There is a medical shop on campus and it's free.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are good and supportive. The teaching quality is also good. Teachers are well-qualified. The curriculum is outdated, so students should prepare themselves for industry standards. Semester exams are not difficult if you focus in class. If you’re taking an IT course, stay connected with your seniors and seek their guidance.
detailed_review.Other: Good placements are available in information technology, which is why I chose it. The college hosts many events such as Avartan, Technocracy, DJ Night, and singing events. The college's location is convenient.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placement with a lot of opportunities and network with alumni.

detailed_review.Placements: Out of 114 students, 76 students got placed. The highest salary is 58 LPA, minimum is 5 LPA, and average is 17.8 LPA. Top companies are Tekion, DE Shaw, Samsung, Optum, Western Digital, ZS, etc. Very little students got internship offers, out of 114, only 12 students got internship offers from companies like DBOI. Top roles are SDE and business analyst.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are not good at our time, no AC, no cooler, Wi-Fi is so bad, and classrooms are also bad. But in recent times, things changed and were renovated. Sports and games are good with all equipment. Hostel facilities are not very good. Food quality is also bad.
detailed_review.Faculty: Associate professors are good but temporary teachers are not very good. Course curriculum is very relevant, but it doesn't make students industry-ready. Semester exams are hard and competitive, but mostly people pass except few like 5-6 people.
detailed_review.Other: Placement is good and best thing is the coding. Vibe coding should be made regularly. A lot of fests are conducted like Electika, Samar, all communities, and clubs.

reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA)
reviews.review_title: If you are looking for MCA don't come here.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 50% of the students get placed in my senior batch with a max package of 26 LPA in optum. The average package is around 8 LPA with the lowest of 4 LPA. Mainly the companies that came here are looking for a full sack developed in Java language. Very few students get internships from here approximately only 10%.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is given to us after we complete one sem and even then the Wi-Fi never works properly, it keeps losing connection every other minute, and after you log in to the Wi-Fi connection, it only lasts for 1 hour. Labs and classroom facilities are also indigent. Students of MCA don't get any hostel except for a few female students on a merit basis.
detailed_review.Faculty: There are some teachers who have good knowledge of their respective subjects, but they are not able to teach effectively. Some teachers seem like they don't know anything about the subject and just keep blabbering. Only very few of the teachers are good. Almost everyone passes the semester exams some those who fail clear it in re-exam.
detailed_review.Other: There are many fests that are held here, but none of them are exciting. If you come from a low-tier college or a small village, then this might excite you, but overall it is not worth it.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering
reviews.review_title: NIT Raipur, A saviour for lower rank students.

detailed_review.Placements: Junior engineer, data scientist, data analyst, SDE roles are available. About 87% of students are placed in my college. For my course, Metallurgical and Materials Engineering, the highest package offered this year is 22 LPA, the lowest package offered is 6 LPA, and the average package is about 10 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure-wise, it's quite disappointing. There are limited hostels and limited seats within them. Not everyone can get a hostel. Students must compete for a spot. You have to be in the top 20 of your batch to secure a hostel seat, and this requirement repeats for all four years.
detailed_review.Faculty: It is quite good. Some teachers are quite helpful, while some are not, it depends on their personalities. The course curriculum is relevant for metallurgical industries. Talking about the semester exam, it's quite neutral, not too tough, not too easy, it all depends on the particular faculty.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I found materials behavior to be quite interesting.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Infrastructure improvisation here.

detailed_review.Placements: For mechanical, the placement percentage stands in top 2 in NIT Raipur with 98%. The average salary is 9 LPA. NIT Raipur mainly concentrates on number of placed in placements. Companies such as Hyundai, Tata, Steel Plants, etc., come to the placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are enough labs and classrooms. Infrastructure is not upto the mark as it was built many years ago. It should improve in terms of infrastructure. With better infrastructure, the ranking goes very high. Hostel is the main drawback as there are not enough hostels provided. Hostels are provided only to some people based on CGPA.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members and curriculum are okay. All the main faculty members are very good regarding their knowledge and their teaching skills. Curriculum is very relevant from 2nd year. But for first-year students, the curriculum is totally irrelevant and only few focus on the course they choose.
detailed_review.Other: Infrastructure should be improved. There are also few events like Eclectika which is the cultural fest of NIT Raipur and it goes well.

reviews.course: Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch.)
reviews.review_title: The college is nice, and the faculty is good. Go for it.

detailed_review.Placements: I'm in the batch of '29, so 1 year is completed here, and all I can say is that this college is good, but please rethink the course you are entering. From my experience, architecture is never about placements, but yes, after passing from here, you will have a very nice fame with you. So don't worry about that, just focus on the concept and all.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is not too good to be honest, but it's manageable. The classrooms are good for the architecture department. The hostels are there if you want to stay inside the college, which you should not, because too many restrictions are there. You can get PGs easily outside the campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is good and helpful. Sometimes, you will feel depressed because of the reviews on your sheet by teachers, but don't get too much affected. At last, they help you see the world differently. This course gives you a vision, you just have to cooperate with the faculty members sometimes.
detailed_review.Other: If you are coming for this course, tighten your trees because there is a lot of hard work in this course. You will feel useless at many points in this course. One thing, if you still feel that you can't do this anymore, quit it in the 1st year itself before it's too late. There is a lot to do, trust me. I don't even know I'm going to make it or not, but damn sure this course teaches you, like everything how to survive in bare minimum.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering
reviews.review_title: It has low infrastructure and few facilities, but it does not mean few placements.

detailed_review.Placements: 92% of students got placed in the Electrical Engineering branch from the 2025 batch. The highest package is 42 LPA off-campus and 19 LPA on-campus. The lowest package is 5 LPA and the average package is 9 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Western Digital, GE Healthcare, Pharmacy, Spine Labs, Sigmoid, Deloitte, Optum, Vedanta, Reliance Industries, and Aditya Birla Group. 10% of students got internships in companies like Western Digital, GE Healthcare, Sigmoid, Spine Labs, and JSPL. The top roles offered by companies are graduate engineering trainee by the core companies, SDE, application engineering analyst, data analyst, and business analyst by non-core companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities available in the college are an academic building, hostels, Wi-Fi, a library, a sports compartment, a basketball court, a volleyball court, a football court, and a cricket ground. Hostels are few, and even only 30% of students from each branch get the hostel, Mess food is not good and the taste is bad. Chapati's are raw with oily food. The breakfast is good and fruits are served mostly along with breakfast. The quality of the Wi-Fi is bad, but very slow. The cricket ground has no grass (but the volleyball and basketball courts are good, so we can enjoy it there).
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful but some teachers can't go beyond their bookish knowledge. Teachers taught good quality of education, even my AI-ML cum signal and systems professors are very good in their domain. They are very good at teaching as well as interacting. The electrical engineering course curriculum is relevant. Even this is the branch with the highest number of placements this year and some students are also prepared for the GATE. It makes students industry-ready. Semester exams are difficult, especially in the electrical engineering branch with less lenient checking. The pass percentage is more than 85%.
detailed_review.Other: I choose this course because of my JEE rank but also my interest in Electrical Circuits & Electric Machines. The best part of this course is that the course is very interesting. There are more opportunities in government jobs like PSU through GATE Railways, Industries and also one can go in the non-core role more easily compared to other lower branches. I wish to improve the syllabus of this course. Some courses are very difficult and less important. Some courses are going to be the latest but less taught. Events are good in college but of less budget. Fests are of low budget but enjoyable.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Due to some rude faculty members, students can avoid this college.

detailed_review.Placements: From the current 4th year batch, 100 students have applied for placements, and among them, around 90-95% of students got placed. The highest package offered ranges from 55-60 LPA, and the lowest package is 3.5 LPA. The average package ranges from 9-10 LPA. The top recruiting companies for our course are JSW, GE Healthcare, DE Shaw, etc. Almost all people got internships, but very few of them got on-campus internships. One student got an internship in GE Healthcare. The roles offered are a leader and a futuristic electrical engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of course is okay. It has installed Wi-Fi everywhere. The good quality of the library is there. Labs are also good. But there is a poor infrastructure of hostels like they don't have much amount of room for 2nd, 3rd, and 4th-year students. According to our CPI, the hostel is allotted. If we fail to get higher CPI then it is very tough for us to do up down from our PGs to college.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some professors are very good in nature but some are very rude. They are well-qualified and they have knowledge too. Some professors don't know how to deliver so it is all up to us to get a good amount of self-study. They conduct industrial visits. Exams are slightly tough, and we can easily pass out if we can start a week before exams. Almost all students pass and very few people fail.
detailed_review.Other: I got into this college through JOSA counseling. I like the course, so I chose it. I just want to improve my imagination skills after that I can feel it more to understand topics. Events are good here as the campus is in the city so there is good connectivity. On campus, there is overall greenery. The inter-NIT sports are held so we can get this experience too.

faqs.question: Does NIT Raipur conduct any entrance test for MCA admission?

faqs.question: What is the minimum eligibility criteria for NIT Raipur MCA admission?
faqs.answer: Students applying for the National Institute of Technology Raipur MCA course must have passed a three-year degree or equivalent degree from a recognised University/Institute with a minimum aggregate of 60% (of all the years) or an equivalent CGPA of 6.5/10. In the case of SC/ST candidates,  55% aggregate marks (of all the years) or an equivalent CGPA of 6.0/10 is the eligibility requirement.

faqs.question: What is the application process for NIT Raipur?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission to the courses offered at NIT Raipur, need to visit the official website of respective national-level entrance exam conducting bodies and fill out the application form in online mode. BTech aspiring candidates can apply for the programme on the official website of JEE Main and register for JoSAA counselling. For the M.Tech programme, the candidates are required to register on the official website of CCMT. For the rest of the courses, candidates need to register themselves on the official website. For MCA admission, candidates need to apply through the NIMCET exam followed by counselling.

data.title: NIT Raipur Placement Report 2025
summary: 131 companies visited the campus and 762 offers were received during NIT Raipur placement 2025. The average package grabbed by NIT Raipur students in 2025 was INR 11.1 LPA whereas the highest package offered was INR 60 LPA . The highest package offered this year decreased by over 3% as compared with the previous year, whereas the average package offered in 2025 increased by nearly 3%.

A total of 658 students were placed out of 933 eligible students during BTech placements 2025. In MTech program, 15 students were placed out of 92 eligible students . Apart from this, a total of 59 students were placed out of 88 students during MCA placements 2025. BArch witnessed good placement this year with 21 students getting placed out of 25 students in 2025.

BTech Mechanical branch followed by BTech Chemical branch recorded the best placement percentage of 92.55% and 84.29%, respectively during placements 2025. The placement percentage recorded for other major BTech branch such as Computer Science, Electrical, ECE, IT and Civil was 77.36%, 81.42%, 70.83%, 81.08% and 67.5%, respectively.

highlights.summary:
Vel Tech University in Avadi, Chennai was established in the year 1997. It has been accredited with an A++ grade by NAAC and NBA. It was affiliated with University of Madras, but the affiliation shifted to Anna University. Vel Tech University has been ranked 96 and 86 in the University and Engineering category by NIRF 2024.
Vel Tech University courses at the UG, PG, and PhD levels are offered in various fields. It has several schools such as the School of Law, School of Management, School of Commerce, School of Science & Humanities, etc. The courses include- BTech, BBA, BCom, BSc, MBA, MTech, MA, etc.
Vel Tech has international relations with more than 390 institutions across 30 countries and has entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with 171+ institutions for various Academic and Research exchange activities. At present, the university offers approximately 50 programmes to students at UG, PG, and PhD levels. Most importantly, Vel Tech Chennai courses are provided to students at reasonable fees, to enable students to acquire knowledge and skills in their preferred area of interest. The college has a panel of guest lecturers to inspire students in their respective careers and to give them tips and invaluable insights in every course. In addition to this, the college also offers an excellent infrastructure to students. For more details, candidates can check out the table given below:

The campus is visited by over 300 companies including top recruiters like TCS, Wipro, Infosys, Capgemini, Accenture, and Zoho. Many students secure internships (sometimes it is reported up to 70 percent) with these firms, which offer final roles predominantly in Software Development and System Engineering.
