Facilities are comprehensive including 24/7 water, unlimited Wi-Fi, laundry services, a gym, and sports courts. The experience is marked by two main factors management is very strict with rules and curfews. Regarding food, the quality is often consistent while South Indian cuisine is generally fine overall, mess food receives mixed feedback and is best described as okay. Medical and canteen facilities are readily available on campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty at Vel Tech are reported to be highly qualified with many holding Ph.D. degrees or actively pursuing them. They are considered knowledgeable and helpful adopting a friendly and supportive approach with students (the mentor-mentee system is frequently mentioned). The teaching quality is rated as good, with professors using modern methods and providing notes. However some long-term student reviews mention occasional inconsistencies in teaching quality across departments, and some regional bias from certain placement coordinators has been noted by a few non-local students.
detailed_review.Other: I'm from the B.Tech CSE (AI & ML) 2024-2028 batch at Vel Tech University, Avadi. I chose this course because of my interest in technology and artificial intelligence. The best parts are practical learning, workshops, and helpful faculty. However more real-world projects and placement support could improve. The campus has good events, scholarships, and friendly students.

faqs.question: Which entrance exam is accepted by Vel Tech?
faqs.answer: Vel Tech University offers admission to its UG and PG courses via both merit and entrance-based. Those who want to get admission to Vel Tech are required to appear for either the university's in-house entrance exam for Engineering courses. i.e., Vel Tech Engineering Entrance Exam (VTUEEE). There are other national-level entrance exams such as CLAT, LSAT, which are accepted for Law courses. To find a list of course-wise selection criteria for all courses, click here .

faqs.question: How do I get a seat at Vel Tech Rangarajan Dr. Sagunthala R and D Institute of Science and Technology?
faqs.answer: Vel Tech Rangarajan Dr. Sagunthala R and D Institute of Science and Technology provides various programmes and specialisations to students. These courses are available in different streams. For obtaining Vel Tech admission, candidates are selected on the basis of entrance tests. For further details, candidates may visit the official website and learn more regarding the eligibility details for their preferred course choice. Accepted exams include VTUEEE, CLAT, TANCET, etc.

faqs.question: How can I apply to BTech at Vel Tech?
faqs.answer: In order to get admission to BTech at Vel Tech, students are required to fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria. At Vel Tech, students can get admission to BTech in direct mode as well as through an entrance exam. highlights.summary: Established in 1926, Andhra University College of Engineering , Andhra University, Visakhapatnam is a public institute in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh. Also known as Andhra University College of Engineering, the institute is approved by the AICTE and CoA. At the UG, PG and Doctorate levels, the institute offers 97 courses across 23 specialisations in Full Time and Part Time modes. The popular Andhra University College of Engineering programs include B.E. / B.Tech, M.E./M.Tech, M.Sc., MCA, B.Arch and Ph.D. Andhra University College of Engineering courses are provided in several streams including Engineering, Science, IT & Software and Architecture & Planning, etc. The institute has a total seat intake of 1629 students. The fees at Andhra University College of Engineering ranges between INR 60,000 and 8,00,000 for the different courses. Andhra University College of Engineering placements are vibrant, with the average median salary standing at around INR 6,46,919. The institute has a well-laid infrastructure with multiple facilities.

reviews.review_title: A supportive campus with good faculty and steady placement.

The highest package offered to them was around 8 to 10 LPA, while the average stayed close to 3.5 to 4.5 LPA. Companies such as L&T, Tata Projects, Shapoorji Pallonji, Ultratech Cement, and several reputed local construction firms usually come for both placements and internships. Many seniors also got internships in these companies, especially in roles related to site engineering, designing, and quality control.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for our course is quite good, with well-maintained classrooms, good Wi-Fi, and regular labs that are updated for practical work. The library is decent and helps a lot during exam time. Hostel facilities are comfortable, and the mess food is manageable, with some days better than others. Sports facilities, like the ground and indoor games, are available, and basic medical help is provided on campus. Overall, the environment is supportive for both academics and daily living.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty in our department is quite helpful and generally well qualified. Most teachers explain concepts clearly and are approachable during doubt or project work. The curriculum is mostly relevant and gives a decent balance of theory and practical exposure, which helps in becoming industry-ready. Semester exams are moderate in difficulty, but if you follow the classes and revise properly, they are manageable. The pass percentage is usually high because internal assessments and lab work also support the final grade. The academic environment is structured and student-friendly.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I was genuinely interested in the field and felt it offered stable career options. The best part so far has been the practical exposure, supportive seniors, and the overall campus environment. Our campus crowd is friendly, and the events and fests make the year feel lively. Connectivity to the campus is decent, and there are enough extracurricular activities to keep things engaging. I do feel that improving the number of workshops and hands-on training sessions would make the course even better.

admission.overview_text:
Chitkara University, Chandigarh generally involves application, an entrance exam and the counselling session. However, before applying for any course, candidates must ensure to meet the eligibility criteria set by the university. To know the admission process briefly, candidates can check the points mentioned below:

faqs.question: Is CUET required for Chitkara University?
faqs.answer: The university accepts CUET scores for both undergraduate courses across various specializations. The university considers CUET scores for admission to its Integrated BBA, BSc, BDes, BPT and other programmes. Candidates must qualify the CUET exam to be eligible for admission, and the exam will cover specific subjects and a general test section.

faqs.question: Is entrance exam required for admission at Chitkara College of Sales and Marketing?
faqs.answer: Chitkara College of Sales and Marketing considers entrance exam scores for admission. Candidates with a valid score in CAT, CMAT, XAT, MAT, and NMAT can get admission in the MBA programme. The tests evaluates the quantitative, verbal, and logical reasoning abilities of the candidates. A valid score in either of these exams is a prerequisite for admission. Once selected, candidates also need to pass other selection rounds i.e. group discussion and personal interview.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission in Chitkara University for MBA?
faqs.answer: Getting admission in Chitkara for MBA is based on the entrance exams. The admission process of Chitkara Business School is available in both online and offline modes. Candidates are granted admission based on their merit rank in the required entrance exams( CAT / MAT / NMAT / XAT / CMAT ), followed by Group Discussion and Personal Interview (GD&PI) round. highlights.summary:
COEP Pune was established in 1854 and now is known as COEP Technological University. Located in Pune, the unitary public university of the government of Maharashtra, through 14 departments, offers UG, PG, and PhD courses to students. These courses are provided across Management, Planning, and various other streams. The university is accredited by the NBA and is ranked 90 by NIRF 2025 under the Engineering category. COEP Pune offers flagship courses such as BTech and MTech.
History of COEP: COEP was established in 1854 as The Poona Engineering Class and Mechanical School within a small space. COEP Technological University is recognized as Asia's 3rd oldest Engineering college. Since its early days, The Poona Engineering Class and Mechanical School evolved into College of Engineering Pune, and is now known as COEP Technological University, Pune.
COEP Course Diversity: COEP offers a large collection of Engineering courses to students in different specializations. These include UG, PG, and PhD courses. These programs are offered through the 14 distinct departments at COEP Tech that offer the flagship BTech and MTech courses. Admissions to COEP Engineering courses are done based on the various prescribed entrance tests like MAH-CET, MHT-CET, JEE-Main, GATE, among others.
Institute Autonomy: COEP Technological University has received a significant revision in its structure and pedagogy due to the fact that it has become an autonomous Engineering institute. Due to this fact, COEP enjoys liberty in providing flexible and quality technical higher education.
Infrastructure: Although it is among the oldest technical institutes, the COEP Technological University offers a variety of facilities such as ICT-enabled classrooms, libraries, laboratories, hostels, and other educational facilities. Other facilities that promote overall development of the students include sports complex, hospital, and cafeteria.
Placements: COEP Tech has continuously featured notable achievements on the placements realm in every academic year. In the 2023-24 placements, reputed companies had over 563 offers. The maximum package was INR 87 LPA whereas the mean package stood at INR 12 LPA. The list of the big companies that will be recruiting at COEP also includes such names as Deloitte, Bajaj, J.P. Morgan, Caterpillar, Deutsche Bank, Texas Instruments, etc.
Leading in Innovation: COEP Technological University has a strong research culture and the institute emphasizes indipendent calibre of the students. In order to encourage the innovation ecosystem at COEP, the institute has established certain Research, Innovation, and Incubation Linkages (RIIL).

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is a great college for opportunities with a good crowd.

detailed_review.Placements: More than 80 percent of students have been placed consistently in recent years. In the previous year, the highest package was 52 LPA, and the average package for the CSE branch is around 17.2 LPA. There is no clear data available on the lowest package. Mastercard, Nutanix, and Oracle are among the top recruiting companies, along with several startups. Around 60–70 percent of students get internships, while the rest are directly hired during the placement season.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Labs are not fully up to date, but classrooms are good. For the CSE course, a new building is constructed and is still under development. But it is well-designed and maintained. Sports facilities are good. The college grounds are located just outside the hostel, so students do not face any difficulty. There are also indoor sports facilities, like a badminton court, within the college campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, but some explanations can be confusing, and understanding depends on individual effort. The curriculum is relevant from the second year onwards. While the first year does not have much relevance to the specific stream. Semester exams are not very difficult to pass. The passing marks range from a minimum of 30 to a maximum of 40 out of 100.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good learning environment with friendly campus vibe .

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are decent in our course. around 70% of students get placements. The highest is about 10 to 12 LPA, the lowest is 3-4 LPA, and the average is around 5 to 6 LPA. Companies like TCS and Infosys visit for internships. They also come for roles like design intern. Around 50 to 60% of students also get internships, mostly in companies like TCS, KPIT, or some local industries. The main roles offered are trainee engineer or basic technical support roles, depending on skills.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for our course is quite good. Classrooms are clean, labs have the basic equipment we need, and the Wi-Fi works fine most of the time. The department has a decent library space, and faculty are supportive and knowledgeable. Hostel facilities are okay. Rooms are simple but livable. The average quality is fine, but it changes daily. Canteen food is better, and we also have basic medical help available on campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty are helpful and knowledgeable, and the teaching quality is good. The curriculum is relevant and helps in building industry-ready skills. Semester exams are moderate, not too hard. If you study regularly, the pass percentage is usually good. Semester exams are manageable if you attend lectures and are on time. The pass percentage is good because the teachers guide you well.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I was genuinely interested in this field. The best part is the practical exposure and supportive environment. I just wish industry connections and labs could improve more. The campus crowd is friendly, events are active, and the morale is good.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: My experience in college.

detailed_review.Placements: It is a 4 year course and has excellent faculty and placement companies. It is the top college in Pune average package of 10LPA for mechanical engineering. It is highly recommended that in order to get a good job it has various courses available.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It has good facilities it has some decent food quality issues but the rest is all good. The locality of the hostel is in a good area of the city with great infrastructure. I am a local so I do not know much about this but all I have heard is good.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Production Engineering (Sandwich Program)
reviews.review_title: College is living up to its reputation with great faculty and an amazing student crowd.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 85% students got placed in my batch, and the highest package was about 45 LPA. Most recruiters were from Nvidia, Nutanix, DE Shaw, etc. The lowest package was about 4-5 LPA. Internships were available in the 3rd year and included companies such as BY Menon, Microsoft, and Accenture. Top roles were SDE or analyst, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is based on the old architecture of the college, but the labs and classrooms are newly developed and are well-equipped. Wi-Fi speed fluctuates, but is decent. The library may seem a bit old. The mess is average, and sometimes, on special occasions, a different menu is opted for. Overall, extracurricular activities are taken care of.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly compatible and are Ph.D. holders with great knowledge. They are very helpful, and the quality of teaching is good. Curriculum is unique due to the autonomous nature of the college, and its syllabus produces industry-ready individuals. Semester exams are not difficult, but need revision and practice at least 3 weeks before the exam. Pass percentage is 90%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this college due to its mindblowing fests and amazing peer crowd. All of them are immensely talented and supportive. Being in the heart of Pune, the college is also well connected with other happening activities in the city.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering
reviews.review_title: COEP: The dream college of every student.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements in the College of Engineering, Pune are very good as compared to the other colleges. Many top companies visit the college campus for recruitment every year. All top companies visit here for placements. Internships are very good in college. Nearly everyone gets internship opportunities.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is a bit of an issue here. Often, there are connectivity problems. The infrastructure is good in the college. There are well-equipped libraries in the college with thousands of quality, useful books, which is good. Mess food is also okay, but in comparison with other colleges, it is very good. Sports facilities are also very good as the college is represented in every sports competition.
detailed_review.Faculty: Good faculty members are in the college. The teachers here are very knowledgeable and are always ready to help if approached. Teachers are helpful. The course pattern is mostly industry-oriented. The exams are tough and sometimes even difficult, but with regular studies, you can crack exams.
detailed_review.Other: The college has its own reputation. The college is very good in all aspects. Events and fests are very good. There are frequently organized events which are very good for the college.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Not satisfied with the way placements are hyped by other people, as we know the reality.

detailed_review.Placements: In the year 2024-25, the average package offered is 6 LPA, which is pretty low for any student getting placed. 61% of students got placed this year. The highest package offered is 18 LPA by Oracle. Top recruiting companies are Tata Steel and Bosch. 70% of students get internships in companies like JSW, and many get research internships at IITs. Roles like quality assurance engineers, etc., are offered here.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college provides plenty of facilities. As we all know, in government colleges, most of the time, Wi-Fi is low. We can get most of the books from the library, but the seating space might be limited. It has a canteen and mess facilities, which are good and cost-friendly. It also has medical facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-qualified and knowledgeable. Just the teaching quality is quite good. We are getting relevant courses, but less company interaction leads to poor quality of engineering. End-semester exams are pretty difficult, and 70-80% of students pass exams.
detailed_review.Other: Plenty of events are organised. It also conducts crazy extracurricular activities.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Satisfied overall because of good college infrastructure, placements, understanding seniors, etc.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 77% of students in metallurgy branch got placed last year. The highest package is around 25 LPA and the average salary is 8 LPA. Core industries like steel companies, mining, etc., are strongly approaching metallurgy students. Some students have chosen non-core roles too and some went for higher studies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Recently new meta building is built. So its more spacious now. Library, classrooms, and labs are of course on top notch. The labs and lab assistant teachers are also good. Real issue is with Wi-Fi. In most of campus area, there are a lot of network as well as Wi-Fi issues. About hostel, its not less than home. Mess food is a little messed up. But its better than other colleges' mess. There are two canteens in the college. The meta canteen is good. But both canteens are a bit suffocating.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are good. But the distribution of teachers is not good. In my case mechanical branch got most perfect teachers compared to us for the same subject. And for us we have teachers who don't teach that well and also who don't give proper marks in exams too. So, it badly affects our overall CGPA. Exams a good and strict too. About curriculum, we have a lot of clubs around 50, and gathering, impression, mindspark, etc. Some clubs are really good for career growth like robotics, aerospace, etc.
detailed_review.Other: There are a lot of scholarships you'll get in college. Most people don't even need to spend a penny in their pockets for fees.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering
reviews.review_title: Helpful faculty, updated syllabus, and easy-to-clear exams make COEP a great engineering college.

detailed_review.Placements: About 80% to 85% of placements are there in my college. The highest package is reached at 55 LPA, the lowest is 4.5 LPA, and the average is about 8 LPA to 9 LPA and the average for CSE branch is about 15 LPA to 16 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Bajaj, Deshaw, TCS, Tata Motors, Bharat Electronics, etc. There are around 270 companies that visited the college this year. Internship percentage is about 90%.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi network is good on the hostel campus but poor in college campus, especially in labs. There is no Wi-Fi and also no network. Food quality is very good in mess and the canteen of the hostel is poor. Sports facilities are very good. Big ground is there for COEP. Students and doctors are available in hostel. Gym facilities are also for both boys and girls.
detailed_review.Faculty: Semester exams are average and not too much difficult but faculty members for the CSE department are not experienced in other departments they are good. Course is irrelevant practical knowledge is not given here and theory is not properly taught. Semester exams are moderately difficult, but with regular study, students can do well. The pass percentage is usually high around 85%.
detailed_review.Other: There are 25 plus clubs in college and 5 fests are other which are very big, clubs like debate youth parliament, civil services, tech clubs, cultural club, drama club, NSS, and many more are there. Scholarship provided from alumni, Sakal Foundation, Cybage Khoosboo, Catalyst, etc.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical Engineering
reviews.review_title: College is really good. No worries about passing the exams.

detailed_review.Placements: I am M.A. first year student at the college. I am pursuing B.Tech in Metallurgy. As our seniors tell us, our college has nearly 100% placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available 24X7. Labs are fully equipped. Classrooms and library are excellent. Cafeterias and canteens are there on both college and hostel campus. Many fests are organized throughout the year. Students here are very exceptional. If you end up here, you will make a really good friend circle.
detailed_review.Faculty: There are two exams per semester and two semesters per year. You need to score a total of at least 30 marks in each subject to get passed. Out of 30, 20 are in teachers' hands (internal). You need to score 10-15 total in both mid-semester and end-semester accumulated. Teachers are very brilliant and experienced, and they always try new ways of teaching. Internal marks are 20. You just need to score total of 10-15 marks in mid-semester and end-semester.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Value for money and placement is 100%.

detailed_review.Placements: In B.Tech in metallurgy, the placements are almost 100%. Minimum salary is 5 LPA - 6 LPA. The students with minimum CGPA also have an opportunity to grab placements in this branch. Faculty members are also so supportive. They can help you throughout the whole process.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and facilities are top-notch. The classrooms are too good and a very good environment to study. We also have a sports club near the academic complex where classes happen. There is a well-furnished library with Wi-Fi all over in college with range. There are many facilities here.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified, knowledgeable, and supportive. They guide us every time in careers and keep us motivated throughout the whole journey. They inspire us a lot. The course curriculum is relevant, and it definitely makes a student industry-ready. Semester exams are highly competitive and we deserve that.
detailed_review.Other: My family background is metallurgical therefore I selected this course. The teaching can be more practical rather than theoretical. Fests and events are top-notch. There are more than 50 clubs in the college.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of College of Engineering, Pune.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80% of students get placed in our batch as I am from the electrical branch. The average package of the electric branch was 9.5 LPA in the past year. The top recruiting companies for our course are Mastercard, Mercedes-Benz, etc. Roles offered are electrical design engineer, power systems engineer, and control system engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are large. Classrooms have all digital services. It has 24-hour Wi-Fi, libraries, computer labs, etc. The quality of facilities is average. There are so many games in COE. Zest Fest is the largest sports event conducted in Maharashtra after IIT Bombay, so sports facilities are above average in our college.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-qualified and helpful. The course curriculum is relevant in many manners, but some portions are outdated. But it makes us industry-ready. Semester exams are above average for some subjects but some subjects are easy like we can pass after studying one night before.
detailed_review.Other: As I had no intention of choosing electrical before and after the CAT round I got an electrical course in this college. I will suggest more improvement in infrastructure in the college as some instruments are old. The college is full of events. It's really fun in the college life. The crowd is so talented in all manners. We will get many scholarships if we belong to a lower caste but if we are from general, we will get a scholarship like Shahu and Panjabrao Deshmukh.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering
reviews.review_title: Our college has very good placements in 2024 and infrastructure is also good.

detailed_review.Placements: Our college has 100% with the highest package. In academic year 2023-24, the highest package is upto 70 LPA. Companies visits like Amazon, Google, TCS, and many more. CSE branch has more placements than ENTC branch have more placements with the highest package.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In our college, labs, classrooms, and library have good structure. The seating arrangement is also very good. We have good internet access Wi-Fi is available 24 hours. College hostels are out of campus but hostel facilities are very nice. Their mess has good quality food.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our college faculty members are best. They teach us very nicely and give the best guidance. In our college, exams are conducted very strictly. If you want to stay in COEP then you have only one option and that is to study. Mid-semester exam is for 30 marks and end semester exam is for 50 marks.
detailed_review.Other: I have seen civil engineering at COEP has good placements. So, I chose COEP.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering
reviews.review_title: I would just say it's a great college for studying and campus life is good.

detailed_review.Placements: Statistics show that 70-80% of students got placed last year that's 2024. The highest package is 50.5 LPA, and the lowest salary is 3.5 LPA. The average salary is around 11 LPA. Top recruits are Google, Microsoft, Texas Instruments, and Amazon. 85-90% of students got internships very easily as COEP has a reputed channel through which they are well-connected with companies. Design engineer, R&D engineer, software developer, network engineer, and data scientist are the top roles offered by the companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I can assure you that the department for ENTC is good but the extension building next to AC building is very good with lots of instruments and labs are sufficient too. Hostel faculty members are good, responsible, and professional. Quality of food varies from mess to mess. First year mess is not that good compared to second-year mess. I would prefer second year mess. There is a medical check-up room too. Sports and games are also taken seriously in COEP too with great.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful. If you attend the classes regularly, you can understand the course. They are qualified and knowledgeable. This course is very relevant if you have an interest in electronics PCBs and cool stuff. It makes student industry ready but your efforts matter more making you skilled than others. The semester exams are tough considering the competition in the college. The pass percentage is good around 80%. Faculty members are good but government college has a reputation for bad professors. But in COEP academics are very strong.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course as I had an interest in electronics since childhood. I wanted to learn more about this in depth. This course is very hands-on, first the campus should be more alive and AC rooms should be available in summer, you get cooked in the mechanical department building and labs can be better. Ragata is a famous event, gathering fests, and crowds are mixed mostly local. The connection is good, and campus is surrounded by life. Scholarships are provided, and clubs are there for extracurricular activities.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering
reviews.review_title: It's a good college in terms of events, opportunities, but academics are not as good as I thought.

detailed_review.Placements: About 95% got placement in the CSE branch. The highest package was 17 Lacs and the lowest package was 6 LPA, and the average package was 8 LPA. Top recruiting companies are JP Morgan, Goldman Sachs, and TCS. Most of the students got internships at JP Morgan. Most of the students are placed as Junior software developers.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I am totally satisfied with the infrastructure that COEP provides. It has Wi-Fi all over the campus, large classrooms that can accommodate 100 students, a library having all types of books, cleanliness and hygiene are well maintained in the college. The hostel also provides all the necessary things like Wi-Fi, a bed, a fan, a bathroom, cleaning, etc. Mess is also good. Sports are also part of our academics.
detailed_review.Faculty: Almost all teachers are helpful. They are kind and generous. They have enough knowledge about their subject. Not all, but some of them have extremely good teaching skills. Some subjects in the 1st year are not at all relevant, like history, Biology, and EDG. I think college should remove these subjects from the CS branch syllabus. Exams are quite difficult for me. The passing percentage is 40%.
detailed_review.Other: CSE is an evergreen course, and also nowadays it's in trend like AI and ML. It keeps us up-to-date with the pace of the technology revolution. Removing non-relevant subjects is the best thing a college can do. Events are amazing here. Enjoying each event.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering
reviews.review_title: College is great for placement, but the moderate facilities, and I recommend this college.

detailed_review.Placements: 90% of students in the computer engineering branch get placed. The highest package was 52 Lacs, and the lowest was 4 Lacs. Many companies like DE Shaw, JP Morgan, Wipro, etc., hire students directly from college. Therefore, placements at the college are good, and securing internships is easier due to the college's reputation in Pune.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is well-maintained but average. The facilities also feel average. The hostels are good, and the mess food is quite decent and reasonably priced. There are many excellent clubs for sports and other activities. Medical facilities are improving.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are good. They are well-qualified and knowledgeable. The quality of teaching is quite good. The course syllabus is relevant compared to other universities. Semester exams are moderately difficult, but due to relative grading, it is easier to pass harder subjects

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering
reviews.review_title: COEP Pune, the college of exposure and best for living an engineering life.

detailed_review.Placements: I am a student at COEP, pursuing a B.Tech in Electronics and Telecommunication. Regarding placements, around 80% of students were placed last year, with some also engaged in startups. The top recruiting companies include TCS, Infosys, Mastercard, Paytm, etc. Not all students get a paid internship by the fourth year. The top roles offered are electronic design engineer and telecommunication engineer, among others.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: To speak frankly, the infrastructure is quite old and average. In my opinion, there is some negligence in developing it. There are many facilities in the hostel and college, but the infrastructure needs significant improvement. There are several games in COEP. It is a good place for sports. This college focuses on study as well as sports.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are good, but some faculty members will get rude and very strict. Professors are excellent in their domain. The semester exams are of a good level, but if you study every day for 2 hours, the exams will be very easy for you. The curriculum is a bit old from today's.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I was interested in interest of electronics and the electric stuff. I will suggest improving the instruments of the lab and the infrastructure in the college.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: My college life. We enjoy a lot in our college.

detailed_review.Placements: I am just studying in my first year but, I have heard from our seniors that the placements are above average in our college and the placement cell is also very supportive. Many experienced students have told us about the placement that we get the best placement. Approximately 75% of students got placed in our college every year.

In the library, there are many books available. Hostel campus is a little far from the college campus. There are two hostels, one for girls and the other for boys. Facilities in our hostel are also best and the rooms are cleaned once a week. Medical, gym, laundry, etc., are available in our hostel for free.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members of each subject are very experienced and supportive. They are well-qualified. They teach very fluently and everybody understands their teaching. Course curriculum is relevant and it makes students industry-ready as faculty members teach every topic properly.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because mechanical engineering is the core branch. And slowly it is also moving towards the technical era. There are many famous events and fests in our college which students enjoy a lot by participating in.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical Engineering
reviews.review_title: All facilities are very good. The quality of education is provided.

detailed_review.Placements: About 70-80% of students get placements in the metallurgy and materials technology course. The highest package is 28 LPA. From the second year, internships are provided for students. Best companies like TCS, Infosys, etc., visit the college for placements. COEP College is good for placements and education.

Mess is too good and they give non-veg every Sunday and for veg students, they give a sweet on Sunday.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are too helpful and qualified. Their teaching quality is better than other colleges. They make students industry-ready. They keep the subject like MPF so that students get experience. They also keep communication skills subject, so that students get ready for interviews with confidence.
detailed_review.Other: Our college organises many events to keep our minds fresh. Surroundings of the campus are too good and lush green everywhere. There is stress everywhere. College gives us all the information on how to get a scholarship.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of College of Engineering, Pune.

detailed_review.Placements: Talking about College of Engineering Pune, the percentage of students placed last year was around 93%. The highest on-campus package offered is 50 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Mastercard, PayPal, Infosys, Paytm, etc. Most of students got internships last year. The roles were web designing, app development, AI/ML intern, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure for college is good but for hostel it has to improve. Wi-Fi is available 24X7 in college and hostel too. There is a facility of library. Classrooms are well-maintained. Talking about hostel mess, food is the overall average. Canteen has lots of varieties of food items like samosas, roll, etc. The court is pretty good in terms of sports and games as it organizes lots of sports events so I will give 10/10 for its sports facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified and knowledgeable. Teaching quality is brilliant. Talking about the course curriculum is up-to-date and very useful for industries. Semester exams are slightly difficult. Pass percentage is about 30-35% for the semester exam.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course as it's the topmost course of this college in terms of placements and value. Lots of extracurricular activities are there for CS students also to get deep knowledge of programming and participate in the hackathon.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering
reviews.review_title: The best college in Maharashtra that offers placement opportunities.

detailed_review.Placements: COEP provides better placements than other colleges in Maharashtra. The highest package is around 52 LPA, and the average package is around 11-12 LPA. Most companies that visit our college are from a software background, but there are also many opportunities for core branch students. Internship opportunities are available from the third year onwards. The top roles are from the software domain.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Courses provided by COEP are the best and have a better level than the IIT curriculum. The college has the best library and Wi-Fi, but some labs are not in proper condition. The hostel provides Wi-Fi, water, solar power, and 24-hour electricity. As for the mess, the quality of the food is average.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the faculty members are very interactive and friendly. They help us with projects and academics. The curriculum is at a good level, but some faculty members have not completed their syllabi by the end of the semester. The college has two exams, the mid-semester exam and the end-semester exam. The mid-semester exam is for 30 marks, the end-semester exam is for 60 marks, and the remaining 10 marks are from internal assessments.
detailed_review.Other: Frankly, I didn’t get admission to the CS course, so I remained with this course. The second reason for choosing this course is that I wanted to learn software skills along with hardware, and this is a perfect match for those skills. There are highly qualified faculty members, including Ph.D. holders, teaching electronics courses.

admission.overview_text: College of Engineering Pune admission is based on entrance exam. College of Engineering Pune ( COEP Pune ) is now known as COEP Technological University . It offers a wide range of UG, PG, and doctoral courses across various streams of Engineering, Architecture, and Management. Students can also pursue a PG Diploma programme in multiple specialisations at the institute. The college provides the course in affiliation with UNIPUNE . faqs.question: Does COEP accept JEE Mains marks?
faqs.answer: Yes, the College of Engineering Pune (COEP) accepts the scorecard of JEE-Main. But the majority of seats are sanctioned for Maharashtra domicile students and are filled through MHT-CET. An additional 25% seats are provided for All India Candidates who are admitted through the JEE-Main score. Apart from UG courses like BTech the College of Engineering Pune also provides a wide range of PG and doctoral courses which have their own specified entrance exams through which students can enroll in the desired course.

faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

faqs.question: What is the stipend for M.Tech in COEP?
faqs.answer: As per the data available on multiple websites on the internet, COEP M.Tech stipend ranges from INR 11,573 to INR 12,435.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for M.Tech at COEP Pune?
faqs.answer: Candidates who have completed BE/BTech in relevant discipline with at least 50% aggregate (45% aggregate for Backward Class categories, Economically weaker section and Persons with Disability category belonging to Maharashtra State) can apply for M.Tech at COEP Pune.

faqs.question: Which entrance exam is accepted by COEP?
faqs.answer: The College of Engineering Pune enroll candidates in its BTech course mainly through MHT-CET and JEE-Main. Registration for MHT-CET usually starts in the month of March and it concludes in April. The second most popular course of VJTI is M.Tech and the candidates willing to take admission in MCA should register GATE exam. Students should prepare well for the said entrance exams to secure good scores/ rank. There are many other UG, PG, diploma, and doctoral courses provided by the COEP under various specialisations. For further queries regarding eligibility for other courses, candidates can refer to coep official website.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission in COEP Pune?
faqs.answer: No, there is no such provision to get direct admission in any of the UG, PG, or doctoral courses. COEP Technological University (formerly known as COEP) admissions are strictly based on merit only. Therefore, only those candidates who have valid scores/ rank of MHT-CET, GATE, JEE-Main, among others can apply for any of the courses provided by the College of Engineering, Pune (COEP). Hence, the interested candidates need to take these entrance exams according to their choice of course in which they want to enroll.

college_info.college_name: SR University

highlights.summary: SR University (also known as SRU), founded in 2002, is located in Warangal, Telangana. SRU is a private institute and it has courses approved by AICTE. It offers 16 courses at UG and PG level. Courses such as B.E. / B.Tech, M.E./M.Tech and MBA/PGDM are provided in Full Time mode. The institute offers these programmes in streams such as Engineering and Business & Management Studies. These courses are served in various specialisations such as Civil Engineering, Computer Science Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Power Engineering. The institute provides an annual intake of 913 students. The average median package is around INR 4,40,994. The total fees for all the courses at SR University ranges between INR 1,20,000-4,37,000. SR University has a well-equipped campus with all the advanced facilities.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: Overall, it is a very good college for students who will join in the future.

detailed_review.Placements: University has very good placements. The highest packages are very good, but the average package is a little moderate compared to the highest. Overall, it is nice. The highest package is 51 LPA, received by a student in Microsoft, and it feels very good to have that amount of package.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Though it became a University in 2019, we have very good infrastructure and more infrastructure is planned for future students. After a couple of years, we will see an indoor stadium in our college and good auditoriums. Recently, we have upgraded the central library, which offers very good infrastructure.
detailed_review.Faculty: Good faculty, but it depends on the course you have selected. Overall, the faculty is very nice. The electrical faculty members are very strict compared to computer science, and they are very genuine in marks for internals, etc. Explanation is also very good, but we don’t have books, we have only online topics on Canvas.
detailed_review.Other: University has small events and very good technical events like Hackathons, audit nights, hostel nights, and cultural fests.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placements in last two years.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements are good in this campus, and the highest package is 50 LPA, and the lowest package is 5 LPA. 50 percent of students got internships from CSE at companies like Accenture, etc. Also, many of the students who passed out got good placements, and they are doing their job.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and the infrastructure are good, and the campus is also eco-friendly and the mess food is also not bad, and they conduct sports like cricket, badminton, volleyball, basketball, etc. Also, colleges take students to South zone tournaments for badminton, volleyball, which is the best chance to show your talent.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are good and well-qualified, and the course curriculum makes the students industry-ready. The semester exams are also a little bit difficult to pass, but the pass percentage is 41 percent. We get the subject knowledge from the faculty teaching on this campus.
detailed_review.Other: I chose CSE because the demand for the course is higher and I like to present software side, and on campus, they conduct many events, fests, and scholarships for the students.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering
reviews.review_title: Our college is nice and good for new students.

detailed_review.Placements: In our college, up to 80 percent of students get placed. The highest package offered is 51 LPA, and the lowest package offered is 6 LPA. The top recruiting companies for our course are Microsoft, Google, PayPal, Accenture, Salesforce, etc. Around 60 percent of students got internships at PayPal, Google, Microsoft, Wipro, Infosys, etc. The top roles offered are software developer, software tester, and software builder.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In our college, facilities and infrastructure are nice and clean. Labs, classrooms, and Wi-Fi signals are so accurate. The ambiance is nice. The library is newly constructed, and it is the most advanced library in the locality. In our college hostel, rooms are very neat and clean. The hostel food is so good. Medical facilities are accurate and on time. The canteen food is good and worth the money we spend on it. Sports and games are so good and enjoyable.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are so helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. The teaching quality is so good. The course curriculum is relevant, and it makes students industry-ready. Semester exams are somewhat difficult, but if we study, it is easy to write the end-semester exams. The pass percentage is 40 percent.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I have an interest in Computer Science, and I love coding. The best thing is that it is interesting to learn. There are no improvements needed in the course curriculum. Events, fests, the campus crowd, connectivity, campus surroundings, scholarships, and extracurricular activities are nice.

highlights.summary:
Panjab University, popularly known as PUCHD, was founded in 1882 as the University of the Panjab Lahore (in Pakistan now). It was then moved to Chandigarh in 1947, where the university was split between Pakistan and India. It is a Central and State Government-funded university and has been accredited with an 'A++' grade by the NAAC. As per the latest QS Ranking 2026, Panjab University Chandigarh is ranked 901-950 under the 'World University' category. It has been ranked 35 under the 'University' category and 57 under the 'Overall' category by the NIRF Ranking 2025.
PU CHD has 202 affiliated colleges across Punjab and offers UG, PG, and Doctoral level courses. The courses are offered fields such as Business and Management Studies, Accounting and Commerce, Arts (Fine/ Visual/ Performing), Design, Engineering, Humanities & Social Sciences, etc. PU Chandigarh admissions 2025 are currently open. Entrance exams such as PU MET, PU-CET (UG), PU-CET (PG), and PhD entrance tests are accepted for admission.
Panjab Uni Chandigarh admission provides several scholarships for the students in need. Placements are conducted by the Panjab University Placement Cell. The University of Punjab Chandigarh offers courses under its School of Open Learning (PU SOL).

PUCHD eligibility varies from course to course. Candidates must fulfil the eligibility criteria to be able to apply for the course. Punjab University's flagship courses are MBA, BTech, BSc, and BA.
Punjab University offers these courses in full-time mode for the duration of 2 to 5 years. PUCHD fee structure includes tuition fees ranging from INR 480 to INR 6.19 Lakh. Punjab admissions to any of the course is based on merit and entrance exam. Therefore, candidates must secure the suggested minimum aggregate in Class 12 and graduation. There is a well-equipped computer lab with 30 computers in it, and free internet connectivity, including Wi-Fi, to further enhance the research ability of the lab, managed by a team of well-trained and dedicated professionals.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers teach with passion. They are very good at teaching and encourage discussion. Most of the teachers are very knowledgeable about their subjects. The curriculum is relevant. They are not difficult if you work seriously. They are easily sold out in one month.
detailed_review.Other: I chose BLLB because I have an interest in knowing about the laws, how they are made, how they function in real life, and how they shape social behaviour. The integrated course gives me knowledge about both legal principles and social science.

reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com. Hons.)
reviews.review_title: Good campus and college life, but placement rates are not that good.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are average, totally depending on students' skills. There are 422 students in the B.Com 1st year. HCL, Wipro, and Infosys are some top companies. Mostly, the students with skills and their communication skills got a good placement in top-notch companies. The top roles of my course B.Com are accountant and manager.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The average infrastructure is not too good. Some classrooms are so good, but some classes are the worst. The benches in some classes are good, but in some classes they're not. The canteen is good with decent food prices. The sports ground is too big, and there is a cricket ground in the college.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are really chill and helpful in my course, B.Com. They are good and qualified. The quality of education is good in DAV Chandigarh. The mid-semester exams are easy, and the pass percentage is 33 percent. The course is good and interesting. I personally like accounts and economics.
detailed_review.Other: I chose B.Com because I want to become a CA, and for CA, B.Com is the best degree to do because the syllabus is almost the same, and I have chosen this college because it's a good and reputable college in our city, Chandigarh. One main thing is that the fests and events are good in this college.

reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA)
reviews.review_title: I am satisfied because the infrastructure is good, and campus life at SD College is also good.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are average in SD college only 20 to 30% of the students got placed in our college. The highest package offered is 11 LPA and average package is 4 LPA and the lowest is 2 LPA top recruiting companies are TCS infosys wipro etc. About 20 to 30% of the students get internship from BCA course .
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the course and hostels is very good at SD College. All the labs are fully AC centralised, even the classrooms too, and the food available in the mess and canteens of both hostels (boys and girls) is good. Medical facilities are also provided if any disease occurs to a student.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty of SD College is good, but not the best, and the course curriculum is not fully relevant, making the student half-industry-ready. Semester exams are easy, but the checking done is too tight, and the pass percentage is also low; like in MST, a student must score 25% of the total percentage of all subjects.

reviews.course: B.Sc. in Medical
reviews.review_title: S.C.D. Government College: pay less learn more.

detailed_review.Placements: My course started with 67 students. The highest package for my course was 5 LPA, while the lowest was 3 LPA. Almost all the students got internships. Only a few of them were able to get paid internships. Roles such as professor and assistant professor were offered for our course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college offers proper facilities for the students who choose to live in their hostels. The entire campus is furnished with Wi-Fi and has projects in a tiered classroom. Both the college and the hostel have a library of their own. The library at the hostel is open 24/7 for students to study.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is very nice and is always willing to help you with your queries and problems. All the teachers have PhDs and are qualified enough. The curriculum is great, and it makes you industry-ready. Almost 95% of students pass the semester exams easily.
detailed_review.Other: This course allowed me to gain knowledge and become a professor to teach at any college I wish. The course could focus more on the Science side. The college is famous for its events and fests.

reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.)
reviews.review_title: First Semester: Promising start; Room for growth.

detailed_review.Placements: I have seen in the brochure and also heard from many people that many students got good placements even during their course. Many companies like Deloitte visit our college. 60% of the students got internships in good companies. The highest salary package is 25 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I am not sure about the hostels as I am not a hosteler, but I heard from students that the rooms and the washrooms are maintained very well. The labs are equipped with the latest software and technology. The classrooms have the material that is required by the teachers to teach.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty quality varies, so it is difficult to explain this. If we see exams, they are challenging but fair, though frequent. The curriculum is standard with a mix of both theory and practical. The curriculum was mostly relevant and up to date. Most teachers were helpful and approachable.
detailed_review.Other: The best part of any course is learning new things and meeting new people. I wish there were more guidance on how to choose courses and plan for the future. Also, more practical experience would be great.

reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Chemistry
reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with the faculty and infrastructure not satisfied with placement opportunities.

detailed_review.Placements: In B.Sc there are no placements only M.Sc. students get a chance to sit in placements. The highest package is 7LPA. Placement opportunities for B.Sc. hons students are limited. There are sole internship opportunities that come every year but they do not pay that well.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is Wi-Fi in whole chemistry department but it works very slowly. When it comes to AC B.Sc. labs have no air conditioning but all classes are air conditioned. Some of the M.Sc. labs are also air conditioned. The department library is very good. Most of the books related to Chemistry research are available there and it is also air conditioned. Timing is 9 to 5.
detailed_review.Faculty: All facilities are very experienced in doing their own research work and teaching at the same time. Teaching methodology is also good. Most of the teachers curriculum is decided by teachers which is also very good but students can understand all concepts in Chemistry with each passing semester.
detailed_review.Other: Chemistry is like everything. I chose Punjab University because my sister recommended it to me and when I came to know about honours school system I made up my mind that I am going to study at Punjab University. There are a lot of fest in Punjab and most of the Punjabi Bollywood singers came here in February.

reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Chemistry
reviews.review_title: Satisfied with university.

detailed_review.Placements: 60 to 70 percent of students got placements, and the majority got a decent package. Various institutes and companies approach our university for jobs, such as Akash Institute, etc. 60 percent got internships as well. The roles offered are according to their requirements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college has well-maintained labs and computer facilities, with air-conditioned rooms and a library. The hostel mess serves good food, and the canteen has multiple options for ordering food. The campus has multiple multi-sports grounds and a health centre as well.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are brilliant with multiple years of teaching experience and are very highly qualified. The course is practical-based and suitable for industry work. The exams are pretty competitive in nature, and the passing percentage is also 40 percent. A very good examination atmosphere is provided to the students.
detailed_review.Other: I chose the course as I am interested in Chemistry.  The university provides a perfect environment for doing research as well as studying. Multiple events take place every year, and scholarships are also available for students.

reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com. Hons.)
reviews.review_title: Satisfied with faculty. The college is good at annual placements and has good infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: For the B.Com 2024 batch, the placement rate was 50–85%. A total of 121 students get placed. The highest package was 7.5 LPA, the average package was around 6.23 LPA, and the lowest package was around 3.82 LPA. Top recruiters are Deloitte, ICICI Bank, and HDFC Bank. Top roles offered were Analyst and Deputy Manager.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is very good compared to other colleges under Panjab University. There is a Wi-Fi in some parts of the college. There is a proper library for study. Labs are well maintained. The college also has a good record in games, and it has won many medals in shooting.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty in the college is good. They are all well qualified and have deep knowledge of the subjects they teach. Examinations are not very tough, as they are predictable by analyzing previous papers of Panjab University.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Altogether a good option for a Tier-2/3 college in the growing phase.

detailed_review.Placements: In my course, around 80 percent of students got placed. The highest package is 22 LPA, and the lowest is 3.6 LPA. The average package is around 8- 9 LPA. Top companies include ZS Associate, AMEX, Deloitte, KPMG, GreyB, TCS, Infosys, Policy Bazar, and ProgDNA. Most of the roles offered are in Data Analytics, and a few are in Software Development roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostels are limited, and most of the students rent out flats or PG. The campus is lush green, and sporting facilities are available. Classrooms are big, and Wi-Fi is available 24/7 in hostels and colleges. Labs are fully air-conditioned and carry out DST-funded research and innovation. The library is also well maintained with a sufficient no of books, journals, and papers.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are cooperative, but not all of them. Teaching is fair in terms of semester exams. Mostly PYQs are repeated, and the evaluation criteria are lenient. Curriculum is well-mapped with Tier-1 colleges and relevant. Students get ample time for other activities.
detailed_review.Other: Campus life is altogether good. Lush green campus and enough sporting facilities. Events are not that big or highlighted. Connectivity is good and in the heart of Chandigarh.

reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Chemistry
reviews.review_title: Overall, it is one of the best institutions.

detailed_review.Placements:
85% students were placed, and others also got placements from outside placements. The highest package is 10 LPA. The lowest package is 4 LPA. The average package is 6 LPA. Aakash and other coaching institutes.
100% internships in industrial companies. Teacher, Analyst, etc., roles are offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: A lot of facilities have well-developed labs, and almost every type of chemical is present. Classrooms are well developed, ACs are present in every class, and smart boards are also present. Wi-Fi is also present in every class. The qualities of hostels are good and well-maintained. Cleanliness is maintained. The quality of food is a little bit poor, but okay. Medical facilities such as X-ray and sports grounds are also present in the hostel.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful and have good knowledge. Teaching quality is also good, and they teach well to clear our concepts. The course curriculum is relevant, and they teach us enough that is useful in the industry. Semester exams are easy and can be easily prepared for in one week.
detailed_review.Other: I have an interest in Chemistry, so I chose Chemistry. I have improved in my experiential knowledge too much. All events happen there.

reviews.course: Bachelor of Arts (B.A.)
reviews.review_title: I am very much satisfied because of the college infrastructure and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: After B.A., you can try giving government exams like UPSC and other exams because the subjects selected in B.A. offer a wide knowledge, such as subjects like history, geography, public administration, political science, and many more. They are beneficial for government exams.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Good course, and the hostel is also good. The hostel provides all necessities which are required by the students, like hot water, separate rooms, and activities like a gym, a library, a canteen, and labs. The quality of the hostel is very good, and even the mess food is good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful and well-qualified. Teachers help weak students and inspire them to attend the lectures, and also guide them about what to do or choose in the future to become successful. Semester examinations are neither as tough nor as easy.

reviews.course: B.A. in Political Science
reviews.review_title: Best college for studying, cleaning, and organizing fests.

detailed_review.Placements: Companies came for placement, and my friend also got a job. Many companies come for jobs for final year students, and I like it because everyone is capable can get a job easily. There are around 200 to 300 students who are happy with the placement.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Best in cleanliness and infrastructure is also good. Food quality is also good, and it maintains hygiene while cooking. Tight security for entering the hostel and the canteen provided a wide variety of food for the students, and the prices of the food are also pocket friendly.
detailed_review.Faculty: Best faculty during exams is not easy to cheat. Not easy for students to cheat, and teachers are strict while in the examination hall, which shows the real capabilities of students while getting results. Teachers are very helpful and they are qualified.
detailed_review.Other: Crowd is huge on the college campus, and I like it.

reviews.course: B.A. (English, Economics, Sociology)
reviews.review_title: S.D. College life in Chandigarh, good faculty and superb crowd.

detailed_review.Placements: No placements were given to us, specially to students from Bachelors fields. There were no internships, sadly, and there were no industrial visits. It doesn't make us industry ready. I think commerce students got some placement opportunities, but I'm not really sure.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is really pleasing, however, in rainy season, a lot of water stores up in the garden area. Our block benches were a bit old, but most classes were held in commerce block! Wi-Fi was given in library. The canteen food was nice, however, limited options were there.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers were quite helpful, well qualified, and knowledgeable. They were quite friendly and taught us in different ways. The course curriculum was very much relevant, but I don't think it makes us industry ready. The semester exams are quite average, and one can easily pass.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I had to give government exams, and the best thing about the course was it gives us flexibility and opens up too many opportunities. I wish there were enough internships and placements, there were numerous seminars, events, and clubs in our college.

faqs.question: What percentage is required for Panjab University BA admission?
faqs.answer: Candidates seeking admission to the BA or BA (Hons) course at Panjab University must have an aggregate of up to 60% in Class 12. This is the minimum aggregate that is needed to pursue BA (Hons) in Economics or BA (Hons) from the campus of PU. For more details on the college-wise and Specialisation-wise eligibility requirements of BA at PU, candidates are advised to visit the official website of the affiliated college or contact their admission office.

faqs.question: Is BA available at the PU campus?
faqs.answer: Yes, Panjab University offers a three-year undergraduate BA or Bachelor of Arts course in both regular and distance modes via its constituent/ affiliated colleges. faqs.question: I have scored less than 50% in 12th boards. Can I get admission for B.Com at Panjab University?
faqs.answer: Candidates who have either passed Class 12 examination or BCom Part- I (old scheme) of Panjab University with at least 45% aggregate or who have passed the Class 12 with at least 50% aggregate or any other equivalent examination are eligible to apply for BCom admission at Panjab University. Hence, a candidate scoring less than 50% in Class 12 is not eligible to apply for BCom at Panjab University. Such candidates can go for other universities and colleges offering a BCom. They can also pursue BCom in distance mode. BCom aspirants can also check out various colleges offering online BCom courses .

faqs.question: Is Punjab University BA application forms out?

The application form can also be filled in the offline mode.

faqs.question: What is the criteria for BTech admission at Punjab University?
faqs.answer: Punjab University offers a four-year BE programme across eight specialisations along with an Integrated BE (Chemical) - MBA programme. Admission to both programmes is based on JEE Main. To add, the university also conducts and considers the scores of  PU LEET and PU MEET scores for lateral entry admissions. The minimum eligibility for BE and Integrated courses is Class 12 with PCM subjects from a recognised board as per JAC Chandigarh eligibility criteria. All the affiliated colleges of Panjab University offering BTech are part of JAC Chandigarh counselling.

faqs.question: Does Punjab University accept JEE Mains for BTech admission?
faqs.answer: Yes, admission to the Bachelor of Engineering programmes at PU is based on candidates' performance in JEE Main exam followed by counselling conducted by JAC Chandigarh. BE is available at five PU-affiliated colleges which are part of JAC Chandigarh counselling. The university also conducts and considers the scores of PU LEET and PU MEET scores for lateral entry admissions. For more details on PUCHD BTech, check out this article mentioning PU BTech admission process in detail .

faqs.question: How can I get admission in Punjab University for BTech?
faqs.answer: As mentioned above, admission to BE at Panjab University is subject to a valid score in JEE Main exam followed by JAC Chandigarh Counselling. All the affiliated colleges of Panjab University offering BTech are part of JAC Chandigarh counselling. Hence, the selection criteria of PU BTech is completed via JAC Chandigarh Counselling. To add, the university also conducts and considers the scores of PU LEET and PU MEET scores for lateral entry admissions. Additionally, Panjab University conducts the PULEET exam for admission to the second year of BTech. However, for first-year BTech students, the university considers the scores of JEE Main followed by JAC counselling. All the affiliated colleges of Panjab University offering BTech are part of JAC Chandigarh counselling. Hence, the selection criteria of PU BTech is JEE Main followed by JAC Chandigarh Counselling.

faqs.question: How to apply for PUCHD MBA admission?
faqs.answer: Panjab University (PUCHD) has a multi-step admission process that candidates must follow to get into the university. Starting with the application process, candidates are required to go through the course-specific selection rounds (if applicable). A step-by-step procedure is as follows: Step 1: Apply for MBA on the official website of Panjab University. The application fee is INR 3,250 at UBS and INR 2,175 (PU MET) for General category candidates. Step 2: For admission to MBA, students are required to appear for the national-level CAT or entrance conducted by the university. Step 3: After the application process is complete, course-wise merit lists are released on the official website (with the names of the shortlisted students). Those who have their names must fill in the admission form. Step 4: Post merit list release, interested students can submit the fee and confirm their admission.

faqs.question: How expensive is MBA at Panjab University?
faqs.answer: The total fee for MBA ranges between INR 42,700 and INR 6.20 lakh. This information is sourced from official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change. For more details and fee break-up for MBA at PU, candidates are advised to reach out to the admission office of Panjab University or the MBA-affiliated college of PU. Other than the course fee, students are required to pay the registration fee for CAT or PU MET exam depending on their admission process The application fee is INR 3,250 at UBS and INR 2,175 (PU MET) for General category candidates.

faqs.question: How much percentage is required for MBA admission at Punjab University?
faqs.answer: In order to be eligible to pursue MBA from a PU-affiliated institute, students must have completed their UG degrees with at least 50% aggregate. However, those with a Diploma must have at least 60% aggregate in it and along with that have at least five years of research/ teaching/ professional experience. Final admission, however, is subject to a valid score in MET exam conducted by Panjab University for MBA admission followed by GD and PI. 85% of the total final selection weightage is allocated to the MET exam and the remaining 15% of admission chances are based on the performance of the candidates in GD and PI. Read more about PU MBA here .

faqs.question: Which entrance exam is conducted at Panjab University for admission to LLB?
faqs.answer: For admission to the three-year LLB programme offered by Panjab University, candidates must appear for PU LLB Entrance Test and score well. Shortlisted students will have their names appear in the merit lists. Those with their names can pay the admission fee and confirm their seat in the university. Before entrance, candidates are required to meet the minimum eligibility criteria set by the university which is a pass in any bachelor’s/ master’s degree in stream with at least 45% aggregate from Panjab University or any other University recognised by the Bar Council of India and Panjab University. The applications are available online on the official website. The application fee for General category candidates is INR 2,395 and for SC, ST and PwD category students, it is INR 1,198.

faqs.question: Which is the best Bachelor of Arts (BA) specialisation offered by Panjab University Chandigarh?
faqs.answer: As per the internet, BA at PU is offered across Economics, History, Sociology and Psychology specialisation, among others. However, students must select the specialisation on the basis of their interest and past academic background and not on the basis of its popularity. While all these specialisations are offered at PU-affiliated colleges, students can pursue BA (Hons) and BA (Hons) in Economics courses from the main campus of Panjab University. Check out all BA specialisations at PUCHD here .

faqs.question: What is the fee for BA LLB at Panjab University?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee for BA LLB ranges betwen INR 3.23 Lacs and INR 5.27 lakh. This fee, however, is sourced from an unofficial sources. Hence, is indicative. sections.heading: Introduction
text: The campus of Panjab University is spread across an area of 550 acres in sectors 14 and 25 of the city of Chandigarh. The university has 78 teaching and research departments and 15 centres/ chairs for teaching and research at the main campus located in Chandigarh. PUCHD also offers infrastructural facilities such as smart classrooms, a health centre, a bank, a shopping centre, a post office, a gymnasium, botanical gardens, a swimming pool, well-maintained parks, sports grounds, guest houses, an open-air theatre, a faculty house, seminar complexes, alumni house, community centre and much more. There are a total of 17 hostels (nine for girls and eight for boys) to accommodate over 6,700 students . PU is also comprised of a working-women hostel with a capacity of 70 residents.
Panjab University Campus Highlights 2024

Panjab University has two campuses. The layout of these two campuses is built in such a way as to meet the academic,  administrative, sports/recreational, residential and other requirements. The university provides Internet and Communication facilities, hostels, and sports facilities. Apart from these facilities, the university also provides some additional facilities such as its own Shopping Centre, Health Centre, Bank, Post Office, Swimming Pool, Gymnasium, Sports Grounds, Botanical Gardens, well-maintained parks, open-air theatre, Guest Houses, Faculty House, Seminar Complexes, Alumni House, Community Centre and a school.
Campus Building:
Campus View:
Panjab University Hostel & Residential Facilities

There are 18 hostels at Panjab University (8 for boys and 10 for girls, where nearly 6700 students can be accommodated. Also, the university has one working women's hostel with a capacity to accommodate 70 residents and one International Hostel with world-class facilities.
Panjab University Sports Facilities

Panjab University has playgrounds for all major sports. The university has an air-conditioned gymnasium hall, an international-level swimming pool, a diving pool, an athletic track, two cemented basketball courts with flood lights, four volleyball courts, one hockey ground, two football grounds, two kho kho courts, three softball grounds, two cricket grounds, two kabaddi courts, three softball grounds, two cricket grounds, one netball ground, one korfball ground, two synthetic lawn tennis courts, 8 grassy Lawn Tennis Courts, one Cinder Lawn Tennis Court. Apart from these, there is an international standard, a 10-meter functional shooting range.
