reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is a good one for a government college.

detailed_review.Placements: Nearly 60 percent of Computer Science students get placed. The highest package is around 21 LPA. The lowest package is 6 LPA, and the average package is about 8–9 LPA. Some of the top recruiting companies include Oracle, Zeta, Verisk, Viasat, and Honeywell. The percentage of internships is unknown. Some of the top roles offered are data analyst, DevOps engineer, and machine learning engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities available for our course are above average. Every classroom has projectors for teaching. Every department has seminar halls and laboratories. Every floor has Wi-Fi access. The college has a central university library and another smaller library with proper facilities. The quality of hostel facilities is below average. The food is worst. The college has an indoor stadium, a ground, and other sports courts.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful regarding the course, and all of them are qualified with Ph.D. degrees in their respective fields. The courses are relevant and make students partially industry-ready. Semester exams in our college are considered difficult. The pass percentage is above 90 percent.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course in this college because I got a free seat. I wish the course would improve its industry-ready curriculum. Events are conducted occasionally. Fests are conducted every year. The college is surrounded by facilities like malls, hostels, theatres, restaurants, and hospitals. Students can apply for scholarships like NSP, FFE, and Reliance Scholarship.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 50% of students are placed now, the highest was 52 LPA, the lowest was 6.2 LPA, and the top recruiting companies were DE Shaw and Microsoft! Almost every person got an internship. Top job profiles for students are Software Developers, Full Stack Developers, IT Consultants, and Quality Analysts.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available for every department, and every lab has its own Wi-Fi. Everything is good in this college. Good campus-wide coverage, well-equipped with projectors and computers, large modern libraries accessed digitally, and affordable basic facilities in the hostel! Grounds and equipment for major sports.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are experienced and keep inspiring us. The curriculum is relevant but can be improved. It makes the students industry-ready. Exams are not that difficult, except for 3 or 5 subjects. Others are easy. The pass percentage is around 85%. Although if students fail, they will easily pass the supply exams.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this college because of its curriculum, experienced teachers, good infrastructure, and so on.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Satisfied with placements and with faculty up to a certain level.

detailed_review.Placements: There are pretty good placements in our college. The average package might hit around 5 to 7 LPA. A large percentage of students get placed in their 7th semester itself and have very good job roles offered. Large companies and mass hiring take place. Around 70% get placed from the shortlisted ones.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi and classrooms are good. We have an excellent university library with a lot of good books, and we even have a small library for general purposes. Our labs are a bit old, but nonetheless, they work very well and satisfy the requirements in most cases. Our department overall looks nice.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our faculty is good, encourages us, and are highly talented professors with an excellent level of professional knowledge. Our course curriculum is excellent and covers the present teaching requirements needed for top companies. Our course makes us industry-ready as soon as we complete it.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because it is the present trend and has a lot of scope in the future, and it plays well. We need to work hard, and this plays accordingly.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security)
reviews.review_title: Review by the First Batch of Cybersecurity at JNTUH.

detailed_review.Placements: In the academic year 2025-2026, as of now, under the CSE branch, 23 students got placed with an average package of 13 LPA. From the CSM branch, 20 students got placed with an average of 11 LPA. Oracle recruited around 10 students for a 20 LPA. The top roles are SDE roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The classrooms are equipped with projectors. There is departmental Wi-Fi. There are many libraries, the main one being the university library, which has 3 floors. The hostel is of moderate quality. The food quality is better than that of other hostels. There is a university healthcare centre.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-qualified, helpful, and knowledgeable. They are quite friendly. The course curriculum is well updated, and I hope it makes the students industry-ready. I feel like there is scope for improvement. The semester exams are not that hard, and many students pass easily.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course as it is trending and evergreen. There is also a cybersecurity club that has been recently inaugurated. This year, our college introduced a cultural fest, whereas previously we only had a technical fest.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good faculty and peaceful surroundings.

detailed_review.Placements: My course is B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering. 50-60 percent of students got placed from my course. The average package offered in my course is about 3 LPA. 40 percent of students got internships from my course, but not every internship from top companies. The placement percentage is a little low compared to Computer Science.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities for my course and hostel are quite good. I really like the infrastructure of my college. But it's not modern as it is an old university. The facilities in the hostel are not that great. Classrooms, library, and labs are good enough. The food is average.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are absolutely helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. The course curriculum is relevant. The semester exams are really tough. The pass percentage is 70 percent. We have the syllabus related to all branches in the first year. My faculty is kind.
detailed_review.Other: I wanted to join JNTU since the 10th standard. I hope the placement percentage increases. The campus is really spacious.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Not a great college, but decent.

detailed_review.Placements: In 2024, the placements from our course were excellent. 72 percent of the students got placed in the campus placements. The highest package offered was 8 LPA, the lowest package offered was 3 LPA, and the average package offered was 4 LPA. JK Construction, DLF, Tata, and TCS were the top recruiting companies from our course. 73 percent of the students got their internship certificates from good companies. The top roles include leading the team and being a structural engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus was widely spread along 45 acres of land with many great facilities like separate blocks for different branches of students, AC classrooms, library, free Wi-Fi around the entire campus, placement rooms, auditorium, project labs, lawn, waiting room, indoor complex, etc. The hostel was also excellent in providing quality facilities like good food, clean rooms, and a hygienic environment. The medical team was doing an excellent job. They were available to the students the entire day. The sports and games were played every day in the college grounds after college.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty were really helpful for the students in teaching the concepts clearly. They are highly recommended for the students as they are highly qualified and well-experienced in their course. The course curriculum of our course is really giving amazing results in making many students ready for the industry. The semester exams were mostly good enough to pass. The pass percentage was 80 percent.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering + M.Tech.
reviews.review_title: Typical government college.

detailed_review.Placements: As of this year, 2025, I think my department, which is EEE, got 50 offers per 200 members (they are my seniors who got placements this year). The highest salary is 28 LPA. Minimum is somewhere near 3 LPA. This year's top company is Accenture (of course, that 28 LPA). I don't know about internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I will give insight into the academic block first. Of course, as a reputation for college indeed depends on cleanliness, it's good. Washrooms are above average. Water supply is average to above average, I mean, no matter how bad the water supply, at least they should be able to provide water before noon. As for the hostel, it is good in my first year (now I am at 3rd year), where I stayed that year. But after that, it's not good, or not worth the money.
detailed_review.Faculty: Don't know why I feel like giving below average, it's probably the worst. The curriculum is the JNTU syllabus according to the R22 regulation, which is okay. As for the faculty, some are the worst I have ever seen (of course, it's not like I studied B.Tech before, still). Feels like even the worst of us can give a better lecture. It's outdated, not talking about this particular college, but the entire state curriculum.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placements and nice infrastructure and above average facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: Nice placements 80 percent of students were placed. 40 LPA is the highest package offered and the lowest package offered is 3LPA. Nice Recruiting companies visited. Internship is also available for students. The Course offers AutoCAD and the very best opportunity. Nice college but bad hostel facilities.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Good facilities and infrastructure are available. In our college in my civil department the nicest facilities are there and good information is given. WI-FI is available in department labs classrooms and two libraries.  Nice food in hostel mess. Canteen and medical facilities are also available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful in studying. They are well educated and knowledgeable. The teaching quality is nice and all are Ph.D. The course curriculum is relevant and makes students industry ready in my college. Paper is very tough. Pass percentage is very low.
detailed_review.Other: Nice college.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Chemical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Inside JNTUH  Education Campus Life and Growth.

detailed_review.Placements: 70 percent are placed, the highest package offered is 13LPA, the lowest package offered is 3LPA. Top recruiting companies are Tata Reliance Dr. reddys etc. I do not know about internship but there are many companies in my college. If you study hard I think you will definitely get placed.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Moderate infrastructure Wi-Fi labs are good library is extraordinary, classrooms are mid related to the hostel everything is good. Sports and games are super nice and tournaments happen. I really like our university library it has so many facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some teachers are very helpful while others are not. I do not think students are ready for industry semester exams are difficult. If you study all chapters you will pass. Semester exam is of 60marks and the pass mark is 21. getting 21 is very difficult.
detailed_review.Other: I could go for research from this course. Only B.Teach in chemical is enough to get a job you need to do M.Teach in iits to get government job. In my college fests happen every year so well.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. in Civil Engineering + M.Tech
reviews.review_title: Love this college. The best college that teaches you life.

detailed_review.Placements: 40% of students got placed. The highest average is 8 LPA, while the average is 4 LPA. 100 percent of internships are done. As compared to other colleges, we get a few fewer core-related companies for placements, whereas there are a few constant companies that approach our college during placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostels are good, but the food may be a bit questionable. The infrastructure is good, especially the equipment provided in the laboratories, which is phenomenal. Food is sometimes good, whereas sometimes it is very odd-tasting and of low quality. The canteen needs to be improved a little bit.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful. The curriculum is good for studying. It is industry-ready in the sense that the student should be aware of their skills. Not all skills can be improved through the course, so self-study and self-analysis are much needed but if we learn the concepts properly, we can get into anything.
detailed_review.Other: Fests are one of the best days of the year. In one word, I love civil engineering, hence I chose this group. They could improve the classrooms a little bit.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University Hyderabad.

detailed_review.Placements: JNTUH college is the topmost college in Telangana. In my college, students should maintain above 85% to crack placements. The highest package in the mechanical branch is 20 LPA, the lowest package is 3 LPA, and the average package is 7 LPA. Top recruiting companies are TCS and PhonePe.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In JNTUH, infrastructure is excellent and it looks like an IT company. Classrooms are very good and clean with wooden benches which are comfortable for students, and every room contains a stage allocated to faculty members.
detailed_review.Faculty: In this college, every course contains 8 semesters over the entire 4 years. In each semester, it contains 2 mid exams and one lab exam for every subject. In labs, there are full equipments which are useful to every student. Finally, the final exam will be conducted. At least every student should score 35% to pass. It is not difficult to pass the exam.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: College life is good, with greenery.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are fine, but not great. However, the average is good. You cannot expect a bigger package from here, but the average is okay for a fresher. Not many big companies will come, and the core branches won't get many core-related companies for placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: As they are old buildings, the infrastructure isn't great, but we can live there. Wi-Fi, water, and food are available in the hostels. A library, sports building, ground, and health center are all available on the campus itself, which is a plus point.
detailed_review.Faculty: As the curriculum is very old and not up to current studies, we have to learn from online resources. The faculty are responsible and support us during projects and other tasks, but they will only teach 75% of the syllabus, which is common in all colleges.
detailed_review.Other: Mostly, there is no other information, but according to the feel factor, it is the best government, top-1 college to come to.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering + M.Tech.
reviews.review_title: Just some sour truth about my college JNTUH which should be known before joining.

detailed_review.Placements: Nearly 60% of the students got placed with decent package. The highest package offered is 41 LPA. The lowest package offered, it is not said public but it is 4 LPA as per seniors. Average package offered is 21 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Micron, Tata Electronics, CG Power, Kaynes, Schneider, Fest, AM/NS, and Applied Materials. Around 80% in top-tier and core semiconductor courses. Internship companies are Cadence, Synopsys, Mentor (Siemens EDA), Micron, Applied Materials, MacDermid Alpha Electronic Solutions, and Trumpf. Top roles offered are analog design engineer, process engineer, digital designer, semiconductor R&D intern, electrical engineer, nanotechnology researcher, and VLSI engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are average. Wi-Fi is slow, and library is good. I am a day scholar, I eat food in afternoon in hostel and its good. Canteen is not maintained. Medical facilities are good, and sports forget about it.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teaching quality is too low even the lecturers hold good degrees. To be honest, it can't follow old curriculum till now, so we have to do internships from outside. Exams are quite difficult but the corrections are rude (so strict). The examiner won't easily pass you, only nearly 30% get passed.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this college because of the 5 years completion of my higher studies which too in my home state, in the best college. I got 11,000 rank (BCB) in my TG EAPCET so I chose this college. College follows the old syllabus which is now trash in market either should upgrade the syllabus for students to make ready and face the market demand. Events are mostly tech events will suit bookworms, to be honest as I don't get bored seeing them. Fests are just okay, don't expect fests like IITs and NITs it's just normal government college for studying. Campus crowd is less and free scholarship you get according to your income certificate. If you got a rank below 10,000 in TG EAPCET. Campus surroundings are good. The only thing I like about my college is that it is surrounded by trees and fresh atmosphere. Very few extracurricular activities are encouraged here.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placement and satisfied with the faculty members.

detailed_review.Placements: Maximum number of students have been placed every year from our college. Internships are mostly done by students on their own. Top roles obtained by our students would be great and satisfy them. Top recruiting companies would be Well Education.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college has good quality of sports. Hostel food is also better than other colleges. They will clean our hostel rooms every day. Medical facilities are also available in our college. Sports and games are also held as per our interests, according to the time given.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our college has good and excellent percentage. Teachers are very helpful to the students here. If they need any help, they will provide everything you want. Semester examinations are usually held after 6 months in our college. Pass percentage would be 60% mostly every year.
detailed_review.Other: I will definitely want people to join our college.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering + M.Tech.
reviews.review_title: Review of Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University, Hyderabad.

detailed_review.Placements: 90% of the students got placed last year. The highest package offered to students is 50 LPA, and the lowest package offered is 3.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course are  MathWorks, DE Shaw, etc. More than 90% of students got internships from college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Proper Wi-Fi is available at every department. All equipment is available in the college lab. Hostels are above average. The food served there is above average, and the hygiene is maintained. Sports are available at the college, and we can access the ground at any time we want.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very friendly and highly qualified. Semester exams are not that difficult, but corrections are tough enough. The course curriculum is relevant, and it makes students industry-ready. Teaching quality is good.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. in Civil Engineering + M.Tech
reviews.review_title: One of the best universities with good placements and infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: One of my parallels got placed in DE SHAW for 52 LPA, and in my department, a guy got placed for 16 LPA. Top companies recruiting are L&T, Asian Paints, companies related to construction, companies related to steel structures, and many more. Nearly 80% of people got internships from our department.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Projectors are available in every classroom, the infrastructure is good, greenery is all around the campus, every piece of equipment required related to a course is available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty are well qualified, helpful, and possess strong subject knowledge, ensuring high teaching quality. The curriculum is updated and relevant, effectively preparing students for industrial demands. Semester exams are not that tough, you just need to study well.
detailed_review.Other: I am a civil engineering student from the 2022–2027 batch.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: The best engineering college, good faculty, and excellent placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost all the students got placed with high packages. Nearly 85% of students got placed. The highest and the lowest packages are around 9 LPA to 60 LPA. Top recruiting companies include D. Shaw, Google, Intel, and Microsoft. 90% of students got internships in these companies, like Airtel and Reliance.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good. The hostel is free of cost; labs, classrooms, library. Everything is perfect. The campus has Wi-Fi facilities, free hostel rooms, and free internet. The mess bill should be paid, which is around 1000 per month. Food is also available in the canteen, and hospital facilities are available with an ambulance and sports facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are friendlier than expected. Teaching quality is top-notch. Semester exams are a little bit difficult, but we can overcome this with the help of teachers and regular revision while referring to various books that are available on the campus. This year, the pass percentage is 75%.
detailed_review.Other: Every branch is the best in JNTUH as it is the topmost government university in Telangana and also a tier 1 college. Here is an overview of JNTUH (Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University, Hyderabad) and its main colleges, campuses, and recent updates. The college is stablished in October 1972, JNTUH was the first technological university in India, created by the Andhra Pradesh Legislature. Since the 2008 restructuring, it has become a standalone university serving Telangana with a strong focus on engineering, science, management, and research programs. The main Hyderabad campus spans around 89 acres in Kukatpally.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering + M.Tech.
reviews.review_title: Great college and much to learn.

detailed_review.Placements: More than 80% of students will get placed every year. Top recruiting companies are Mathworks, Silicon Labs, Honeywell, etc. Most of the students got internships at Honeywell core company, and Oracle an IT company. The highest package is around 23 LPA, and the average salary is 2 LPA - 4 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have good facilities and infrastructure in both college and hostel. Digital classrooms, professors guidance in and out of classroom, library 24X7, and even Wi-Fi 24X7. Hostel provides homely food, 24X7 hot water, and will address our issues immediately.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are too good. They are highly skilled. Curriculum is relevant, and it makes students industry ready too. Semester exams are not too difficult. We can pass if we try to start studying atleast 1-2 weeks before semester, and correction depends on the content we write.
detailed_review.Other: Mine is an integrated B.Tech so I thought within 5 years I could complete both M.Tech and B.Tech so I took this course. Every year around April, we organise a students fest, it is the most awaited thing in our college life.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical Engineering
reviews.review_title: The college has decent faculty and good infrastructure but exams are tough.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 50-60% of students are placed in metallurgical engineering at JNTUH. The highest package offered is around 11 LPA, the lowest is 3 LPA and the average package is about 3.5-4 LPA. Top recruiting companies include JSW and Vedanta. About 40% of students received internships mostly in companies like JSW. Visakhapatnam Steel Plant. and Local Manufacturing Unit. Top roles offered are graduate engineer trainee and quality control engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college has good infrastructure with decent classroom facilities and functional laboratories for practical work. Wi-Fi is available in only some academic blocks. The library is well-stocked with books related to metallurgy and other core subjects. Hostels are clean and maintained 5 days a week. The mess food is average but sometimes hygienic. The canteen options are decent. Medical facilities are available on campus and are accessible during emergencies. Sports facilities like a basketball ball court, cricket ground, and indoor games are also present for students.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are knowledgeable and supportive with most having strong academic backgrounds. The teaching quality is decent and they are approachable to doubts. The curriculum is moderately relevant to industry needs though some parts are outdated. Semester exams are very tough and the paper correction is strict, resulting in a low pass percentage. Students need to prepare well in advance to score decent marks and clear all the subjects on time. The pass percentage is low.
detailed_review.Other: Each department organises its fest with a unique name and these events are usually conducted over 2 days. Fests are lively and offer a good break from academics with participation from both students and faculty. The campus crowd is friendly and there are opportunities for extracurricular activities. However, connectivity to the campus from the remote areas could be improved. More industry interaction and technical workshops would also enhance the course experience.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. in Civil Engineering + M.Tech
reviews.review_title: Fantastic and memorable moments are get.

detailed_review.Placements: Mostly, everyone gets a good placement in the college itself. The college provides the highest package is 8.9 LPA, and the lowest is 5.9 LPA. L&T, Recording Civil Design Structure, Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University Hyderabad, College of Engineering and Science, and Technology University of Hyderabad are some of the institutions involved.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All are well, and they give their best. Facilities are fantastic and meet all the needs of the students. The food provided is good, which is mostly provided in the hostels at Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University Hyderabad.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are helpful and well-educated. The placement percentage is 74% at Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University Hyderabad, College of Engineering, Science and Technology, University of Hyderabad, Civil Engineering and Structural Engineering departments.
detailed_review.Other: I am interested in this and need more practical experience. All are available.

highlights.summary:
CV Raman Global University, established in 2020 is located in Bhubaneswar, Odisha. The university, through various departments, offers UG, PG, and various other courses to students. These courses are provided across the Engineering, Management, Science, Law and various other streams.
CV Raman University is ranked 150-200 by NIRF 2024 under the Engineering category, 101-150 by NIRF 2024 under the University category, and 11th by Times 2024 under the Engineering (Private) category. CV Raman Global University is accredited by NBA and with an A Grade by NAAC.
CGU is recognised as a Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation (SIRO) by DSIR, the Government of India. The university has a state-of-the-art infrastructure with several facilities provided to students and teachers. The university has well-equipped laboratories, a cafeteria, auditoriums, a library, academic labs and other facilities. CV Raman Global University offers a training and placement cell to students. The university is visited by top companies such as Ncompass Tech Studio, Cognizant, and other reputed organisations. The University is known for its BTech and MBA courses. reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Really good infrastructure, but it lacks placement.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement is not that good. From my batch, there are almost 800 students only in CSE and allied branches, I'm talking about and out of which till now only 200 are placed. The top recruiters are Infosys and Accenture. The highest package is 9 LPA on campus, and the lowest is 3.6, which is by Infosys.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: No doubt, the infrastructure is very good, they have invested a lot in the infrastructure. The labs and classrooms are all up to the mark. They have a smart screen for each class. But the only bad thing is the hostel's mess food, which is of the worst quality. The hostel rooms are fine.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful and qualified, except for a few. Talking about the curriculum, I think after our batch, it's a bit hectic. Only the soft skill training is useful, and our whole 6th semester has been changed for training, but I didn't find it that useful. Semester exams are easy to pass.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course in 2022. The best thing would be that I get to know more about this field and explore new things. If the placements had been better, I think then only it can be considered a good college.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics & Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: It's an average college, but you can still consider it.

detailed_review.Placements: I am not certain about the overall placement statistics for the B.Tech programme. However, in recent years, the electronics and communication engineering branch has achieved an approximate placement rate of 85%, with an average package of around 5 LPA. Top recruiting companies for my course are TCS, Infosys, IBM, Accenture, Wipro, Cognizant, Tech Mahindra, Cisco, and Tata Steel. Top roles offered are AIML engineer and cloud engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Circular infrastructure is pretty good, with proper air-conditioned classrooms, comfortable seats, proper workbenches, equipment, and machinery available for a good hands-on experience. All the computers that are provided in the laboratories are high-end for simulations and AIML. There are many clubs that can help in gaining experience. Hostel facilities are below average, although some new hostels have been constructed. The condition of the old one is the worst, and the mess is a nightmare. There are some canteens available all over the campus, which are the lifeline of hostellers. Sports facilities are quite good, there is a dedicated football and cricket ground.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is quite good, they are helpful, but you have to be lucky to find one. Talking about the curriculum, you still have to waste your first year just to enter your domain, but the things taught in the first year are still interesting. The course curriculum is somewhat industry-relevant.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics & Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: You can take admission in this college.

detailed_review.Placements: In my course, Electronics Engineering, 91 percent placement is there, 6–7 LPA in 2024. Top companies were Wipro, Accenture, Apollo, IBM, etc. I have no idea about the internship programs. Many top roles are there, you can participate in any of the competitions and if you win, you can get a chance to go for state or national level.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus is very good, neat and clean, and the campus is fully Wi-Fi enabled. The classrooms are also very good, in fact, many of the classrooms are fully air-conditioned. The library is also very good, you can borrow books from the library. The food is called average. The medical facility is also very good here, with 24*7 ambulance service of the university.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very good and very helpful. The teachers have done Masters in their subjects, all teachers are well qualified and the teaching quality is also good. The pass percent is 40 percent, and if your attendance is less than 75 percent, they will not allow you to give your exam. If you have a reason, they will allow you.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Satisfied with faculty. Placements are average. If you study hard, you can get placed.

detailed_review.Placements: This is my second semester. The minimum percentile should be 7. Infosys comes here. Recently this year, the maximum placement is 45 LPA, so, it is good.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Many hostels are good. Many are not that good, so they can be called average. The course is nice, and Wi-Fi and library are good. Medical facilities and an ambulance are always available. The canteen is not good at all. In sports, not all sports are good because of the players, but the volleyball team is at the state level. Everything is good, but there is no good food in or outside the campus unless you cook by yourself.
detailed_review.Faculty: Semester exams are moderate to difficult. They help to clear your concepts even more. Teachers are very helpful. The quality of teachers is very good. Most teachers are helpful, but some are not good. Others manage in their place, so it is no big deal. Faculty is top-notch.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science & Information Technology
reviews.review_title: Can't say that it's a bad college, just needs improvement in its environment.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement percentage is different for every branch. For example, like last year, the ECE students had 100% placement, whereas the Computer Science and allied branches had an overall placement of 75-80% with very few securing above 5 LPA. This year's placement is ongoing, where Infosys is offering a 3.5 LPA package to approximately 80 students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel facility is quite good with different categories, single bed, 2 bed, 3 bed, 4 bed and more, with the hostel fees according. The Wi-Fi is available in the hostel. The food in the hostel mess is manageable, like not very good, but also will not make you sick, it's like tasteless food without salt. The non-veg served in the mess is quite good and is prepared well. The classroom and labs are very good with the latest equipment and top-notch facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers in CV Raman are okay, they have done their M.Tech from IIT, but not all are good. Some teach nicely and slowly, some just finish fast, and we don't understand much. Teaching quality feels mixed. The course is useful, but some parts feel old and do not match real company work. Students need to study extra to be industry-ready. Semester exams are not very hard. Questions are simple, and many students pass easily. The Pass percentage is high.
detailed_review.Other: I was interested in computer Science and its applications, and this college was not very far from my home, so I chose this course. The course curriculum is good. Every Saturday is for college clubs and extracurricular activities, so no classes on that day. The campus crowd is not good, nobody interferes in anyone else's life, like there is no senior-junior interaction, and everyone minds their own business.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Absolutely dissatisfied the faculty and facilities good infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Most of placements are from a CS background. Infosys Tech Mahindra, Cisco IBM etc are the top recruiters. Not much internship but those who perform get a good chance of opportunities with CSE CORE. There are allied branches like AIML AIDS Cybersecurity & IoT.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are good. Classes and labs are the only things that are worth it in college. Mostly the EE lab is worthwhile because it has lots of good and quality machines. Mess food is not so good for protein its only for being alive. One good thing is that it has 1 cricket and 1 football ground. There are opportunities for indoor games also which are organised by their own clubs.
detailed_review.Faculty: There are some good faculty members and some are like out of mind. Teachers are helpful but their way of understanding is not good. Curriculum is relevant. They need to upgrade. They teach Chemistry to a CS background. Difficult is medium mostly student pass it easily.
detailed_review.Other: They do not know what the event fest all about. The worst nothing good at all and Roshni night in Diwali they banned it. Only this college is left with elegance in which no celebrity comes. They are doing well after taking 3LPA.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering (AI and Machine Learning)
reviews.review_title: Dissatisfied with teaching faculty, very much worried about placement, and infrastructure is good.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 70 percent of students are placed. The highest package is 45 LPA, but it is just in pen and paper and on online website it is off campus package not on campus. The lowest package is 2 LPA - 3 LPA, and average is 4 LPA - 6 LPA. Recruiting companies are Wipro, Infosys, Cognizant, etc. 50-60 percent of students got internships at Infosys, Wipro, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available everywhere on campus. It has a digital classroom. Library is good but non-AC. Labs are not good enough. Food quality is average. Hostel rooms are very congested. The bad thing is that there are no medical facilities on the campus. Sports and games are good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are not good, not intelligent enough like out of 10, 5 are good. The non-teaching staffs are not helpful. They don't make us industry-ready. Semester exams are difficult and very strict also. The passing mark is 40 percent. They teach us to complete the syllabus.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because future demanding course. I think better faculty members are needed. Fests are not occurring properly.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering (AI and Machine Learning)
reviews.review_title: My experience with CGU is great and enriching.

detailed_review.Placements: The passing-out batch is 2025. 70-90 percent of students get placements in this course at our college. The highest package is 35 LPA. The lowest package is 4 LPA. The average package is 5.6 LPA. The top recruiting companies for our course are Honda, TVS, Cognizant, and others.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities here are very satisfactory and of high quality. It has a CAD lab, which is very useful for students interested in 3D and 2D design. There are many computer labs for CSE students to do programming. There is a BEE lab to learn about electrical and electronics courses. Wi-Fi is available on the campus. The food at the canteen is good, but there are not many varieties. There is also a food court. A dispenser provides free basic primary treatment, and there is a free ambulance facility.
detailed_review.Faculty: The college has experienced and average teachers. Teachers in the CSE department are very helpful and friendly. They do their best to teach, but some students do not pay attention in class. Many students struggle in the first year, but later 60% of students pass.
detailed_review.Other: The best thing about the course is the combination of core Computer Science principles with specialized AI and Machine Learning skills. Which prepares you for diverse, in-demand roles in fields like Data Science, robotics, and software engineering across many industries.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Excellent decision for any individual thinking about joining this college.

detailed_review.Placements: 95 percent of our students have been placed. The lowest is 4 LPA, average is 7 LPA, and the highest is 38 LPA. Recruiting companies are TCS, Wipro, Tech Mahindra, Infosys, IBM, and L&T. 75 percent of students got internships at Accenture. It depends on their respective domain.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It has excellent infrastructure with Wi-Fi, AC, study table, individual desks for study, and individual godrej for keeping things. There are digital classrooms with high-quality benches and AC classrooms. Wi-Fi is enabled.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are most helpful and supportive. They come from different types of IIT and NIT colleges. They are fully knowledgeable with high quality teaching. This course curriculum is relevant and updated for every batch. It makes the students industry to go next level. Exams are too easy as our teachers are much supportive with their knowledge and experience. The pass percentage is 95 percent.
detailed_review.Other: As this course is better in the market in recent times. No better course is required for this course CSE as it is excellent in our college. Events and fests are held every year. Every occasion and extracurricular activities are conducted. Sports meet is also held every year to encourage students by physically fit.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
reviews.review_title: Above average, if you do not get any GFTI or any other good private college then you can opt for it.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement is average as compared to all the decent tier 3 private colleges in India. Top recruiting companies are TCS, Infosys, Cognizant, Wipro, etc. Top role offered is software engineer. Average package is 6 LPA - 6.5 LPA. 85-90 percent of students are placed in B.Tech course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classes are good. Wi-Fi is available across all campus, but runs smoothly in hotels. AC is available in labs. Classroom have smart and white boards both. Hotels are as per your requirement. If you give more money then you will get good faculty members. Mess food is average.
detailed_review.Faculty: Quality of teachers is above average. In 1st year we are getting more assignments and quizzes. There are practical classes of 3 hours which are helpful to students. Overall a weak schedule is held. Semester exams are not much difficult. If you study you can get good CGPA.
detailed_review.Other: Events are organised rarely, one or two in a year.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: In short, the college is a good choice for you for your UG course for the next 4 years.

detailed_review.Placements: As asked from seniors and known from other sources, the average stands at 4 to 5LPA. Some students also got placed with an annual of 9.75LPA. Big techs like Cisco, JP Morgan visited for the academic year batch of 2020 to 2025 and recruited students up to 25LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms are maintained well and ventilated, most CS labs are air conditioned, and Wi-Fi conditions are good, but they need to be improved. The mess food is good, but it also needs to be improved. Moreover, the hostel rooms are also well maintained and in line with modern architecture.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty is kind of good and experienced, with some assistant professors as new joinees who provide ample amount of knowledge and good lectures within the day, and assignments and quizzes headache is not there very commonly. The student teacher interaction goes well in the classroom.
detailed_review.Other: Events are mainly organised at big festivals such as Diwali and Holi. And the main event, which is the college fest, is celebrated every year, thats the elegance.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: For B.Tech, it’s a good college, not the best, but good.

detailed_review.Placements: According to my seniors, placements are good, but not as good as you might expect. Companies do come, but it depends on how well you prepare. Enough companies visit, some with low packages, some with high, and it depends on how skilled and hardworking the student is.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In my opinion, hostel and mess food is good. I’ve seen on social media that some say the college food is the worst, but I think it’s good. They need to add some variety, like milk, tea, extra snacks, or a better morning breakfast, sometimes they give only one dosa, which is very little in quantity, not taste.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very good. If you listen carefully, all exam answers are discussed in class, so you don’t need to study overnight, If you talk to them nicely, they are the best in your eyes. They are well-educated, not all, but they try to help everyone pass the exams.
detailed_review.Other: All students are good, and there is no ragging here. Nice campus.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics & Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Well, my college is an average college with some good faculty.

detailed_review.Placements: In my course, I am not sure about the placement percentage, and I’m also not sure about the highest, lowest, and average package. Well, Qualcomm, AMD, and JSPL are the top recruiting companies for our course. The major roles offered are VLSI design engineer and embedded system engineer. Almost 60% of students got internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Well, our classrooms are fully air-conditioned, and we have many labs in our ECE department, we have an average-sized library with a moderate Wi-Fi connection, the hostels are good, fully air-conditioned, and even have a badminton court inside. The food is okay, but not good enough.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are really helpful and knowledgeable. The course curriculum is relevant and does make students ready for upcoming industry challenges. The exams in my college are moderate, not too difficult, and there is a high pass percentage depending on your performance.
detailed_review.Other: I chose the ECE branch because it provides opportunities in both hardware and software work lines.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering (Data Science)
reviews.review_title: Absolutely dissatisfied because of faculty and college team, including security and campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 75% students get placement according to college. The lowest is 2.45 LPA. The college does not refer you or train you for internship. If you want that background, you have to apply in different college and get internship.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are like normal lower class facilities. Wi-Fi is not working properly. Classrooms are not like an engineering college. Library is decent. Low-level facilities are present in hostel, not fun. Nothing else. Food is average according to me.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some teachers are very well behaving, and others are behaving like it is their own college. Security guards behave like your father bad college. No, this course curriculum is not relevant. No semester exam is good, but teachers don't tell you what is coming or what is important, only come, get the attendance, read some PPT, and go.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science & Information Technology
reviews.review_title: Incredibly satisfied with college infrastructure, its academic, its placement in 2025, really good.

detailed_review.Placements: SEE, if you talk about the placement in CV Raman College, the placement comes top notch. The obvious placement for CSE branches goes minimum 5 LPA and ranges till 35 LPA like JP Morgan, and sometimes Microsoft also comes. Overall, I am satisfied with TPO of college. Also, the placement of other branches is really excellent like Adani, Voltas, L&T, Bosch, Siemens, and other core companies have visited the campus placement a lot of times and have taken handful of students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I tell you, all across Odisha, the best infrastructure for classes or hostel is holding C V Raman College. The girls hostel has already a lot of facilities like shopping complex, stationery shops, and all shops within it. Boys hostel has same again things, parallel consisting of gaming areas, sports complex inside hostel. Now, talking about the college premises and infrastructure that holds academic, it's excellent. You will have all AC classes, fully digital, new methods, really good.Now talking about the college premises and infrastructure that holds academic it's excellent, you will have all acs classes fully digital new methods really good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are so knowledgeable that they will guide you not only for your academic courses but also for competitions like GATE, WorldSkills. All faculty members are mostly Ph.D. and really good faculty members. Course curriculum is relevant, helpful for GATE exam. Semester exams are moderate level if you study well enough.
detailed_review.Other: I chose B.Teach because my whole family has studied from CV Raman College because of its amazing infrastructure and academic, also most important, its placement. Fest is the best deal of college. I enjoyed the CElegance fest a lot.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good infrastructure and facilities, but still something needs to be improved, like mess food.

detailed_review.Placements:
As far as I know, 90% of students got placed in 2023. The highest package was 37.7 LPA, and the average package is 4-5 LPA. Companies recruiting are cognizant, Deloitte, Bajaj, Accenture, TCS, Infosys, etc.
Top roles offered are software developer, engineer, data scientist, data analyst, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are more than enough. Bus facilities are available for students belonging to CTK and BBSR. Library is present, and anyone can borrow books. AC classrooms are there. AC labs are there. Mess food is below average. Washrooms are clean and don't smell bad.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very good and helpful. All are highly qualified from IITs and NITs. Teaching staff have no ego or attitude. You can ask them doubts without hesitating. Course curriculum is relevant, and it's very helpful for students to be industry-ready. Semester exams are average, no need to be toppers only. Questions come from the question bank provided by teachers. Pass percentage is 80% or above every sem.
detailed_review.Other:
Too many events take place on holiday, Saturday and Sunday.
So many clubs are there for everyone. Chess, carrom, volleyball, cricket clubs, etc., are there too. Still, some things can be improved, like the back gate, management system, roads and drainage system of the college.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: College is okay. It should provide good placement, good labs, teachers, and infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80-90% of students get placed. The highest package offered is 12 LPA by Amazon. The lowest package offered by Infosys is 3.6 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course are Infosys, TCS, Mindtree, Capgemini, and Accenture. Approximately 70-80% of students secured internships. Top roles offered are software developer, software engineer, and software tester.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are okay. Classrooms are good. Labs are equipped with the necessary requirements in good condition. The library is clean and quiet with a lot of material to help. Hostels are of two types, one is a new boys hostel that is like a typical hostel, and the other is an apartment hostel, which is good and properly cleaned. Sports and games are conducted regularly.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some teachers were helpful, some were a bit distant. But overall helpful if reached out. The quality of teaching was mediocre for almost all teachers. Senior faculty members were exceptional, with impeccable knowledge and advice to help us in the long run. The course curriculum is relevant to today's technology. Semester exams are easy, and the pass percentage is 33%.
detailed_review.Other: I am interested in CSE, so I chose it. The best part of this course is getting knowledge about programming and coding. I wish more lab classes were included to get the benefit of the improvement of the course. Events and fests were organised, and they were helpful to us.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The college is good for nothing.

detailed_review.Placements: About 75% of students get placed this year. The highest package is 10 LPA, and the lowest package is 1.5 LPA. The average package is 3 LPA. TCS is the top recruiting or mass selector company. 56% of students got internships from our college. The top role offered is a software developer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are average. The infrastructure is also average. Wi-Fi and labs are good. Classrooms are the worst. In the BS and CS buildings, there is no AC. Facilities are good, but every work or problem is solved at the speed of a tortoise. The food served is below average. Medical facilities are also average. Sports are encouraged here.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are qualified but not able to explain properly. The course curriculum is not relevant. This course does not make students industry-ready because the curriculum is very old. Semester exams are medium to hard. Everyone has to study for the semester exams. The pass percentage is 33%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I want to join Google. Nothing is good here. I have learn everything myself. Everything should be better. Very few events are organised, and we are not aware of them.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Long distance between departments.

detailed_review.Placements: In the year 2024,  35% of CSE students got placed. Highest package might be 86 LPA, lowest package is 4 LPA offered by our course. Top companies are Wipro, Infosys, TCS, Microsoft, Intel, and others. To be honest, I am not well familiar with the role they gave us in placement.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Labs are fabulous. You get a well-maintained lab with smart attachments. Classrooms are getting better after January 2025. Wi-Fi is better in hostel, lab, and library than in classroom. In hostel, you get good rooms, but hostel food might be average, but not every day of week.
detailed_review.Faculty: I don't get enough words to express qualities of teaching and research. They are very good in all sectors. Semester exams are held at the proper time. But instead of preparing for semester, you might get busy with the assignments, which is a headache.
detailed_review.Other: I have chosen this course because I want to make some things valuable in the future, not just for me, but also for the people I belong to.

reviews.course: B.Sc. in Agriculture
reviews.review_title: College is the best because of faculty and the worst because of politics.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 50% of students got placed. The highest package is 5 LPA and the lowest is 1 LPA. Fertilizer and agro-based companies are recruiting. Top roles are in banking, law, and civil services. Agriculture is a developing sector in India, so there is much scope in which you can go into and enjoy the future.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are good with infrastructure and excellent teachers. You'll love learning. Wi-Fi is also available in labs with equipment. You are free to use and rest all the equipment, although for some practical reasons, they ask us to get our equipment at our own expense.
detailed_review.Faculty: As I said, the teachers are very good at their work and you'll enjoy learning. They are well-qualified and knowledgeable. They are passionate about teaching. The course curriculum is also relevant. Although you have to be industry-ready by yourself, with the teacher's guidance.
detailed_review.Other: Fests are yearly organized and the campus is happening.
