reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Information Technology
reviews.review_title: Good infrastructure, strong academics, and decent placements at IIIT, Gwalior.

detailed_review.Placements: More than 90% batch is placed. The highest package is 80 LPA from LinkedIn, and the lowest goes till 6-7 LPA. Top recruiters are DeShaw, Google, Uber, Media.net, and many more. Around 30% batch gets intern, intern, season, and top roles are SDE and business analyst.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The department has well-equipped labs, smart classrooms, a library, and campus-wide Wi-Fi. Hostels are decent with basic facilities, food quality is average, medical care is available, and sports facilities support indoor and outdoor games and others.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are generally helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. Teaching quality is good, with a mix of theory and practical examples. The curriculum is relevant and provides a solid foundation, though students need self-learning to be fully industry-ready. Semester exams are moderately difficult, and the pass percentage is fairly high.
detailed_review.Other: I belong to a diverse and motivated batch with students from different backgrounds, which created a good learning environment. I chose this course due to my interest in technology and career opportunities. The best part is skill-based learning and exposure. More industry tie-ups and updated tools would improve it. The campus hosts regular events, fests, and extracurricular activities. Has good connectivity, a lively crowd, and a supportive campus environment with scholarship options available.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. in Information Technology + MBA
reviews.review_title: Satisfied with the facilities provided, and the placement is really good and improving every year.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement is nice. There are a lot of opportunities provided by the college to get placed. The placement record is good, too. The only thing is that many off-campus offers are included. Overall, the Training and Placement Cell (TPC) here has experienced staff who have pretty solid connections, hence bringing ample offers to the college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostels for first-year students are more recently built, hence are better than any college compared. The hostels that are allotted for the later-year students are old. There are lots of things which don't meet the expectations, like the old fan connections and all. The mess is pretty decent for all hostels. Wi-Fi and LAN connections sometimes have a few little fluctuations, like any other college, but overall, they are nice.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum is sure a little hectic, but at the same time, it is updated to the latest technologies, and this makes it better when compared to other colleges' obsolete curricula. The exams are held twice a semester and are pretty much manageable. There are many talented faculty with a passion for what they wanna teach, which is good. Overall, the course is good and not useless in terms of industry standards.
detailed_review.Other: The events and festival culture are best here. There are many sports events held (at least two in a year), and there is a fest held once a year or every two years, which is a techno-cultural fest and has a very large number of participants and includes all ranges of events and competitions in that.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. in Information Technology + MBA
reviews.review_title: First established the IIIT under the MOE.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 95% of the students were placed by the placement cell. The on-campus placements were almost 67%, and the remaining were off-campus. According to the RTI, we got to know that the minimum package was 7 LPA, which was received by a 2-year MBA student, and the highest package received was 65 LPA in every branch, and the average package was around 28 LPA. Internships were given by many top-level companies such as Google, DE Shaw, and many more. The most prominent roles offered were related to SDE.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have a library with AC equipped in it, and we also have a Wi-Fi-enabled campus reaching 50 Mbps in the worst areas. Labs are very well-equipped, and the computer lab is the best of all, having the best configuration of systems and almost more than 200 PCs of that configuration that are very easily accessible.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum is a bit hectic, but our college is more focused on academics, as the course involves many related subjects; we do not have any of the general Science subjects, so we do not have to study those subjects that will not be useful for us. Sem exams are a bit easy, but the attendance criteria are mandatory for all. In our batch, 100% were promoted to the next year, but a couple (~1%) had to retake a subject, so you will not fail any subject.
detailed_review.Other: The city is not as great as Mumbai or Delhi, but the campus is full of happening, great events year-round, and the crowd is very top-notch. Many seniors are into teaching and are also very easily accessible. The clubs in the college are much more active, and you can participate in any club and become a part of it.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Really good infrastructure and placements.

detailed_review.Placements: 98.21% of students passed out this year from our college. Highest package is 67 LPA, the lowest package is 10 LPA, and the average is 24 LPA. Top recruiting companies from our campus are Google, Grow, Microsoft, and Meesho. Google also hires students for internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Library is very good. All kinds of books are available there, and you can also issue books for yourself. Wi-Fi routers are provided, and internet speed is also quite good. Classrooms are air-conditioned. Labs are also maintained properly. Food is not as good as it should be, and in mess after sometimes quality degrades. There are 3 canteens where you can eat. Medical facilities are available. There is a doctor present at his time, and you can consult him in case of small injuries.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful and qualified. Most of them have done PhD's and they are available at their cabins for doubt solving. I find a problem in understanding their language, and it causes quite trouble but they do support our projects and all. The curriculum is relevant and very suitable for a student pursuing software development. Students do make industry reach by following the curriculum. Semester exams are not so hard generally but I would say they are between moderate to difficult. Passing percentage is 35%.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Large campus area, top-notch placements, hostels and mess food can be improved.

detailed_review.Placements: Due to less number of branches, placements are excellent. In this year (2025), 97.76% of students got placed. 38 students got above 50+ LPA. The highest salary is 67.5LPA, and average salary is 28 LPA. Top recruiters are Google, Cisco, etc. Almost 80-85% of students got internships. Top role offered is SDE.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good, but the boys hostels are not so good because the hostels require renovation as they get older. All the necessary facilities are available for living in hostels, like Wi-Fi (sometimes there may be some problem but mostly good with upto 80-90 Mbps speed), classrooms are fully air-conditioned with proper sitting arrangements, and library is also there, which is also fully air-conditioned. Mess food is okay. Medical facilities are available, whenever required. All the sports grounds are available on the campus like basketball court, lawn tennis court, cricket ground, kabaddi ground, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are supportive and expert in their respective fields. About 80-85% faculty members are Ph.D. holders. They are helpful for suggesting study materials, answering questions regarding the course, and solving doubts regarding academics. As it is an IIIT so the academics are hectic like other IIITs. In 1st semester, you may feel that the subjects are not relevant to your branch, but in further semester subjects will be branch-specific. Courses are really good and enough to be industry-ready. Semester exams are not that tough. You may score high to study 1 day before exams (but not recommended). Pass percentage is 95-98%.
detailed_review.Other: I am a student of CSE branch. I chose this course because it is not much far from my home (I live in Delhi). The placements are really fascinating. Campus area is awesome like other IIIT, it is a government IIIT. Fee is lower than other IIITs. So CSE is considered a very good branch, no improvement is required in the mid-term exam. Campus is located on the main highway so the surroundings are really awesome. Fests and events are very enthusiastic and enjoyable, and famous artists come for concerts. All the management is done by students and SAC department.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. in Information Technology + MBA
reviews.review_title: Fantastic placements in 2025, but I am dissatisfied with the hostel.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of people placed is about 97%. The highest is 56.5 LPA, and the lowest is about 7.5 LPA. Top recruiters are Google, Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, Samsung, Atlassian, Deloitte, Goldman Sachs, and Oracle. I think the percentage of people who got internships is about 90%; they mostly got them from the same companies that offered those placements at startups. The most common roles offered for my course are product manager and software engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have a huge library and labs for each professor and their research. We also have Wi-Fi in hostels and in the academic block, where all the departments and lecture halls are present. We have various types of classrooms of differing capacities, ranging from 60 to 200, some of which have plug points at each seat. Each classroom is enabled by Wi-Fi. The first-year hostel is very good, and the hostels from the 2nd year onwards are average. The mess quality keeps varying, but it is mostly good. There is a dedicated health center, and there are facilities for various sports.
detailed_review.Faculty:
Some professors are good, some just do it for the job. The course curriculum is updated every 4-5 years and is very up to date and relevant
The pass percentage is about 90% on the first try and exams and grading is fairly easy and tests the comprehensive understanding of the course.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course simply because it was the one with the highest placement, which I was getting through the JEE. The things I wish were better are the hostels, and I would also like it if the number of selections were increased.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mathematics and Scientific Computing
reviews.review_title: Strong academics and good placements, but infrastructure and campus life need improvement.

detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is not very good, but as this is the oldest IIIT, it has the infrastructure of 1997, so it’s pretty old. New hostels are definitely good and well-equipped, while the old ones are okay. There are also some hostels in progress, which seem pretty good. The library is very good, and the classrooms have AC installed.
detailed_review.Faculty: About the faculty, I would say it depends. Not every professor is good, but not every professor is bad either. Some are very helpful and supportive in nature. They will help you with other stuff beyond studies too. The curriculum is pretty nice, and the core part is focused and given good weightage. Exams are also held normally and strictly.
detailed_review.Other: Campus life is not very bright here, but decent, as there are not so many branches and people. The campus is not that crowded or vibrant. But compared to other IIITs, the campus life is good. The crowd is super, everyone has mastered something. Mostly, none are dumb here. Everyone is so talented.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Information Technology
reviews.review_title: IIIT Gwalior - A perfect college.

detailed_review.Placements: There are product-based companies that come for summer internships and placements like DE Shaw, Google, Curve Fit, and American Express. These are some top and permanent companies that always visit our college every year. Almost all students get placed. Even those who remain unplaced at the end of the placement season eventually get placed. Companies used to visit even at the end of the placement season. Also, 95% of students get placed. Software developers, cloud engineers, and system engineers are some of the top and common roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good; a new hostel is also under construction and is expected to be completed by 2026. A new hospital is also being built. We have a huge college divided into two parts: Pockets A and Pockets B, connected with an underpass. The infrastructure is very cool. In the hostel, we get 24/7 internet, also wireless, so you are always connected to the internet. Coolers are allowed, and we have fully air-conditioned lecture halls, classrooms, and a library.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very good and knowledgeable. They all have PhDs from top IITs, some from IIIT and NIT. Also, some professors even have their postdocs from abroad. The course curriculum is versatile and gives you an overview of all engineering core subjects. Exams are moderate, and professors are good; they teach up to the gate level. Some of the students appear under 300-400 each year in GATE.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because it is versatile in terms of engineering courses. It does not give you the feel of only the software part, but also of communication and even some hardware parts. So I think information technology is more versatile than CS; that is why I chose this course. The crowd is smaller in our college, but new branches like mathematics, computing science, and electronics have been introduced. In the future, they are planning to acquire students for different branches.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. in Information Technology + MBA
reviews.review_title: Satisfied, as it provides good campus life, lovely fests, active clubs, excellent placements, etc.

detailed_review.Placements: This year, 214 out of 224 students are placed successfully. Specifically, the average of our batch this year is 28.49 LPA, and the median is around 25 LPA, with the highest being 54 LPA. Because of the MBA integrated program, many students got offers for techno-managerial roles in the company. This year, integrated branches had a higher average package than the BCS branch.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I would say the infrastructure is old. The obvious reason is this is the oldest IT, so the buildings are pretty old. But the interior of the academic buildings is good. Also, the library is very nice here. With its infrastructure and vast variety of books, this library has everything you need. Hostels are a little on the low side. For first-year students, hostels are pretty good, but after the first year, you get either single or double sharing rooms. The rooms are okay, not so good I would say, but the lobbies are congested. There is little room for airflow, so some people don’t like it.
detailed_review.Faculty: It’s an objective question. It depends on you also. Some faculty members are very good, and some are not. Some help you in non-academic stuff too, but some are the opposite. Mostly, if you try to get along, you will understand their teaching, otherwise, not. About exams, it’s fine. It’s like normal college midterms and end terms. Some teachers change the weightage of practicals if they feel the course is more practical-based than theory. That’s the good side of professors and exams. However some professors focus mainly on theory, which may be a headache.
detailed_review.Other: I would say it depends on your batch. But most probably, you will enjoy it here. The crowd is a little bit study-oriented, but it’s a good one. Supporting each other, everyone grows together. Make a good friend circle and you’re set to go for the next 4–5 years. Campus life is good. Very minimal restrictions, a good and big campus, cool people, everything is good. Even fests held here are awesome. There are technical fests, cultural fests, techno-cultural fests, and many small functions keep happening now and then.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: Average plus a good college.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80%-90% of students get placed depending upon course and batch. The highest salary package offered ranges from 40 LPA - 80 LPA. The average salary package offered ranges from 25 LPA-  20 LPA and the lowest salary package offered ranges from 5 LPA - 10 LPA. Our best courses are IMT, BEE, and BCS. Many skillful people got internships in their second years and coding is much focused here.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities available are Wi-Fi, labs, air-conditioned classrooms, and a big library named LRC. Mess food is average. There is a big sports complex, a cricket ground, a swimming pool, and many clubs.
detailed_review.Faculty: We have the best teachers. They focus more on study and coding. Semester exams are not much difficult as normal here. Professor is passed from IIT, NIT, and IIIT. Professors are PhD holders.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mathematics and Scientific Computing
reviews.review_title: Don't expect much; you will be disappointed and good in terms of placement.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost around 90 percent of students are placed from our college. The highest package is around 60 LPA with an average of 21 LPA. The lowest package is about 8 LPA. Top recruiting companies of IIITM Gwalior are Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, Deloitte, Google, etc. The first batch of our branch, Mathematics and Scientific Computing, started in 2023, and they are still just in the 2nd year, so there is no information about internships for our branch. But Mathematics and Scientific Computing is similar to CSE with some more mathematics courses. Thank you.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms and library are good. Many useful books are available in the library. Labs are okay, average. Hostel is not much good but adjustable. No Wi-Fi is good here, and the mess food is bad; it's below average. The sports club is good, and it's okay for playing sports. Canteens are available to eat your favourite food. Canteens are also not the best but average.
detailed_review.Faculty: Every teacher has a different style of teaching. Some will teach perfectly, and some are not understandable. They are helpful and qualified enough. Course subjects are good and useful. Semester exams are average in terms of toughness. We can write well with some preparation.
detailed_review.Other: I chose Mathematics and Scientific Computing because of my interest in Maths. Many small fests are conducted, and I suggest this college if you are more interested in studying further than expecting an enjoyable B.Tech life. You will be disappointed if you expect the best B.Tech life in terms of hills and enjoyment.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Information Technology
reviews.review_title: Really happy to take the course. Also happy to see the placements of this year.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement statistics of our college are pretty good. The placement is growing at a good rate after COVID. This year many big companies came to visit our campus, like Google, Meesho, Deshaw, Uber, etc. The average package of our college is around 25 lakhs per annum.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is well maintained. All the rooms and labs are air conditioned. We have WiFi at our hostels and classes. We have full access to them. Sometimes the internet is not stable. Overall, it works fine. The food quality totally depends upon the mess committee. Sometimes responses are taken late. There are also cases of food poisoning as well.
detailed_review.Faculty: All the faculty are PHD holders in our college. There is strict criteria of 75% attendance . Although the leniency also depends upon the faculty who is taking the course. Some care about attendance over grades, while some don't. Some are very strict in giving grades, while some give good grades easily. Overall, the paper pattern is easy and it is quite easy to score good marks with even less preparation.
detailed_review.Other: The course was the best I could get at my rank. Additional to it, it was a five-year course , so I didn't have to care about my masters later. The college organizes a variety of fests. You will never feel bored of it. The college intakes only 1500 students every year. The campus is huge as compared to students. You might sometimes feel alone unless you make good friends . The campus is pretty close to the main market. Malls and shopping complexes are pretty nearby.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good college but sometimes regret choosing this college because of a few circumstances.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements in our college are good. Well, that is when we consider a specific domain like web or app development. The in-campus placements mainly are for the above two-mentioned domains and most of the students here also pursue the same. As for other domains, there are very few offers and it would be better to try off-campus.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The buildings are a bit old. Well, there are a total of 5 hostels for boys and one hostel for girls. Among the five hostels there are two for the first years of B.Tech and the remaining three are for the second, fourth, and fifth years and M.Tech and Ph.D. students.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are helpful and the curriculum is good. Well, that is public opinion and for us students, we don't even understand why we have a few specific courses which won't be of use to us at all. They make us learn engineering drawing in the first semester and that's it we don't use it anywhere. Most courses are either taught in c, cpp or Java.
detailed_review.Other: The crowd and campus life. Well if you get your gang together quickly you could have a fun college life. There would be interaction with seniors and the seniors are also very helpful.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Information Technology
reviews.review_title: The institute has a peaceful vibe and is quite big compared to other IIITs.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement percentage at the IIITM Gwalior is high. The placement percentage for Integrated B.Tech+ M.Tech IT is 90.91%. The highest package in IMT was 65 LPA, the average package was 22.6 LPA, and the lowest package was 7 LPA. Top recruiting companies here are Amazon and Samsung.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: First-year students got a separate hostel called SATPURA, which is situated just outside the main campus. It's a 3-seater hostel. Wi-Fi, particularly in hostels, is very poor; we get very low internet speed. The library building is quite big but has books only related to the courses available, as it has much space to accommodate more books. Classrooms and labs are quite good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers teaching here are well qualified from reputed institutes and have their respective PhDs in their area. But some teachers are not quite good at teaching, while others are. The curriculum is very loaded with many classes and labs. Usually classes are from 9 to 4 pm, and sometimes 9 to 6 pm also.
detailed_review.Other: I simply chose this because it is the best I can get based on my JEE rank. It is the oldest, so I chose it. The first-year curriculum is full of irrelevant subjects, though it gives a chance to explore, but I feel it is unnecessary. There are many festivals and clubs. Campus is very less crowded; it has only 1500 total students. They offer scholarships based on your academic performance and provide various extracurricular activities.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Information Technology
reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with the faculty members and placements. Average in mess and Wi-Fi.

detailed_review.Placements: Above 90% students are placed off and on campus combined. The highest package offered is 65 LPA, the lowest is 6 LPA, and the average is 22.68 LPA. This year, in spite of the recession, it is a good figure. Top recruiting companies are Meesho, DE Shaw, Macari, etc. About 70% students got a chance for internships in companies like TCS, Infosys, etc. Top roles offered in the course are SDE, consultant, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is not so good. It lags too much, labs are well-equipped and have all the things that are required for doing any experiments. Classrooms are too good, they have comfy seats, a central AC system, projectors, and good sound system. Mess food is average but canteen food is way better than it. Colleges have several canteens that provide both vegetarian and non-vegetarian food to students at a minimal cost. Medical facilities are good, they have all types of medicines. If they do not have a solution for the disease, they refer patients to any city hospital, and all costs are covered by the institute itself. Sports and game facilities are way better. Libraries are too good to have all the resources that are needed.
detailed_review.Faculty: All faculty members are Ph.D. holders from premium institutes like IITs, NITs, IISC Bangalore, etc. They are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. Teaching quality is too good. But sometimes it seems that they are fast. The course curriculum is relevant, and it makes the students industry-ready. Semester exam difficulty level is just above medium. Passing CGPA is 6.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: ABV IIITM Gwalior (An Institute of National Importance).

detailed_review.Placements: The average placement of our college is quite impressive. The average CTC for the Computer Science branch is 25 LPA, the average CTC of the 5-year IT program is 23 LPA, and the average CTC of the 5-year IT + MBA program is 18 LPA. Two new branches were added in 2023, so their placements haven't occurred yet. The maximum package from our college is 1.9 crores (international package), and the minimum package is 10.2 LPA. Top companies such as Google, Amazon, Microsoft, DE Shaw, Goldman Sachs, Zomato, Nutanix, Oracle, etc., approach our college in both live and online modes. Top roles such as SDE, CTO, etc., are also offered. Almost every student in our college gets an internship in their field of interest, and seniors help by giving referrals for internships and placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is very good. As our college was established in 1997, it had enough time to develop. Each department has a special block, called A, B, C block. The college provides excellent Wi-Fi connectivity and LAN ports in hostels. The labs in our college are good, having been maintained well over the past 25 years. For the EEE course, which is newly added for B.Tech, we have all the necessary lab equipment. The classrooms in our college are spacious, fully air-conditioned, and equipped with projectors and boards. The library, also termed as LRC (Learning Resource Center), is large and has many books for students preparing for competitive exams as well as for their courses. It is also considered the largest library in Central India.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers and professors at our college are very experienced, as all are Ph.D. graduates with extensive knowledge. It is said that only two institutions in India have all Ph.D. graduate professors: IIT Bombay and IIITM Gwalior. The quality of teaching is excellent; the material is fully understandable if you listen carefully. The course curriculum is relevant. You might hesitate to take admission in a new branch like EEE because their placements have not yet occurred, but you will soon realize that the professors are knowledgeable and the placement cell is effective. Working on your skills is important. The exams are not very difficult, but consistent learning is necessary. Each semester includes two exams: Mid-semester and End-semester. The passing percentage is almost 100 percent, with only a few students failing due to important work or illness.
detailed_review.Other: I also hesitated at first while choosing this course, but after coming here, I realize that I am fully satisfied with my decision. The college campus, hostels, teachers, and most importantly, the coding culture of this college are very good. From the first year, you will gain knowledge about DSA, Web Development, ML, etc. Events such as Aurora (Annual fest), Celestia, Infotsav (Annual technical fest), Urja (Annual sports fest), and others such as Ganesh Chaturthi, Janmashtami, Lohri, etc., are celebrated. Our college is well-connected, being almost 7-8 km from Gwalior Railway Station, 3-4 km from Gwalior Airport, and 2 km from the Bus Station. You can easily reach the college by autorickshaws. The campus is beautiful, full of trees, plants, birds, and even has a biodiversity park. Scholarships are given for maintaining good performance in exams. The first type of scholarship is for the top 5 percent of students in terms of CGPA or JEE Main Rank, which provides a 100 percent waiver in tuition fees and 12 thousand per year. The second type is 3 thousand per month for the next top 10 percent of students. There are many clubs such as AASF (coding club), E-Cell, Rotaract Club, Manchtantra, SGM, IEEE, Uthaan (reporting club).

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Better when compared to other tier 2 NITs and really good infrastructure but not the placements.

detailed_review.Placements: When it comes to the matter of placement at IIITM Gwalior, most students get placed off-campus, with only about 60 percent getting placement within the college. The highest and lowest packages are 55L and 22L, respectively. The top recruiters include Google, Microsoft, Apple, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure at IIITM Gwalior is really awesome. You will enjoy the environment here, full of greenery, etc. The library system here is very good, making every book available. Classrooms are fully air-conditioned, and labs have been equipped very well (for Computer Science alone) since 2023. Sports are really encouraged here, and the sports complex is not equipped very well, but the director has assured that it will be fully equipped by the academic year 2024-25, as the inter-IIIT sports meet is going to be held in this academic year (2024-25). Hostel food is not too tasty, but when it comes to quality, it is better.
detailed_review.Faculty: Only some of the teachers are skillful and dedicated to their professions, but others are just useless. However, in engineering, you need to learn stuff yourself through online resources and books. Everything is available online now; you don't need to depend on the teachers. The courses here are very relevant to your life, but in the 1st year, you will have to learn some useless subjects that don't help you in your career but help you in life. Almost 90 percent of students pass the semester exams, but the 10% who are negligent fail. Exams aren't so tough for a guy who cracks JEE.
detailed_review.Other: The best thing about the course, which is different from other colleges, is that you don't need to learn the useless subjects after the 1st year. Yes, but the disadvantage is that very few events are conducted. But a IIIT's motive is to make a student study, so the events are very few. Scholarship facilities are available, and details about the scholarship are informed to every student to apply before the deadline. The strength of the whole campus is less than 1500, hence there is a great opportunity to interact with every senior who will help you in all ways. Teachers are also available all the time to clarify your doubts.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: IIITM street: A dream college.

detailed_review.Placements: Our college has 100% placements. The highest package in 2022 was 65 LPA. The average package was 22 LPA, and the lowest was 13 LPA for B. Tech CSE branch. Our top recruiters include Goldman Sachs, Nutanix, Google, Generate AI, etc. Several of our students managed to bag internships at big-box companies like Amazon, Walmart, Google, Uber, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is great throughout the campus. Ethernet is available too in hostels. Hostel facilities are good. Washrooms are cleaned regularly, and a geyser is available. The girls' hostel has only single rooms, which is convenient, and the food is pretty good too. The canteen and non-veg canteen both are great. Basketball court, tennis court, billiards, squash room, badminton court, swimming pool, all facilities are available. On-campus medical facilities are available; you can visit the doc in case of any health issues.
detailed_review.Faculty: Yes, the teachers are quite qualified as it is a must in our college for professors to hold a Ph.D. doctorate. The course curriculum is highly relevant, and subjects that might come in company interviews are all taught as well. It absolutely makes the students corporate-ready with its curriculum, which is updated constantly to include current changes in the industry. Semester exams' difficulty varies according to how one prepares. Pass percentage depends on how everyone in class overall scores as we have a relatively grading policy.
detailed_review.Other: I chose B. Tech CSE here because of its infrastructure and amazing average package. Our college has central India's largest fest called Aurora. We also organize technical events like ARIC and several IEEE events. We have wonderful clubs like Uthaan, E-Cell, AASF, Beathoppers, Manchatantra, and Rotaract club. Given its aesthetic large campus and infrastructure, I would recommend anyone who has IIITM on their mind to join our college without second thoughts because our college is one of the very few IIITs which offer average packages equivalent to IITs and NITs.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Information Technology
reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied because of its good infrastructure and campus life :).

detailed_review.Placements: The placements this year have been quite promising, with over 35 students securing salaries ranging from 30-32 LPA as of September. As far as I know, Amazon has not been participating in campus placements for the past few years; the company has blacklisted this college. However, this hasn't been a significant concern because the majority of the companies visiting here are offering salaries above 20 LPA, even for average students, such as Nutanix, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The air-conditioned classroom is quite surprising; the mess food is good, and a new non-veg cafeteria opened here just started in December 2023. However, the sports complex needs renovation. The plaster on the wall got broken, and the gym is not that good. But nowadays, they are also focusing on sports, so it will develop soon.
detailed_review.Faculty: From 2022, some new syllabi were introduced, such as physical education. In 2023, a new branch of electrical engineering was added. For the first semester, two additional courses, namely fundamentals of electrical engineering and engineering drawing, were included. Another new branch introduced was Mathematics and Scientific Computing. There are alternative pathways apart from JEE and DASA to enter computer science and electrical branches; some scholarship exams are available for those routes.
detailed_review.Other: A major fest like Aurora (scheduled for February 2024) will be held after a gap of 4 years, as it was halted due to COVID, although the campus life remains good.

reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Information Technology
reviews.review_title: Everything is mostly average.

detailed_review.Placements: This year top companies do visit our campus like Oracle, slice. College does provide the information reg offline opportunities available. Mostly students got placed. This year IPG-M.Tech branch has the highest average package. I guess if you are serious about your courier than no one can stop you from grabbing golden opportunities.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: 100% Ph.D. faculty. Many are very hardworking. I mean they work on providing good quality knowledge to students rather than just in hurry of completing syllabus. Though everything cant be perfect. In that cases we have to work ourselves. Talking about infrastructure, very good range of Wi-Fi available in campus, hostel. I'm quite disappoint from non working computers in labs. We have to totally depend on our laptops. It's not easy for every one to afford laptop in ist year after paying high feels and shifting and all that stuff. Mess food and canteen is average sometimes it is very good and sometimes it is average.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful. They provide us with best of their knowledge. Yes, it is totally relevant. Coming to previous point, everything can't from one side only, we have to put our efforts also. Exams are not too difficult, for some courses you can just score good in one day, and for some you need to go classes regularly to have a look at what's going on.
detailed_review.Other: This college does not provide any fees grant to economic weaker sections (ews) whereas NIT, IIT does. Only for sc/st caste feels grant is avalliable. Scholarship based on rank are provide to just 5-6 people from class of 70, fests is too high. So a normal person can't afford to stay in this college without loan.

For example, aspirants must apply on the official JEE Main website to get admitted to BTech. Candidates must pass the GATE test in order to be admitted to the M.Tech programme. Eligibility for the GATE exam requires a minimum of 60% in graduation.

faqs.question: What rank is required for IIITM Gwalior?
faqs.answer: IIITM admits students to its BTech and dual degree programmes based on their JEE Mains marks; however, students seeking MTech admission must meet the IIITM Gwalior GATE cut-off. To be eligible for the next stage of admissions, students must fulfil the IIITM Gwalior cut-off for their particular category. The total number of seats available for admissions at IIITM Gwalior, the total number of applications submitted for the test, the category-wise distribution of students, and other criteria all influence the cut-off for a given year. faqs.question: How much rank should I score to get IIIT Allahabad?
faqs.answer: IIIT Allahabad accpets JEE Main score for admission to the BTech courses. The Round 1 closing rank for BTech ranged between 4817 and 8428 for BTech. So, considering the previous year Round 1 and the Last Round closing ranks, candidates seeking admission to IIIT Allahabad must secure a rank over and above 4800 and 9600 for the General ALL India category candidates. faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

faqs.question: What is the BTech cutoff for SC and ST categories at IIITM Gwalior
faqs.answer: IIITM Gwalior BTech cutoff 2023 for Computer Science Engineering was 1846 for SC and 945 for ST category. While the admissions are based on the scores/rank obtained in JEE Main, the last cut offs also change a lot depending on All India quota or Home State. It also varies if the applicant is a female.

faqs.question: What is the cutoff for BTech at IIITM Gwalior for other than general categories?

While the admissions are based on the scores/rank obtained in JEE exam, the last cut offs also change a lot depending on All India quota or Home State. It also varies if the applicant is a female.

faqs.answer: ABV IIITM Gwalior offers a two-year PG course in MBA. This course is offered across four specialisations. faqs.question: How to take admission for M.Tech at IIITM Gwalior?
faqs.answer: IIITM Gwalior offers a two-year M.Tech course at the postgraduate level. IIITM Gwalior admission to the MTech  course usually starts in the month of March-April after the GATE exam result declaration. The final selection is based on the GATE scores followed by CCMT counselling . The centralised CCMT counselling process for offering admission to M.Tech is done through online mode. Selected candidates have to further report at the institute to complete formalities for admission confirmation.

faqs.question: What is IIITM Gwalior M.Tech cutoff?
faqs.answer: IIITM Gwalior cutoff for M.Tech course is based on GATE scores followed by the CCMT Counselling, which was concluded with Round 6 .  According to the IIITM Gwalior cutoff for Round 6 in 2023, the closing scores for all M.Tech specialisations ranged from 393 to 350 . M.Tech. in Cyber Security and Cyber laws closed at 374 , followed by M.Tech. in Wireless Networking and Computing with closing score of 359 and M.Tech. in VLSI and Embedded Systems with 350. Candidates who are seeking admission 2024 to IIITM Gwalior M.Tech course must have a valid GATE score.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria to get admissions into IIITM Gwalior for M.Tech courses?
faqs.answer: The eligibility criteria to get admission into MTech courses at IIITM Gwalior is candidares must have completed their BTech degree or equivalent with a minimum aggregate 60% marks (or CGPA 6.5 on a 10-point scale) for Gen/ EWS/ OBC-NCL whereas 55% marks (or CGPA 6.0 on a 10-point scale) for SC/ ST/ PwD. Furthermore, GATE and CCMT are the entrance exam and counselling process that are accepted for admission to IIITM Gwalior M.Tech courses.

faqs.question: What is IIITM Gwalior cutoff 2024 for MTech?
faqs.answer: In 2024, IIITM Gwalior offered M.Tech specialisations via GATE exam scores. Talking about the IIITM Gwalior cutoff, the needed score to get the institute stood between 353 and 422 for the General AI category candidates. For the OBC AI quota, the needed score ranged between 307 and 371 .

faqs.question: How many seats are available for MBA? Is there any quota for girls? I am already shortlisted in the list of 47 candidates.
faqs.answer: The institute has not officially released the number of seats available for the MBA programme. For admission to MBA, IIITM Gwalior accepts a valid score of CAT . highlights.summary:
National Institute of Technology Hamirpur is also known as NIT Hamirpur. NITH was established in 1986 as one of the thirty-one NITs of the country. NIT Hamirpur was initially set up as a Regional Engineering College (REC) in 1986, with only two departments - Civil Engineering and Electrical Engineering compared to 13 departments at present. REC was given the status of a deemed university and upgraded to NIT Hamirpur in 2002. The institute has been ranked 30th in the Architecture and 97th in the Engineering category by the NIRF 2025. NIT Hamirpur offers a variety of UG, PG and doctoral courses. NIT Hamirpur offers courses across streams like Engineering, Architecture, Sciences, Humanities & Social Sciences, and Management. The flagship courses offered at NIT Hamirpur are BTech and MBA.
NIT Hamirpur also offers scholarships to students. NIT Hamirpur admission is both based on merit and entrance. The university accepts national entrance exams such as CAT, MAT, JEE Main, GATE, IIT JAM, NATA. During NIT Hamirpur placements 2024, the highest package stood is INR 56 LPA. The university is spread over 320 acres of area. It has a library, a sports complex, an incubation cell, a healthcare centre, a hostel etc. Candidates can check the important NIT Hamirpur overview in the table provided below:
30+ courses across 13 departments
Semi-Conductor Laboratory (SCL), Department of Space, GOI; IIT Roorkee; Rajiv Gandhi Government Engineering College Kangra; among others.

NIT Hamirpur Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Absolutely the best placements in 2023.

detailed_review.Placements: Students become eligible from 7th semester. Companies like Amazon DeShaw Salesforce Deloitte etc visit here. They respectively take a good number of students. The highest package offered is 80LPA by DeShaw and average package is around 13 to 15LPA. 93 percent of students are placed. I am also planning to sit in the placements and go into the development field.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In hostel we get a basic room with 3 to 4 people sharing with basic facilities. There are no AC rooms and there are common washrooms. Meal quality is good and it serves cuisines from pan india. Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. Labs are good all apparatus used in industry is available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are quite approachable. You can just directly go to the facultys cabins and talk to them. There are 4 exams in a year 2 per semester mid sem and end Sem. There is no such marking scheme and it completely depends on the faculty. Exams are sometimes a bit tricky.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good location, nice atmosphere.

detailed_review.Placements: Students become eligible from the 7th semester. Companies like Amazon, DeShaw, Salesforce, Deloitte, etc., visit here, and they respectively take a good number of students. The highest package was 80 LPA by DeShaw, and the average package is around 13 to 15 LPA. 93% students are placed. I am also planning to sit in the placements and go into the development field.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is a large variety of books in the library related to all fields. All the classes are equipped with smart boards. There are a lot of clubs and societies. Societies function throughout the whole year, and clubs in their respective semesters. In the hostel, we get a basic room with 3-4 people sharing with basic facilities, there are no AC rooms, and there are common washrooms. Meal quality is good, and it serves cuisines from pan-India.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum is well planned, with each subject divided judiciously in different semesters. However, a bit of change must be made regularly to keep pace with this rapidly changing technology. Faculty members are quite approachable, you can just go directly to the faculty's cabins and talk to them. There are 4 exams in a year, 2 per semester (mid sem and end Sem), there is no such marking scheme, and it completely depends on the faculty. Exams are sometimes a bit tricky.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Absolutely good campus and culture of my college.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement record is 93%. The lowest package is around 8 LPA, average is 12 LPA, and the highest is 53 LPA. Recruiting companies are JP Morgan, DE Shaw, Cisco, Wells Fargo, Samsung, Dell, and many more. Internship record is around 60-70% in B.Tech, M.Tech, and others too. Top recruiters are Samsung, Dell, and Oracle.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college has good infrastructure. It has great scenery in college since it is in the mountains. Building of each department is too good with proper management and all. Hostels also have better space management and mess systems for hostelers, along with night canteen facilities. Separate hostels are available for both boys and girls of each year. Lecture halls are there with all facilities like AC rooms and smart board.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are good in terms of teaching their subjects. They teach us with their own different style making us understand each topic clearly. Each student is assigned a faculty as consultant to look care of students. Faculty also help in getting internships, and work experience either in companies or in other IITs.
detailed_review.Other: Being student from CSE I must say that all faculty members are skilled in their domain and tried their best that they can do for students. Also, events like Hill'fair and Nimbus are arranged on our campus which are must to attend that glorify our classes.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Highly recommended college.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are excellent. Recent years show great placement sessions for CSE placement index is 92% for mechanical, and it was 99%. A student of the mechanical engineering department got placed at 205 LPA on campus placement in an international company. Placements for other branches are also good.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are very good quality hostels present in our institute. There are a total of 13 hostels in the National Institute of Technology, Hamirpur. The quality of food in our hostel is very good and is hygienic. Mess workers are corporate, and night canteens are present in every hostel. A hospital is also present in our institute.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teaching staff are very helpful. They solve every doubt of every student. All are well qualified. Most of them have done Phds from IITS. All professors in foreign countries are very knowledgeable. Exam levels are difficult. But according to my paper, it comes at a moderate level. Course curriculum is relevant.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: The natural beauty of NIT Hamirpur is so awesome. You will love it.

detailed_review.Placements: About 80% to 90% of the students of the ECE branch have been placed in different core and tech companies like Google, Microsoft, JP Morgan, Atlassian, Samsung, Nvidia, etc. 68 LPA is the highest package offered for two students in the ECE branch, the average package is around 18 LPA, and the lowest package is 6 LPA. But overall, the highest package is around 2 crore per annum offered to an MNC branch student in game development. The CSE branch average package is 27 LPA in 2025. Around 30% to 40% of my branch students got internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: If you are a fresher, then your hostel is KBH (Kailash Boys Hostel). Hostels are so awesome, but you will see some monkeys. Monkeys are not as harmful as you think. The one thing is that there are three to four LAN cables in each room. If your LAN is not working, then you can also use Wi-Fi, which is very fast and unlimited. The library is also open for you, but till 8:00 PM in the first year. When you become a senior, you will get HBH hostel and library up to 12:00 AM. All classrooms have a digital board.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well educated and taught everything, but not the details, so you can rely on the professors only. Some of your efforts also involve the exams. The course curriculum is relevant for all the branches, but if you want to go in tech, then you must also study. Semester exams are so easy. The only thing you need is to prepare for exams for a week only, and all the time you can spend to learn other skills. To pass any course, you have to get 40% of the total marks.
detailed_review.Other: There is a scope of the semiconductor industry in the past years. Nearly all the tech companies allow you to sit in the interview for tech fields. Hillfair is an annual fest that is conducted around Diwali. This is conducted on the ground. You will enjoy so much with the top singer of Himachal. So many scholarships are available that you can fill, but at a time, you can only fill one. If you have knowledge of how to fill out a scholarship or which is better for you, then go to the student welfare office. All the information about the scholarships they provide.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Chemical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Best weather, strict faculty, trips are absolutely heaven, and more than average placements.

detailed_review.Placements: More than 95% students are placed every year, and most of the time, there are 100% placements. The average package is 6–7 LPA. Top companies also include Siemens, Accenture, Quizziz, and core chemical companies. Internships are mostly in Technip, BIS, ONGC, IOCL, and research internships in IITs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available in the hostel, library, and lecture halls. The library is central, fully air-conditioned, and has blowers in winters. Departments are really nice except the MNC department, which has only classrooms and not exactly a separate department. Hostels are quite nice and get lenient as you move to higher years. Mess food is more than good except in HBH boys hostel. Ground and SAC are there for extracurricular activities, sports, and games, and the gym is also there, separate for girls and boys.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers have quite great knowledge on the subject as far as I see in my own department, and the teaching quality is good. They prepare you well through tests and viva to be placement ready. Some semesters are easy and some are tough. Overall, you'll not get a backlog as far as you cover class notes. It’s easy to get 9 SGPA almost every semester except two.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I got through JoSAA counselling, but I wanted CSE. Anyways, college and campus life have been quite fun. Weather, scenery, and Himachal trips are the best. Fests are fun but not comparable to IITs. The girls-to-boys ratio is very good here, and all types of activities are promoted, fun, NGO, growth, promoting fitness, tree plantation, etc. Classes have a 75% attendance criteria and no relation if you fail or perform poorly in exams.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: NIT Hamirpur College review.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement records are outstanding, with the highest package offered being 1.2 crore per annum. Many well-known organizations come for placement drives and internship programs. As expected, the strongest students are the ones getting the top offers. Apart from placement, the college also offers good information and learning opportunities.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel and mess are good enough to manage. Wi-Fi is available in classrooms, and LAN is available in hostel rooms. We can get anything you want on campus only. Classrooms are well-ventilated, and every classroom has a projector. There is a big stadium for cricket and football, and an indoor stadium for badminton.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are good. You need to be regular in classes. Almost all are passing the exams. The syllabus here is somewhat random dots; we need to connect them to become industry-ready. Semester exams are at a good level; you need to prepare well to pass the semester exams.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Overall, NIT, Hamirpur is the best.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 90% students in Computer Science branch got placed. Students got placed easily without any hassle, and Computer Science engineering is so good in this college. Highest and lowest packages are so good, as the highest package in 2025 is INR 205 LPA, and average package in 2025 is around INR 10.58 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities available in our college are so good, as there are furnished labs, a good library, classrooms with a projector that are air conditioned, a lecture hall, and a library. Due to the quality of food being average, I prefer to choose a hostel because in a hostel, the food is average in mess. You can even see it, but anyway, do choose a hostel over mess food.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. You can easily clear your doubts and concerns with you to study at your own pace. They will guide you. All faculty are very good, and professors are good at teaching and have experience of many IITs and NITs. I think that, in my opinion, the course curriculum is effective and useful. You can beat industry with this curriculum because today the generation is compatible, and for that you have to be updated.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Perhaps the best college you can get at this rank.

detailed_review.Placements: The number of students getting placed in electrical department is usually 90 percent plus. However, the average package remains quite low, considering it is a circuital branch. Internship opportunities are decent. Many students secure research internships in nearby IITs, usually IIT Mandi, and some make it to DRDO or ISRO.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities are decent, with some issues. The food is generally good with some exceptions. Major issues can be shortage of water during rainy season which causes a lot of problems. The issue is that there are mostly 4 seater rooms till third and single seater rooms available only for fourth-year students. The lab facilities are good, and there are more than enough opportunities for those who try to get them.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members here are more than qualified however, there seems to be an issue in communication with students, which creates a lack of interest. Some younger faculty members are also quite helpful.
detailed_review.Other: Well, I decided to choose this branch because it is a circuital branch and allows me to choose either tech or core field, thus keeping both my options open.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Beautiful engineering college.

detailed_review.Placements: 83% of electrical branch students get decent placement. Talking about the highest package, it is around 30 LPA, which is quite good. Top recruiting companies are TCS, Google, and many more. Around 10 to 20 students get an internship at a decent value at Google.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Beautiful and green campus location, and there is Wi-Fi all over the campus, you will stay connected near the department building, hostel, and library. Talking about the library, it is quite good, I'll say, and provides every facility that is necessary. Hostel food is, I'll say, average, not too good, and there are medical facilities 24/7 and a health centre within the campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some teachers are helpful, while some are just teachers teaching for their salary, but they are highly qualified and have vast knowledge and many years of experience. Course is relevant, but not for the first year, which is the same for all branches. Semester exams are easy, and passing criteria are 40%.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good off-campus placement, decent overall.

detailed_review.Placements: High percentage of placement with a decent median package 8.5 LPA (median not average), highest package is a bit low as compared to other NITs at similar ranks, that is 30 LPA for electrical engineering, but for tech branches it's higher, and off-campus placements are very good (hill location limits on-campus company placements). Internship is generally offered from 3rd year, but you can get some even as early as 1st year online. Many PSUs and companies like Wipro and TCS hire students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure:
Department infrastructure is great, but hostel infrastructure depends on blocks. Some blocks of hostel have good quality services, but others don't have proper cleaning, and some are even broken. There is a library, Wi-Fi is also available, however, it is pretty slow in some areas. Labs are good, and so are the classrooms (1st year lecture hall is a bit bad as it doesn't have AC, but later it gets good). Food in Kailash Boys Hostel (1st year hostel) is good except dinner (Only sweets are good in dinner).
Health centre is near the academic area. Sports and games are available in both hostel and the SAC.
detailed_review.Faculty: Professors are knowledgeable but very rude (a few exceptions). Teaching quality is decent, as most professors teach from PDFs. The curriculum is also somewhat relevant, as core placements are decent. Semester exam toughness depends on the professor and the days of study. Mid sem occurs quite early and carries 30% marks. Some students do give supplementary exams, but rarely any back cases.
detailed_review.Other: Electrical is a core branch that also opens the door for GATE and tech jobs. Great view, very beautiful campus. Events have been a bit off over the past few years. Connectivity is also pretty bad. Activities are great.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering
reviews.review_title: NIT, Hamirpur college shiksha review by Abhivadan Chandel.

detailed_review.Placements: College placement facilities are very good because they do not admit multiple students to this course. There are 300 students taking admission, and 50 to 60% students are getting placement in high industry companies and a salary package of 4 LPA to 15 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: This college has the best infrastructure facilities available and uses high-quality products, and many things are the same as those in multiple colleges. In this college, canteen food is also good and hygienic. This college has available facilities like a classroom, a bathroom, labs, Wi-Fi, a lift, a campus, an auditorium, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: This college faculty is very strict, but good behaviour for a student, and this course has a total of 8 teachers allocated for the theory and practical lectures. This course is not difficult to pass because there is a 40% required for passing the exam, and internal exams are not included in the semester exam marks.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Chemical Engineering
reviews.review_title: NIT Hamirpur engineering course admission taken in 2025-26.

detailed_review.Placements: This college's placement facilities are very good because 70 to 80% of students are placed in companies. These companies provide salaries ranging from 6 lacs to 20 lacs, with the highest package at this college. These companies require a 2-year agreement to be signed, stating that students will not leave the company for 2 years.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: in this course, there are many facilities available for the student, like a classroom, a bathroom, a library, auditorium, CCTV, a canteen, hostel, etc. facilities are available. in this college, the canteen food is very tasty and hygienic, and many sports and games are organized every year.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers in this course are also good, with very high-level education and experience. This course has a total duration of 3 to 4 years, and the exam is very difficult because there are very lengthy answers required for one question to get the highest marks, and hard questions are asked in the exam.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering
reviews.review_title: The college campus is really beautiful.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost all students were placed in our course during my academic session. The highest package offered in our course is 32 LPA. The average package is around 10-12 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Havells, V Guard, LG, Samsung, etc. Around 80% of students get internship offers.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course are extremely good. A large library is present on the college campus with proper study arrangements. The quality of facilities available in the hostel is also very good. The campus is very beautiful.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable in their respective domains of study. Most professors are alumni of IITs. The teaching quality of our faculty members is great. The course curriculum is relevant. Semester examinations are not easy.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: A very beautiful college campus.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement percentage of students in our course was nearly 100%. The highest package offered in our course was 32 LPA. The average package was around 9-10 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Accenture, IBM, L&T Infotech, Infosys, and many more.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Hamirpur is a clean and eco-friendly district. There are 4 separate hostels, each for boys and girls. A sports facility was present. Guest rooms, LED TVs, Water coolers, geysers, etc, were also available.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers were helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. The teaching quality of our faculty members was extremely awesome. The course curriculum was relevant. Students were under the supervision of faculty members. The semester examination was a little tough. The academic was so busy.

reviews.course: Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch.)
reviews.review_title: Dissatisfied with faculty members.

detailed_review.Placements: 100% placement this year in 2025. Minimum package is 4 LPA and maximum salary is 7 LPA right now. Companies and firms that come for placements in architecture department are V Construct, Godrej, Tata, L&T, etc. Top roles are offered in our course to training and placement candidates.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are library, computer lab, design studios, and seminar halls in architecture department. They also provide guest lectures and workshops. The quality of food is above average. There is a medical center on the campus, also the sports facilities are good. Sports exposure is pretty good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are nice and knowledgeable. Their teaching quality is not bad. The exams are sometimes hard and sometimes easy also. The passing percentage is above 30% in theory exams. But attendance should be above 50% so that a student can be eligible for giving exams.
detailed_review.Other: There are fests like hillfair, nimbus, and lalkaar. These are cultural and technical also sports fests that are held at the college.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering
reviews.review_title: NIT Hamirpur is the best college.

detailed_review.Placements: There are about 70% of students placed in my college. The highest package is about 25 LPA, and the lowest salary is about 6 LPA. Top recruiters are L&T, Zerodha, etc. About 80% of students got internships in my college where we study about electricity component.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: My college provides a good environment for study. It is a reputed college and infrastructure is also very good. Wi-Fi is available almost everywhere and buildings are also new. Classes are good and now talked about hostel, we have above average hostels and mess food.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very supportive. They support us mentally and socially. They are very knowledgeable and highly qualified. They provide us with resources for study. Curriculum is also relevant which makes us a good engineer. Semester exams are also easy, we can make it.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Strong infrastructure, average placements, and academics have become strong over the past 2 years.

detailed_review.Placements: NIT Hamirpur has approximately 89.1% placements of eligible students. The average annual package was 10 LPA, and the highest package was 1.2 crores, offered to B.Tech CSE students. Top recruiters were Oracle, Microsoft, Amazon, CRED, Infosys, Samsung, etc., and various others, which can also be accessed from its website. Mechanical Engineering had 100% placements last year. Almost every branch has more than 60% placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: NITH has Wi-Fi-enabled hostels (8 boys hostels, 4 girls hostels), and the most affectionate part of the college is its infrastructure. The view that hostel balconies provide is full of serenity, and one can sit there for hours without any gadgets or a second thought. Hostels are more like staycations, with Wi-Fi, good food, and events that happen annually on the hostel premises, including inter-hostel and intra-hostel tournaments. The college has a Health Care Center. The library and reading halls are fully furnished with AC facilities. Labs of each department contain instruments under the guidance of lab assistants.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty in NITH are well educated and hold degrees from NITs and IITs themselves. They have various research papers published in their name, which can provide enormous guidance to students for their projects. The course curriculum is relevant as per the latest 2024 batch. The older one was not upgraded, but after 2024 it has changed and includes various practical subjects and industrial training in the curriculum. Semester exams are of moderate to difficult level and include actual application-based questions. The passing percentage is 5 grade points each semester and includes an attendance criterion of 75%.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: A genuine review of NIT Hamirpur.

detailed_review.Placements: About my course, the strength was 120 people, one of the best courses in Miranda House. Usually, Miranda House has more humanities-oriented courses and there is a placement cell as well in the college. The placements are mainly average with a stipend of 4- 6 LPA. Mainly universities from abroad provide students with opportunities, from my course most of the people did internships. I got to know one from our class and even did an internship at the Parliament House. Top roles usually are in policy analyst, bureaucracy roles, professors and researchers, journalists, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Labs are equipped with all the machines, and instruments required to make a student industry-ready as well as to connect the theoretical aspects with the practical ones. We do have two lecture hall complexes. Wi-Fi is also available on the campus. Hostels are very good with great infrastructure and good food quality. Each hostel has its playing area while the campus has also a separate ground. We also have a health center having all the required facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are available all the time to help you. You can ask them doubts through emails or visit them personally. They are ready to help you. The course is relevant as well and the societies or clubs maintained by the students provide the hands-on experience that makes the student industry-ready. You need to score 15 out of 50 in the end-semester examination and 40 marks overall out of 100 to pass the particular examination. Both criteria need to be fulfilled. The exams are quite difficult as you can expect from an institute of national importance.
detailed_review.Other: The reason I chose this course was the beautiful campus of NIT Hamirpur and my genuine interest in Mechanical Engineering. Activities keep going all around the year with two mega-fests occurring in a year. Scholarships are also provided to eligible students and extracurricular activities are also planned like teaching the privileged students, yoga, NCC, NSS, etc.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering
reviews.review_title: This is one of the better colleges if you want to pursue engineering in Himachal Pradesh.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are decent—not too fancy, but not bad either. In my department, the placements were slightly below average last year. In the anti-penultimate year, they improved a bit. The packages started at 5 LPA and went up to nearly 10-12 LPA. Top recruiters included JSW and a few others.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The labs and classrooms are quite good. The library is well-equipped with books on every topic. However, the quality of the hostel is, on the other hand, a bit average. Some of the hostel rooms are good, while others are somewhat worse. The mess food can also be considered a bit average.
detailed_review.Faculty: The professors are highly qualified, with each having numerous research papers to their credit. The curriculum is reasonably good, although some topics may seem irrelevant in the broader context. The difficulty of exams varies significantly depending on the subject.

admission.title: NIT Hamirpur Admission Overview 2025
admission.overview_text:
NIT Hamirpur admission 2025 is entrance-based. The students are selected through national-level tests conducted by various authorities. Presently, NIT Hamirpur comprises five departments and one centre. The departments and centres collectively offer over 30 UG, PG, and doctoral degree courses.

It awards the degree of BTech, BArch, BTech-MTech (Dual Degree), MTech, MBA, MSc, and PhD in Engineering, Science, Architecture, Management, and Social Sciences. To apply for a course at NIT Hamirpur , aspirants shall complete the application procedure for the national-level exam conducted for the desired course.

faqs.question: Is admission to NIT Hamirpur merit based or entrance based?
faqs.answer: Getting admission to NIT Hamirpur depends on candidates performance and also on meeting the eligibility criteria. The admissions procedure is given below for Undergraduate Programmes B.Tech: NIT Hamirpur offers admissions on the basis of JEE Main ranks Postgraduate Programs: Getting into M.Tech calls for a GATE score and depends on candidates CCMT ranks. Securing a seat at NIT Hamirpur usually requires candidates to appear for an entrance exam. Thus, the admission process is entrance based.

faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

faqs.question: Is NIT Hamirpur hard to get?
faqs.answer: Yes, its hard to get admission at NIT Hamirpur. The institute accepts admission based on entrance exams. The university accepts various national-level entrance exams such as JEE Main,  NATA, CAT,  MAT, GATE,  IIT JAM, and others. Candidates willing to get admission to several courses at the National Institute of Technology Hamirpur must apply online on the official website of the university.

faqs.question: Are NIT Hamirpur MBA admissions merit-based?
faqs.answer: Yes, NIT Hamirpur MBA admissions are merit-based but they are not done based on merit secured in the entrance exams and graduation. The entrance exam and graduation score allow candidates to be selected for the Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI) rounds. A merit list is then released of candidates clearing the GD and PI round, it is according to this merit that provisional admissions into NIT Hamirpur MBA takes place. Therefore, candidates will have to clear multiple rounds to finalise their admission into the programme.

faqs.question: When will JEE Main 2026 be conducted?
faqs.answer: Every year, NTA conducts the JEE Main entrance exam for the selection of eligible candidates in IIT, NIT and IIITs. The admission process for JEE Main 2026 (session 1) registrations has been completed. JEE Main 2026 session 1 exam will be held from January 21 to 30, and session 2 will be held from April 2 to 9.  January 21 to 30.

faqs.question: How to apply for M.Tech at NIT Hamirpur?
faqs.answer: Aspirants are required to take the GATE exam followed by CCMT counselling to be eligible for admission to the institute. Candidates are hence required to complete the GATE application process. NIT Hamirpur shall shortlist students based on the exam scores and counselling.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in NIT Hamirpur?
faqs.answer: NIT Hamirpur admissions to all courses are entirely entrance-based. Candidates are selected based on the entrance exams conducted at the national-level. Interested candidates can check the basic eligibility criteria and qualify for the respective entrance exams for admission to NIT Hamirpur. Check below the course-wise selection criteria for NIT Hamirpur admissions: Courses Eligibility & Selection MBA BTech MSc MTech BArch M.Arch PhD

faqs.question: Is NIT Hamirpur campus good?
faqs.answer: As per the student reviews, the NIT Hamirpur campus has been remarked as especially beautiful and full of greenery. The campus is spread across 320 acre land. Further, the location makes it ideal for students to make a weekend trip to scenic places, such as Manali, Dharmshala, and more. All these places are within a few hours of travel. There are also multiple cafés which specialise in various cuisines and have their own signature taste and specialty.
