faqs.question: Can I get into NIT Hamirpur M.Tech without GATE?
faqs.answer: No, candidates can not get into NIT Hamirpur M.Tech without taking the GATE exam. It is the only entrance exam the university recognises for admission into the M.Tech programme. Candidates with a valid GATE score will have to appear for CCMT counselling to get provisional admission into the university. Therefore, a valid GATE score is necessary and candidates can not gain admission without it.

faqs.question: What is the fee at NIT Hamirpur for BTech?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee is INR 5 lakh . This fee is calculated as per the official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change. The data available on unofficial sources and hence is subject to change. Moreover, students also have to pay for Hostel Charges of INR 2.46 lakh and One-time Payable charges of INR 13,000, separately.

faqs.question: How to get admission to BTech at NIT Hamirpur?
faqs.answer: To get admission to BTech course at NIT Hamirpur, candidates must fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria in the first place. Candidates who passed Class 12 with a minimum of 75% aggregate are eligible to apply for the course and appear for JEE Main entrance exam. Admission to BTech course at NIT Hamipur is based on a valid JEE Main score. Further, the final seat allotment is done through JoSAA Counselling. If seats are left vacant after JoSAA, then seats are filled through CSAB counselling.

faqs.question: What is the seat intake for BTech at NIT Hamirpur?
faqs.answer: As per the official website, NIT Hamirpur offers BTech course across nine specialisations. The seat intake for all specialisations is 830. Find below the specialisation-wise seat bifurcation for BTech offered at NIT Hamirpur: *This information is sourced from official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for BTech at NIT Hamirpur?
faqs.answer: For admission to BTech at NIT Hamirpur, students must pass Class 12 with 75% aggregate with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects with any one of the Chemistry/ Biotechnology/ Biology/ Technical Vocational subject (for SC/ST,  65% aggregate is required).

faqs.question: What is the minimum eligibility requirement for MBA admission at NIT Hamirpur?
faqs.answer: To be eligible for NIT Hamirpur MBA programme, a candidate needs to pass a bachelor’s/ professional degree from a recognised institute/ university with a minimum of 50 per cent aggregate or equivalent CGPA (45 per cent for SC/ ST/ PwD candidates). Candidates, appearing for the final year of bachelor's degree/ equivalent qualification or awaiting result, are also eligible to apply.

faqs.question: What is the MBA fee in NIT Hamirpur?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee for NIT Hamirpur MBA course is INR 1.4 lakh. Moreover, the applicants also have to pay the application fee, which is INR 1,200 for general category students. However, for SC/ST students, the fee is INR 600. The fee payment is accepted in online mode. However, this fee is calculated as per the official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change. The data available on unofficial sources and hence is subject to change.

faqs.question: How to apply for an MBA at NIT Hamirpur?
faqs.answer: Interested candidates with a Bachelor’s degree from a recognised university and a valid CAT/MAT/GMAT/CMAT score can apply. Eligible students can then apply by filling out the admission form, which can be availed via online mode (nith.ac.in) and has to be sent via post. The selection is based on academic records and scores in the national-level Management examinations.

faqs.question: How can I seek PhD admission at NIT Hamirpur?
faqs.answer: Admission to PhD programme offered at NIT Hamirpur is based on academic merit of the candidates and also subjects to the reputation of the institute/ university from where the candidates have pursued previous degree/ exam. Further, candidates need to have a valid score in GATE, UGC NET, CSIR NET to qualify for the shortlisting process. For final selection, the shortlisted candidates are called for a presentation round, followed by a PI round. The presentation round is based on the respective topic/ subject of the proposed research work of the candidates.

faqs.question: Does NIT Hamirpur offer a PhD programme?
faqs.answer: Yes, at the research level, NIT Hamirpur offers a PhD programme in both full-time and part-time modes across multiple streams, including Engineering, Architecture, Sciences, Management and Humanities.

faqs.question: What is the tuition fee for a PhD programme at NIT Hamirpur?
faqs.answer: As per the unofficial sources, the tuition fee is INR 1.7 lakh.

faqs.question: Is a GATE score required for PhD in Engineering programmes at NIT Hamirpur?
faqs.answer: Yes, a GATE score is accepted for admission to the postdoctoral-level course in the Engineering stream.

faqs.question: How to register for CCMT Counselling?
faqs.answer: CCMT Counselling registration process is conducted in an online mode. Candidates have to register for the counselling process by filling their name and GATE related details such as year of exam, registration ID, exam paper and score to generate the login details. Check below detailed step to apply for CCMT Counselling process: Category Registration Fee General or Open Category (OC) Rs 3,000 Other Backward Class (OBC) Rs 3,000 SC/ST/PwD Rs 2,500 Step 6 - Choice Filling and Locking: Candidates have to select their choice of colleges and courses during the allotted time. Change, re-order and deletion of choices could be done within the choice-filling period. Candidates must fill the choice in the order of their preference. Editing of selected choices cannot be done after locking. A printout of the filled choices must be taken for future reference.

faqs.question: Can I join the NIT Hamirpur MBA programme without an entrance exam?
faqs.answer: No, all MBA admissions into NIT Hamirpur are done by entrance exams. Candidates have to appear for CAT/MAT or CMAT entrance exam to be eligible for admission into the MBA programme at NIT Hamirpur. A candidate cannot apply for direct admission into the university and has to apply through these entrance exams to be eligible for admission. The admission in the programme is through multiple rounds, candidates have to be part of a group discussion and a personal interview followed by the payment of tuition fees to finalise their admission.

faqs.question: How many semesters do I have to clear to get an MBA degree from NIT Hamirpur?
faqs.answer: The MBA programme at NIT Hamirpur is two years long. The program follows the semester model, thus candidates have to study for four semesters at the institution and clear the evaluations of four semesters to be eligible for an MBA degree from the institution. As the programme is offered in full-time offline mode the candidates also have to maintain certain attendance standards throughout the four semesters.

faqs.question: Are admissions open at NIT Hamirpur?
faqs.answer: National Institute of Technology Hamirpur admission 2025 is open. The instiute offers admisison based on merit and entrance exams. The institute accepts national entrance exams such as CAT, MAT, XAT, JEE Main, and others. Candidates willing to get admission to several courses at the National Institute of Technology Hamirpur must apply online on the official website of the university.

faqs.question: Does NIT Hamirpur provide scholarships?
faqs.answer: NIT Hamirpur offers various merit and means-based scholarships to promote education and encourage talented students with a financially weaker backgrounds. A total of 28 scholarships are offered by NIT Hamirpur to eligible students. The need-based scholarships are offered keeping in mind the financial background of the student whereas merit-based scholarships are offered to bright students with a good academic record. Some of the names include Top Class Education for SC- Category Students, National Fellowship and Scholarship for Higher Education of ST Students (formerly Top Class Education Scholarship for ST -Category Students), Merit-Cum-Means Scholarship to students belonging to Minority communities i.e. (Muslim, Sikh, Christian, Buddhist & Parsi ), etc.

faqs.question: What is the MSc course fee at NIT Hamirpur?
faqs.answer: As per the unofficial sources, the total tuition fee is INR 1.23 lakh.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: NIT Hamirpur provides modern amenities with state-of-the-art infrastructure to its students. Located on hilly terrains surrounded by pines, NIT Hamirpur is considered to be the second most beautiful campus in India including all Engineering colleges/ institutes. It is spread over 320 acres of area, it was ranked as the best NIT in terms of infrastructure by the World Bank in 2007.NIT Hamirpur infrastructure has the following facilities:
For more information about NIT Hamirpur - National Institute of Technology check out the below videos:
list: Hostel:NIT Hamirpur is a residential campus with eight boys' hostels and four girls' hostels. These hostels are a combination of triple-seated or four-seated rooms, while some are double occupancy as well as single occupancy rooms.

Healthcare Centre:NIT Hamirpur has its own healthcare centre to meet the basic health needs of students or anyone who is part of the system. The emergency cases are sent to the zonal hospital in Hamirpur.

Sports Complex:NIT Hamirpur has a sports facility for different indoor and outdoor sports activities. The sports complex has a ground and a courtyard where students can play cricket, football, lawn tennis, volleyball, badminton and more.

Central Library:Spread over a floor area of 3200 sqm, NIT Hamirpur has a central library with more than 1 lakh books and a plethora of scientific journals, present in both print and electronic media. The central library also has a reading room with the capacity to house 600 students at a time.

Incubation Cell:In March 2017, NIT Hamirpur entered into an agreement with the Government of Himachal Pradesh to set up an incubation cell at the campus. Incubation cell is set up in the central block building with a designated area of 64.28 sqm.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is a good college and has great placements.

detailed_review.Placements: 95% of students get placed in my branch. The highest package is 42 LPA, and the lowest that I know of is 4 LPA. Top recruiters are Google, JP Morgan, Tata, Reliance, and PayPal. All students have to do internships at the end of the 3rd year, so the internship percentage is 100%. Some students get internships at JP Morgan, and most of them work in startups.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: PDEU has 2 hostels. UG for 1st and 2nd year students and High Rise for 3rd and 4th year students. All rooms have 3 sharing. All rooms are provided with high-speed Wi-Fi. High Rise has many grounds, a basketball court, and a badminton court. The mess food is average. It is not bad, but it is not super good either. PDEU has a huge campus and many labs equipped with the latest tech, a huge library with all the required books for the courses. All classrooms have AC, projectors, and good benches.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very qualified, knowledgeable, and helpful, but not all of them are good at teaching. The course has recently revised, so it is very relevant to today’s industry and makes students industry-ready. Semester exams are average, not too easy nor too difficult, and the pass percentage is 80–85%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose CS because I always wanted to study it and have an interest in it. I chose PDEU over Nirma since PDEU has better infrastructure and campus life. There are several clubs here and 2 huge fests every year. The crowd is friendly.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Life at PDEU is comfy, and education is good.

detailed_review.Placements: 97% students are placed. There are many big companies visited, and they gave good placement, no worries about placement. Basically, the college is Ambani's college. Reliance and many other companies have collaborated with the college. I feel proud to be a PDEU student.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All facilities are available. There are good classrooms, all classrooms are well ventilated, good seats, comfy environment, a projector, every student gets their personal charging point and Wi-Fi, there are two big libraries in PDEU with all the books you know.
detailed_review.Faculty: All the faculty are well educated, mostly having graduated from IIT and many big universities. There are many opportunities for courses that provide lots of labs for a better experience. There are not that many difficult exams you can easily pass and score a good CGPA.
detailed_review.Other: Good placement.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information and Communication Technology
reviews.review_title: Greater infrastructure of the college.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are very satisfactory while the students have maintained CGPA above 7.5. Many students who have good CGPA like above 9, they get placement at companies like Nvidia, Microsoft, or many more. This is what I get from the holder record of the university placement record.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have clean and big classroom for study. The nature of the campus is very friendly and familiar. Hostel and mess also have great facilities, like our hostel has Wi-Fi, hot water, attached bathroom, etc. All these facilities are given to us at this college. They also have facilities like library, computer lab, physics and chemistry labs, which are really helpful for our studies.
detailed_review.Faculty: The nature and behaviour of our faculty members are very nice. They all teach us in a friendly way. The exam system also has fairness in that.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information and Communication Technology
reviews.review_title: 50 shades of PDEU, which describe PDEU.

detailed_review.Placements: As per previous years' data, above 80% of students got placed at good companies. Average package of this college is 7.5 LPA, and the highest is around 52 LPA. Company offers many roles like MERN stack, software, VLSI developer, etc. Our college provides students best internships, and they also help with applications. There are many small companies that are tied up with our college. It helps students to get internships and placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college infrastructure is very new and good for studying and living. There are many places to spend time relaxing with friends. There is also apple lab in our college which is very good. Mess and hostel are very good compared to any other college hostel. There are medical facilities, sports, games, and mess facility provided by the college.
detailed_review.Faculty: In our college, faculty members are very experienced. More than half of faculty members have graduated from IIT, NIT, or IIIT. Course curriculum is very relevant. This college puts this type of course which makes students industry-ready, in the curriculum. Semester exams are not easy and not much hard, it is moderate level. Above 93% of students pass semester without backlog.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Great placements, awesome infrastructure, and supportive faculty. I'm loving my college experience.

detailed_review.Placements: I'm really impressed with the placement opportunities at my university. 90% of B.Tech students got placed with more than 550 job offers from more than 175 companies. The highest package is 42 LPA, and the average package is 7.50 LPA. MBA students have a 100% placement rate with 117 students placed, averaging 8.50 LPA. Top companies like Google, Amazon, and Reliance Industries visit our campus, offering roles in software development, AI/ML, and more. Many students secure internships, gaining valuable experience. The career services team and alumni network are super helpful. Overall, I'm really happy with the placements here.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities at my university are amazing. We've got Wi-Fi all over campus, and the labs are super equipped with industrial-level machinery. The classrooms are comfortable and have smart boards. The library's huge, with tons of books and digital resources. The hostels are pretty cool too. It has AC, and the food is good. We've got a medical clinic on campus, and the sports complex is awesome, with courts for basketball, football, and more. The gym is well-equipped, and there are plenty of extracurricular activities to get involved in. Overall, the facilities are top-notch and enhance the college experience.
detailed_review.Faculty: My teachers are super helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. They're always available to clear doubts and provide guidance. The teaching quality's great, with a mix of theory and practical. The course curriculum is relevant and industry-focused, making us job-ready. Semester exams can be challenging, but they're manageable with regular study. The pass percentage is good, and most students clear their exams easily. Overall, the faculty is supportive, and the curriculum is designed to prepare us for the industry. I've learned a lot, and I feel confident about my future career prospects.
detailed_review.Other: I chose mechanical engineering because I'm passionate about designing and building things. The best things about my course are the hands-on projects, industry exposure, and supportive faculty. One thing I'd like to improve is more focus on emerging technologies like AI and robotics. The campus has a great vibe, with regular events and fests. The crowd's friendly, and connectivity is good. The surroundings are peaceful, and there are plenty of extracurricular activities to get involved in. Scholarships are available for meritorious students, which is a bonus. Overall, I'm loving my course and the university experience.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Life at Pandit Deendayal Energy University.

detailed_review.Placements: I am a first-year student and very new to the university and the branch. I cannot judge it correctly, but as I have communicated with seniors. The placement of the ECE branch is very good. In fact, it is competing with the CSE and ICT branches. ECE students can sit for interviews in both hardware and software companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms, Wi-Fi, library, open areas, washrooms, and labs are all very good in condition. Especially labs are fully working and well-equipped with instruments and required equipment. Talking about the mess food, it is good, healthy, and a little bit tasty.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum and examination are super good. It is strict and sophisticated. We have to be regular in order to maintain the minimum attendance, or else we cannot get the hall ticket for the examination. We have to maintain minimum attendance in each and every subject, including labs.
detailed_review.Other: Events and fests are very fun and playful.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information and Communication Technology
reviews.review_title: The college is great for studying and has a great campus and social life.

detailed_review.Placements: The highest package in information and communication technology is around 14 LPA. The average package is around 7 LPA. TCS, ION, Infosys, HCL, PayPal, and Amazon are recruiters. The college provides good placement at least above average than other colleges at the same level.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities are great. Each hostel room has an AC and there is no electricity bill. It is filled with greenery and has a gym and a badminton court. It has a ton of places to hang out with friends. The infrastructure of the campus is great too. There is an entire separate sports complex for playing.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are available for doubt-solving and explain to you until you are satisfied with your doubts. They teach good and relevant topics along with their application in real life. Labs give hands-on experience to all the theories we study and specially computer lab in ICT is at par. The semester exams are not that difficult if you study 2 hours a day and pay attention in classes.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course as I wanted a mixture of hardware and software in the IT industry. One thing that could be better is that in the first year they teach biology which doesn't make that much of sense. The events are fantastic with tons of clubs provided for extracurricular activities.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: The college provides the best facilities and infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: As per my information, 70% of students are placed in the current placement cell, which is also running. The highest package is about 18 LPA, and the average package is 6 LPA. The recruiting companies are Chevron, Reliance, Adani Power, MG Motors, Micron, Tata, Nippon India Steel, and Sabrmati Gas. About 80-90% of students get internships at ONGC, BOSS, Reliance, ISRO, and local companies in Ahmedabad GIDC.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In our college, there are facilities like free Wi-Fi, well equipments in labs, and all labs have advanced machinery. The computer lab has an i7 system, which we can use at any time. The classrooms are very neat and clean, and create a learning environment. PDPU has 3 libraries for different streams, like SOT, SLS, and SOM, with enough books available in physical and on the PDPU library website. All the facilities available in PDPU like a mess, hostel, and sports. There is 1 cricket ground, football ground, 1 running track, 8 to 10 basketball and volleyball courts.
detailed_review.Faculty: The PDPU faculty members are very helpful and always ready to help students. They also help with a research project. The course curriculum is made with new technology, which is in high demand in the future. The exams are moderate to hard, and the questions are not asked from the books, but are asked from real-life use, which is slightly difficult for students.
detailed_review.Other: I chose Mechanical Engineering because I love machines. It is one of the oldest branches, and it always demands for best engineers. PDPU offers its own GATE scholarship, which is a full and half waiver schemes.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering
reviews.review_title: All you need to know before taking admission in PDEU.

detailed_review.Placements: Our batch has at least 80% of the registered students placed in premier MNCs and startups. The highest package in the 2025 batch is around 35 LPA. The average package is around 9 LPA. The lowest is around 3 LPA. Top recruiters include PayPal, JP Morgan Chase, Aspect Ratio, Shipments, Accenture, Infosys, etc. Students have bagged internships in the above-mentioned companies. All placements are for SDE, AI/ML, and web developer roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure at PDEU is top-notch with the latest equipment, labs, and amenities. Hostels in PDEU have modern infrastructure including air conditioning. The quality of the mess food in PDEU is above average, with a variety of food being served along with a grievance redressal system.
detailed_review.Faculty: All faculty members in the college are well-versed in their respective fields. They are active publishers in prominent research paper publications. All of them are Ph.D. holders. The course curriculum is updated as per the current and future industry demands. College exams test the theoretical as well as practical knowledge of students throughout the semester.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because of my aligned interests towards the software engineering field. The best thing about my coursework in PDEU is that it aligns with my career goals and helps me prepare for a career in the same. One thing that can be improved is a continuous revision of the syllabus as per industry dynamics. The technical fest of PDEU is Tesseract and the cultural fest is Fair. Both are fun and well-organized.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering
reviews.review_title: PDEU is one of the best colleges in Gujarat for CSE students, and its facilities are good.

detailed_review.Placements: I am currently pursuing a B.Tech in Computer Engineering at PDEU. And 90% of students are placed in Computer Engineering. The highest package is 38 LPA, the average package is 9.01 LPA, and the lowest package is 6.06 LPA. JP Morgan Chase, Jio Platforms, Amazon, and many more companies are top recruiters for the course.

Each lab and classroom has AC and projectors. The library also has AC and a collection of books. Hostels, a canteen, and medical facilities are available on campus. There are sports grounds, including a volleyball court, football field, cricket ground, badminton court, and more.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members are great and highly intelligent. Most of them are from the Indian Institutes of Technology. The teaching quality is excellent. The course curriculum is relevant. The semester exams are moderate to difficult, and the question paper covers most course outcomes.
detailed_review.Other: I like the campus of the college and the teaching. I am interested in this course because of coding. The college has many clubs and events as well.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering
reviews.review_title: Really good college placement and the infrastructure is very good.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement in computer science is very good. Top recruiters are also coming to the college for the placement and Pdeu also provides good placements. They also teach how to prepare for the placement. The highest package is around 42 LPA in 2023 and the average package is about 10 LPA in computer engineering other branches' placement is also very good.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the University is also very good there is a library as well as on campus. Which helps students to provide a good environment for the study. There are also good facilities for the mess and also the canteen there is also a good sports complex in the university there are some sports events in the university.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty are also very good of the pdeu curriculum of the university is also very nice which can also help for the another examination like CAT GATE faculty are also very helpful and supportive there is main 2 exam in the university mid sem and end sem the pass percentage raton is also good .

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information and Communication Technology
reviews.review_title: PDEU - A perfect balance of academic life and extracurricular opportunities.

detailed_review.Placements: I am in the first year of ICT batch. The average salary package offered in ICT batch is 6 LPA. The highest salary package offered someone has ever got is 9 LPA. I know the package is quite low compared to other colleges. But the CSE branch of PDEU has really good on-campus placements. The average salary package offered is 9 LPA. The highest salary package offered is 38 LPA which is quite good as compared to other colleges.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: PDEU infrastructure has high-speed internet everywhere on the campus. The campus is clean and green. The air here is very fresh. The flora and greenery on the campus are maintained on regular basis. There are many places where we can hangout with friends. Mess and canteen provide a good quality of food. I am a local light so I don't know about the hostel facilities. But I have heard from my friends that the hostels are affordable and provide good facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members here are very approachable. They are well educated and many of them are from top IITs of India. The exam difficulty was moderate. The passing percentage is 90%, and IE 90% of students get passed. Indias course curriculum is relevant.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Inside life of PDEU, must join.

detailed_review.Placements: Students placed: 30-40%. The lowest package: 3 LPA. Average package: 5 LPA. The highest package: 12 LPA. Top recruiting companies: Reliance, Aspect Ratio, Suzuki Motors. No companies come for internships in college. Top roles: GET roles, software roles, and hardware roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities are very good, and the infrastructure of the college is also very nice. There is greenery everywhere, and NAAC also rated PDEU as A+ recently. The labs are good, and the whole campus has PDEU Wi-Fi. The hostel facilities are decent, and the mess and campus food is hygienic.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are average. Like some faculty members are very good, but some of them are not. All the teachers are qualified. Yes, some teachers are very good and help to grow and make us stay focused. The semester exams are average, not too difficult. The pass percentage is nice.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because of the growing demand for ECE engineers in the industry. An ECE engineer is very flexible as they can go into both hardware and software domains, unlike other branches. Yes, there are many events and extracurricular activities on campus. Fests are there.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Better place to study and improve your skills.

detailed_review.Placements: In college placements, almost every student gets placed. However, it totally depends on your academic record and your own excellence. The college provides the best opportunities from around the country and good exposure to companies. In the mechanical department, the placement is good but cannot be considered the best, as the highest package this year was 20 Lacs, and the average package in the mechanical department is 9 Lacs per annum, which can be low for students as they pay almost 20 Lacs in four years if they are not local students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college has one of the best infrastructures in the state, as they provide every facility. The college also has an in-house hospital and a team of doctors who are specialized in different fields such as orthopaedic, gynaecology, and pathology. The canteen facility in the college is very hygienic and well-maintained; however, the food might not taste up to the mark. The facilities and amenities provided by the college are better than many other colleges in Gujarat and even out of Gujarat. The course facilities are the best in PDEU, as it has the best mechanical labs.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members in PDEU are very helpful in every way. Be it an academic issue or a personal problem, the faculty members are always available to guide us in every way. The faculty and student interaction is also better, as the class strengths are small and it is easy for the teacher to create better communication with every student. The curriculum is also very efficient and covers all aspects of the real market. The semester is about 6 months, and we have two exams in it: mid-sems and end-sems, and also the internal assessment.
detailed_review.Other: The college also organizes various events on the campus, which are on different topics, and also a lot of workshops on new things going on in the market. The clubs in the college will help you refine your passion and skills.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information and Communication Technology
reviews.review_title: The college provides excellent faculty and a huge and atmosphere-friendly campus.

detailed_review.Placements: There are 180 seats for ICT B.Tech. The highest salary package offered is 9 LPA. The lowest salary package offered is 6.31 LPA. The college provides top companies like IBM, Shell, Jio Platform, TCS, and many more. The overall placement session for 2023 was 90% with over 100 companies participating in the recruitment process.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are amazing like classrooms, the atmosphere, libraries, and labs. Facilities in the hostel are good. The hostel follows the discipline in the canteen and mess. Overall, it is good. I would recommend this college to you all.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very supportive and help you understand the concept very easily and in a good manner. The course and college both make students industry-ready. This college helps you to explore and learn. Exams are pretty moderate. They are not very hard not very easy. The pass percentage is around 85%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this college because the campus, faculty, and exposure they give to students are amazing.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: All about my college from Devarshi.

detailed_review.Placements: The particular department has comparatively fewer placements because most of the students go on to their personal businesses. However, of those who applied for placement, above 80% got placed. Internship opportunities are also provided by the institute.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The classrooms are modern, and the internet connection is also good. The library is also one of the biggest. The food in the mess is above decent, and the quality is good. Sports are highly rated in the college. Medical services are also provided anytime when needed.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty are highly trained, and all are teaching according to the latest curriculum. Industry ready students are made from the latest syllabus, and the exams are moderate to tough, depending on the subject. However, most of the students pass the course.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good curriculum, certain faculties are not up to the mark, inconsistent and harsh grading system.

detailed_review.Placements: The highest package recorded for Mechanical Engineering until now was 20 LPA, and the average this year was around 6-7 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Micron, Reliance, L&T, JSW, etc. The university and the department claim that they offer 100% placements, but that’s not the case. The placement percentage is quite lower than that.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel facilities and infrastructure are decent, but catering/food services and quality are below average. Most of the classrooms, labs, and libraries are good, better than most private colleges. Sports facilities are also good, with a newly established huge sports complex.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are highly qualified, some of them are helpful and knowledgeable, but many don’t have good teaching skills and don’t give deserving grades to students. Evaluation can be very harsh sometimes. The semester exams are usually moderate to tough, and way more challenging in comparison to most of the other private colleges. The curriculum overall is quite decent but can be improved as well.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information and Communication Technology
reviews.review_title: University have good infrastructure and very well designed curriculum.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements for PDEU College are very good and students are placed very well. ICT department placements are 3.45 Lacs on average and higher placements are 8.90 Lacs, recruiting companies like Google, Microsoft, and Accenture also visited for placements and placed very well.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The university has very well facilities for students and well-designed infrastructure for our course and department. The college also provides free wi-fi facilities and easily accessible labs, libraries, and classrooms also, students anytime issue books from the library, and easily accessible.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty also have a good mindset for teaching students very well and good techniques for learning it and teachers are very helpful and qualified for teaching students very well faculty members are also relevant for this course and curriculum and also knowledgeable and good mindset.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information and Communication Technology
reviews.review_title: Insights of Pandit Deendayal Energy University.

detailed_review.Placements: Nearly 30% of final-year students get campus placements, and 20% got off-campus placements from different companies. The highest package was nearly 24 Lacs per annum, which was given to a CSE student, and the average package for CSE students is nearly 12 Lacs, whereas for ICT, the average package is 7.5 Lacs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good. The quality of food in the mess is medium. The hostel rooms can also be termed as average. We have two libraries: one for SOT, which contains books for all B.Tech branches like civil, mechanical, etc., and one library for SLS students, which includes courses like literature and other language courses.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teaching quality can be said to be above average. The difficulty level of the semester exams depends on the faculty assigned to that subject. The exam is divided into three parts: mid-semester (25 marks), internal assessment (25 marks), and end-semester examination (50 marks).
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course as it provides insight and knowledge of both the hardware part, which mainly includes the communication field, and the software part, which mainly consists of coding and designing software.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information and Communication Technology
reviews.review_title: Review of SoT, Pandit Deendayal Energy University (PDEU).

detailed_review.Placements: Placements for the petroleum branch are pretty good, but placements for the branch like ICT are not good. Local companies visit our college. Mass recruiting companies like Accenture and Infosys visit the college and provide a salary package of 3.6 LPA. Approximately 30 students got placed. Reliance visits here and provides good perks. It offers a wonderful salary package of 17 LPA. It is for the petroleum branch. Jio visits our college and provides a salary package of 7.5 LPA with other perks.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is pretty good compared to other colleges in Gujarat. Labs are well-equipped with good PCs and hardware-related resources. Three libraries operate from morning 9 AM to evening 8 PM. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus. There is a mess and a cafeteria. The food quality is not good in the mess sometimes.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members here are mostly Ph.D. holders from IITs. They have good knowledge of their particular subjects. They are very supportive of doubts. They provide end-to-end guidance for any project. The research work in the college is good. The teaching is very good. We get a supportive environment.

The first is the theoretical systems; conducted primarily in the form of lectures, tutorials and labs, which are accompanied by frequent consultation of various knowledge sources. The second is the practical system, in the form of Industrial and Research Training, during which the students apply theories learned. Students undergo industrial training in their respective fields to make them familiar with industry operations. The ultimate goal of the training is to accelerate integration into professional careers once the student is hired to do a certain task.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering
reviews.review_title: It has poor management and poor facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: I am from the 2021-2025 B.Tech Civil Engineering batch from NIT Puducherry. Our class strength is 25, out of which 10 students got placed in the 2025 campus recruitment. Companies like Sobha and L&T visit the college for recruitment. The highest package offered is 13 LPA this year (2025) in our batch.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: NIT Puducherry has 2 boys' hostels and 1 girls' hostel. There is a sharing problem as freshers need to adjust 4 boys per room and 3 girls per room. Senior students need to share with 3 or 2, depending on the availability of the room. There is no single room available in this college. There is poor management, and if anything gets damaged or a Wi-Fi problem occurs, it takes nearly a week to get solved. It has a poor quality mess and canteen. Limited items are available on campus. Mostly, students go out to eat, which is 10 KM away from campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very responsible and very strict. To get a signature, students need to wait for several hours during rush. Semester exam difficulty level varies with the branch. In civil, it is not so tough, and mostly repeated questions are seen. Throughout the semester, we have 2 cycle tests (CT 1 and CT2, both for 20 marks plus and 10 marks assignment) followed by the end-semester of 50 marks total, comprising 100 marks. Students need to get 35% to pass the semester.
detailed_review.Other: If students are from the North, then this college is not highly recommended. For girls, it has major issues as they need to enter their hostel before 9:30 PM. They need to do a signature every time they are going out of the hostel or going to class. If students are going off campus again, then at the main gate entry, they require an ID card. Staff members and security are rude to students.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: EEE Graduate from NITPY, it is still developing.

detailed_review.Placements: People were placed with an average salary of around 7 LPA in EEE. Companies like Hitachi, Nexturn, L&T, and QBit Labs came for recruitment. The placement season is not over yet. A few people got into ABB. The roles offered were Graduate Trainee, Data Analyst, and Software Developer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It's under construction; a lot of facilities are yet to be established. Currently, there are two boys' hostels and a girls' hostel. One of the boys' hostels is air-conditioned, and the second hostel has good facilities. Mess services are average, and the food-providing service maintains cleanliness and hygiene.
detailed_review.Faculty: EEE faculty are good and supportive, although experts are limited to some areas of electrical engineering, and not a lot of research facilities can be availed. The course load was manageable, but with the advent of NEP, things have changed quite a bit.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of NIT Puducherry - National Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements:
95% of the students got placed in my course. 
62 LPA is the highest package and 9 LPA is the lowest package.
Samsung is the top recruiter.
100% of the students got internships in companies like Samsung, Intel, Wipro, etc. The top role offered by our college is in the artificial intelligence course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure:
We have three computer labs with all the software that is required for our practice and development of our knowledge and we have a library that consists of many books that are useful for students. 
Our hostel is a little bit messy, but when it comes to food, it is adjustable.
detailed_review.Faculty:
Yes, our faculty is very much qualified and experienced. The teaching techniques include the theory about the topics and the practical examples and the solutions to solve the problems. 
The course curriculum is very useful for the students. 
40% is the pass percentage and the semester exams are moderate.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of NIT Puducherry- National Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements:
50 percent of students were placed in the IT sector.
The highest package as of now is 16 LPA, the lowest is 3.5 LPA, and the average package is 8 LPA. The top recruiting companies are ABB, CDOt, Accenture, etc. 
50 percent of students got internships from my course and in Lenevo company.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities in our college are average because it was constructed only 4 years ago. The Wi-Fi will be there strongly sometimes, and the Wi-Fi will be there very little sometimes, so it is difficult for us to use the internet. The food qualities will be bad.
detailed_review.Faculty: Yes, the teachers in the national institute of technology Puducherry will be more helpful, and the quality of their knowledge is very high, and they are so knowledgeable. Yes, the course curriculum is relevant, and the students from our industry were ready.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I am very interested in physics.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: All about NIT Puducherry.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 77% of students are placed in our batch this year with average packages. The highest package offered is 20 LPA and the average package offered is 7-8 LPA. This year, Samsung, ABP, and many more companies visited our institute. Half of the students got internships in companies like ONGC.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities given in classrooms are good enough. There are 10 fans in every classroom with good ventilation. There is good Wi-Fi network everywhere in the Science block where classes are going on. The library contains every textbook included in our course. Hostel rooms are good.
detailed_review.Faculty: The best thing in our institute is the faculty members. They are highly qualified and have a wide range of knowledge in their respective fields. Our college is following NEP, that is, New Education Policy. It has the most updated syllabus. Semester exams are easy only if you have studied in class.
detailed_review.Other: EEE is the best after CSE in our institute. Sports facilities need improvement. Fests are average.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering
reviews.review_title: Don't judge a college by its tag.

detailed_review.Placements: This year, almost 30 percent of students from civil engineering got placed. Generally, companies like ABB, Ford-IT, Next TURN, L&T, BOSCH Global software and Samsung offer a median to high package. In civil engineering, the placement scenario is worse; most of the offers are for CSE or IT-related. This time, one senior Anna from Civil got a package of 1.2 LPA that also included CTC. The highest package in the core was approximately 15 lpa.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In terms of infrastructure, this college is worse. Currently, it is in the developing phase. Wi-Fi is lower-band, classrooms are not AC-fitted, and the library is not enhanced enough to be called a central library. Only a handful of books are available there. For girls, there is AC in the hostels; it's called Moyar Hostel. For boys, we have two hostels, one in Bharali and another in Bhavani. In hostels, you will get yellow water that will help you attain your 30 quickly, because at the age of 20, you will start to look like an older guy due to excessive chair falls. Mark my words, you will experience the worst life here and no authorities even care about it.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are friendly but not well trained. If you are good enough to establish a sweet relationship with them, you will excel in academics. Teaching quality is far below the standards of an institute of national importance. I am happy with the course curriculum because it gives you the freedom to choose subjects from different departments. As per the rules of NEP 2020, a student with a decent CGPA has the academic freedom to choose a major from a different department. But this year, the authorities here compelled us to go with the minor option instead of a major for our own comfort, citing the infrastructural limitations.
detailed_review.Other: I was interested in getting the NITian tag, so in the search for mirage, I landed here. Now I am regretting my choice. The best thing about this college is that it doesn't exist. As of now, you have to wait 10 more years to discover if any better things are yet to come. Events here are neither entertaining nor creative; they are not even engaging. The most active club here is Hotshots, the dance club. I do like them. But they only dance to Tamil songs; it feels like they are still living in the old Bollywood era.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: This is a college under development.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement statistics say approximately 95% of those who appear for the placement get a hiring letter. The highest package in recent years is evolving around 25–30 LPA, and the lowest is 6 LPA. Zoho, L&T, ABB, SAMSUNG and many more companies recruit students from this college. In my class, people are opting for paid internships. Top roles include data analyst, data processing supervisor, program developer, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It's currently under development. Pentagon will take 2 more years; similarly, multiple buildings are being constructed for residence. Wi-Fi is bad and classrooms are not AC-fitted. The library is primitive and the labs are not hi-tech. Very limited sports facilities are there. Here we have a single basketball court, a single badminton court, a single volleyball court and 2 volleyball courts. Foods in a mess are not up to par. They are neither nutritious nor tasty but still, they charge 23,000 per semester as a mess fee.
detailed_review.Faculty: One teacher in CSE simply copied from the YouTube channel. One teacher gives a crystal clear explanation but doesn't hesitate to get students clean-brained in the exam. So at the very least, I can say they are qualified but not experienced and updated. The course curriculum is relevant. The difficulty of exams compounds with each passing semester, so be careful.
detailed_review.Other: I wanted CSE in an NIT and this was the most luminous option for me. I wish they should use digital methods to make classes more engaging. Leciel i is a cultural festival, but it needs a drastic improvement as all the invited guests are local and predominantly Tamil; there is no space for other languages. There is nothing like crowd life here.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good infrastructure and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: 85 percent of the students who go for placements get placed. Companies like ABB and QBit are offered in NITPY. An average package of 9 LPA is given. Internships are offered from companies like Ericsson, and small-scale industries like NSIC, which train the students in different roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Labs and libraries are air-conditioned, and Wi-Fi facility is available throughout the campus. Classrooms are equipped with projectors. The hostel is good, with a cot, table, chair, and cupboard provided for each student. The food in the mess is okay, and medical facilities are provided 24/7.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-qualified, and they make us knowledgeable; both professors and assistant professors teach well. Yes, the labs do help us with industry-related skills, but in most cases, it is up to us to learn. The semesters are okay if you are well-prepared.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Highly qualified faculty and multiple placements opportunities offered to the students.

detailed_review.Placements: NIT's holds good records for the placements for computer Science. At our college around 50-60% of the students gets placements in this course. Average package offered was 4-7 LPA. Top recruiters at the college were TCS, Infosys, Amazon, Wipro, Accenture, Oracle, Cisco etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: NIT Puducherry is having really good infrastructure for the computer Science course. Computer labs were available for the students programming. Library was there in the college campus with all kinds of books. Wi-Fi, hostel, canteen and other facilities were also given to the student. Multiple sports facilities were available for the students.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty of the college was highly qualified and knowledgeable. In each subject there was highly qualified faculty available at this college. Teaching quality was also good. Course curriculum is relevant and it makes the students industry ready. Various hackathons and other coding programs were organized at this college for the students developments. Semester exams of the college were not very hard to pass.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good but can be more better.

detailed_review.Placements: 59 students are studying in this batch of electronics and communication engineering. The maximum package this year was 15 Lacs. The internships are mostly done by the students themselves, college doesn't help the students for finding any internship.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is not so bad. Since it's under construction, it is a bit difficult to walk and since our hostels are a bit far from college, it makes it difficult to walk so far. The Wi-Fi is not so good on the college campus and also in the hostel.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful and good but since the new education policy the curriculum has been bit difficult. Sem exams are not so difficult and this also depends on the professor. 40 percent is the pass percentage. The course not help the students in getting ready for the industry.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: Not satisfied with this college.

detailed_review.Placements: One of the seniors with whom I was in contact got a package of 11 LPA. He was a brilliant student. Zoho, LnT and Deloitte came for placement. Most of the students got placed in the core company. If someone maintains a decent CGPA, then you will get placed for sure. The lowest package was 6 LPAs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available here. We know but every 15 days there will be a Wi-Fi cut for 2 to 3 days. All blame goes to the hostel administration. No sports complex is there. Fairly speaking, there is no scope for sports. Canteen food is overpriced. The library is too small and does not qualify to be called a NIT library.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful and qualified but some are utterly disappointing. The course curriculum is relevant. Semester exams are comparatively easy. Almost 95 percent of students manage to pass the exam; the rest are extremely lazy so there future is dark. I'm literally giving you a pro tip: if someone seriously prepares a topic, then in 90 percent of the cases, you will find that you are more knowledgeable than your teacher.
detailed_review.Other: This college was near my home so I chose it for my convenience. Infrastructure, student bodies, and plant cover need to be improved. Fest is mediocre. Campus life is 4 stars out of 10 stars.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of NIT Puducherry - National Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: 69% of students were placed this year. The highest package in MECH was 15 LPA and the lowest was 3 LPA. Top recruiting companies are L&T, Abb, UltraTech, etc. None of the students placed got a preplacement offer or an internship. Generally, students were offered mechanical engineering, although some were placed with consulting companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is under construction. No. A proper library or departmental building is there. Life here is like a boast trying to float in a desert full of cacti. Your expectation makes an angle of 180 degrees with reality. Mess. Food lacks all the essential nutrients; very soon you will face severe hairfall, a lack of vision and fatigue. Sports is a nightmare.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are not qualified enough to be called professors. Teaching quality is below the poverty line. Semester exams are moderately difficult. Although the course curriculum is good, it will not benefit you a lot as your friend circle will always be busy with useless entertainment.
detailed_review.Other: I did not choose this course; this course chose me as a scape goat. Events, fests, co-curriculars, etc. are not that good.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: A best place to have a quality education along with entertainment.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements are good in our college and most of the people get placed with a decent package. If you have skills, I'm pretty sure you will get picked for a great package. Many top teaching giants, like ABB, CDot, L&T, Ford, Tech Mahindra and many others, visit us each year.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: In terms of infrastructure, our college is still developing since it was established only in 2010. But infrastructure development is at its full wing. The classrooms are well facilitated and the laboratories are top class with good technician and scholars.
detailed_review.Faculty: The exams and curriculum are easy to cover and learn, provided a little effort has to be taken from our end. Apart from academics, we have various clubs to develop our skills and we can spend a lot of time developing our technical and management skills.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: I am regretting my choice.

detailed_review.Placements: Previously placement was not that good. This year the highest in mech was 15 LPA and the lowest was 6 LPA average was 7 LPA. Abb, cognizant, ola, zoho visited for placement drive. No student got internship in 3 year. Top roles are like instrumedesign, vehicle management etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi in college is very poor I mean very poor they are charging money of 300 per as Wi-Fi feels but the Wi-Fi speed is terrible same applies hostel but for hostel if your room is facing the Wi-Fi outer you will enjoy 4k vdo streaming without interruption otherwise oops 303 Error not found. If you are choosing this college get used to eat price without vegetables.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty are but not qualified enough. Curriculum is good but here they teach only theory the teachers are not practical oriented. Especially Physics faculty and Chemistry faculty. Sem exams are easy but to be an 10 holder you have study round the year.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: My life became hell when I entered this college.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement is improving day by day. Companies like cognizant, samsung, Abb, L&T, zoho visits here for placement drive. The highest package is like 20 LPA and the lowest package is like 2 LPA. Avg is 10 LPA. Rarely any body gets a placement here. Here there is no coding culture. Teachers are not serious even students are also not serious.
detailed_review.Infrastructure:
Only moyar hostel has good facility. Bharali and bhavani hostel are like some third class government college hostel Additional there is money maniac. Money sole my friends 45 k earbuds 
Last month. So you have tocloseyour door and windows 24 hours.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are friendly. Some are experts some tries their best some are in capable and taking the best advantage of their government job. Cillege exams are of medium to easy level. National education policy 2020 has been fully implement here. Overall course curriculum is good.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course by mistakenly thinking that this college will be in pondi and I will be enjoying in the beaches with foreign beauties but this college is in Karaikal district near coastal area. Karaikal is a rural are the nearest market from our college is 3 km. Campus life is bitter. Hot sun scorching heat, dirty water, water submerged campus, care less authorities and meagre facilities.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Mesmerizing and stress relieving.

detailed_review.Placements: In CSE, the placement is decent but in comparison to other colleges still need to be improved. By the way one positive news is that the placement is increasing drastically every year. The highest package of the college is 40 Lacs per annum but that was grabbed in off campus placement. For In campus placement the highest figure is approximately 22 LPA. SEE if you managers to have decent CGPA and have some practical knowledge in your subject easily you can grab 15 LPA. In it sector you will be offered roles like programmer, soft aware developed, backed and front end developed based on your coding and subject skills.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: This college is still under construction mode. So there is not much to explore. No proper Drinking water supply and daily use water level is below average it looks yellow and hostellers are facing severe hairfall and skin tanning because of the un hygienic water. No sports complex is there, not even proper grounds are there. Wi-Fi speed is very slow. Library does not have the required books. Its very small.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are helpful. Many of them are great but majority of them are mediocre. Course curriculum is good but majority of the students do not prefer text book because the library fails to provide sufficient text books. Sem exams in first year and second year is very easy just open the book 5 days before exam memorise and vomit in the exam.
detailed_review.Other: Fest is there but there is a lot discrimination for other languages Like Hindi and Telugu, they only invite so called local stars who prefer only Tamil. Puducherry consists of Yanam, mahe, and karaikal but I don't know why before inauguration of every event they will play only Tamil Nadu state anthem. Campus life is horrible. Thanks god gender ratio is like 2:1. But the garden is ful of black flowers so there is no scope for white butterflies.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is an average college. Do not expect much.

detailed_review.Placements: 80% students got placed in my department this year. The highest package offered was 15 LPA by Abbs. L&T visited this campus. 5 to 10 percent students got internship. All of the students got placed in core sector and very few in IT sector.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are only 2 hostels for boys. Moyar and Bharali. Bharli is congested and worse. Moyar has AC and good facilities. The hostel administration is careless. Water is yellow like urine. No proper drinking water facility. Wi-Fi speed is not upto mark. You got to complain to get proper facility. Some juniors recently staged a protest kind of thing then only they got the proper drinking and electricity facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are helpful but they lack the necessary teaching skills. Tamil teachers have awful accent so it becomes difficult for outsiders to process those pronunciations. Exams are of medium level. Start reading before 10 days then you will be among top 20% of the class.
detailed_review.Other: I chose it because my parents did not want me to go outside the state. Sports facilities, mess facilities, in time and transportation facilities need improvement. The authorities are not that active to improve the college. Fest is disappointing. Normally no celebrity comes here. Only local so called stars come and waste our time. Tamil dominance is there in cultural activities .

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: A developing college with lots of opportunities.

detailed_review.Placements:
Recruitment has been good for our batch compared to other years. Around 80 percent of students have been placed. Top roles offered to us would be Network Engineer, Software Engineer, Full Sack developed, Data scientist and Data analyst. The highest package -14.5 LPA
the lowest package -I am not sure.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college opened 7 years back. The college has been developing slowly along the time. Individual classrooms for all depth and year students with projector facilities provided. There is a central library present in the campus to cherish and grow and knowledge. Wi-Fi is present in all the building in the campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: The professors are really knowledgeable and friendly too. Some of them are 10 to 15 years experienced. The course covers basics to semi advanced in Electronics and Communication. There has been little tweaks in the syllabus lately. They have been updating according to the industrial requirements and standards.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of NIT Puducherry - National Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: Our college provides good placements. Almost 80% of students are placed. The highest salary package offered is 18 LPA and the average salary package offered is 7 LPA. Top recruiting companies like ABS, Ford, Oracle, etc., visit our campus. To secure a good salary package, focusing on the software aspect is crucial. Our seniors are excellent and helpful.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Labs are well-equipped. Air-conditioners are available in labs. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. The hostel is good. The quality of the food in the canteen is good. Medical facilities are good. Classrooms are well-ventilated.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our teachers are helpful. The course curriculum is new as per NEP, which is very helpful for students. NEP offers a wide range of options, enhancing the potential to secure higher-paying positions off-campus by learning many things.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of NIT Puducherry - National Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: The highest salary package offered is 20 LPA. The lowest salary package offered is 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Oracle, ABB, etc. Top roles offered are software engineer, software developer, python developer, etc. Our college doesn't provide internship opportunities.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college provides us with all facilities. The hostel facilities are not good. Wi-Fi facility is available in the hostel. The library has a few books. It is equipped with air-conditioners. The food served in the mess is not good. The food served in the canteen is average. Medical facilities are not good in our college. They don't provide an ambulance for sick people.
detailed_review.Faculty: The coursework is not much informative. If we want to gain more knowledge, we have to do self-study. Semester exams are not much difficult if we pay attention to the class and study the notes. It is sufficient to get more than 8 CGPA. They have recruited more faculty members. The course curriculum has changed.
detailed_review.Other: The infrastructure of our college should be improved.

data.title: NIT Puducherry Placement Report 2025
summary: The NIT Puducherry has released the placement brochure for academic year 2025-26. As per the report, the highest and average packages offered stood at INR 23 LPA and INR 9.63 LPA , respectively grabbed by the MTech ECE branch. Moreover, the overall BTech placement rate was 82.89% . Over 50 recruiters took part during the hiring process and placed more than 160 students in total. Notable recruiters such as Accenture, Amazon and Samsung participated during the NIT Puducherry placements 2025.

During NIT Puducherry placements 2024, 56 recruiters participated and placed 158 BTech, 8 MTech, and 6 MSc students of the 2024 batch. The students received 42 dreams and 135 non-dream offers during the placement session 2024 . The highest and average package offered to the BTech batch in 2024 was INR 24 LPA and INR 7.9 LPA . MTech batch 2024 received highest and average package of INR 16 LPA and INR 11.28 LPA . BTech placement rate in 2024 was 80.2%. MTech and MSc placement rate in 2024 was 57.14% and 31.6%.
The top recruiters of NIT Puducherry in 2024 included Publicis Sapient, Samsung, Jio Infocomm, Schlumberger, Straive, Oracle, Zuora, Eaton , etc.

college_info.college_name: SKCET Coimbatore: Courses, Fees, Admission 2025, Placements, Cutoff, Reviews

highlights.summary:
SKCET Coimbatore, formerly known as Sri Krishna College of Engineering and Technology, was established in 1998. It is one of the premier institutes in South India located in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. SKCET Coimbatore is affiliated with Anna University with 7 programmes being accredited by NBA. Based on the NIRF ranking 2024, Sri Krishna College of Engineering and Technology got 83 rank in the 'Engineering' category.
SKCET Coimbatore offers 11 UG programmes, 4 PG programmes, an integrated programme and 8 research programmes. SKCET Coimbatore courses include BTech, MCA, MTech, MBA, and PhD among others, offered in the disciplines of Engineering and Management. SKCET Coimbatore admissions are based on entrance for admission to all undergraduate and postgraduate courses. SKCET - Sri Krishna College of Engineering and Technology offered courses for 1653 seats in the fee range of INR 35,000 to INR 2.5 lakh.
The institute also encourages financially and categorically backward students with several scholarships with the intent to promote equal opportunities. SKCET Coimbatore Placements are conducted by the institute placement cell. According to the latest report, SKCET recorded a 91% placement rate for the batch 2024 till February 2024. Further, the highest and average package offered during SKCET placements in 2024 stood at INR 51 LPA and INR 6.20 LPA, respectively. Sri Krishna College of Engineering and Technology provides good facilities all around the campus such as auditorium, boys hostel, cafeteria, convenience store, girls hostel, gym, hospital/ medical facilities, hostel, labs, library, shuttle service, sports complex, and Wi-Fi campus. A few of the important highlights regarding Sri Krishna College of Engineering and Technology are mentioned in the table below:
Check out the below videos for more information:

college_info_program.intro:
Sri Krishna College of Engineering and Technology comprises several departments, including the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, the Department of Electrical Engineering, and the Department of Engineering Design, among others. Through its departments, SKCET Coimbatore offers various UG, PG, and PhD courses.
The BTech and MTech programmes offered at the Sri Krishna College of Engineering and Technology are very popular among the students. The institute offers a four-year BTech programme and a two-year MTech programme in numerous specialisations. The popularity of these programmes is attributed to their curriculum, which has been developed and upgraded to enhance the knowledge of students in various branches of Engineering and Technology. SKCET Coimbatore aims at the holistic development of students and helps them to develop technical competencies as well as various soft skills required to target core-industry roles. The industry-institute relations established by SKCET Coimbatore provide students with the opportunity to undergo various training programmes organised by industry partners. SKCET Coimbatore also offers placement assistance to students and helps them get placed in top companies. The notable SKCET Coimbatore recruiters include Microsoft, Google, Accenture, Amazon, Infosys, Bosch, Capgemini, and HCL, among others.
