reviews.course: Integrated B.Tech.+ M.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Faculty members are good, and there is good campus life. A lot of good people from different culture

detailed_review.Placements: About 60 members were placed in this course. This course has only one batch per year. The highest package was about 44 LPA, the average package is 10 LPA, and the lowest package was 3 LPA. Companies like Google and Chorizo hired about 10 to 15 members for Software Engineer roles. So this is all about the placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is too good and top-notch. The cleanliness is next level. Wi-Fi is available both in the college and the hostel. The library is one of the largest libraries in Tamil Nadu.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty was quite good, and they would explain everything in detail. Teachers have very good knowledge about the subject, and the teaching quality was quite good, but not too good. The course is 100% relevant and includes one coding language every semester. The semester exam questions would cover the entire syllabus and are of a medium level.
detailed_review.Other: If you are interested in coding languages and want to do both a Bachelor's and a Master's at the same time, this course will suit you the most. You should not expect any college fests because this college is only for the curriculum.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
reviews.review_title: Good placements, supportive environment, and excellent infrastructure for overall growth.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80% of students in my batch got placed with packages ranging from 3 LPA to 12 LPA and an average of 6 LPA. Top recruiters included TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Accenture, and Capgemini. Nearly 60% secured internships with companies like Deloitte, HCL, and Cognizant.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Campus offers excellent infrastructure with well-equipped labs, high-speed Wi-Fi, spacious classrooms, and a rich library. Hostel facilities are clean and comfortable, with 24/7 water and electricity. Mess serves decent and hygienic food with both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are knowledgeable and supportive, though teaching styles vary among departments. Curriculum is mostly relevant but could be updated more frequently to match industry needs. Semester exams are moderately difficult, focusing on both theory and practical applications.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: Life at Sri Krishna College of Engineering and Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: My college is one of the finest colleges in Tamil Nadu. It offers good placements. Usually, the average package is around 8 LPA. There are more software placements than getting into the core. It is good for computer science. It is one of the good courses.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Usually, my college hostel is not worth it. The money costs around 2 lakhs which is not worth the money. Infrastructure of the course is good and good for computer science. The hostel food and rooms are not upto the standards where always a problem.
detailed_review.Faculty: The exams are a bit of theory and it is not upto the standard of other colleges. At the end of the semester, they will give us the question bank and we just blankly memorize and write it in the exams. Usually, the academic part is a bit unstable here which is not good.
detailed_review.Other: My college is good for computer and other related departments.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: Excellent facilities, good placements, good faculty, and an extraordinary library.

detailed_review.Placements: Everything is good, and everyone likes to join because we can gain knowledge and experience to work in jobs. Top companies like Amazon, Microsoft, TCS, Soliton, and some dream companies are also present. From the 2nd year onwards, we can go for internships and gain some knowledge.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Extraordinary sports performance in zonal and inter-college events, free Wi-Fi provided in classes and hostels. Medical facilities also present in our college, and all labs with good machines, circuits, and computers. The college gives importance to players.
detailed_review.Faculty: Exams are good with extraordinary questions that help to gain knowledge. Semester exams are conducted once every 3 months. Teachers teach well and solve tough problems to help with our education, knowledge gain, and GATE preparation.

reviews.course: B.E. in Mechatronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is a good choice for mechatronics with strong placements and infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 70 to 80 percent of students in our course get placed every year. The highest package offered is 10 LPA and the average ranges from 4 to 5 LPA. The lowest package ranges between 2.5 to 3 LPA. The top recruiting companies for our course are Bosch, TCS, Infosys, Zoho, L&T and Cognizant. Nearly 50 to 60 percent of students also get internship opportunities in companies like Ashok Leyland, TVS and various startups. Core roles like design engineer, embedded systems developer and automation engineer are offered along with software development roles in some cases.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our department is well-equipped with modern labs for robotics, automation, electronics, and mechanical systems. Classrooms are spacious, air-conditioned, and Wi-Fi enabled. The central library has a good collection of technical books and journals. Hostels are well-maintained with decent rooms, 24x7 water and electricity supply. The mess food is hygienic and offers both veg and non-veg options, though it can be repetitive. Medical facilities are available on campus. There is a large ground for sports like cricket, football, and athletics, along with indoor game facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are experienced, approachable, and supportive. Most of them have strong academic backgrounds and industry exposure. The course curriculum is quite relevant and includes recent advancements in AI, IoT, and automation. It prepares students for industry roles, especially in core fields. Exams are moderate in difficulty. The pass percentage is generally above 85%, but consistent study is needed to maintain a good CGPA. Practical learning and projects are emphasised from the second year.
detailed_review.Other: I chose mechatronics because it is an interdisciplinary field that combines mechanical, electronics, and programming skills. It is perfect for the automation and robotics future. The best part is the hands-on learning and project-based approach. I wish there were more industry collaborations and updated lab equipment. Overall, the environment motivates us to grow both technically and personally.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good infrastructure and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: 100% of students are getting placed. 44LPA is the highest package, and 6LPA is the lowest. Software designer, circuit controller, IT department, and coding positions are being offered in the software sector, and they are quite limited as well. Everyone is being placed.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have excellent infrastructure. For the first-year students, we provide a switch box facility to charge our laptops at our convenience, and the Wi-Fi is functioning well. Our library is the largest in any college in Asia. The hostel rooms are quite decent, and there are no issues with them. The only problem is the food.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members are quite good, and everyone teaches well. Portals have been launched, which are very useful for students seeking placements, as every programming language is taught each semester by experts, and tasks have been assigned to be completed.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: I love the college the most.

detailed_review.Placements: 80 to 90% of students get placed in our college. The highest package is around 40 - 50 LPA. The lowest package is around 4-5 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Amazon, TCS, Accenture, etc. Most of the students got placed in my course which is cyber security.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I love the infrastructure most. The college infrastructure is maintained properly and regularly. Classrooms are high-tech with smart boards and projectors. We have a big library which is maintained properly. I love the canteen most. I love the food I get in the canteen.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very friendly with students. They are well-qualified. They are well-experienced. They teach us practically. They update the syllabus regularly according to the trend which helps students to get placed in good companies.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this college for its infrastructure and the placement rate. My course cyber security has great value in future. Many technical events are conducted in our college. They encourage us to take part in many events.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
reviews.review_title: SKCET review by Wilsonpaulraj.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 90% and above students got placed. The highest package is 51 LPA in Microsoft (off-campus) and the lowest ranges from 5 LPA to 6 LPA. Top recruiting companies include ServiceNow, Accenture, TCS, Wipro, LTIMindtree, etc. They offer various roles like software engineer, data analyst, and ML engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure in SKCET is very good. They have modern labs and classrooms. Hostel facilities are also very good. Hostel food is edible and non-vegetarian food is not available. Sports are also focused in this college. There is a football ground, cricket nets, basketball court, tennis court, and more.
detailed_review.Faculty: There are 2 CIA exams. Course curriculum are related to the course. Pass percentage is also very high. Semester exams are moderately difficult. There are written exams and practical exams as well. Semester exams are assessing the skills of students effectively.
detailed_review.Other: I chose AI because of my interest and it's trending nowadays. It would be better if there are more practical lessons and workshops. Events are conducted very rarely. It's a big disadvantage.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology
reviews.review_title: Infrastructure at SKCET.

detailed_review.Placements: The best departments for placements at SKCET are CSE and IT. Most companies that visit the campus are IT-based, such as Accenture, CTS, Wipro, Mr Cooper, Amazon, ZOHO, and Excelacom. Even though most placements are in IT services, core students can also attend these IT company interviews.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure was excellent. The classrooms were modern and had smart boards. The library was one of the largest and had a vast collection of books. This made it easy to find resources for project work or research. The canteen offered good food with decent options.
detailed_review.Faculty: The professors at SKCET are friendly and approachable, especially those in IT and CSE. They are always willing to help students with doubts and project work. The management is supportive, and if you have any issues, you can always email the chairperson. We get a lot of encouragement for academic activities like hackathons, research, and even patent filing.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placements till 2022 after that due to recession there is fall in placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Some of the top recruiters are Amazon, JP Morgan, Tech Mahindra, and Soti. They recruit from various locations, including Chennai, Coimbatore, Bangalore, Pune, Hyderabad, and Cochin, with packages above 8 LPA. Internship opportunities are very good, especially for third-year students. We have AICET internships from the government and various internship opportunities to ISRO via hackathons like Smart India Hackathons.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The classrooms at this college are good and sufficient, and they are provided with all the necessary facilities. The mess and canteen facilities are very good, and they serve a good quality and variety of foods. The medical facility is average, and the boys hostel wardens are mostly friendly and supportive.
detailed_review.Faculty: I studied at SKCET and found the faculty to be supportive and knowledgeable. They are well qualified, and the teaching quality is good. The study materials are well designed and meet the standards. Semester exams are difficult for mathematical papers. For other theoretical and core papers, you need to write neatly and provide supporting evidence.
detailed_review.Other: Good campus connectivity.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Awesome placements, if you have skillsets then you can definitely get your dream offer.

detailed_review.Placements: The opportunities provided here are tremendous. Even if we miss one or two opportunities, if we keep trying, we will definitely get our dream offer. But after every interview, we need to upskill and upgrade ourselves on what we have missed during preparation. Many students have gotten dream offers here, including offers of 10 LPA, 13 LPA, 18 LPA and 22 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The library at this college is the best I've ever seen. It has a wide variety of books from fiction to nonfiction. The library staff is friendly and helpful. If we can't find the book that we have been looking for the librarian will try to get it for us. The only downside is that the library rules are strict. If we don't return a book on time, we will have to pay a fine. The hostel is good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Semester exams are slightly difficult and the pass percentage is 50 percent. For internal exams, the exam is for 50 marks but the pass mark is 30. It is slightly difficult to pass because we need to answer all the questions without options. Still for semester exams, we can easily score good marks by just filling out the pages.
detailed_review.Other: The college needs to improve on connectivity.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: You have to pay extra fee for training but good placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Thanikachalam training and face prep training are essential for placement preparation, but they cost extra. Other types of training are free, including system design, core subjects, and data structures. Top recruiters include TCS and Accenture.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is good, but some things are not maintained. The hospital at the entrance to the college, called "Ramakrishna Hospital," has been closed since the day I started studying at this college. Also, there is no emergency medical facility, and the nearby hospital only accepts patients during certain hours.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty are good and helpful. However, they prioritize their own safety and tend to blame students for everything. The faculty teaching won't make you industry-ready, but the industrial training does. Starting in our second year, we'll be ahead of many toppers in other colleges because of the specialized college training.
detailed_review.Other: No events, fest, extracurricular activity and no proper sports training.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good college for only placements

detailed_review.Placements: SKCET has a strong track record in placements, with leading companies like Cisco, JP Morgan, Acko hiring students. Top salary package include 25 LPA-13 LPA. Although many students secure internships, converting them into full time. However nowadays some company may not extend full time.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Very good infrastructure with good wifi and even laptops are being provided. The labs are good with ac and good ventilation. The mechanical and electrical labs are highly equipped and we have a big fiber ground, a tennis court and a basket ball court but sports is given 0 importance. There is no proper faculty for sports and also no support. Students who come through sports quota will have a great disappointment. The hostel is very strict with average food.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculties are good and our college is in collaboration with industrial experts like Neo, face prep and amprp for placement preparation and to gain industrial knowledge. Our college also conducts many codethon and coding competitions and also internal hackathons. We should not expect for any cultural events in our college even industrial visit is also not permitted.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Business System
reviews.review_title: Unfriendly faculty, regret joining skcet but good placements

detailed_review.Placements: Internship and full time opportunities are really good in our college. Students get placed in top companies and managed to get internship via the opportunities provided by college and their own skillsets. Top internship recruiters are Accenture, Amazon and Service Now. And college also provide PEGA certification training which help you get higher packages.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: College environment is good and is designed in good manner. College is full of plants, trees and flowers. Just awesome environment to study. But college hostel is not good, I hate it for being there for 2 years, absolute dissatisfaction. No emergency medical facility and warden is very strict.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculties are very rude and not understanding, They will punish you if you are late for 5 minutes to college and some times they are target you. During the end of semester they will load you with large number of assignments, test. core papers are tough to pass and sometimes they voluntary fail you in your arrear exam if they came to know you have cheated in exam.
detailed_review.Other: Rude and average knowledgeable faculties.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Modern campus and great placements

detailed_review.Placements: I am currently pursuing Computer Science And Engineering final year. My college placements is very good. Many companies visit our college from 3rd year itself. Companies like Accenture, Cognizant do the bulk hiring of more than 100 students and also many companies like Securonix , Azentio, Excelacom, Zoho, Soliton come to our college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: My college is known for the aesthetic environment and good infrastructure. Our college have great labs for industrial training. New labs were renovated in my first year which helps us to gain more knowledge. The library in our college is also large with even a digital library. The hostel in our college for boys is not so strict but for girls strict timing is followed and for going to our hometown we have get sign from hod, tutors and warden which is very complicated. The food is vegetarian only and is average.
detailed_review.Faculty: I am studying computer science and the curriculum is very good and we have industrial training for all subjects In our 2nd year and 3rd year we did 2 projects using java, react and spring boot which helped us to improve our industrial skills. Our faculties also encourage us to participate in hackathons and codeathons.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Sri Krishna College - Good Placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Still, 50% of students got placed in our department. The highest package is 25 LPA, and the lowest package is 3.5 LPA. The average package is 5 LPA. Many students received offers from Accenture, which is the easiest to crack in the interview process. Several companies are offering 4.5 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is really good compared to other colleges. Classrooms are really good, and the library is huge with a lot of books on different themes. The facilities available in the hostel include good food. However, the hostel is too expensive, which is not that worth it.
detailed_review.Faculty: The college mainly focuses on hackathons and training. Apart from that, sports, cultural events, and other activities are not happening in college. There are not many events happening overall, and the semester exams are very easy, which mostly consist of filling out the paper.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: SKCET - Good facilities and placements

detailed_review.Placements: The number of students placed in our department is 60%. Compared to other departments, ours has a higher number of placed students. The highest package is 25 LPA, and the lowest package is 3.5 LPA. Most CSE department students are placed with an average package of 5 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The labs are available separately for CSE, IT, and other departments, with Wi-Fi facilities. The library is huge, with all necessary books available, and if a book isn’t available, we can request it from the library. The hostel is a bit unhygienic, and the food quality is not very good.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are very helpful, and we can also get help from seniors. The seniors guide juniors in many ways, especially in project development for hackathons. The hackathon is a great way to gain recognition in the college, with cash rewards.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology
reviews.review_title: Placements and opportunities in SKCET.

detailed_review.Placements: The top companies recruiting from our college include Amazon, Accenture, Cisco, Zoho, JP Morgan, Mr. Cooper, KLA, and Azentio. The top package in our batch is between 20 to 25 LPA from Cisco, JP Morgan, Acko, and KLA. The average package varies from 4 to 10 LPA, and almost 60% of the students got placed this year. We can still attend companies until next April. The roles offered include software developer, data analyst, frontend developer, full stack developer, and backend developer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have a huge library with many informative books, and a digital library is also present. We are provided with unlimited Wi-Fi, and laptops are available. New labs are being renovated, which helps improve our practical knowledge. Industrial training is provided for all departments, which is very helpful for placements. The hostel facility is good, but the fees are very high. Only vegetarian food is provided. The rules of the hostel are strict, and timing is very important; we have to be inside the hostel by 5:30 PM, and attendance is taken every evening.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are qualified, but the real advantage is the industrial experts who provide us with a lot more knowledge. The teachers are always supportive of learning new technologies. The course and curriculum are mostly relevant, but we have to study some subjects like biology, physics, and chemistry, which are not relevant. Industrial training is given for Java, ReactJS, and C++, and we also built two web applications that made us industry-ready. The semester exams can be easily passed, and a high CGPA can be easily obtained, as only direct questions are asked.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Very good college with sports.

detailed_review.Placements: I am a computer science student, and there are almost 180 people in my department. About 3/4 of them have been placed in good companies with good packages. The training will be provided for students. The training includes aptitude and coding. Some mock interviews will also be conducted for students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-fi facilities will be provided inside each lab and library. Because students will be given practice and training, they need to code on laptops in labs, so they provide wifi. Inside the library, they also provide Wi-Fi because many students will study in the library.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum will always be related to course. Since I am computer science student, the curriculum will be related to java, MySQL, React, etc. In the third year, we will build one mini-project and one full-stack project and in the fourth year, we have built projects with trending technologies.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placements and infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Very good placement is available in Sri krishna. Many students got internships both offline and online. During the end of the 3rd year, companies will start visiting the college. So be prepared for placements from 3 years itself and the training will also be provided by the college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel provides all the necessary facilities for the students. If a student is suffering, they will immediately take them to the hospital. A separate van will always be available to take them to a nearby hospital. The canteen will be clean and for each department, separate labs are available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty are very supportive and teach concepts more clearly to the students. Faculties support students in all ways. Whenever a student needs help, they can ask for help from tutors without hesitation; they will definitely find the solution. Curriculum will be easy to study .

highlights.summary:
Amity University Kolkata started functioning in the year 2014. It is private university, formed when the West Bengal Act of 2014 passed. The exact place of the university is Kadampukur, Kolkata, and Amity University Kolkata is the 10th university campus formed through the Amity Foundation, which is a non-profit organisation.The University has 70+ departments, and 150+ institutions and centers through which it offers 300+ programmes.
Amity University Kolkata courses are offered to students at the UG, PG, and PhD levels. The university offers various courses to students such as BTech, BSc, BBA, BCA, BCom, MTech, MPhil, MCom, MEd, MBA, etc. Kolkata Amity University has various research collaborations under its name, while it has sanctioned 30 funded projects and submitted 301+ funded projects so far.
The university has 170+ PhD scholars, and around 570+ books and chapters have been published under the University name through 1130+ research publications. It is located with a campus size of 110 acres. The University has 800 patents filed by faculty, and 300 government funded research projects carried out by the faculty. It also has 80 international universities as research partners. For more details around Amity University Kolkata, check out the table below:

reviews.course: Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch.)
reviews.review_title: Professional teachers with good skills.

detailed_review.Placements: Some of the emerging companies like L&T, Tata Housing, Godrej, and Sobha Developers took part in the recruitment drive of our college nowadays. But during our time of recruitment, only 5 to 8 companies were involved in recruitment. Various professional architects participated in the webinars to provide some chances for doing internships with their network.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: College events like promotions, cultural, and technical fests are conducted twice or thrice a month. A specific set of penalties and punishments is assigned for all the wrong behavior of us. Hostel premises are liberal, but accurate records are maintained. The usage of mobile phones within specified hours is allowed.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers certainly engage with the students through their personal relationships. The responses of the students are gathered and valued, and proper responses are given by the teachers. Teachers discuss the lessons with creativity and in simpler contexts. They are highly professional in sketching diagrams.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: My experience at Amity University Kolkata is really positive.

detailed_review.Placements: Percentage of students getting placed is approximately 60 percent in B.Tech computer science. Generally, at Amity University Kolkata students get placed at TCS, Deloitte, EY, SAP, etc. Top role offered in my course is SDE. The highest package is 28 LPA, the lowest is 3 LPA, and average is 5 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Campus of the university is not that huge. It has spread over 15 acres of land. There are two academic blocks such as A and E blocks. The campus is located in the outer area of Kolkata. Classrooms are good. The campus is fully air-conditioned and Wi-Fi enabled. Campus has a library consists of more than 10,000 books. Different types of labs such as Matlab, seminar halls, etc., are available. There are two canteens present on the campus that serve good quality food to the students.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some of the faculty members at Amity University Kolkata are good, while some are average. Teachers have done research work and also completed their Ph.D. from prestigious institutions. Their teaching style is so good, and they also help with our academics. Teacher to student ratio is 1:40 which is not bad, according to me.

reviews.course: B.A. LL.B (Hons.)
reviews.review_title: Amity Law School is one of the best private law schools in West Bengal.

detailed_review.Placements: As this is a law course, majority of students here are not first-generation lawyers and often practice with their parents. Amity provides placements in the corporate sector and is very helpful about it. I am not aware of the highest or lowest package offered. Internships are provided by the college, but there are criteria, and not everyone gets them.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is on point, and the best that money can buy. Library is huge, and an entire spare building is allotted for it. You will find all the books you can imagine. College also provides an online e-library that gives you a subscription to SCC online and manupatra.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful without a doubt. The curriculum is relevant, and semester exams are 7/10 tough. Many people fail in the semester exams and have to take the summer semester. Studies are the top priority, contrary to what others say.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I have always wanted to know the law of the land. It is my curiosity that leads me down this path. College should not make attendance so strict because sometimes people have emergencies that the college may not approve of, and we end up losing attendance, marks, and sometimes even get debarred.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Infrastructure is good but academics are not good.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 60% of students were placed in our course. Other than this, some students were also recruited for irrelevant jobs. The average package was around 5 LPA. The highest package was about 12 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Accenture, Capgemini, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Our college had world class infrastructure. It provided Wi-Fi campus, big classroom, very furnished labs, and library with lots of books. Quality of hostel was also good. Limited sports facility was available. It had basic medical facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers were helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. Some were arrogant but most of them were very kind. The teaching quality of our faculty members was kind and innovative. Course curriculum was relevant. Semester examination was moderate.
detailed_review.Other: College had multiple arts and cultural events despite tech events.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical and Automation Engineering
reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied because of campus and academics, good placement for B.Tech.

detailed_review.Placements: More than 70% of students got placed with a median salary of Rs 50,000 monthly. The highest package was around 7 LPA last year. The lowest was 4 LPA. Average was around 6 LPA. Volvo, Manhindra & Mahindra, Reliance, and Honda were the top recruiters. 100% of students were offered internships by IT companies like TCS, Wipro, etc. Core companies like Reliance, Mahindra, and Tata. Retail, operations, and QC/QA are the top roles along with some R&D.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, functional labs, spacious classrooms, centralized library, and canteen are available. Other high-quality facilities include hostel, ATM, cafe coffee day, water coolers, elevator, centralized air conditioning, clinic, sports complex including gym and swimming pool, basketball court, cricket pitch, football field, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: Highly helpful, amiable, qualified, and knowledgeable faculty members are there throughout the departments. Course curriculum is relevant and apt as per the new education policy and other higher standards. It's optimised for making pupils industry-ready. Semester exams are medium difficult but are easy with a little effort in studying and being attentive in classes. Most times, less than 90% is the pass percentage.
detailed_review.Other: Campus life is enough to choose this college. Academics are an added bonus. Labs and practical classes should improve. Events happen all the time with Amiphoria fest once a year. Campus life is smooth and easy. Surroundings are aesthetic, green, and eco-friendly. Scholarship is easily awarded to eligible students. Extracurricular activities are facilitated through existing active clubs.

reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA)
reviews.review_title: Great college life, average placement. Enjoyed 2 years of fests - Amity hosts the best in Kolkata.

detailed_review.Placements: 60-70% of students were placed in our MCA course. The highest package was 12 LPA offered by IBM, the average package was 5-6 LPA offered by some startup companies, and the lowest package ranged from 2.8 to 3.5 LPA. As far as I know, IBM was the top recruiting company. The college provides both paid and unpaid internships. For unpaid internships, you must pay the registration fees, and the same applies to paid internships. You may also receive performance-based offers or PPOs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is easily accessible throughout the Amity campus. The labs and classrooms are very good, and I can say the library is the best I have seen compared to other colleges. The facilities in our hostel are of high quality. The food in the canteen is much better than that in other college canteens, and the prices are affordable for everyone.
detailed_review.Faculty: In our MCA course, all the teachers are helpful. Every teacher holds a Ph.D. degree. The teaching quality is excellent, and the course curriculum is relevant. The teachers give their 100%, and if students do the same, they can become industry-ready. The semester exams are not very difficult; if you attend all classes and prepare well, you can pass easily.
detailed_review.Other: The best part of the university is the events it organizes. I have experienced the best fest in all of Kolkata.

reviews.course: M.A. in Applied Psychology
reviews.review_title: I did a master's from Amity University, Kolkata.

detailed_review.Placements: Particularly in my course, there are no placements. However, for other departments, there are placements. Students get placements from top companies like Amazon, TCS, PwC, etc. Even if there are no placements offered in this course, one can still contact the placement cell and enquire about it.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Amity University, Kolkata, has a huge campus and provides a lot of facilities. There are gallery classrooms, AC, Wi-Fi, a library, and labs. In total, there are 3 canteens on campus. There is also an infirmary on the campus with a nurse and a doctor present. Amity has a yearly sports fest called Sangathan.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are highly qualified, knowledgeable, and helpful. Along with major subjects, they teach subjects like business communication, ethical guidelines, which are extremely helpful to make one industry-ready. There are internal exams and external exams. Semester exams are not so tough that one cannot pass. The pass percentage depends on the course.

reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA)
reviews.review_title: Really good infrastructure, and helpful faculties, but needs a bit of transparent placement process.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are decent, but there can be some improvement. Companies like TCS, Capgemini, and IBM recruit from the college every year. The college provides ample internship opportunities to students, and the placement cell is quite helpful.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the hostel and college is absolutely amazing. It has top-notch facilities, with good Wi-Fi, air-conditioned classrooms, and a huge library with all kinds of books needed for courses. There are three canteens, all serving hygienic and vegetarian food. There are also many shops outside the college that serve non-vegetarian food, which can be brought into the college canteens to sit and eat.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified and knowledgeable and are always ready to help. The course consists of both theoretical and practical knowledge, and students are trained in various soft skills and business management skills, which make them helpful for the industry in the future. The semester exams are moderately hard.
detailed_review.Other: The college has a very strict anti-ragging policy, and hence the environment around the college is quite healthy. The main reason for chosing BCA here is that it has a comprehensive syllabus which follows the National Education Policy and provides extracurricular facilities such as foreign language and communication skills. The annual fest, Amiphoria, is quite spectacular. Clubs are very helpful and welcome new students every year.

reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA)
reviews.review_title: Everything about Amity Kolkata.

detailed_review.Placements: In our time, approximately 67% of students get placed in every type of company, ranging from good to bad, based on their skills. The average packages vary from 7 LPA to 2.5 LPA, with Deloitte being one of the top recruiters. Almost 95% of students secure internships, but not with very prestigious companies. Companies like Traversal and other startups collaborate with our college. The top roles are consultant, analyst, and developer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good, in fact, one of the best I've seen in Kolkata. Wi-Fi is provided, there are good labs and desktops, and a peaceful library, though it has fewer informative books. Medical facilities include AC rooms. The sports ground is very small, but it is encouraged through several programs such as Sangathan, which is a department-wise sports competition.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, but there are fewer teachers available, so one teacher may teach more than one subject. The faculty strives to prepare students for the industry by appointing teachers for soft skills training. Semester exams are fair, and the pass percentage is 60%.
detailed_review.Other: I think this course is in demand. Our HOI could improve behavior, but other aspects are fine. There are different clubs, such as the events club, music club, and extracurricular activities.

reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA)
reviews.review_title: The college has good infrastructure and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: I pursued a BBA at Amity University, Kolkata and we were the batch of 2016-2019. Among our course, 80% of students were placed. The highest was 4.8 lacs and the lowest was 2.4 LPA packages. Some top companies like Indigo, Airlines, Amazon, and many more visit our college to recruit students as top recruiters. 100% of students got internships in administrative companies. They provide manager posts.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure were on point in every aspect or department like multiple A/C or Wi-Fi available, all kinds of labs and classrooms high-quality sports equipment, and facilities with skilled coaches. There was a theatre and also a cafeteria. The hostel was the best in the town with ample facilities and luxury. The food in the cafeteria was good and the most important the medical facilities were 24-hour and we got a separate infirmary.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers were very helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable at the same time and the quality of teaching was excellent. The course curriculum is relevant and makes students industry-ready. Semester exams were not difficult. The pass percentage is 33%.

reviews.course: Master of Commerce (M.Com.)
reviews.review_title: Eventful college life will make you fall in love with the university.

detailed_review.Placements: 7 out of 13 students were placed in my course. The highest package was 9 LPA and min was 3 LPA. Top recruiting companies are TCS, Deloitte, and KPMG. You are also provided with interview classes to sharpen your skills which will help you with the interview. You can get an audit role or HR or sales.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are good facilities provided by the university. The lab, Wi-Fi, classroom, library, and canteen are top-anotch. There are 3-4 canteen and all have good food with reasonable price. The library is very well maintained. You have a quiet and personal space for each student.
detailed_review.Faculty: All the faculty members are highly qualified. They have good knowledge of the subject they are teaching. The course curriculum is very relevant. It makes the students industry-ready. The exam's difficulty level is moderate. The passing percentage is 40% for each subject.
detailed_review.Other: The attendance system is a little complicated and mess as you have to take care of that. The campus life is amazing, if you get a good group of people then you'll have the great college life ever. Just the attendance system is a little bit strict otherwise everything else is fine.

reviews.course: M.Sc. in Economics
reviews.review_title: Amity University is home away from home.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost all students got placed. The highest salary package offered ranges between 8 LPA - 9 LPA. The average salary package offered is 5 LPA. Top recruiting companies are PWC, KPMG, Deloitte, and Accenture. Everyone got an internship in different companies. Top roles offered are consult and tax.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is full Wi-Fi connection on campus. The infrastructure of our college is beautiful. The college is full of greenery. Classrooms are spacious and air-conditioned. The whole college is equipped with air-conditioners. The food quality  is good and tasty and they maintain hygiene.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our teachers are well-qualified and knowledgeable. They teach us in the best possible manner. The course curriculum is totally relevant and it makes students ready for the industry requirements. Semester exams are good if you have studied properly and enough.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Students can join this college without any hesitation.

detailed_review.Placements: Nearly 70-80% of students get placed. The average package is around 10 LPA. The campus is good. Big companies like Amazon visit the college for placements. The college has a strong placement record and top companies visit the college for recruitment. It offers good packages, internships, and career guidance to help students secure jobs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Labs and classrooms are very well-maintained. The library is very big and peaceful. It has a sports complex and other activities. There is a basketball ground and a badminton court in the college. But we do not have any cricket ground but there we can play football in a small area.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very helpful and friendly. They help us to get a good job. The exam system is very strict. If we get a UFM and backlog then we have to pay Rs. 1,500 and give the exam after 1 year to pass the exam. Some foreign faculty members are there in college .
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I have a strong interest in the subject, and I believe it aligns with my career goals. The course curriculum offers a good balance of theoretical knowledge and practical applications, which will help me develop the skills I need for my future. Additionally, the faculty members and research opportunities available at this institution made it an ideal choice for me.

reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com. Hons.)
reviews.review_title: There are really good infrastructure and faculty members in the college.

detailed_review.Placements: B.Com is a very good batch. Many students got placements in EY and PwC. Many students got internships. The average package offered in our course is 12 LPA, and it is a very good package after doing B.Com. Many students are doing investment banking.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Amity University has a library with comfortable and silent surroundings. This university has 5 blocks. The examination block is separate from other blocks and 4 blocks are for classes for different courses. The university has a sports complex with different games.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are qualified and knowledgeable. Semester exams are a little tough if we study what faculty members taught then we can score well. Faculty members interact with students so students do not feel bored in classes. Many activities are held in classes to make the course understandable. They are good, and they teach very well.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because of my finance background. I get the benefit of a finance background by making several PPTs on finance. Many events and fests are orgnaised in college, and they are also very enjoyable.

reviews.course: M.Sc. in Biotechnology
reviews.review_title: I am satisfied with the job and faculty.

The highest package goes 40 Lacs, average goes 6 Lacs and the lowest of 3 Lacs. I placed in dlf company in 2020 with 5 LPA.

There are all the important facilities like classrooms, playgrounds, courts, a library, medical rooms, Wi-Fi, labs with all the equipment, and so on. We have to attend 75% of classes otherwise, penalty charges are there. Teachers are helpful and qualified here. Semester exams are difficult to pass. They are held twice a year.

reviews.course: M.Sc. in Biotechnology
reviews.review_title: Amity University Kolkata as my vision.

highlights.summary:
Amity University Gurgaon (a private university of Haryana) was established in 2010. Amity GGN is a part of the Amity Group and has its campuses present in India and abroad. Amity Gurgaon has been accredited A Grade by NAAC. It is also a member of the AIU. Amity Gurugram has 16 schools of study and colleges. The university provides UG, PG, PhD, & other programmes to students across the Eng, Management, Law, Design, & other streams.
Amethi University Gurgaon courses are accredited by the Accreditation Council for Business Schools and Programme, ACBSP, USA, ASIC, UK, Indian Nursing Council, Council of Architecture, the Rehabilitation Council of India, and IET. The Amity University Gurgaon courses are approved by UGC, the Bar Council of India, and the Pharmacy Council of India. Some of the available popular programmes available at Amity are BTech, BSc, BA, BBA, BPharm, BA LLB, BOPTM, BCA, MSc, MBA, MTech, MCA, etc.
The Amity Gurgaon campus is spread over 110 acres of land near the Gurgaon with a 20-acre sports complex. There is a Tennis Court, Football Ground, Cricket Field, Basketball court, etc available in the Amity University Gurgaon campus. In addition to this, the Amity University GGN campus has a total of 20 interdisciplinary research centres & more than 200 hi-tech labs. Apart from this info, the university has signed various MoUs with several universities & organisations, including the University of Cincinnati, the University of Queensland, the Russian New University, etc. The major highlights of Amity University Gurugram Haryana are tabulated below:

reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) Honours/Research
reviews.review_title: Review of Amity University, Gurugram.

detailed_review.Placements: 45% placement with 15-30 Lacs pachage. 98% student passed the college. In amity the highest package was 67 Lacs and the lowest package was 20 Lacs. Ghe top recruiting companies for my course was google and more. 69% student got internship from my course in google and more big companies .
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostels are in very good condition. Very good facilities and infrastructure are available for your course and department; for example, Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a library are all very good. The quality of the facilities in hostels is very good. The quality of food is also very good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, and they are very qualified and knowledgeable. This course is very relevant. This college makes students industry-ready. Very easy to clear the course; the passing percentage is 55%.
detailed_review.Other: Amity organizes a program every month.

reviews.course: MBA in Advertising and Public Relations
reviews.review_title: My review of this college.

detailed_review.Placements: Amity offers all eligible candidates the opportunity to get placed in MNCs. Amity provides both internships and placements. Mostly, all students are placed. It invites various companies to visit the campus for pre-placement talks, to share requirements for vacant positions, and handpick students for the best-suited roles. Amity University offers 100% placements for its students. Some of the big names include Amazon, Think & Learn, Zycus, ITS, Aditya Birla, Coca-Cola, etc. The average package offered to students is 3.25 LPA. The highest package offered last year was 22 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It is great. The hostel is very comfortable with a friendly atmosphere everywhere. Students taking the AC hostel are given separate rooms with an almirah. For a non-AC hostel, the same things are given, but instead of separate rooms for students. They are given 3 sharing and 2 sharing rooms. The food quality is really good in the mess. The campus has many food outlets, which leaves no doubt in getting good food for hostellers and day scholars as well.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are well qualified. They use modern ways of teaching using modern tools like computer PPTs, slide presentations, live examples, etc. Most of the faculty members are very good. They are friendly and helpful. One particular faculty member even helped me secure an internship outside college. They go out of their way to help us if we are nice to them. Students have a mentor assigned to them to help them in case of any grievance. Each semester has one set of internal exams and then the final exams. Internal is of 30 marks and external is for 70 marks, a total of 100 marks. There are fun subjects and a lot of practical subjects like radio, photography, graphics, and news analysis. It basically covers all the bases.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Amity University Gurgaon B.Tech CSE review.

detailed_review.Placements: I am pursuing B.Tech in CSE from Amity University, Haryana. In our current batch 2025, many students who appeared for placement have relevant skills get placed in their placement session. The highest package is around 15 LPA above, and the lowest package is around 3 LPA - 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Capgemini, TCS, Yamaha, and many startups. Role offered is software developer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure at Amity is good with very calm environment. There are many active clubs and societies you and become part of those and explore yourself. You can also make a good connection here. There are only few places where you can get Wi-Fi. Library is one of them and college classrooms are air-conditioned. Hostel is overall good with good facilities for hostel mess. There are 2 messes at Amity and many other outlets for food. Amity has a very big sports complex timing is 1:00 PM - 2:00 PM only.
detailed_review.Faculty: Amity has very helpful teachers. They support you and they are well qualified and knowledgeable. They put best efforts into teaching. Course curriculum is very much relevant. If you work on yourself and learn skills yourself, you will become industry ready. Semester exams are little much difficult, you can easily pass if you study well. Pass percentage is 35% only.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course to become an engineer. Best thing about this course is that I get enough time to study and gain knowledge. If it provides some more computer practical, it will be better. College organizes many small and large events one of them is Amifest in which singer comes to give a performance. Crowd of Amity is too good and connectivity to the road is poor, it is inside the village. College provides scholarships based on your 12th marks and JEE score.

reviews.course: B.Sc. in Nursing
reviews.review_title: Amity University is considered as a good university for studies.

detailed_review.Placements: 100% of students got placed in this course. The average salary is 3 LPA to 5 LPA. Medanta, Fortis, Gangaram, and Narayana are the recruiting hospitals. 100% of students got internships from our course at Medanta, Fortis, Gangaram, Narayana, etc. Top role offered in our course is nursing officer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library, and all are available. Infrastructure is very good. Facilities in hostel and course are good including food of the best quality. Medical facilities are available with doctors and nurses. We have good sports ground and different games.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified and knowledgeable. Teaching quality is good. Curriculum is relevant. Students get internships. But the difficulty level is moderate to serve in the exam, and the pass percentage is 85 to 90% for our course. Teachers are cooperative and helpful.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I wanted to serve the one with the patient and the inpatient. The best thing about the course is that it provides care to all. The event, fest, and campus crowd are very clear. There is good connectivity. Campus is surrounded by woods. It provides scholarships and there are many extracurricular activities.

reviews.course: B.Sc. in Nursing
reviews.review_title: Amazing procedures and life-size equipments to get a thorough knowledge of nursing.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 80-85% of the students are placed in my senior year while they are still attending classes, and with a very decent and respectful package. Recruiting companies like Medanta, Fortis, Paras, and Sri Gangaram Hospital. We have a 6-month internship in the last semester in a community setting at Medanta and Civil Hospital, Gurugram. Top roles offered are staff nurse, operation theatre nurse, and availability to higher courses.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have atleast 4-5 different labs catering to each department and having human size models, dummies, and equipments. All the procedures and equipments to perform and practice for the future. Our hostel is a very safe and secure place having sets of 2 beds in each room, 6 students in each suite. For food, we have at least 7 different places with amazing food and a way to connect to people. Medical facilities are available 24X7. Sports events and cultural fests happen twice a year.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, qualified, and up to date with all the updates and trends of nursing knowledge, and ACT as mentors to help each student in every way. The course curriculum is properly related to the hospital setting having 2 months of clinical practice in each semester. The pass percentage is 50% and has every important topic covered in exams, both the sessional and the end-term exams.

reviews.course: Post Basic B.Sc. in Nursing
reviews.review_title: College infrastructure is good and canteen food is good.

detailed_review.Placements: All students get placed. The average salary is Rs 25,000 per month. All students get placed at Medanta, Apollo, and Fortis. Roles offered are staff nurse in Narayana hospital, next nursing life, Jobizo, and Spinal Injury, Ganga Ram. They also provide number of opportunities to the students of the campus gives tremendous experience.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available, classroom is ventilated, and AC is available. Number of options and variety are available. Classrooms and corridors are always clean. Washrooms are clean and hygienic. Air-conditioned classrooms are available. It provides proper uniforms for clinicals. It also provides laboratory facilities and training.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful and knowledgeable. Teaching quality is good. Lab lectures are available with proper demonstration material and environment. It is quite difficult and pass percentage is 80-85%. Teachers are polite and very responsive. They have helping nature.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I did GNM previously. I think it's fine. There are number of activities happening on the campus.

reviews.course: B.Sc. in Nursing
reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with faculty members. There are 99% placements and really good infrastructure.

Top recruiting companies are Medanta Hospital, Gangaram Hospital, Paras Hospital, and Artemis Hospital. Roles offered are nursing staff and nursing officer. The highest package is 5 LPA, while the lowest package is 3 LPA. Amity University and Amity College of nursing provide the highest package, and 99% of placements per year. detailed_review.Other: Events and fests of Amity are just wow. I chose nursing because it provides 99% placements.

reviews.course: Post Basic B.Sc. in Nursing
reviews.review_title: Studying here always feels like learning something new every day.

detailed_review.Other: This course provides global opportunities for the students. Events, fests, and everything are very enjoyable.

reviews.course: B.Sc. in Nursing
reviews.review_title: I feel proud as a student of Amity University Haryana.

detailed_review.Placements: I feel proud to say that almost 99% of students have got placement from my department. The amazing package our department offers is 3 LPA-5 LPA. Some of the top hospitals visited our college, like Medanta, Ganga Ram, Narayana Hospital, and Fortis. 99% of students got internships in it. Some of the top roles offered in our college are nursing counsellor, nursing officer, and CHO.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Amity University Haryana has one of the best infrastructure, which is well-maintained in terms of lab classes, library facilities, and the list goes on. AC, non-AC rooms, water cooler, lift, study table, medical facilities, sports complex, playground, and mess food. These are some facilities which are provided to hostellers.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members here are generous, well-qualified, and knowledgeable. They teach in the best way possible and help students in their hard times. Faculty members here also support students with their curricular activities. They do make students industry-ready. Difficulty levels of semesters are pretty decent, and the pass percentage is 80%-85%.
detailed_review.Other: This course makes me realise how you feel when you help people out in any way. The best thing about my course is that it teaches me how to save someone's life in any condition and how you help people just by being there for them. There are events that take place every year in our university, like Amifest, Autumn Carnival, and Sangathan, which attract a crowd here and have amazing scholarship offers.

reviews.course: B.Sc. in Nursing
reviews.review_title: Amity University provided what students needed the most.

detailed_review.Placements: 98% of students got placed from my course, and the 3 LPA-5 LPA is the highest package offered in our college. Hostel, if we talk about hostel, food is the first thing we have in our mind, and here the food is amazing, including other facilities too, good food quality, and medical facilities, everything is good here.

The best thing about my course is that nursing brings humanity, and teaches empathy along with sympathy. Events such as Sangathan, Autumn Carnival, Amifest, and others are planned for students, and for extracurricular activities, some clubs are arranged by students to enhance and improve their skills and their ability to learn something new.

reviews.course: Bachelor of Tourism and Travel Management
reviews.review_title: "Great infrastructure and facilities with diverse student amenities."

detailed_review.Placements: About 80-85% of students get jobs after finishing their course. The average salary is 3 LPA, and the highest salary is 4.5 LPA. Big travel firms hire students. Students can do internships locally and internationally. Common roles include travel agent, tour planner, hotel manager, and tourism consultant.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The ASH department offers excellent infrastructure, including Wi-Fi-enabled campuses and modern classrooms. Hostels are comfortable, but sometimes the food isn't good, while sports facilities enhance the overall student experience, and the medical facilities are also not good in the university.
detailed_review.Faculty: Amity University has knowledgeable and qualified faculty with good teaching standards. The curriculum is industry-relevant, and semester exams are moderately challenging, ensuring students are well-prepared for professional success. The pass percentage here is 33% separately in both internals and externals. One has to pass both.
detailed_review.Other: The BTTM course focuses on practical learning, industry insights, and global tourism trends. Amity University’s lively campus, events, scholarships, and extracurricular activities enhance the overall experience, though internship placements could be improved.

reviews.course: Bachelor of Hotel Management (BHM)
reviews.review_title: I would recommend others take admission here, especially if they are looking for hotel management.

detailed_review.Placements: Hotels like Taj Hotel and Oberoi Group come for placement. The highest package is 5 LPA and the lowest is 1.5 LPA. Every role is offered during internships, such as front office, chef, and manager. All my seniors have get internships from different hotel groups.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Students who are interested in sports will find a decent sports complex at this university, and tournaments are held at specific times of the year. Hostels are also decent, with food quality being good and offering variations. Hostels also have recreational rooms.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers have so much experience, and they do not limit themselves to book knowledge but also share their personal experiences. The constant industrial visits make students' learning more efficient. Most students clear all subjects, and exams are not difficult. Overall, it is very good.
detailed_review.Other: Scholarships are provided. I chose this college because of faculty. I appreciate efforts of my faculty, they are helpful.

reviews.course: Bachelor of Hotel Management (BHM)
reviews.review_title: A balanced college with good opportunities and campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 95% of students. The highest is 5 LPA, and the lowest is approximately 1.5 LPA. Taj Group of Hotels, Oberoi Hotels and Resorts, ITC Hotels. Everyone from my batch gets an internship, and we do our internship at Leela Ambience Gurgaon. Students are trained across various departments of the hospitality and service industry.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is actually better than many universities. We have a front office lab, restaurant, kitchen, bakery lab, Wi-Fi, and a library everything. There are approximately 5-6 canteens, and they are very clean. The food is also very good and hygienic.
detailed_review.Faculty: In my course, my faculty members are excellent because they are not only supportive but also care about every student, and the teaching quality is just awesome. Of course, this course makes students industry-ready. To be honest, semester exams in this college are very easy because of your teachers and faculty. I have a 9.88 CGPA. At Amity University Haryana, our faculty members are awesome.
detailed_review.Other: I want to be a chef, so I chose this course. There are many things that attract me because it's not like a 9-5 job. It's interesting to meet different people from around the world. More practical classes. We celebrate every festival, like Holi, Diwali, Amifest, etc.

reviews.course: Bachelor of Tourism and Travel Management
reviews.review_title: The best private university in Haryana.

detailed_review.Placements: The entire batch has great placement opportunities. The highest package is 6 LPA, the average is 4 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA. Companies include GMR, Roseate, MakeMyTrip, Hilton, Taj, ITC, and Radisson. 100% of our students receive internships at institutions like MakeMyTrip, Southern Travel, ITC, Radisson, Taj, Roseate, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Clean and tidy classrooms with state-of-the-art infrastructure provide a smooth learning experience. The library is a very comfortable place to study. There are multiple cafeterias on the campus to chose from, offering a variety of meal options. A big sports complex includes sports such as tennis, basketball, badminton, football, volleyball, etc. A medical room is available in the hostel.
detailed_review.Faculty: My faculty members are very supportive and believe in the holistic development of students. They do not restrict us to classroom knowledge and help us make practical use of our learning by implementing it in various fields. The quality of education is top-notch. The course teaches everything there is to know sky for a Travel and Tourism professional to learn.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course to be better equipped with knowledge on how to provide travel services that result in guest delight. Amity School of Hospitality has taught me exactly that. I wish there were better roads to the campus so that more students could conveniently commute, which would result in more enrollments. Amifest is really fun. Multiple scholarship options are provided by Amity University Haryana.

reviews.course: Bachelor of Tourism and Travel Management
reviews.review_title: I'm completely satisfied with Amity University Haryana.

detailed_review.Placements: The Amity School of Hospitality department offers placements in reputable hotels like Hilton, Radisson, and Roseate, where the starting package is 3.4 LPA. Students who opt for tourism get placed in recognized travel agencies such as Travel Raasta, MMT, and Cleartrip, where the starting package is 2.5 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of Amity University Haryana is one of the best parts, where vibrant college life truly thrives. Our Amity School of Hospitality department is introduced with two new classrooms along with a new restaurant and kitchen. The hostel offers both AC and Non-AC rooms, along with two hostel messes and a food court.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are absolutely amazing, and students find their solutions instantly. Moreover, they are nature of being friendly and supportive. The best part of the curriculum is that Amity University teaches various subjects apart from the core subjects, such as foreign languages, environmental studies, behavioural studies, and communication skills, along with workshops for the benefit of students. Examinations are conducted in a prominent manner.
detailed_review.Other: Amity Gurugram Campus is a great place to connect with people and get involved in student activities across various fields such as sports, fashion, dance, music, and even student community clubs.

reviews.course: Bachelor of Hotel Management (BHM)
reviews.review_title: Amity University is a very good college and also has the biggest campus.

detailed_review.Placements: There are 17 students in our batch. The lowest package is 3 LPA and the highest is 8 LPA. There are ample hotel opportunities, for example Taj, Leela, Le Meridien, Four Points by Sheraton, and ITC Welcomhotel. 100% of students get internships from our course in very renowned hotels and resorts.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good. Our labs have all the equipment, and all classrooms are well-cleaned. Our library is also clean, fully air-conditioned, and has every type of book. There is a lift for our comfort also.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our teachers are very experienced. One of my teachers has worked with a very big hotel brand, and there is a continental chef who has worked in more than 40 countries. They are very humble and helpful to every student. The practice we do in the lab also helps us in our future. Faculty members are very humble and kind.
detailed_review.Other: I am interested in kitchen activities. I usually cook food at home with my mom. Then I saw that this course is available at Amity University, and since it is also a top university, I chose this course.

reviews.course: B.Sc. in Biotechnology (Honours/Research)
reviews.review_title: Life and learning at Amity University, Gurugram.

detailed_review.Placements: University provides 100% placement assistance to all students. Recruiting companies are Biocon, Panacea Biotech, Serum Institute, and many other food and pharmaceutical companies. Research labs visit the university IN CRC department to help students in internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Amity has AC and non AC both the facilities separate for boys and girls. The rooms are clean with attached washrooms. Wi-Fi is available and the curfew time is 7:30 PM. Staff are supportive of 24/7 security. There are more than 3000 seated hostels surrounded by green landscape.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are supportive and most faculty members hold Ph.D. in biotechnology, microbiology, and biochemistry from AIMS. DU and JNU generally follow a concept of presentation and live demonstrations research paper presentation and seminars. We have to study for whole year.

reviews.course: B.Sc. in Biotechnology (Honours/Research)
reviews.review_title: A good college with helpful teachers and a friendly campus environment.

detailed_review.Placements: I am a B.Sc. Biotechnology student and around 80% of students got placed. Companies like Biocon, Cipla, Serum Institute, and many other institutes are recruiting. Our placement cell is very helpful with resume building and interview preparation. I'm happy with the placement and internship packages.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure at Amity University Gurugram is modern and well-maintained. Campus is clean, green, and spread across a large area. The classrooms are equipped with smart boards and projectors and the entire campus has good Wi-Fi connections. We have an AC and non-AC 3000 seated hostel.
detailed_review.Faculty: Amity has an industry-based curriculum we have to study for a whole year. Evaluation is serious. Teaching is good teaching and teachers are Ph.D. qualified and well-experienced having experience in academics and research. Faculty members have patents and various publications we learn from live projects.

reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) Honours/Research
reviews.review_title: My review of Amity University, Gurugram.

detailed_review.Placements: My batch is from 2022 to 2025. We have 100% placement assistance. I have done my internship for 2 months. We have an active CRC department taking care of placements and internships for all the students. Companies like Hero, Google, and Spalba. The average package offered ranges between 5 LPA to 7 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Amity has a good infrastructure. It has 3,000 seater hostel on campus with IP camera surveillance and a biometric campus. It has a modern library with 1 lakh books and various e-books and publications are there. Campus has smart Wi-Fi and we have 7 days of compulsory military training camps.
detailed_review.Faculty: At Amity University, Gurugram we have supportive faculty members with Ph.D. and research. We have an industry-based curriculum and experiential learning through live projects and industry visits. For semester exams in university, we need to study hard to experience various software.

reviews.course: B.Sc. in Biological Science (Honours/Research)
reviews.review_title: My review of Amity University Gurugram.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 90% of the students are placed through campus recruitment from our course. The highest package is 12 LPA. Top companies like Rapture Biotech and Viv Renovation take part in recruitment. Approximately 85% of students are offered internships and placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our department is well-equipped with modern facilities that support both theoretical and practical learning. Classrooms are spacious and well-ventilated. Laboratories are well-maintained and stocked with all the necessary chemicals and equipment. Hostel facilities are decent and cater to all the basic needs of students.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty at Amity University is generally helpful, well-qualified, and knowledgeable in their respective fields. Many industries include practical training, industrial visits, internships, and guest lectures from professionals. In addition, Amity offers personality development classes like communication skills and behavior skills workshops in each semester.
detailed_review.Other: I choose B.Sc. in Biological Sciences because I have always been deeply fascinated by how life works at the cellular and molecular level. I want a course that gives me a strong foundation in genetics, biochemistry, molecular biology, etc. Amity University provides a well-structured course in accordance with my interests.

faqs.question: Is the CAT syllabus difficult?

Besides having an understanding of the CAT syllabus 2023, candidates also need to be well aware of the CAT exam pattern before they start preparing for the exam. facilities.name: Library
facilities.description:
Amity University library is an integrated knowledge resource centre that is stocked with approx 50,000 books, 20,000 journals and 2,500 publications. 

Amity students have access to Ebsco Host, UGC-Infonet, INDEST-AICTE, IS1 and Delnet. All Amity students are members of Amizone - Amity Intranet Zone which allows them easy access to these journals and papers.

These Libraries consist of Reference Sections, Circulation Sections, Audio-visual Sections, Periodical Sections and Digital Libraries.

facilities.name: Cafeteria
facilities.description:
All cafeterias of Amity University have menus that are designed by a team of professional dieticians, comprising nutritious and wholesome food to ensure a well-balanced diet. 

There is multi-cuisine food court with facilities like Dosa Plaza, cook house, canteen, etc.

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description:
Amity University provides air-conditioned apartment-style accommodation facility for 2100 students. The rooms are well-lit and well-ventilated, with geysers in every bathroom and TV set in the common room for entertainment.

The separate facilities for boys and girls, caring wardens and a tight security ensure a pleasant stay allowing students to focus on their academics. The air-conditioned residential apartment suites consist of 3 single rooms with an attached bathroom and sitting lounge equipped necessary furniture.

highlights.summary:
Anurag University was established as a part of the Anurag Group of Institutions in 2020. It is recognised as one of the first few integrated campuses of South India, offering programmes in Engineering and Technology, Pharmacy, and Business Management. Anurag University is one of the leading private universities and is located in Hyderabad, Telangana.
The Anurag University Hyderabad courses are AICTE and PCI-approved. Moreover, the university is accredited with an A grade by NAAC and TCS, and all BTech and BPharmacy Programs have been accredited by the NBA. Additionally, the Anurag University HYD offers various programmes in affiliation with JNTU, Hyderabad. The university provides a high-quality graduate, postgraduate, and doctoral education in engineering, pharmacy, and management fields. The Anurag University Hyderabad campus spans across 150+ acres and caters to almost 15,000 students along with 500+ doctorate-qualified faculty members across different states in India.
According to the NIRF ranking 2024, the university received a ranking in the band of 151-200 in the Engineering category. Whereas, in the University category, Anurag University is ranked under the rank band of 151-200. Further, Anurag University also ranked 60 and 22 in 2023 in the Engineering category by Outlook and Times, respectively. Anurag University is also ranked 71 under the Pharmacy category by the NIRF ranking 2024.
The university offers education to its several schools such as the School of Engineering, School of Agriculture, School of Management, School of Medical Sciences, and School of Pharmacy. For more details, candidates can check out the table given below:

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering (Data Science)
reviews.review_title: The real and honest review of Anurag University.

detailed_review.Placements: More than 50% of all my batch mates are placed in various companies on and off campus. The average package is 6 LPA - 8 LPA, the lowest is 3.6 LPA, and the highest is 12 LPA. Most students get internships and are working on some great projects too. The roles mostly offered to us are software developer, data analyst, and testing roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Labs are equipped with the latest generation PCs that support almost all the latest technologies. All kinds of programs like AI, DL, etc., can be executed without hassle on the systems. Hostels are very good. We have all kinds of amenities, food, and other extracurricular activities are good on the campus like volleyball, football, cricket, and others.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very great and experienced. The way of teaching and quality are good. Almost all the faculty members have doctorates. The curriculum is up to date and focuses on the new and required skills for students to land great jobs. They teach all the new and hot skills needed in the market at the moment.
detailed_review.Other: I chose my course as I considered it to be the next very important and growing field, and I wanted to pursue my career in IT. I am inclined towards research and information, so I chose CSE as my major. Anurag University has various technical and non-technical clubs that students can be a part of from their second year. Some clubs are IEEE-CS, CSI student chapters, click cadets, toastmasters, and kriya.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering

detailed_review.Other: Always plan your career path and have a plan B if things don't go your way.
