data.description: Anurag University strives to become a leading university that provides transformative education and research to create leaders and innovators of tomorrow and to expand frontiers of knowledge for the betterment of society. To fulfil this mission, a team of experts works towards achieving this goal. Faculty members at Anurag University have a unique teaching approach that is a blend of theoretical depth and practical problem-solving, designed to equip students with not just knowledge but the ability to innovate and lead in the tech-driven world.

qualifications: Qualification: He received an integrated M.S.Engg in CSE from the USSR and his Ph.D. in Computer Science from JNTUH.

Experience: He served as Associate Professor and Professor at SIT, Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University, Hyderabad (JNTUH) for 13 years. He is nominated as Executive Council Member for Dr. B.R. Ambedkar University, Srikakulam, Andhra Pradesh by the Govt of Andhra Pradesh. He served as Director of Admissions, Professor, and Chairman BOS for more than one year at RayalaSeema University. He guided 42 research scholars for Ph.D in Computer Science and Engineering, and published more than 130 research articles in international journals.
Qualification: Dr.P.Narayan Reddy did his PhD from Jawaharlal Nehru Agricultural University, Jabalpur, specialising in plant pathology

Experience: Worked for 32 years as a Professor at Jayashankar Telangana State Agriculture University in various capacities in teaching and research fields, and worked for 3 years in IIIT Hyderabad in the e-sagu project. Also received training on Pest Risk Analysis at the USDA under the US AKI project. He has published more than 100 research publications, textbook chapters and plant protection bulletins. Guided several PhD students. Acted as a member for reviewing research programmes of several Agricultural universities and ICAR institutions.

Experience: He was CEO, Vice-Chairman and co-founder of KRIA Healthcare Pvt. Ltd., before he was founder-CEO of PiramalSwasthya (formerly HMRI) and president (Corporate Sustainability) at Piramal Healthcare Ltd. He was involved in designing 108 emergency services and 104 health services. He was the founding CEO of HMRI, which launched India’s first dial-a-doctor service at scale. Other services such as remote healthcare using Telemedicine and mobile itinerary health services. He is Chairman of the Centre of Environmental Concerns, an NGO in the service of dry-land farmers offering water-conserving products and labour-reducing tools for agriculture.

Experience: Dr. B. Vasudha is presently working as Dean, School of Pharmacy, Anurag University. She obtained her Bachelor's from Kolhapur University and Master's from Manipal University with specialisation in Pharmaceutical Sciences. She completed her Doctor of Philosophy in Pharmaceutical Sciences in 2009 from SDNT University, Mumbai. She is an awardee of a senior research fellowship under the DBT program sponsored by the Government of India. Her research work mainly focuses on diabetes, inflammation, behavioural studies, Polycystic ovary syndrome, Self-Emulsifying drug delivery System and Nanoparticles.

Experience: Dr. B. Lakshmi Prasanna is an esteemed medical professional with a wealth of experience and expertise in the field of medicine and medical education. As the Dean of Neelima Institute of Medical Sciences, she brings a profound commitment to excellence in education, patient care, and research.

Experience: Professor Rafath Razia is presently serving as the Dean of the School of Nursing at Anurag University. Professor Razia brings with her 47 years of rich experience in different profiles, having successfully carried out classroom and clinical teaching

Experience: Dr. V. Srinivasa Rao is a Mathematician with over 20 years of teaching and research experience. He did his Master's from NIT Warangal in the year 2003, and he received a doctorate from Osmania University, Hyderabad in the year 2011. He is a life member of the Indian Science Congress, APTSMS, and ISTE. He completed a minor research project funded by UGC, New Delhi during the year 2014-16 worth Rs. 3,75,000. Under his supervision, two research scholars are pursuing Ph. D. and one scholar was awarded a Ph.D. from JNTU Hyderabad.
Designation: Professor and Dean, Faculty of Naturopathy and Yogic Sciences at SGT University
Department: He graduated and post-graduated in CSE and did his Ph.D in CSE from JNTU, Hyderabad

Experience: He has more than 20 years of experience in academia and has published around 80 publications in International journals and conferences. He received the Inspiring Faculty Award by Infosys and, Significant Contribution Award by CSI.
Qualification: He obtained his B. Tech from Kakatiya University, M. Tech and Ph.D from JNTUH University.

Experience: He has 23 years of teaching and 13 years of research experience. He has organised and attended various workshops and conferences at the National and International levels. He has published more than 65 papers in various National & International journals & conferences and guided 6 Ph.D scholars.
Qualification: He finished his Ph.D in Civil Engineering from the International Institute of Information Technology, Hyderabad (IIITH), India.
Experience: Dr. Bodige Narender is an Associate Professor at Anurag University and joined in the year 2016.

Before joining Anurag University (formerly Anurag Group of Institutions), he was an Assistant Professor at Vasavi College of Engineering (VCE) and Lecturer in JB Institute of Engineering and Technology (JBIET), Hyderabad. Dr B. Narender worked as a research fellow at IIITH and was involved in National and International Projects in year 2011 to 2013, such as DISANET (JICA-JST) for a set of building vibration sensors in Chandigarh city and Vulnerability Assessment of Nanded City and Himachal Pradesh. He was also involved in consultancy work for the Ramappa temple to study the effect of Near Site Tunnel Blasts of Devadula Project in the year 2011 and Third-Party Quality Control of GHMC (2018 to 2021). He published thirty-three papers in various National and International conferences and journals.

BE/ BTech, ME/ MTech and MCA are among the popular flagship courses. The institute offers this program in Full Time mode. The fees of IT & Software and Engineering courses at the Vishwakarma Institute of Technology ranges between INR 1,73,914-6,19,128. The infrastructure of the institute provides a better learning environment for the students.

Vishwakarma Institute of Technology Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

reviews.course: B. Tech. in Computer Engineering
reviews.review_title: Very honest, this was the best decision of my life.

detailed_review.Placements: Maximum students get placed every year, their placement ratio is very good. The highest package is 11 LPA, the average is 6 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA, but the maximum number of students got placed in average slots. 89 percent of students are placed every year. Software developer is a role offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are of the top-notch. They include air conditioners, Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a library. We have five cafeterias inside the college. The medical facilities are also provided by them. We have two hostels for boys. One for girls with premium security also has 23 stationery shops.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. Teaching experience is very nice, and they teach us in the best way possible. The course is very irrelevant, that's why I'm doing it, and it's making trust ready for the industry visit sometimes, and exams are a bit difficult, you have to study.
detailed_review.Other: I found the course very interesting and usable in the future. That is the reason I chose this college. I want to improve everything about this course. Everything is perfectly organized, and the fests are conducted campus crowd is also good. They have connectivity, and the campus surrounding everything is perfect.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is the best college for placements and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: Due to the increasing admission in various sectors of engineering streams, there may be chances of difficulties during the placement of the students. The highest package of electronics and telecommunication engineering is 44 LPA, and average package is 6 LPA. It's your placement topic so choose wisely.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good due to increasing admissions in various sectors of engineering streams. There are chances of a lack of classrooms otherwise, everything is best. It has good beautiful campus, labs, classrooms, library, and a peaceful place. It is also good for foreign students.
detailed_review.Faculty: All faculty members are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. Teaching quality is also the best. My course is electronic and telecommunication, of course I think it will make me industry ready. Semester exams are easy, you only need practical knowledge.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering(Data Science)
reviews.review_title: One of the top colleges in Pune with good placements, infrastructure, and curriculum.

detailed_review.Placements: I am a student of the 2027 batch. In the previous batch, around 90% of students got placed in companies like Microsoft and Amazon. The package offered ranges between 3.6-45 LPA. The average package offered is 9 LPA. Around 85% of students get internships in companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel facilities in the college are nice, as the hostel is not on the campus of the college. It is too near the campus. The hostel has facilities like clean rooms, 24x7 hot water, and Wi-Fi. The mess provides a variety of food in a very hygienic way. The college has a very good collection of books in the library.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members of the college are very nice, understanding, and supportive. Exams are held in a very strict manner. The course curriculum of college is very up-to-date in terms of today's world. The teaching techniques of teachers here are very nice. They teach in both ways, theoretically and practically.
detailed_review.Other: In this college, there is a fest named Gandharva, which is a techno-cultural fest, and it is absolutely amazing.

reviews.course: B. Tech. in Computer Engineering
reviews.review_title: It has a good curriculum and helps in learning tech which industry refers more.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement opportunities are so good in this college. Companies like Nvidia, Morgan Stanley, JP Morgan, and a lot more than 500 companies come to campus. Roles like backend developer, frontend developer, full stack developer, data science engineer, data engineer, business analyst, etc., are offered by the companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college does not have its own hostel facility, but around the college area, there are a lot of hostel facilities and mess facilities under the 500-meter area of the college. Libraries and reading rooms are open for students for their studies with Wi-Fi facilities. The college has a canteen, but frankly speaking, the food is not that good. The college has a cafeteria and two small canteens like FNF. It has good food. On the college's backside, there is a hotspot lane and there are a lot of options to eat like rolls and chats. The mess has good quality food.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers of this college are so helpful and supportive. The course curriculum is designed in such a way that it is so helpful for our industry-level entry. The curriculum involves cloud, DevOps, DSA, and languages like Java, Python, C, and C+. It has an exam structure like it has two written exams in the semester and end-semester. Other than this, we have CIEs (online MCQ exams on chapters of subjects), and moral and SCE exams.

reviews.course: B. Tech. in Computer Engineering
reviews.review_title: It has an awesome campus and good placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are quite good. Many companies visit our college for placement. This year, more than 300 students got placed with decent packages. The average package here ranges from 6-8 LPA. The highest package offered this year till now is 18 LPA. Big companies like IBM, Morgan Stanley, PayPal, etc., visit the college to hire students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus is too good for a quality hostel life and college life. Classrooms are well-maintained and clean. The infrastructure is too good, with proper quality labs and hostels. The food is good and easily available around the campus. The college has a huge ground for sports activities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are qualified and are always helpful. The course curriculum in this college is efficient, which consists of internship modules where students can gain industrial experience as well. Exams are not difficult, and we can score good marks easily.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Vishwakarma Institute of Information Technology is a good college.

detailed_review.Placements: My course is electronics and telecommunication, and currently, I'm pursuing my B.Tech from Vishwakarma Institute of Information Technology. My batch is 2025. The highest package in my course is 24 LPA, the lowest is 3 LPA, and the average package is 4 to 6 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is Wi-Fi available in every department, which is a good part. Labs are big, and there are many PCs available in them. Classrooms are also good. There is no hostel facility available. There are two canteens on campus, and the quality of food is average.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers help students. They are well-qualified and knowledgeable. The teaching quality is good. This is a curriculum-relevant course, and it makes students ready to work in the industry. The semester exams in college are average, not so easy, and not so hard.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering
reviews.review_title: My college review: Absolutely satisfied because of good placements and faculty members.

detailed_review.Placements: I am from the 2026 passing-out batch. I am from the civil engineering branch. Now in my batch, placements are not started yet, but from last year's batch,  80 out of 58 students got placed and others have their different plans like higher studies and government exam preparation. In my course, the highest package is 14 LPA. The average package is 7.5 LPA. The lowest package is 4 LPA. Top recruiters are Everest, JSW, KPMG, Tata Projects, Godrej, Mahindra Lifespaces, and many more. 70 to 75% of students got internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the whole college is good especially the civil department infrastructure is good. It is a 2-floor building. It consists of spacious classrooms and large labs for various civil subjects. Wi-Fi facility is there. In my college, there is a common library which has a large section in the civil department. The college does not provide a hostel facility directly but it is type with other hostels.
detailed_review.Faculty: All staff members are well-qualified. 90% of the faculty are Ph.D. qualified. All faculty members are very helpful. They have their connection with industries. The teaching quality is the best. The course curriculum and site visits are specifically designed to make students industry-ready. The difficulty level of the semester exam is medium to hard.
detailed_review.Other: I have an interest in civil engineering, so I chose this course as my B.Tech degree. Gandharwa is the technocultural event of my college.

reviews.course: B. Tech. in Computer Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good college for those who didn’t want so much stress like other engineering colleges.

detailed_review.Placements: The Nvidia, which is known as a prestigious company, comes only in VIIT college as well as BlackRock, Ansys, and much more well-recognized companies also came to the placement drive. If you are good at DSA, then nobody can stop you from taking a 10 LPA job. The college offers so many opportunities for us.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The food quality is good, you can eat it, and on Sunday it’s definitely very good. It’s like hotel food you get on Sunday, and you will also get a sports area as well as a geyser and daily needs objects in the hostel. One thing you didn’t like about the college is that there are so many branches in the college that there will be a crowd around you.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty is so helpful that they give holidays for second-year and third-year students to prepare for internships, and as well, college time is not that much like other engineering colleges in Pune. The semester passing is much easier in our college. If you are attending college regularly and paying attention, you will get 8.5 CGPA always in each semester. For internship modules, your CGPA should be above 8.5, and for placement drives, your CGPA should be greater than 8.
detailed_review.Other: Activities are always conducted for so much time that you always participate in much more stuff.

reviews.course: B. Tech. in Computer Engineering
reviews.review_title: Honest review of VIIT campus.

detailed_review.Placements: 10% of students get placed only every year. Till now, the highest package was 15 to 20 LPA and the lowest was 2 to 3 LPA. Companies like Cisco, Wipro, and TCS come for campus placements. 5% of students get internships. That’s an average. There are no roles offered in our course. If you want to get admission to this college, think again; you may get better options too.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is too boring. Literally, the projectors don’t even work properly in the class, the labs are okay, and the canteen is also not so good. Talking about the hostel, it’s also a bad experience. The hostel doesn’t even have good facilities. The college doesn’t even have a sports ground for each game. As a sports person, I always felt bad for taking admission here. Medical facilities are not even available.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are good. The curriculum is also designed very well. The marking scheme is best; exams are also not that tough, and you’ll pass easily. The curriculum is a little bit sufficient from your placement point of view. Semester exams are too easy, and the passing marks are only 16. You’ll pass easily.
detailed_review.Other: At the time of admission, I was thinking this is the best college and I chose this college for my engineering, but when I came here, the reality felt hard. The environment is not good, and even the area around the college is not so good. In the college, there’s a place called "hotspot" where people go to smoke, and sometimes we have to go through that road because the gate may be closed. So, this is not safe for girls or boys. Scholarships are provided by the government and come every year. There’s only one fest per year.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science Engineering
reviews.review_title: The college is good, and the faculty is also very good.

detailed_review.Placements: More than 60 percent students were placed in my course in my institute. The lowest package offered is 3.5 LPA, the average package is 5 LPA and the highest package is 15 LPA. Top recruiting companies are TCS, Infosys, etc. More than 80 percent students got internships from my course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is good and the college is large. The college has good facilities like up to date labs, well ventilated labs and library with up to date books required for the courses. The quality of the hostel is good and the quality of food in the canteen and mess is average. The campus has a nice sports ground for playing cricket and football.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are well qualified and quite knowledgeable about the subject they teach and they are also quite helpful about everything. The course is very relevant and provides very good exposure to the industries. The semester exams are easy and can be passed by studying a few days before the exams. The percentage required to pass the exams is 40.
detailed_review.Other: The course provides industry exposure and good placement opportunities.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering(Data Science)
reviews.review_title: Good faculty members, good placements and average facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: As we are the first batch of CSE (Data Science), there is no record of placements for our course. However, branches like CSE, IT, and ENTC also do not have good placements. Only 45-50% of students were placed last year. According to data, the highest package is 40 LPA for core CSE. The average package is 7 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available on campus but not yet in every classroom. The speed of Wi-Fi is good enough. Labs provided for our course are very outdated. However, branches like core CSE and IT have good and powerful PCs. The college hostel is far from the college. Mess quality is below average. The sports ground is very small. Food in the campus canteen is very oily; hygiene is not there.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are qualified and are very supportive in our branch. They teach us well. The curriculum follows the new education policy rules, so the syllabus is up-to-date. Being an autonomous college, it is very easy to pass the semester exams. Chances of getting backlogs or failing are very low. But by chance, if any student fails, a retest is taken just after the result declaration.
detailed_review.Other: A grand event occurs named GANDHARVA.

reviews.course: B. Tech. in Computer Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review for VIIT, Pune College.

detailed_review.Placements: Most of the students get placed in my college, around 90-95%, while the rest opt for Masters or have their own startup. The highest and the lowest packages I have known so far are 40 LPA and 8 LPA, respectively. The top companies which visit my college are NVIDIA and Microsoft, and the majority of the students get internships as well as junior software dev roles.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and the infrastructure of the college are great, and the departments are well maintained with excellent services and hospitality. The admin dept is known for its fast services for the students. The quality of the food available is okay, but all the other things like sports and medical are great.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty teachers are quite qualified and knowledgeable, and at the top of the work they do. The syllabus and the curriculum are well defined according to industry standards, while the exams conducted in the college at the end of the semester are of standard difficulty.
detailed_review.Other: I chose B.Tech in Computer Engineering because I am a technophile and want to build my own tech company in the near future. Even though I feel that the structure of my course is well defined, I still think there's some room for improvement in the structure of the education portals the college uses.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology
reviews.review_title: Really have nice enjoyment here.

detailed_review.Placements: Nearly 80 percent of students get placed; the highest package is nearly 41 LPA, and the lowest is 2.5 LPA, and the average package is 6 LPA as per last year's data. TCS, Wipro, Nvidia, etc. are the top recruiters. All students try to take internships in nice companies, but due to many tech events occurring here, many companies give direct internships to some students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Nice faculty, good infrastructure, greenery everywhere, Wi-Fi is everywhere, and canteens are also good but not for meals. Libraries are less with many technologies like high-speed Wi-Fi, RFID systems to take books, headphones, etc. Sports and games events are also there and Gandharva is the main annual event.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is nice, supportive, very strict, and active in terms of placement. The curriculum is also updated, but many courses per semester students have to face with no study gap in between two papers; exams are conducted with a full set of cameras and invigilators with no regrets.
detailed_review.Other: Overall, a good college, but if you have more potential to score high, then definitely prefer other high placement records colleges too.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of Vishwakarma Institute of Information Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: Students get placed in companies like TCS, Infosys, Barclays, BNY Mellon, Nvidia, Samsung, Capgemini, etc. Roles offered in this course are data analyst, data scientist, data engineering, etc. The highest salary package offered in the 2024-2025 batch is 20 LPA by JP Morgan.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college provides neat classrooms which can accommodate 100 students at a time. It provides Wi-Fi for students. There are many labs for students with many high-end computers. The mess and canteen are well-cleaned and provide hygienic food.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well-qualified and knowledgeable about their specific fields. All teachers are Ph.D holders in their specific fields. They help students and guide them to become industry-ready instead of only teaching theory. Semester exams are not very difficult, and students can pass their internal exams.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering
reviews.review_title: It's a good college; you can take admission. Supportive faculty, and the placement ratio is also goo

detailed_review.Placements: The need for percentage is according to the stream or field you choose like Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, and Data Science require more marks in MHT CET, but Mechanical Engineering and Civil Engineering require comparatively fewer marks. The highest package, according to my knowledge, is 32 Lacs from the Aids department, and the lowest is 4.5 Lacs. Top recruitment companies are Tata Motors, IPAC, and L&T.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is no official hostel at Vishwakarma Institute of Information Technology, but around the college, there are many private hostels, PGs, and flats available. The sports room is good, and all the equipment is in good condition, but there is no sufficient ground for sports like football and cricket. Wi-Fi is available in every department building, and it's free to use for students. The speed is good, and there are no restrictions.
detailed_review.Faculty: Honestly, I don't know about other faculties, but the Civil Engineering department faculty is very supportive. They encourage students to explore new things, not only in study but also in sports and other activities. They all have master's degrees in their respective fields from IITs and NITs.
detailed_review.Other:
I am from the Civil Engineering department. I chose this field because there are many opportunities, such as:

I can do a government job because, as we know, there are a lot of vacancies for civil engineers when compared to other departments.
I can join private builders, contractors, or private jobs.
I can start my own company or consultancy related to construction.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology
reviews.review_title: Good facilities and a college worth the money, but a lot of crowd.

detailed_review.Placements: A decent number of students are placed in my branch with good packages. Many companies visit VIIT, making the college's placement ratio high. Some of the top companies visiting our college are J.P. Morgan, Amazon, and Case, which offer very high packages. Companies also visit for internships and PPOs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All college buildings have Wi-Fi installed, along with projectors in the classrooms. There are proper computer labs. The college has its own hostel with decent facilities, including a mess and some sports equipment inside the hostel.
detailed_review.Faculty: The college faculty is very helpful, especially when it comes to assisting with projects, which helps build your resume and gain more knowledge. The college is autonomous and has its own curriculum. Exams are not too difficult and can be passed with ease. The passing percentage is around 40%, and internals can help you achieve that.
detailed_review.Other: I was specifically looking for software-related branches, and this was the best college available for my percentile, so I chose this course. The college also conducts events, with a major one called Gandharva.

reviews.course: B. Tech. in Computer Engineering
reviews.review_title: Overall, it's a good private college.

detailed_review.Placements: Over 120+ companies visited the campus, and 1500+ students were placed (as per the official college website). The highest package for the year 23-24 was reported to be 54 LPA, with the average being approximately 7.8 LPA. The number of students placed is slightly less, around 70 percent, since some students opt for higher studies, some have their own startups, and others do not qualify as per company requirements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: VIIT college does have a sports ground that is available for everyone, but it is mostly empty; students are not interested in sports. Very few students have sports teams, and they do represent the college in their respective sports. The infrastructure is average—not very bad, but not very good either. Considering the fees, they literally ask you to buy a 1.5k kit and other accessories, excluding a calculator and other basic items, despite charging 200k from students per year.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are very cooperative and decently qualified. However, you would need to study alongside your ongoing college syllabus. Though VIIT is an autonomous institute and SPPU affiliated, its syllabus is not very up-to-date.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering
reviews.review_title: The truth of the college.

detailed_review.Placements: The core branches of the college rarely get placements. In the civil branch, only one company is part of the placement. However, IT branches such as CS, AIDS, AIML, etc. have a very high placement rate and up to 70% of students get placed through campus placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college has Wi-Fi in every building, and the library is very well equipped. We can find almost every book that you require in relation to the course that we have opted for. The classrooms are well ventilated and spacious, providing a good learning experience.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers that teach at this college are very well qualified and quite knowledgeable. They are keen to help students with their doubts regarding their subjects. The course curriculum is relevant for today's date as advanced techniques used in industries are also taught. The level of difficulty of the examinations is medium.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science Engineering
reviews.review_title: B. R. A. C. T's Vishwakarma Institute of Information Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80 percent of students were placed. The highest package was 20 lakhs per annum, whereas the lowest package was 3 lakhs per annum. The top recruiting companies were TCS, Wipro and others. The placements are not so good and not even fully satisfying.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is proper infrastructure for the classrooms, labs and other laboratories. There are no issues regarding infrastructure. There is a Wi-Fi connection but that doesn't work properly and moreover, there is no range in the building. There is a proper mess on the campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are not highly knowledgeable and are not even less than required. I am not doubting their qualifications, but they are not very helpful. Quality is not so good, not so bad and it can be termed average. The curriculum courses are nicely designed. The semester exams are not so difficult.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence)
reviews.review_title: Dissatisfied because of outside area, but the highest package is 44LPA. Good infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: This is a new course introduced in 2022, so we are only the second batch. Currently, there are no placement reports, as the previous batch is only in their third year. We are hopeful that starting from their third year, they will get internships or PPOs (Pre-Placement Offers).
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The curriculum of our branch is well-structured, with no doubts in that regard. Digital classrooms are available, along with a specific lab for project work equipped with Wi-Fi services. Hostel facilities are quite good, with a well-maintained mess, although it is average. Cleanliness is maintained every two days, and Wi-Fi is available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful and qualified from recognized institutes, mostly holding M.Tech and Ph.D. degrees. The course is industry-related and encourages students to undertake industry projects from the second year onwards. Semester exams are relatively easy compared to other colleges, making it possible to achieve a good pointer. Out of 125, you need to score 50 for passing.

faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

faqs.question: What entrance exams are accepted by VIIT Pune for admission to B.Tech?
faqs.answer: VIIT Pune offers admission to its B.Tech programme via MHT CET and JEE Mains exams . If you're from the Maharashtra state, you get admission by taking the MHT-CET exam, which fills 85% of the seats. But if you're from anywhere else in India, you have to take the JEE Mains exam, which fills the remaining 15% of the seats.

facilities.name: Library
facilities.description: The Central library is enriched with an excellent collection of latest text books, reference books, hand-books, journals, periodicals, proceedings CDs, etc. It consists of Reference Section, Journal Section, Reading Hall, Digital library section, Multimedia Facility, Stack-Room etc. Overnight issue, reading room service, photocopy service are also available. reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Average and budget-friendly option with normal placements.

detailed_review.Placements: 50-60% of students were placed, and the lowest package was 3.5 LPA, whereas the highest package went to 18-20 LPA. Companies like EPAM, PhysicsWallah, Watchguard, TCS, Cognizant, FICO, Deloitte, Accenture, KPIT, LG, Namma Yatri and DBS were the recruiting companies. Top roles offered were Quality Analyst, Software Developer, and Data Analyst, and there were not many internships that were offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is just average, classrooms are pretty much normal, and there is no Wi-fi. The library is also not that big and has just basic course-related books. Labs are also not that highly developed. The boys' hostel is good, but in the girls' hostel, many problems do occur, and the mess food is not that good, but they do have variety, and food is provided on time. Basic medical facilities are available on campus, and there is an arrangement of sports too. Also, a plus point is that the hostel does have a gym, and the campus is quite beautiful and peaceful in the evening.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty are not that knowledgeable, but they do provide support if sought. Teaching quality is okay, and attendance is compulsory for this particular course. Semester exams are quite difficult, and the classes are not that interactive and practical-based. The pass percentage is 34%.
detailed_review.Other: The college does have a lot of fests like DB nights, guest talks, tech and non-tech events. The MUN conference is also conducted every year, and the co-curricular activities are pretty good.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology
reviews.review_title: Review of Chandigarh Group of Colleges, Landran

detailed_review.Placements: Placement is good. About 65 percent of last semester's students got placed. The average package is about 5–6 LPA. Placement drives are continuing. Students from Chandigarh Engineering College also go to Chandigarh University during placement drives, as they have joint placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The entire campus is Wi-Fi connected, and the classrooms are big enough. They have proper fans, lighting, and exhaust fans. Every classroom has a projector and a whiteboard. Hostel food is average, sometimes good, and sometimes bad. Non-veg food is available on selected days in the hostel mess. Medical services are available 24/7 with an ambulance for emergencies. Grounds for football, volleyball, basketball, and badminton are available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, though some are rude. The course curriculum is relevant, but in the first semester, almost every branch has the same subjects. Later, subjects are assigned according to the stream. Semester exams are not too tough. With good study and concentration, students can easily pass them.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology
reviews.review_title: Good for CSE students but needs some improvement.

detailed_review.Placements: I am from the 2025 IT batch. 85 percent of students are placed with top companies like TCS Infosys Wipro Amazon Watchguard etc. Mostly roles include Software Developer Full sack Developer Data Analyst Sales and Marketing. The highest package offered is 40LPA and the average package offered is 6LPA. 80 percent of students got placed in major IT companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our CSE department has high speed Wi-Fi advanced labs smart classrooms and a well stocked library. Hostel facilities are comfortable mess food is decent canteen is clean and students get proper medical support along with good sports and gym facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are mostly helpful and qualified and the teaching quality is decent. The curriculum is fairly relevant but needs more industry focus semester exams and moderately difficult and pass percentage is usually high with regular study.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course for good career scope and the best part is good exposure and supportive faculty. Labs and industry training can improve. Fests are decent the crowd is mixed connectivity is good and extracurricular activities are fair.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: The college has good infrastructure and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: A lot of students got placed in a good number of companies that came to the college. The highest package is 1 cr, and the lowest is 3 LPA. The Top recruiting companies for my course are like Accenture, etc. Recently, the Accenture company came for an internship at my college. Top roles in my course are graduate trainee, technical programmer, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: A good Wi-Fi connection is provided. Mess food is good. All facilities were provided in good condition, and they kept both healthy and junk food. Medical facilities are available. Sports and games are also provided for both hostellers and day scholars.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful and knowledgeable. The course is very relevant and makes students ready for placements. GD and CS sessions are taken in college with different sections to prepare students for further placements. Exams are of a medium level, so students can qualify for them.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The college is above average in the private university segment.

detailed_review.Placements: It is a great college among private ones. In my senior batch, the placement percentage is around 75–80%. Most students get placed in mass recruiter companies like Capgemini, TCS, and Infosys. The starting salary in these companies is quite average. But with 1–2 years of experience, a person can easily increase their package 2–3 times.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of this college is wonderful. In recent years, the infrastructure of the college is maintained very well. Regular construction and small changes make it much better than other colleges. Labs are fully functional and air-conditioned. Air conditioning is missing in classrooms, but still, the classrooms are well-ventilated.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers here are fully supportive and help a lot in mid-sems and end-sems. Teachers are very sincere and serious about the studies. Especially, the training and placement program faculty is really impressive. Both technical and non-technical faculty are very hardworking and give their best for students.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: There are good placements and a chill campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 90% of students in our course got placed through campus placements. The highest package is 12 LPA, and the lowest package is around 3 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course are Accenture, TCS, Wipro, Infosys, Deloitte, Nokia, etc. I do not have a proper percentage, but only 40-50% of students got internships in MNC companies and startups. Roles offered are related to development, security, testing, and sales.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are just fans in classrooms. Wi-Fi is available only in the lab rooms. The library has a proper set of books related to the course. Semi-furnished rooms, 24-hour security, 2 gyms, on-campus medical facilities, and reading rooms are available in the hostel. The hostel mess used to serve only vegetarian food, but the food used to be very tasty. There are multiple canteens on the college premises. There are 3 main gardens, 1 Parivartan ground, 1 COE ground, and 1 is the famous fighter planet ground. Basketball court, volleyball, cricket, and football sports equipment are available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some teachers are not that qualified to some extent, but some teachers are PhD holders. Still, all of them are helpful and supportive to students. They exhibit mixed teaching qualities, with some focusing on practical knowledge by providing real-life examples, while others use simple language. The course curriculum is industry-relevant, including subjects related to technologies like machine learning, cloud computing, IOT, etc. Semester exams are a bit challenging if we have not attended lectures daily, but moderate for those who are attending lectures with full attention. There are final external exams. The pass marks are 27 out of 60.
detailed_review.Other: I chose CSE as there are multiple job openings in this field, and personally, I am more interested in computers and cybersecurity. We need more specialized labs and updated software. More guest lectures, workshops, and internships from the top product companies would help bridge the gaps between campus and industry. Surroundings of the campus are elegant, clean, and lush green. Connectivity is at its peak as it is on the highway, so public buses, autos, and other means of transportation are easily available. The college also has its own buses. The campus crowd is mostly North Indian, and there are students from states like Jammu and Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, Punjab, Haryana, UP, and Bihar.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is the best private college for B.Tech.

detailed_review.Placements: There are more than 700 students in CGC Landran, Mohali, Punjab. Companies like Google and Infosys visit our college. More than 300 students do internships in the 2nd and 3rd year in many companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Many facilities are provided by the college, such as a lift facility in the hostel and a library. Sports management is very good. We have more than 20 courts of different types of sports. Our college provides laundry facilities. There are many parks and grounds. There are ACs in each classroom.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. Teaching quality is very good. Teachers have more than 20 years of experience. Our teachers and HOD are mostly PhD holders. There are more than 200 teachers and more than 6,000 students.
detailed_review.Other: Many fests and functions are organised by CGC Landran, Mohali, Punjab, such as a Holi party, a Diwali party, Parivartan, and a freshers party. The campus is very beautiful and lush green. More than 250 companies visit the college to hire students.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: CGC Landran is a great B.Tech CSE college with modern labs, good education, and affordable fees.

detailed_review.Placements: The college offers internships in many companies. Students seeking B.Tech CSE with a good education at an affordable price must check it out.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure like labs and classrooms is very good. Each class has AC and proper air conditioning. Workshops and EDGE classes are well-planned, and studies are all A+. The sports room and canteen are also awesome. I'm not a hosteller, but when I asked my friends, they said the hostel food, rooms, and medical facilities are all very nice.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful and well-qualified. They send helpful question banks during exam time and also mark important questions that really help in improving our scores and preparation. Semester exams are not too hard, just moderate. Studying and passing are easy if students do some smart work.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I'm very passionate about CS. The best thing I like is coding and the exposure to the coding world. I think everything is good and there is no need for improvement. But, if more coding subjects are included in the 1st year of B.Tech, that would really help us. CGC Landran College is a good option for students who belong to middle-class families. This college offers B.Tech CSE education at an affordable price.

highlights.summary:
CIT is an autonomous Engineering institute established in 2010. CIT is an affiliate of Anna University and is recognised by AICTE and UGC. According to the NIRF 2025 ranking, the institute is ranked among the 101-150 engineering colleges by the NIRF 2025. NAAC has accredited the institute with a grade 'A+'. Chennai Institute of Technology has signed numerous MoUs nationally and internationally, enhancing student opportunities for learning and research.
Chennai Institute of Technology offers full-time engineering programmes, including undergraduate programmes in 14 specialisations and postgraduate programmes in 3 specialisations such as Artficial Intelligence & Data Science, Communication Engineering, CSE, and others. Admission to the BE/ BTech programme of CIT Chennai is based on the TNEA score. For ME admissions, the college considers the GATE score. CIT has awarded scholarships exceeding 10 crores to deserving students. During the 2025 placements, the institute had over 230 companies participating in the recruitment events.
During the CIT Chennai placements 2025, the highest package stood at INR 51 LPA. CIT hosts over 30 centres of excellence dedicated to advanced education and research, alongside initiatives like faculty exchange programs, study abroad opportunities, and international internships. The institute facilitates its students with a library, auditorium, seminar or conference halls, guest houses, internet & wifi, hostels, and a canteen, among others. admission.title: Chennai Institute of Technology Admission Overview 2026
admission.overview_text:
CIT admission is completely entrance/counselling-based and is conducted by DOTE Chennai. CIT courses are affiliated with Anna University.

The institute offers undergraduate and postgraduate programmes in the field of Engineering. CIT offers BTech and MTech courses. The BTech programme is offered in 14 specialisations, such as Computer Science and Engineering, Artificial Intelligence and Data Science, and Electronics and Communication Engineering. CIT offers 3 PG courses, including Computer Science and Engineering, Artificial Intelligence and Data Science.

To furnish the financial needs of the students, the institute offers a few scholarships to students based on merit. Learn about Chennai Institute of Technology admission for BE and ME courses. A list of Chennai Institute of Technology courses along with the entrance exams accepted for respective admission:

faqs.question: Which entrance exam is accepted by Chennai Institute of Technology?
faqs.answer: Yes, Chennai Institute of Technology accepts the scores of GATE / CEETA PG exam for admission to the two-year ME programme at the college campus. Chennai Institute of Technology offers full-time two-year ME programmes across five specialisations. Candidates, to be eligible, are required to have completed their UG degree in relevant field with 50% aggregate for General category students and with a minimum of 40% aggregate for reserved category students.

faqs.question: How to get admission at Chennai Institute of Technology?
faqs.answer: Candidates willing to pursue BTech at CIT need to appear for TNEA counselling to be eligible. The TNEA application form is released in online mode only and eligible candidates can register for the online state-level counselling at tneaonline.org. Apart from the online application form available on the website, candidates can also visit the TNEA Facilitation Centers (TFC) established in selected cities and fill out the application form. Step 1: Application Process Interested students seeking the steps to fill out the TNEA application form can check out the detailed process below: The TNEA 2023 application fee can be checked in the table below: Read more details on TNEA and its counselling process here. Step 2: Selection/ Shortlisting of Candidates All the candidates seeking admission to BTech are required to go through TNEA counselling and that becomes the basis of the final selection done by the Directorate of Technical Education, Tamil Nadu. Step 3: Payment of Admission Fee & Admission Confirmation Candidates selected for BTech need to pay the admission fee of the course at CIT to confirm their admission at the institute.

faqs.question: Can I get Chennai Institute of Technology with 15000 rank?
faqs.answer: Chennai Institute of Technology provides admission to BE and BTech on the basis of TNEA scores. Among the General AI category candidates, the cutoff ranks varied between 3537 and 18646 . Therefore, it is possible to get admisison to the college at 15000 rank. However, the choice of specialisation would depend on the cutoff rank of that particular specialisation. At 15000 rank, admission to a few specialisations is possible such as BE in Mechanical Engineering and BE in Civil Engineering.

faqs.question: How much rank should I score to get Chennai Institute of Technology?
faqs.answer: To get into Chennai Institute of Technology, candidate must attain the rank as per the category they belong to. If the candidate belong to the General AI category, then the rank must be 18646 or below. For candidates belonging to the OBC AI category, the rank must be 23053 or below. Login: Candidates who register successfully are issued login details that include a username and password. Fill out the online application form: Candidates have to complete the online application form which has seven parts. One part of them is the application fee payment. Preview and submit the online form: Candidates can preview the form carefully once before final submission. Download the online form: The online form can be downloaded after the final submission. Candidates must keep the downloaded copy with them. It is not meant to be sent to the authorities. Step 2: Selection/ Shortlisting of Candidates All the candidates seeking admission to BTech are required to go through TNEA counselling and that becomes the basis of the final selection done by the Directorate of Technical Education, Tamil Nadu. Step 3: Payment of Admission Fee & Admission Confirmation Candidates selected for BTech need to pay the admission fee of the course at CIT to confirm their admission at the institute. sections.heading: Introduction
text: Chennai Institute of Technology is an engineering college with an established reputation. The institute is known for high-quality teachers and research, thus having a lot to offer. The campus is attractive and compact, with excellent student accommodation, and proximity to the city. The institute offers an ideal and conducive environment for learning. See the informantion below to know more about CIT infrastructure.

sections.heading: Chennai Institute of Technology Campus Highlights
text: Chennai Institute of Technology is considered one of the best engineering colleges across Chennai. The campus of the institute is wi-fi enabled with highly sophisticated equipment. The institute has spacious and ventilated classrooms, laboratories with the latest high-configured equipment, a digitalised air-conditioned library with huge volumes of books, journals from national and international. Wifi connectivity is available at all times. The institute has Canteens, pure drinking water facilities, ATM Services, and an NSS Unit. There is ample parking space and 24*7 security. Various student clubs are there along with women's power programme.
A few highlights are given below:

sections.heading: Chennai Institute of Technology Academic and Research Facilities
text: Chennai Institute of Technology offers academic excellence by having a well-developed academic infrastructure. The institute offers well-equipped classrooms and laboratories across all its departments. There is a modern, Wi-Fi-enabled campus, a smart library, spacious classrooms, and dedicated research facilities . The infrastructure of the institute supports interaction among students and faculty. Moreover, the atmosphere offers a space for balanced growth and development of students.

The institute offers a variety of full-time engineering programs, including Bachelor’s B.E./B. Tech and Master’s M.E degrees. Over 14 undergraduate and 3 postgraduate specialisations, such as Computer Science & Engineering, Artificial Intelligence and Data Science, Electronics & Communication Engineering, among others, are being taught.

CIT has formed numerous MoUs both nationally and internationally to enhance student opportunities and aspirations. It is also home to over 30+ centres of excellence that support advanced learning and research. The initiatives, like faculty exchange programs, study abroad opportunities, and international internships, can greatly enhance the learning experience for students at Chennai Institute of Technology. These programs not only expose students to different cultures and academic environments but also help them build valuable global networks.

sections.heading: Chennai Institute of Technology Hostel and Residential Facilities
text: CIT has hostels for men and women, located within the campus. The hostels with well-furnished rooms provide an ideal ambience to make residents feel at home. The hostels have wired internet connectivity. The Men’s hostel is a multi-storied building. The hostel includes indoor sporting facilities and a common room on the ground floor. Residents can use the Chennai Institute of Technology boarding facilities.
The hostel facilities are designed to provide a comfortable, secure and welcoming environment. There is 24/7 surveillance and round-the-clock security.

CIT also has a Bank branch and an ATM counter on the campus. It is on the first floor of the main building. Students can easily open an account by completing the bank's requirements. The institute provides primary health facilities to students. The students also have access to the hospital housed on the same campus.

sections.heading: Chennai Institute of Technology Library
text: The central library of the institute is equipped with quality books, journals and magazines at the national and international level. The Chennai Institute of Technology department has many sections, such as the digital library , reference section , issue section and reading room .

CIT has a stock of over 15000 books and study materials, offering comprehensive material for students and faculty. Apart from books, periodicals, journals , etc, an air-conditioned digital library with multimedia material is also available. The library is well protected with fire alarms and CCTV Security systems .

It provides various social activity options to students, thus making the learning process more enjoyable. For this purpose, the Young Entrepreneurs Club , the Public Speaking Club and the Creative Club are set up.

sections.heading: Chennai Institute of Technology Sports Facilities

The College also organises various sports and games on our campus. Outdoor and indoor games facilities available on the campus are effectively used by the students during and after college hours.

reviews.course: M.E. in Construction Management
reviews.review_title: Coimbatore Institute of Technology in M.E Construction Management course information

detailed_review.Placements: About 80 percent of the students can get jobs. The highest offer is 10 LPA, the lowest is 3 LPA, and the average is around 5.8 LPA. Companies like L&T, Tata Projects, and NCC are hiring a lot. There are a lot of good internship opportunities, mostly in site and project coordination.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Campus has clean classrooms, good Wi-Fi, and labs for planning. There are a lot of books on engineering management in the library. The rooms in the hostel are clean, but the food is always the same. There is a sports field and medical help, but the service can be slow.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are friendly and professional, and they connect theory to real-world situations. The syllabus is mostly practical, with lessons on budgeting, safety, and planning projects. The tests are fair, and most students pass them with ease. Not many subjects need to be updated.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Chemical Engineering
reviews.review_title: The placements were good at my college.

detailed_review.Placements: 85% students were placed in my course. 13.5 LPA is the highest package, 7.5 LPA is the average package, and 4 LPA is the lowest package. John Mathey, reliance recruited. 75% got an internship. Core-based and software-based roles are offered. My department faculty members were working sincerely on their work.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure for my course are very good. Wi-fi is available throughout the campus, and the labs are so good, all equipment is available in Physics and Chemistry labs. For separate departments, they have labs. Especially in my course, labs are large and have more facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty:
Teachers are helpful, and every teacher in my course completed Ph.D. in the course, moreover, they are knowledgeable, skilled and friendly.
Also, they were curriculum-relevant. It is easy to pass the semester exams if we are clear on the concept knowledge.
detailed_review.Other: The chemical engineering course is unique compared to other courses.

reviews.course: Integrated M.Sc. in Data Science
reviews.review_title: Good college if you are ready to learn by yourself.

detailed_review.Placements: 90% of students got placed. The highest package is 24 LPA, and the lowest is 6 LPA. Top recruiting company is KLA. 60% of students got internships on campus interviews at companies like KLA, Thorogood, etc. Top roles offered are data and AI consultant, software engineer, data scientists, and data analyst.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good. There is no Wi-Fi in computing block for students access. Labs are clean. Library is easily accessible and good. Hostel and mess are good. Hostel mess is okay when you can adjust to the normal, minimal food that is not too tasty. Hostel rooms are good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are qualified. Curriculum can be improved but it is okay for now. Students will be well-developed when they learn more by themselves. Semester exams are not that much difficult. Pass percentage as of 3rd semester is 87% in our class. Passing exams are easy but getting more CGPA is based on the student's knowledge.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: A peaceful life at Coimbatore Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: 97% of students were placed in good company. The other 3% choose to continue their studies to the next level. The siphon is also a little worth for the job. Top companies visit our college to recruit students. There are vast options to choose from for your placement.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are specific labs for each and every department. We also have a computer engineering lab with full-fledged. There is a Wi-Fi support in almost every computer. The hostel is neatly maintained by the hostel students and the appointed staff. The hostel is vast and sufficient.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum for our batch is easy and good compared to other colleges. Our faculty members are jovial and understanding. They clarify each and every doubt with needed examples and clear them specifically. The decorom is maintained with due towards the college.
detailed_review.Other: The campus life here is quiet and calm which is a need for each and every student. There are many committees and clubs for anti-ragging and other unwanted stuff for the safe.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: College is very good in terms of placements.

detailed_review.Placements: The top recruiters are Bosch, Deshaw, Toshiba, L&T, Hyundai, and many more. The highest package in the college is 52 LPA by Deshaw. The lowest package is 4 LPA. The average package is around 5-6 LPA. Many other software companies also recruit from this college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is decent and not very fancy. Labs are good, and the systems are all functioning. The library functions from 9 AM to 7 PM except for Sunday. Canteens and chaat shops are available. The sports and athletics club is present. Sports like cricket, football, badminton, chess, and many more are available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are supportive, helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. The mode of teaching is chalk and talk and PPT presentations. The course curriculum is relevant, and the focus is more on core subjects. It makes students industry-ready. The difficulty level of semester exams is moderate. The pass percentage is nearly 90%.
detailed_review.Other: A lot of clubs are present in the college, such as technical clubs, cultural clubs, and special interest clubs.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: Learning phase of the life.

detailed_review.Placements: The highest package was 52 LPA and was offered by Deshaw to 8 of my collegemates, and 2 of them got placed in the 5th semester itself and got a summer internship. The package was 3 lakhs for two months and then they automatically converted to FTE. The minimum package was around 1.5-4 lpa and the median package is around 5-6 lpa.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: 4-5 specific labs are available for every department, which is provided with every piece of equipment that is needed for potential engineers but the infrastructure is old and outdated as the college was built in 1950s. The college recently started the renovating process, which is going on.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers were very helpful, qualified and very knowledgeable, and their teaching quality was very high. The course is very relevant to the academic course as well as the placements. The semester exams, which are conducted by the college, are median, as the questions were set by internal faculties and the pass percentage is 50%.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: A good place to gain knowledge and placements but has bad infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements:
About 80% of the students got placed in reputed companies, and the placement drive started in the 7th semester and ended in the 8th semester.
The highest package was 56 lpa and the median package ranges around 5-6 Lpa.
Companies like L&T, Schneider Electric, Soliton, Tata Elxsi, and TVS offered good packages.
detailed_review.Infrastructure:
4-5 specific labs are available for every department, which is provided with every lab equipment that is needed for a potential engineering but the infrastructure is old and the college has started the reconstruction of new buildings.
The hostel and the food provided are below average.
detailed_review.Faculty:
The teachers are highly knowledgeable with various specialization and also approachable and loyal. They were always ready to help us if approached.
The course curriculum is ready-made for placements; they have added materials which will be useful in preparation of placements.
The semester exams are usually easy, and the average CPGA lies around 8.

reviews.course: M.E. in Construction Management
reviews.review_title: Events .The college events conducted by the various clubs

detailed_review.Placements: When it coms to the placement scenario in our college, it is pretty encouraging. Students are allowed to participate in campus placements from their 5th semester. Companies like AMNS, Dana Anand Pvt Ltd., Birla, JSW Steel and many more come over to our campus. The highest package offered is around 3.5 LPA, while the average package to be around 2.5 LPA. Around 70% of the students get recruited through their campus placement drives. Regarding my plans for the future, I will be looking forward to getting a job after completing my degree.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel infrastructure is good.Rooms are allocated with 2 persons per room . It's fair spacious.considering campus life interacting with seniors makes it more interesting via club events and some department events.Sports are pretty good in out college.Our college contains various club so that every student can participate in any of the club activities .social service clubs like nss ,yrc,rsp etc are also here which taught students about the responsibilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: In our college, there are 60 students in each department and 7+ faculties thereby maintaining a good teacher- student ratio. All faculties are nice and helpful and my favorite teacher is Ritesh Mandal sir and Ujjwal Baidya sir Because of their pleasant personality and its teaching. The year is divided into two semesters, two internal exam 20 marks and one external final exam 60 marks. the left 20 consists of assignments 10 marks and attendance 10 marks. For lab subjects total score is of 100 marks which includes projects, viva and lab work. The exams are fair, .difficult yet i can't say they are unjust. The oral curriculum is practical and related much to how the students will benefit themselves in the...profession. And passed students percentage very high 95%.

reviews.course: Integrated M.Sc. in Software Systems
reviews.review_title: Good hostel, classrooms, and placements record.

detailed_review.Placements: 90% of students from the batch secured job offers across various sectors. The highest was 12 lpa, and the lowest was at 70k per month. Zoho, Infosys, Royal Enfield, TCS, and Wipro are the top recurring companies for this course. Full-stack developer, backend developer, cloud engineer, site reliability engineer, and product engineer are some of the top roles offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure:
We got a new block recently, especially for MSC integrated courses. Classrooms are good. The institute provides well-maintained facilities for sports like football, cricket, basketball, and tennis.
A modern gym equipped with cardio and weight-training equipment is accessible to students.
detailed_review.Faculty: It's quite good. High-speed internet connectivity is available throughout the hostel premises. Laundry facilities are available to help students manage their daily needs with ease. Round-the-clock security personnel and CCTV surveillance to ensure student safety.
detailed_review.Other: I chose it just because it was different from other courses.

reviews.course: M.E. in Environmental Engineering and Management
reviews.review_title: Student driven clubs and the activities that gives students a boost up to their personality.

detailed_review.Placements: At Coimbatore Institute of Technology, the placement rate is usually 75% or higher. The highest and average packages also vary from year to year. Companies that have hired from Coimbatore Institute of Technology include Amazon, Flipkart, Samsung, Qualcomm, BEL, GAIL, IOCL, and many other MNCs and PSUs.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our lab is completely a teach-ready lab, which is an important thing in every college. When it comes to sports, each sport has its own clubs, and the students and members actively participate in intercollegiate and all levels of sports and come out in shining colors.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty at Coimbatore Institute of Technology are very good and experienced. They have good teaching skills, and the student to faculty ratio is 1:6. There are two mid-term exams and two unit tests. Midterm 1 consists of theory and labs, as does midterm 2. Before midterm 1, unit test 1 is given, and before midterm 2, unit test 2 is given. Later in the semester, the final exams are held.

reviews.course: M.E. in Environmental Engineering and Management
reviews.review_title: College is likely good and the infrastructure is peaceful.

detailed_review.Placements: From the end of the 6th semester, you were allowed to enter into the placements that the students are eligible for on campus. Many companies, including TCS, IBM, and Deloitte, offer placement. The highest package on campus gets up to 36 Lacs per annum and the average package is about 12 Lacs per annum.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Club involvement in the college is very good. They made a drama club for the students, a dance club for the students, a singing club for the students, and many more clubs. The martial arts club especially focuses on the girls safety. Every morning, 2 hours for the martial arts club and athletes in the sports clubs.
detailed_review.Faculty: All the facilities are well known about the subject, and they can clarify the doubts to the students in an approachable way. All the faculty are doctorates and well experienced; they will explain the topics clearly, and though you can ask doubts personally.

reviews.course: M.E. in Environmental Engineering and Management
reviews.review_title: I like the infrastructure and the campus very much.

detailed_review.Placements: From the 5th semester onwards, it’s eligible to attend campus placements. I have been placed in TATA ELXSI. Many good companies visited the college, such as Wipro, Soliton, Econ, TCS, TATA ELXSI, Amazon, Cognizant, Kaar Technologies, KPIT Technologies, Johnson Control, Emphasis, Traid Software, Accenture, Newgen Software, BNP Paribas, Presidio, and Ernst & Young Global.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There will be 28+ clubs in CIT, such as Rotaract, Nature Club, Literary Club, EBSB, KKC, MAC, and so on. The extracurricular activities are amazing, and there will be daily sports practice for football, volleyball, cricket, and so on. There will be good facilities in the classrooms for the students to enhance their knowledge. There will be huge benefits for the students due to their access to the library, and different fests will be conducted frequently.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty here is highly professional and supports us very much. Teachers here are highly educated and share their experiences with us. Exams happen often; every couple of months, we have two exams per semester. I found the staff to be very supportive; the college is very good.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good college with excellent placement records.

detailed_review.Placements: Our batch is 2020-2024 and I belong to CSE Department. The percentage of students placed are around 60–70%. The highest package was 52 Lacs per annum and the lowest was 2–3 Lacs per annum. Top recruiting companies is D. E. Shaw, offering 52 Lacs per annum. Around 50% of students got internship by D. E. Shaw, MBRDI, Root quotient, etc. The roles offered vary. But some of them are developers by SDET.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure are good. Computer labs have Wi-Fi facilities. The classrooms have smart boards, etc. The hostel's quality was mediocre. The food is like all other hostel food. We can't expect food to be great in hostel. We have a separate canteen where we have to pay eat.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum was good. The teachers are helpful and qualified enough. The course syllabus is relevant as knowledge; as I am from CSE, we had subjects like data structures, database management systems, machine learning, etc. The semester exams are not that tough. I would say. You would be able to attempt all the questions if you referred to the question papers from last year.
detailed_review.Other: I chose CSE because I am interested in computer science. I think they can keep the course syllabus even more practical. Speaking about events, CIT has a lot of events, and there are around 30 clubs. There are scholarships available too, particularly for students.

reviews.course: M.E. in Construction Management
reviews.review_title: Coimbatore institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: One of the best colleges in Coimbatore for Construction Management. Many big companies like L&T, M Moser, Adani infra etc. participate in the on campus drive. Many students get above 4.5LPA package. After selection in the company, we have a  trainee period of 6 months after which an on-role job given. Roles offered are that of junior project coordinator, and assistant construction manager.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is not good. There were some old buildings where the construction was going on. In labs, some of the equipments didn’t work. Our library is very big with all the academic books mase available along with a Wi-Fi and WLAN cable. I had some bad experiences with the hostel. There are no fans, I brought a fan for the room myself. They need to at least provide the basic facilities. Our mess food was moderate in quality. No medical facilities are given by the college.
detailed_review.Faculty: The department has a dedicated faculty team including 11 faculty members. There are mostly male faculty members. The teachers are M.Teach Civil or Construction management qualified with some having experience in the field of construction. Course curriculum is balanced with equal hours for practicals and theory. Semester exams are difficult but more than 80% of the students passed in our batch.
detailed_review.Other: Our college fees is very affordable but hostel feels is expensive if we consider its facilities.

reviews.course: B.E. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: A place where you can sculpt yourself.

detailed_review.Placements: 86% of students got placed in my Electrical & Electronics Engineering department, with nearly 99 students securing jobs. The highest package offered was 20 LPA, the lowest was 3.3 LPA, and the average was 6 LPA. Recruiters included Larsen & Toubro, Bosch, Schneider, TCS, Lucas TVS, Zoho, and HPE, offering roles such as GET, Software Developer, and System Engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The lab is well-equipped with all necessary equipment. Smart classrooms provide an effective learning environment. The library is stocked with a variety of books, both core and non-core. Hostel infrastructure can be improved; however, the food is satisfactory. There are three dispensaries for medical support, and sports facilities are good.
detailed_review.Faculty: CIT has good teachers with knowledge who cover the entire syllabus and encourage us to take seminars. The course curriculum helps students be ready for both core and non-core aspects. Labs contribute to a better understanding of the subjects. Exams are moderate.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied because of faculty, good placements, quality of studies, etc.

detailed_review.Placements: My other department seniors have been placed with a good package. The highest package is 62 LPA. The core based companies are recruiting more. Following are the top recruiting companies: DeeShaw, wipro, HCS, Effitrac, etc. The institution provide training for placements from 1st year onwards. So, students need not worry about the placements. They can be fearlfree.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Though the infrastructure is looks old, the quality is good. Comapred to other colleges, hostel food is very excellent in our college. The food menu will changed in a routine manner. The internet will be good through ethernet. Library has Wi-Fi facility. The labs are also of good quality in a way that the students find comfortable to do their work there.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members are very good. They teach us in an understandable way. Very friendly. Even the HOD (Head of the department) is also very jovial to students. Our department provides insights to us by conducting various techtalks, meets, etc. Through these activities, we gain the knowledge on industry projects. The semester exams are a little tough that we need to prepare the syllabus from various books. Our department has a pass percentage of 90%. .
