Candidates must have the following: A pass in any recognised bachelor’s degree of minimum three-year duration with at least 50% aggregate (45% in the case of BC, BCM, MBC, SC, SCA and ST candidates belonging to Tamil Nadu) in the qualifying degree examination. The graduation degree should be in any of these formats: 10+2+3/ 4 /5 years’ pattern OR 10+3-year Diploma + 3 years’ pattern or BE/ BTech/ BArch/ BPharm or 10+2 + AMIE or 10+3 years’ diploma

faqs.question: Is MBA offered at Coimbatore Institute of Technology?
faqs.answer: CIT Coimbatore offers a full-time two-year Master of Business Administration (MBA) under the Department of Management Studies. The duration of the course is two years divided into four semesters. Available across six specialisations, admission to CIT Coimbatore MBA is subject to a valid score obtained by the students in the TANCET MBA exam conducted by DOTE Chennai. The specialisations available under MBA include Business Analytics, Financial Management, Marketing Management, Human Resource Management, Operations Management and Information Systems Management. For more details on CIT Coimbatore MBA, its admission process, placements and more, click here .

sections.heading: Introduction
text: CIT Coimbatore infrastructure consists of world-class classrooms, a library, hostels, and cafeterias. It features smart classrooms equipped with whiteboards, projectors, and other modern facilities to cater to students' academic needs. For cultural programmes, workshops, and guest lectures, spacious seminar halls and large auditoriums are exclusively constructed within the institute. Every department has labs designed according to global standards. C heck out the video below t o learn more about the Coimbatore Institute of Technology infrastructure,

sections.heading: CIT Coimbatore Campus Highlights
text: The CIT Coimbatore campus is vast and surrounded by lush greenery. From academics to research, it has all the modern infrastructure to meet the students' academic needs. The institute has advanced research centres for artificial intelligence, renewable energy, materials science, and big data analytics. The campus features several auditoriums and conference halls. They are equipped with modern audio-visual technology. Owing to their roomy spaces and features, the halls serve as a perfect venue for national-level seminars, workshops, and cultural fests. The campus is fully wifi enabled and has 18 departments. Some other on-campus facilities include an ATM, a bank, canteens, sports grounds , etc. It also features technical and cultural clubs for students to participate in cultural events. Some of the key campus highlights are tabulated below:

tables.CIT Coimbatore Campus Highlights: Library, Cafeteria, Hostel, Sports Complex, Auditorium, Research centres, Medical services, etc.

sections.heading: CIT Coimbatore Hostel Facilities
text: CIT has hostel facilities for both boys and girls. Each hostel is safe and has basic furniture such as beds, study tables, and cupboards. Both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options in the institute’s mess. With recreational areas like TV rooms, reading halls, and indoor games, students get an enjoyable environment. The hostel is under the surveillance of a 24/7 CCTV camera for the safety and security of the students residing in the CIT Coimbatore hostel. The hostels are located in close proximity to the main teaching sites so that the students can read on time for their classes.

CIT has high-speed internet connectivity and Wi-Fi-enabled hostels and common spaces. The centralised computing centre allows students and staff to seamlessly access servers, networking labs, and cloud applications. The institute also provides facilities like Learning Management Systems (LMS) for digital assignments, online exams, and project submissions. Some of the other hostel facilities are as follows:

sections.heading: CIT Coimbatore Library
text: Located next to the main building, the CIT Coimbatore central library is spread across a vast area of 13881 sq. ft. It acts as a knowledge hub for students and faculty, as it has around 100,000 volumes of journals, books, and research project reports, along with educational CD-ROMs and audio-video cassettes. One of the unique features of the library is its open-access system, which enables students and teachers to access books and other materials without the help of a librarian. Digital access and Wi-Fi connectivity ensure that students and staff have access to learning resources in and off campus. In addition, students can easily access digital platforms such as ScienceDirect, IEEE, and Springer Learning repositories for research and learning.

The timings of the CIT Coimbatore library are 9:00 am to 7:00 pm from Monday to Friday. For Saturday, the library can be accessible from 9:00 am to 3:00 pm , and during vacation, the timing is 9:30 am to 4:30 pm . Some of the major collections of the CIT Coimbatore library are as follows:

sections.heading: CIT Coimbatore Sports Facilities
text: CIT Coimbatore has the infrastructure for both indoor and outdoor spots to promote holistic development in the students. The sports centre has a football field, a hockey turf, an athletics track, a cricket ground, and volleyball courts. The indoor facilities include badminton, table tennis, chess, and carrom. To promote physical well-being, the institute has a gymnasium with modern fitness machines, a yoga room, and wellness activities. The institute also organises sports meets and inter-college tournaments.

sections.heading: Places To Visit In & Around The CIT Coimbatore Campus
text: CIT Coimbatore has a huge campus which can be explored with friends on weekends. Outside the campus, there are plenty of nearby places to explore, such as museums, ancient temples and local parks for recreational activities. Some of the famous museums near the CIT campus include the Gass Forest Museum and the Coimbatore Science Centre . Popular temples, such as Arulmigu Eachanari Vinayagar Temple, Perur Pateeswarar Temple , etc., can also be explored by the students. Some of the famous eateries also include Shree Annapoorna, Junior Kuppanna , etc., which can be explored for local cuisines.

highlights.summary:
College of Engineering Trivandrum (COE Trivandrum) is one of the leading engineering schools on the state as well as national levels. The college, accredited by NBA and AICTE. College of Engineering, Trivandrum (COE) offers 50+ courses at UG and PG levels in the streams of Engineering & Technology, Business & Management Studies and Architecture & Planning. The BTech and the MTech programme offered at the institute are also available in evening batch and lateral entry mode.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good infrastructure, facilities, and faculty members. Good placements as of 2024 and 2025.

detailed_review.Placements: I am from the 2025 batch, Mechanical Engineering. I have completed my first semester here. I have communicated with a lot of seniors. As I have talked to them, from the Mechanical Engineering branch, more than 50 percent of students get placed from every batch. And for other branches like CSE and ECE, there are a good amount of placements too. The highest package is 40 LPA for the college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Good infrastructure, and all the lab facilities are available here. Course-related facilities are well provided. Most of the classrooms have Wi-Fi access. There is a central computation facility where there are a lot of computers, and it is accessible for all the students from 9 am–9:30 pm on all working days. Men’s hostel has good facilities including washing machines. Food is also provided for all the inmates.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are good and experienced. I would not say that about all the faculty members, but most of them are good. Sincerity is seen in most of the faculty members. The curriculum is a bit hard to catch up with but is manageable if you keep in touch with the academic side. There are two series exams, lab exams, and end semester exams. Series exams are a bit tough to make sure we have good knowledge of the subjects.
detailed_review.Other: I chose Mechanical Engineering because I have a good interest in machines and developments. It has a lot of practical work, and all such lab facilities are available here. I would like if the college had more technical facilities. Good events have been conducted at college at the time of fresher’s events. And I am still at my 2nd semester, and more is yet to come.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering
reviews.review_title: Overall, CET is very much value for money with good placements and exposure.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 60–70 percent of students get placed, with the lowest package of 1 LPA and the highest of almost 44 LPA. CET is considered to have good placements. The number of placements offered for CS is the highest, followed by EEE, and then ECE. The average package of CET is around 7-7.5 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure can be considered good, though not the best. Newer buildings are coming up. Wi-Fi is good, and the college has a good library and an indoor stadium. Labs and workshops are a little old, but for the fees, the college is very much worth it. Overall, CET stands neutral in terms of infrastructure and hostel facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members have very good backgrounds. We have teachers from IIT KGP, IIT Delhi, IISc Bangalore, etc., who are well established and provide us with good exposure. However, the university KTU is not very good. Exams are easy. The curriculum is good, and the pass percentage is around 95 percent.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: A strong engineering programme with great campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: Many ECE students get placed in core or IT companies but average placement packages tend to be more modest. Around 5 LPA–6 LPA for those placed through regular placement drives (excluding high offers) in some years. CET offers excellent placement opportunities for ECE students, with a mix of high-paying core roles and strong IT placements. Students who build good technical skills and project experience often secure top offers.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Well-equipped laboratories: For engineering branches including ECE, CET provides departmental labs and technical facilities for practical and research work. These include the Communication Engineering Lab, Digital Electronics / DSP Lab, Microprocessor & Microcontroller Lab, and VLSI & Embedded Systems Lab. These labs have modern equipment like CROs, function generators, FPGA kits, DSP kits, and relevant simulation software.
detailed_review.Faculty: The ECE department at CET has a mix of experienced professors and associate professors covering a broad range of specializations including communications, signal processing, optical communications, VLSI/microelectronics, embedded systems, robotics, and biomedical electronics.
detailed_review.Other: Students participate in events like hackathons, ideathons, and project expos. These clubs help build real-world skills beyond the classroom.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The best college for average students.

detailed_review.Placements: Approximately 80% of the students are placed by this college. The highest package is around 40 LPA, and the lowest package is around 3 LPA. Here, most students are placed in 6 to 10 LPA. The top recruiters are TCS and Texas Instruments. Last year, 14 students were placed in Air India for 10 LPA. Around 90-98% students got internships from Wipro, TCS, IBM, ABB and Accenture. The top roles offered by the course are Software Developer, Data Scientist and Data Analyst.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college offers comparatively good lab facilities and other infrastructure. The college has a very good library, which contains a large no of books that are helpful for academics and industries. The college Men's hostel is well-maintained by the officials and students and offers good food.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are helpful and teach in a good manner. The curriculum is not quite relevant. But it offers industry-ready courses like AI and data Science. The internal exams are quite tough, but the end-of-semester exams are a bit simpler. It is quite easy to pass the sem exam rather than the internal exams.
detailed_review.Other: The students in the college organise so many events to enjoy, and other tech fests for students to build their profile.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is a good college in Kerala with good placements.

detailed_review.Placements: I am currently studying, and approximately 80% of students get placed from this college. The highest package is around 40 LPA, and the lowest package is around 3 LPA. Most students get placed in the 6–10 LPA range. The top recruiters are TCS and Texas Instruments. Last year, 14 students got placed in Air India for 10 LPA. Around 90–98% of students get internships from Wipro, TCS, IBM, ABB, and Accenture. The top roles offered by the course are Software Developer, Data Scientist, and Data Analyst in Computer Science.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities of the college are average. All kinds of labs are available, but they are not well maintained or furnished. The main hostel is excellent. The mess is controlled by students themselves, so the food is excellent. The rooms are well maintained, and the monthly rate is affordable for everyone. A football ground, volleyball court, basketball court, and badminton court are also available. The ambience of the hostel is very nice.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are well-qualified and have good experience. Some of them are graduates from IIT. They are very kind to students. The curriculum is okay, not very nice. The exams are a little difficult. For a semester, there are two series exams and an end-semester exam.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The curriculum is old, but campus life is the best.

detailed_review.Placements: In 2025, already 40 to 50% of 4th-year students get placed with packages of about 10 to 20 LPA. The highest package is around 30+ LPA, and the lowest is 4 to 6 LPA. The average package for Computer Science is nearly 8–9 LPA. The top recruiting companies are TCS and Texas. Each year, 70 to 80% of students get placed in my course from companies like TCS, Wipro, Infosys, Deloitte, Oracle, Amadeus, etc. Around 40% of students get internships in companies like Oracle, IBM, TCS, etc. Top roles include software engineer, app technician, and data analyst.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is free Wi-Fi in every class. All computer labs are fully air-conditioned and work from 9 am to 9 pm. There is a library in each department and also a technical library for the entire college. The hostel is above average. There are workers to clean washrooms, and free Wi-Fi is available. The mess and canteen are very good, providing the best food at low cost. There are football, volleyball, and various other grounds. Medical services are near the college and easily accessible.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are good and qualified. They clear all our doubts. They teach using boards, PPTs, or projectors. Seminar hall classes are also conducted sometimes. The course curriculum is a bit old, but I personally don't appreciate it. KTU curriculum is the best. Semester exams are easier, but internal exams are of good quality and standard.
detailed_review.Other: I like programming and coding, so I chose this course. I wish the curriculum were more updated and efficient. Events, fests, and other extracurricular activities are good and enjoyable.

reviews.course: M.Tech. in Geotechnical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Almost every day, clubs and groups conduct programs for a best college life.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement at my college is above average. Many students are getting placed in different companies all over India and abroad. In the Civil branch, a lot of students are placed in this academic year. My stream comes under the Civil Engineering branch. The top recruiting companies are WSP, L&T, TCS, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The overall infrastructure of the college is good. Almost all facilities are available, including Wi-Fi, well-equipped labs, well-ventilated classrooms with projectors, and a central library under KTU inside the college. The quality of food is good. The college also supports extracurricular activities like sports, games, dance, music, and more.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful and well qualified. In my stream, most teachers have a Ph.D. Teachers are very supportive and clear our doubts. Exams are conducted under KTU. The pass percentage is above 90. Semester exams are sometimes difficult and sometimes of medium level, depending on the questions from the university.
detailed_review.Other: This college is one of the top engineering colleges in Kerala. College events and fests are well organized. Students get the best college life from this college.

faqs.question: Can I get into College of Engineering, Trivandrum without giving CAT?
faqs.answer: CAT is not a mandatory requirement for admission to College of Engineering, Trivandrum. CAT scores are required only for admission to the MBA program offered by the college. Candidates must take one of the CMAT, CAT, or KMAT tests in order to be considered for enrollment in the M.B.A. programme offered by the CET. Based on their exam results, they will be shortlisted and contacted for the group discussion and personal interview rounds.

faqs.question: Can I get into College of Engineering Trivandrum with 70% in CMAT?
faqs.answer: It might not be easy to get into the College of Engineering Trivandrum (CET) with a 70% Common Management Aptitude Test (CMAT) score because CET mainly offers undergraduate engineering and technology degrees. The CMAT is a nationally recognised admission test for management schools. Although it could indicate your ability for management studies, it has no bearing on your eligibility for CET's engineering programs. With a CMAT score of 70%, there isn't a direct admissions route into CET's engineering programs; nevertheless, you might want to look into other choices, such management programs at CET or other universities, or getting a management degree and applying to engineering programs later. It is imperative to acknowledge that the material supplied is broad in nature. For the most precise and current information, one should refer to the official rules and regulations of CET and other pertinent institutions.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for MBA at College of Engineering Trivandrum?
faqs.answer: College of Engineering Trivandrum offers MBA and have good reputation for students graduating in Business. It has very good business environment for startups. highlights.summary:
MIT World Peace University Pune is also known as MIT WPU, Pune. It is a private university and is located in Pune, Maharashtra. It is one of the top Engineering and Management colleges in Pune which was established in 2017. The university has been accredited by the NBA and offers AICTE-approved courses to students.
MIT WPU offers UG, PG, diploma, certificate in Management, Engineering, Design, and other streams. Some of the most popular programmes offered at MIT Pune are BTech and MBA. These courses are offered across several specialisations such as Computer Science Engineering, Bio Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, etc. It has 150+ programmes in Management, Engineering, Design, and more. MIT Kothrud Pune consistently ranks among the country's top universities and is a part of MAEER’s MIT Group of Institutions. The MIT University of Pune curriculum is industry-ready. It includes activities, projects, events, and assessments, apart from academia. Maharashtra Institute of Technology has been ranked 70 under the 'Pharmacy' category by the NIRF 2025.
The University has a vibrant, academically driven environment. It organises events to enhance cultural and social presence. MIT Pune Maharashtra faculty also conducts seminars, workshops, field work, projects, training sessions, etc. The MIT Pune campus is technologically advanced with gym, bank, cafeterias, hospital/medical facilities, smart classrooms, and many more.
As per the latest MIT-WPU, Pune placement stats, the students of BTech, MCA and B.Des courses received placement offers from various recruiters. The highest package offered during MIT-WPU, Pune placement 2024 stood at INR 51.36 LPA. The major highlights of MIT-WPU, Pune are tabulated below:

reviews.course: BBA(Hons.) in Global Marketing and Event Management
reviews.review_title: Great College, possibly have a lot of money, but it has a very strict attendant policy.

detailed_review.Placements: As per what I have listened, around 40 percent of students got placements. The highest package is around 11 LPA. Companies from all over the world. Only 30 percent of the people got internships; the other 60 percent are doing their own business. Senior event manager to handle the companies’ events.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the syllabus and the course is very interesting, and we get to go to the rural areas for some days and a national study trip. I can’t tell you much about the hostel as I am not in MIT hostel, but as per what I have listened, the rooms are really good. Hostel food and its quality is not very promising. They have lots and lots of sports activities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are really qualified and helpful. They will guide you very well in one-on-one sessions. They will share their knowledge and their contacts with you. The course is very good. Till now, we have got lots and lots of opportunities for internships, event management opportunities, and information. All of the semester exams are really workable if you attend classes regularly. They explain the topic by video, PPT, and sometimes even by discussing and taking case studies.
detailed_review.Other: I have chosen this course as it contains a dual course, global marketing and event management. I am very interested in doing events. I wish that MIT itself conducts big events and gives us the opportunity.

reviews.course: BBA(Hons.) in International Business
reviews.review_title: It's a good college for anyone genuinely interested.

detailed_review.Placements: In my batch, around 55-60 percent of students are placed. The highest package offered is around 12 LPA-15 LPA. Common roles offered are business executive, relationship manager, and operations executive. Overall, opportunities exist, but the outcome depends heavily on internships and how we carry ourselves.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus is neat and clean. There are clear rules mentioned, and actions are also taken against violators. I can't say anything about the food as I haven't tried it, but the vibe of the campus is top class, especially when it rains. The crowd is amazing too, and we will feel like coming to college every day.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very qualified (almost everyone holds a Ph.D, and those who are genuinely looking for quality education can take admission. The problem I notice is in the management of the whole semester. Communication is not transparent, and if anyone has a problem, he/she will be passed around from one building to another, and the problem will rarely be solved.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good college with balanced academics and campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: In my course, around 75 percent of students got placed, and the rest opted for higher studies outside India. The highest package offered is around 30 LPA, and the average is around 7 LPA. Top recruiters include Infosys, Microsoft, HCL, and Tech Mahindra. Top 5 percent of students got internships with a stipend, and in very good companies, the rest had to struggle for it.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is modern. Our department has well-equipped labs with Macs and high-speed Wi-Fi. Hostel facilities are decent, the mess food is manageable, not amazing, but edible. One girls' hostel is on the campus itself, but the only boys' hostel is around 8-9km away from the campus; however, the college provides bus facilities. Sports grounds, indoor games, and medical facilities are available in the new sports complex.
detailed_review.Faculty:
The faculty in my course are generally well-qualified. Most teachers are supportive when it comes to clearing doubts. Semester exams are very easy to clear if you study for at least 30 min or 1 hour a day. The curriculum is updated as per industry requirements, with workshops every month.
.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because the best part of the course is the hands-on lab sessions and opportunities to participate in various tech hackathons. The thing I wish could improve is the placements. I hope the big MNCs recruit more students. Also talking about the college life, a very active campus and Events literally every week, and also many student clubs which you can join and learn new things and connect with like-minded people.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security and Forensics)
reviews.review_title: Strong cybersecurity programme with supportive faculty.

detailed_review.Placements: For the placement drive 2024, the CSE cybersecurity and forensics branch has around 120-130 students, out of which around 80 got placed, and the highest salary offered was 19 LPA, and the average package was around 7-8 LPA. Major companies included IBM, TCS, Accenture and HCL. Top roles mainly consisted of a Security analyst.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The entire academic building and labs are covered with campus-wide Wi-Fi. In speak hours, it may slow a bit, but overall connectivity is reliable. Most CSE classes are conducted in newer academic blocks, so classrooms feel modern. The biggest library you'll find in Pune has various books from different streams available. Hostel rooms are not luxurious, but comfortable and functional. Mess Food is average to good, completely veg. MIT has 2 different canteens, one of the premium ones called Encave and the other, a budget-friendly one called Shreeraj.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers in the department are generally helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. Most hold M.Teach/PhD degrees. The curriculum is industry-relevant. It includes cybersecurity tools, digital forensics, networking, cloud, AI basics, and hands-on labs. Semester exams moderate not very difficult if you attend classes and study regularly. Questions are usually from the taught syllabus. Around 80-90% clear the exams.
detailed_review.Other: I chose cybersecurity because I personally want to pursue a career in it, coz it is one of the fastest-growing industries. Better placement focus for cybersecurity-specific roles can be the only improvement. The campus has active events and fests, a friendly crowd, and a vibrant campus life with many clubs and activities. The surroundings are safe, well-connected, and student-friendly.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is one of the best college.

detailed_review.Placements: This is my first year in college and I am not more aware of the placement. While taking admission in college my staff member told me the lowest is 3 LPA and the highest is 1.5Cr. I do not know exactly they told me this only. There are many cloud of internships in this college but they charge. Till now I have not done any internship but I saw many companies coming to college for internship programme like Tata etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It has excellent infrastructure and it has availability of Wi-Fi labs classrooms and library. Library is to good for this college. I did not see any college that has this kind of library.  Hostel canteen food is not that good. Sports and game facilities are good. It has a dark side also some students are addicted to drugs and do wrong things. 1 or 2 months ago there a child ordered something from Blinkit and some things happened that the Blinkit boy beat our campus student he was full of blood.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful well qualified and knowledgeable.  I am not ready for the industry because I am in my first year. My semester exam did not happen that is why I do not know about the examination. Some class tests and internal tests happened. They are easy and some are also hard.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I was interested in the IT field and by Gods grace I got 96 percent in MHT CET.

reviews.course: Integrated M.Sc. in Biotechnology
reviews.review_title: The college has good infrastructure and plenty of clubs.

detailed_review.Placements: Seniors mentioned that most students from both technical and non-technical branches get placed successfully if they are consistent and make proper use of the training provided. College also organises workshops, mock interviews, and aptitude tests to help students improve their communication and problem-solving skills, which play a key role during recruitment.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is the best thing at MIT-WPU. Also, our (biotech students) building of work (maitre, Kashyap) has proper classrooms and labs. I don't know about the hostel as I don't live in a hostel, but some of my friends do. They have said food quality is not so good, also they have other facilities like washing machines and all provided, but still they don't like it much.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, but in our department, there is a lot of communication between the faculty. They literally tell us today's to-do list before 1 hour before the college starts. Also, most of the lectures get cancelled, even exams get cancelled, and they don't even let us know unless we contact them.
detailed_review.Other: There are a lot of clubs where you can participate in, other than academics. It's really value for money as we can do so many things.

reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Applied Statistics and Data Analytics
reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with the college and faculty.

detailed_review.Placements: This year would be the first passing out batch for this course, and most of them have started getting placement with great packages. Top companies do come for placement drives. Most of them get placed as a Data analyst and risk analyst. As far as I know, the highest package has been 15 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college has great on-campus hostels with Wi-Fi and all amenities. The library is just mesmerising, its ambience is on another level. Classrooms have a great ambience, as in our department. Mess food is average, but the sports facilities are just amazing. Overall, it's excellent.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very qualified and well-experienced and teach us through their experiences and life perspectives. If you attend classes every day, then it would be quite easy in exams to score good marks, otherwise, it's somewhat difficult. The course is meant to make you industry-ready.
detailed_review.Other: MIT is famous for its events and campus life. It'll provide you with one of the best college experiences.

reviews.course: MBA in Human Resource Management
reviews.review_title: My review of this college.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement cell and its members were pretty active and had good contacts with employers throughout the country. It was a very good campus placement experience. Aircel, Airtel, Sai Infosystems, and many more companies came for campus placements, and 80% placement was done in our batch. The best part about the college was that most of the students got placed at least 6 months before the course completion. The average package was at a whopping 7.5LPA, with the minimum threshold of 6.5LPA. The highest package offering was 23LPA. College provides 100% internship opportunity to all the students, its compulsory.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The course curriculum was different from the rest of the colleges. There was a brew of finance, operations, marketing, and HR for the elective options. They imparted both theoretical and practical knowledge. It was a very flexible system that favors students for their betterment. The hostel was completely air conditioned and was equipped with free Wi-Fi. There was ample space provided for the balcony and terrace. The rooms were dual sharing with separate washroom facilities for each room. The mess was purely vegetarian, which offered 3 meals a day, and the quality of food offered was satisfactory.
detailed_review.Faculty: All the Faculty members were highly qualified and had good teaching as well as industrial experience. Faculty were mostly Ph.D. holders, thereby very experienced in teaching. They are very friendly and approachable. They create a sense of community and belonging in the classroom, provide warmth, accessibility, and enthusiasm with care. Exams were not hectic. In every semester, there were 6 subjects, each subject was holding 100 marks. 70 Marks from the external Pune University exam and 30 from the internal exam conducted by MIT. Internal exams were very frequent, and assignments & presentations were part of it.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering (Robotics and Automation)
reviews.review_title: The college has good and friendly faculty with a fresh environment and campus.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80-85% students are in robotics and automation. The highest package is about 35 LPA, and the lowest package is about 3.5 LPA. Top recruiters, including TCS, Infosys, and Amazon, often join MIT WPU for student internships. Around 70% students got an internship. The main roles are offered in robotics and automation, including software development, designing, data analytics, and Q&A.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our campus has good facilities of Wi-Fi, smart Google classrooms, and well-stocked libraries. Hostel facilities are designed with hygienic food. Even with the good medical facilities and well-trained doctors. The college also supports sports and various national and international competitions.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. Mostly explain the concept clearly. The curriculum is relevant and oriented with industry experts. This mostly helps with placement and internships. The past percentage was around 85 to 90%. I will definitely recommend you to take admission.
detailed_review.Other: I chose the course robotics and automation. This course aligns with my interests and career goals, offering me a solid foundation in the subject matter. The best things about this course are that it has provided me with enriching learning experiences and practical skills.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Data Science)
reviews.review_title: Absolutely dissatisfied with the faculty.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement is decent. The college, like many others, assures us of 100% placement if CGPA is above 8.5, but of course, it's not true. The highest package was like 12 LPA or so, and students stood placed at a mean salary of like 3 to 4 LPA. It's definitely not worth it considering the 3.7 LPA for the course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have a specially designed Vyasa building for CSE branch students. It's definitely amazing, the labs are brand new, and each system actually works. The only thing is that the network connectivity is terrible. The mess is good, but the En Encave Cafe is below average.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers, damn man, in IIM workshops we used to have a sir, he didn't give a damn about our students' injuries, whether they were doing stuff correctly, he just scolded students at the end of the session and said they are incompetent. How will students do if u didn't teach properly? LADC and PP faculty are the only reason for going to college. It actually feels like college. EC ma'am is another sleep chem ma'am acting like a school teacher. Sir is a typical Physics sir teaching through PPT, completing the syllabus in like 2 months or so.
detailed_review.Other: The faculty could have been a lot better. Hostels are damn far from college and are even in areas where there are no metro stations. It takes Rs. 190 from the hostel to college.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placements with top-notch infrastructure, but the fees are a little bit on the higher side.

detailed_review.Placements: Majority of students got placed who maintained a good CGPA above six and completed internship as it also carries credit for the course. The highest package offered is 50 LPA, and it is a domestic package. The average is around 10 LPA, which students got in reality.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Cannot comment on hostel as I am a day scholar. Infrastructure available is of top-notch quality. Many canteens are available on the campus. Library has some limited books and is not up to date.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers here are helpful, supportive, and knowledgeable and can be trusted blindly, but the curriculum is not up to date, it lags 20 years behind. Semester exams are tough and cannot be taken for granted. Many students got backlogs in their exams, and those who got 5 backlogs need to repeat a year.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this college because it is the best in Pune and also helps students get placed.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: MIT WPU  This is the reality.

detailed_review.Placements: I am currently studying in the course of B.Tech CSE AIDS, and it is one of highest placing courses. It has the required skill set that companies these days look for the most. You can get offered as an AI expert, developer, or data analyst. Around 40% of the students get placed through campus placements. The average package is between 7 LPA  to 10 LPA, and the highest has gone upto 50 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are well-developed and invested labs for different subjects. Campus has Wi-Fi. Library is also very useful and very accessible. Campus has a medical room for emergencies, and the hostels are decent. Hostels are okay, but they are extremely far away from the college. Although the college offers transport, it gets tiring to travel that much every single day.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are well qualified and they teach well. The course is also well updated and nicely designed to cover all the concepts that companies need. The exams are mildly difficult but around 80% of the students pass. Sometimes the faculty is a little biased towards certain students but that is usually not the case.
detailed_review.Other: College organises a lot of events. There are student bodies in which you can take part and organise those events yourself.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of MIT-WPU.

detailed_review.Placements: 70% students were placed, and the average for CSE was 10 LPA. Many were unable to get placed. They were given internships by the college, and then they got placed at lower salaries. Still, the placement rate is so high, it's worth it. Many got placed in cities like Bangalore with a 15 LPA package.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: For CSE, we have a new building, and it has top-notch infrastructure. 4 labs on each floor, and each lab has 70 iMac setups. Canteens are really good, and the on-campus café too. We also have a sports complex where the ground floor has a huge swimming pool, which is very clean, and above that is the indoor games floor, like table tennis, and on top, we have a badminton hall.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are generally good. We have guest lecturers also, and the curriculum is the reason for choosing it among other Pune colleges. It has a unique curriculum designed to make anyone industry-ready. College exams are not that tough, but every lab session and every small tutorial is of good quality and helps someone learn a lot. It's not just for submission's sake.
detailed_review.Other: I wish there had been AC in the library, lol. Other than that, the college is really good, lol. The fests are really awesome, and many teaching and non-teaching events keep happening from time to time. The college's reputation wasn't good a few years ago, but now the college has undergone many substantial changes.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: MIT WPU CSE  Industry oriented curriculum with lively campus culture.

detailed_review.Placements: MIT WPU CSE 2028 has 80 to 85% placements. The highest package offered is 45LPA, the lowest package offered is 4LPA, and the average package offered is 8LPA. Top recruiters are Microsoft, Google, TCS, Infosys, Accenture, Capgemini, and IBM. 70% of students got internships, with a stipend up to 6LPA. Roles offered are SDE, Analyst, and Consultant.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: College offers smart classrooms, MAC labs, library, and research space. Hostels are not that good but have clean rooms, study areas, and Wi-Fi. Mess food is the worst. Sports and recreation are average, with a decent basketball court, table tennis, and a gym. Overall, the infrastructure supports both academics and student life effectively.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members for CSE are qualified, not quite approachable, and supportive, with many holding industry/research experience. Teaching quality is average, blending theory with practical applications. The curriculum is updated regularly with AI, data science, plus internships and projects that build a career. Semester exams are moderate in difficulty, and conceptual understanding is tested more than written learning. Consistent preparation, they are manageable. The pass percentage is generally high, around 80%, as the evaluation is fair and students get ample support.
detailed_review.Other: I chose CSE at MIT WPU because of my interest in technology, and the wide career scope. The best part is the industry oriented curriculum. It could improve with more advanced research exposure and better mess facilities. The campus has a lively vibe with events, cultural fests, hackathons, and active clubs.

reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA)
reviews.review_title: Most of the students are getting job offers.

detailed_review.Placements: Our college provides an organized placement opportunity for students. Around 85% to 90% of students are placed in many companies every year. The highest package offer was 42.5 LPA, and the average package goes to 7 LPA. Top recruiters of our college are TCS, Capgemini, and Accenture. These companies frequently hire students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college infrastructure is top-notch. The whole campus is Wi-Fi enabled, labs are properly equipped, and a central library is located with a variety of books. The hostel is great. Hostel rooms are properly cleaned, and all types of facilities are available here.
detailed_review.Faculty: All faculty members are well-experienced and qualified in their respective fields. Their teaching methods are great, and the concepts are easily understood thanks to their teaching skills. They make students industry-ready. Students are confident during interviews as they are prepared by college teachers. Semester exams range from moderate to difficult, but students pass easily.

reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA)

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering (Robotics and Automation)

There's a 100% placement for all the courses provided by MITWPU, thanks to over 600+ companies visiting each year for campus placements. Top recruiting companies are Amazon, Flipkart, Capgemini, DRDO, etc. The roles start from data analyst to designer, FEA analyst, and much more. faqs.question: Are CAT cut offs announced along with the CAT result?
faqs.answer: CAT cutoffs are usually not announced with the CAT result. The CAT cutoffs are also not released to the public. They are published after a few days of the result announcement when the IIMs and other colleges start their shortlisting process. The IIMs opens their shortlisting window based on the CAT cut-offs two to three days after the result announcement. The CAT percentile of candidates shortlisted for the Written Ability Test (WAT), Group Discussion (GD), and Personal Interview (PI) can be considered the cut-off for that IIM. For example, if a candidate with a CAT percentile of 99 belonging to the General category is selected for the WAT/GD-PI of IIM Calcutta, then the CAT cut-off for IIM Calcutta is 99 percentile. Only those candidates who make it to the WAT/GD-PI round of IIMs will get to know the cut-offs.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: MIT WPU offers state-of-the-art infrastructure to its students. It has modern amenities to cater to the needs of students' academic and reserach need. MIT has a well-equipped lab, multiple cafeterias, vending machines across the campus. Some other facilities are as follows:
Labs- MIT-WPU has a well equipped lab.
Cafeterias- There are multiple cafeterias and vending machines across the campus.
Hospital / Medical Facilities- The campus has a full-time doctor, 24/7 pharmacy, a multiple bed medical facility, and ambulances for emergencies.
Auditorium- MIT-WPU auditoriums equipped with audio-visual and multimedia facilities.
Hostel- MIT-WPU provides students with modern and comfortable hostel facilities.
Sports- The university provides amenities such as Badminton Courts, Basketball Courts, Cricket and Football Grounds, and Volleyball Courts.
Gym- MIT World Peace University gym is a modern fitness facility equipped with contemporary exercise equipment.
Bank- The Bank of India branch at MIT - WPU provides essential banking services on campus, tailored to the needs of students and faculty including an ATM.
For more information about MIT-WPU (MIT World Peace University) check out the below video:

facilities.name: Cafeteria
facilities.description: MIT-WPU has thoughtfully placed multiple cafeterias and vending machines across its sprawling 65-acre campus. With a wide array of menus available, these facilities ensure that students can enjoy a variety of delicious and nutritious meals. This intentional placement not only fosters a sense of community but also offers convenience, allowing students the flexibility to dine at different locations throughout the campus.

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description:
MIT-WPU provides students with modern and comfortable hostel facilities, catering to diverse needs and interests. Equipped with amenities such as dance studios, gyms, basketball courts, and inviting common areas, the hostels offer a vibrant and engaging living environment. Students have the flexibility to choose between twin-sharing and triple-sharing rooms, each furnished with unlimited high-speed Wi-Fi and regular housekeeping services. 

The safety of students is a top priority, with full-time wardens, CCTV monitoring, and biometric-enabled entrances ensuring a secure living space. MIT-WPU's commitment to providing well-equipped and secure hostels reflects its dedication to creating a conducive and enriching residential experience for its students.

facilities.name: Sports Complex
facilities.description: MIT World Peace University stands as a hub for sports enthusiasts, offering outstanding indoor and outdoor facilities. Committed to fostering physical and mental well-being, the university provides amenities such as Badminton Courts, Basketball Courts, Cricket and Football Grounds, and Volleyball Courts. The university's students have excelled at various levels, securing victories in Inter-Collegiate, University, State, and National competitions. The University actively organizes diverse sports tournaments, fostering a dynamic sports culture on campus.

facilities.name: Gym
facilities.description: MIT World Peace University's gym is a modern fitness facility equipped with contemporary exercise equipment, providing students with a versatile space for various workouts and fitness goals.The gym provides a space for individuals to engage in physical activity and work towards their fitness goals.

facilities.name: Labs
facilities.description: MIT-WPU ensures a hands-on learning approach by providing specialised labs for each programme. From the Computer Lab for programming to the Robotics Lab for automation and the Fluid Mechanics Lab for fluid dynamics, every specialisation has a dedicated space. This commitment to practical experience equips students with real-world skills, enhancing their readiness for successful careers in their chosen engineering fields.

data.description: MIT World Peace University has experienced and skilled faculty members. MIT WPU faculty are PhD, degree, and diploma holders and have years of experience in relevant fields. The university invites guest faculty for lectures and also conducts faculty and student exchange programmes. Tabulated below are some of the faculty members at MIT WPU:

highlights.summary:
SRM Easwari Engineering College (also known as Easwari Engineering College) is a private college with 6 sister institutes. Established in the academic year 1996, SRMEEC was approved by the Government of Tamil Nadu and AICTE, New Delhi. SRM EEC is ISO certified and accredited by NBA, NIRF, ARIIA, and NAAC. As per the Govt regulations for affiliations, earlier the SRM Easwari Engineering college was affiliated with the University of Madras, and presently, it is affiliated with Anna University, Chennai. SRMEEC Chennai offers various scholarships on the basis of merit, need and various other eligibility criteria.
SRMEEC has a legacy of 27+ years, marking a placement record of 98%. The college has 3K+ research publications and offers more than 15+ UG and 7+ PG programs in various disciplines such as Engineering, Management, and many more. SRMEEC Chennai has obtained ISO 9001:2008 Certification from TUV, South Asia. It has more than 17 institutions across the country. Some of the Easwari Engineering College top recruiters are Virtusa, Just Pay, Amazon, Johnson Controls, India Mart, City Union Bank, etc.

SRM Easwari Engineering College offers a wide range of programmes at the UG and PG levels. The flagship programmes offered by the SRMEEC Chennai are mainly BTech and MTech. Each course has different eligibility criteria. SRM EEC admissions for various courses are merit-based and entrance-based.
The college offers respective courses for durations varying from 2 years to 4 years with a total tuition fee ranging from INR 70K to INR 2 Lakh. Admission to the respective courses is offered on the basis of Class 12 qualification with 45% aggregate for UG-level courses. For PG-level courses, candidates must secure a minimum aggregate of 50% in graduation. The curriculum of BTech and MTech is designed by the expert faculty as per the affiliating body standards.

reviews.course: M.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: The college is feature technology enabled learning environment.

detailed_review.Placements: I belong to the 2025 to 2026 M.E Computer Science engineering branch. 80 percent of the students are placed with a package of 4 LPA to 6 LPA. The top recruits are TCS, Accenture, HCL, and Capgemini. Nearly 60 percent  of the students secured internships in various companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our course is good and well maintained. The department has classrooms with projectors, well equipped computer laboratories, and campus wide Wi-Fi connectivity. The central library has a wide collection of textbook reference books.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members for our course are well qualified, knowledgeable and supportive. Most teachers explain concepts clearly and are approachable for doubt clearing which helps in understanding both theoretical and practical subjects. The teaching quality is good.

reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: A useful and critical review of Easwari Engineering College by assessing all the major factors.

detailed_review.Placements: I am currently studying in the 2nd year (4th semester). As far as I know, my college gives placements from moderate to high packages to students. According to recent data, the highest package of the 2024-25 batch is 40 LPA, and an astonishing average package of 8 LPA for students. Major recruiters are Amazon, Virtusa, Microsoft, Zoho, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is pretty decent in our college. I am from the CSE department, so I can see that all the systems in the labs are clearly working, and I have not heard any complaints from other students regarding infrastructure. As a day scholar, I do not have personal experience with a hostel environment, but my friends from the hostel are satisfied with the hostel provisions and safety.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are quite friendly and knowledgeable, which drives us to reach out to them in case of doubts or clarifications. Curriculum is well structured with newer implementations like Joint courses and Research courses instead of traditional Theory and practical courses alone.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I believe my interests are aligned with the developing digital technologies, and also a major reason for choosing this college is the fact that it is closer to home and in the center of the city.

reviews.course: B.E. in Biomedical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Average infrastructure and facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: 70% of students are placed in Zoho, Infosys, Zifo, and TCS. The highest package is 22 LPA, average is 5.6 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA. Siemens and GE Healthcare are top recruiting companies. 70%-80% of students are placed in hospitals across India and Tamil Nadu and companies like Phoenix Medical System and ICAR-CIRCOT Mumbai as sales and service engineers.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms with projector and sometimes fans, light, and windows will be broken labs-microcontroller, instrumentation. Quality of food and hostel is average. In sports, you will be given chances to participate in other college sports events if you are a sports person.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teaching quality is average, and some of them won't be teaching properly. You will have to study on your own. Course curriculum is average, and somewhat makes students industry-ready. Difficulty of semester exam depends on the subject, and pass percentage is 80%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course as it is related to biology. Best thing is that it helps the doctor. I wish the infrastructure, facilities, and placement offers related to core companies were improved.

reviews.course: B.E. in Civil Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is the best college to study in the city.

detailed_review.Placements: Most students get placed in our college, especially from my department. My seniors recently got placed with good packages ranging from 8-10 LPA. The top role offered in our department is a civil engineer. Many students secure internships in their third year, especially those with a CGPA of 8 and above.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college offers many facilities. It includes Wi-Fi. Water is available on every floor of the campus. Classrooms are clean and well-maintained. The hostel is also well-maintained and cleaned daily for cleanliness. The quality of food in the hostel is good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers who teach us are very helpful and make it easy to understand concepts clearly. Courses they teach are always related to the curriculum. It makes students ready for the industry, allowing them to gain experience.
detailed_review.Other: I chose the civil engineering course because I wanted to become a civil engineer. I had a good experience in this college for studies, and it is also good for placements. The college also conducts many events.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Biotechnology
reviews.review_title: The campus facilities meet the necessary academic needs.

detailed_review.Placements: Since our batch is the first from this department, placement outcomes are not yet available. Even though students are encouraged to focus on skill development and internships alongside academics. However, the college is actively developing its placement cell and connections.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The department is equipped with basic academic infrastructure. Laboratories are available and are gradually being upgraded as the department is relatively new. The quality of the food in the canteen is good and the hygiene is good. The institution encourages students to take part in extracurricular and curricular activities too.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members are knowledgeable, approachable, and supportive, too. The curriculum is structured well and covers all the fundamentals and necessary concepts required for the course. The exams are actually conducted as per the college norms, it is neither very easy nor extremely difficult.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I was interested and its scope for future opportunities. As the department is in its early stages, it should improve laboratory facilities and core placement-related training. This college organizes one of the best and finest campus fests and events.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology
reviews.review_title: One of the good colleges in Chennai with decent placements.

detailed_review.Placements: 75% of students are placed in our batch, and placements are still coming to campus. The highest package is 25 LPA, get by a single student. Most packages range from 3 LPA to 8 LPA. There are some 2–4 companies that hire only one candidate with a high salary.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Good facilities are available. We have multiple computer labs, one robotics lab, and many other lab facilities in Easwari Engineering College. Hostels are provided with both A/C and non-A/C options. The canteen has two floors, and we also have two grounds for outdoor games.
detailed_review.Faculty: The semester exams are a bit difficult. Some parts of the course curriculum are relevant to students, but some courses are just not up to that level. Teachers are well-qualified and helpful. The teaching quality is good and comparatively okay.
detailed_review.Other: More events take place.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Biotechnology
reviews.review_title: Good infrastructure and growing opportunities. Supportive faculty and positive campus experience.

detailed_review.Placements: As we are the first batch, we are not well aware of the placements in our department, but in reviewing the overall college-wide placements, the other departments have 75-80 percent of the students placed in the top-most companies. The placement opportunities for our course are still developing, but the faculty support, exposure, and training are excellent. We're confident that in the coming years, Biotechnology will also achieve strong placement results similar to other departments in the college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for the Biotechnology department is well-developed and constantly improving. The department has well-developed and well-equipped laboratories for microbiology, cell biology, etc. Classrooms are spacious and have well-facilitated Wi-Fi all over the campus. The hostel's facilities are quite good and comfortable. Rooms are clean and maintained regularly, and basics like Wi-Fi, laundry, and study areas are available. The mess food is decent, with both veg and non-vegetarian options, and the canteen serves hygienic snacks at affordable prices.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members are very supportive, knowledgeable, and approachable. All the faculty members are well-qualified with postgraduate or doctoral degrees in biotechnology and related fields. To explain the concepts clearly, give personal attention to students, and also guide them in projects, research works, and internships. The curriculum is well-structured and updated, covering both core and advanced topics. The semester exams are moderate in difficulty, students who attend the classes regularly and study consistently can easily clear them. The pass percentage is above 5CGPA.
detailed_review.Other: There are many extracurricular classes present in our college. As I am in the first batch of biotechnology, my experience so far has been very positive. I chose this course because I've always been interested in life sciences and research. The campus crowd is friendly and diverse, and there's a good mix of academics and extracurricular activities. Overall, the experience in this college is motivating and enjoyable.

reviews.course: M.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Beyond the books- my honest take on SRM Easwari's placement and vibe.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement is based on the performance of the most recent passing out batch. As my batch, ME CSE 2027, is still in its initial years. The placement scenario at Easwari is pretty solid, which is a major relief. The placement rate is consistently high, usually over 90 percent for those eligible. The last batch sees some impressive offers. The highest package is up to 20 LPA. The median package is 4.5 LPA for the 4-year programs. For our course, the average is usually between 5 LPA and 7 LPA. We get visits from big names like TCS, Wipro, Infosys, and Amazon.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus infrastructure is fantastic. A major plus is that our department labs are a true highlight. They are equipped with modern tools and tech that support genuine hands-on learning. Classrooms are spacious. The campus is fully connected with Wi-Fi, which is essential for projects. For those in the hostel, the experience is highly comfortable. Rooms are clean and well-maintained. The mess is hygienic. They offer a decent food variety. We have good sports facilities. The whole campus is supportive and well-rounded.
detailed_review.Faculty: The academic core of Easwari is incredibly strong, starting with the faculty. Most teachers are highly qualified and very helpful. They genuinely go the extra mile to clear the doubts and provide quality guidance, which makes a huge difference. The curriculum is relevant to the industry, aligned, with a focus on practical projects and the latest technologies. This truly makes us feel industry-ready. Exams are fair, while the CATs can be challenging, they provide excellent preparation for the semester exams, which are manageable if you study diligently. The pass percentage is generally high because of the supportive teaching environment.
detailed_review.Other: The crowd here is ambitious and vibrant. Since it's located right in the city. The campus is bustling. The overall environment is very supportive and professional. There is a great balance between academics and fun. Thanks to the numerous clubs and events happening throughout the year. We have major cultural festivals like Swagat and technical symposiums like Kratos that keep the energy high. The location also ensures great connectivity and access to the city.

detailed_review.Infrastructure: One good thing is the library. The mess food is just okay. Not so good for real. Hostel facilities are better, and the classrooms are well-maintained. The main areas such as the library, MBA seminar hall, etc. We have Wi-Fi facilities. They have well-ventilation.
detailed_review.Faculty: All faculty members are good and kind. They help with all the curricular and extracurricular activities. They are really motivated and help with all other activities. The course curriculum is pretty much relevant to the department. It makes the students get more interested in the industry.
detailed_review.Other: All is good here. The best engineering course one can choose after a biology background. They have a vast scope in both higher and placement options.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology
reviews.review_title: Review regarding the college experience.

detailed_review.Placements: Better and good training is provided for every semester. It focuses on placements for a minimum of a week to 14 days. The package offered ranges from 3-40 LPA. Top recruiting companies for our course are Amazon, Autodesk, and Microsoft. The role offered is a full-stack developer. Students also get placed in Tier 3 companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It has a better infrastructure and moderate hostel facilities. Wi-Fi is provided only for education, placements, and training. Food is better and worth the money. Medical facilities are provided in the nearby SRM Prime Hospital and SRM pharmacy, which are near the college.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our college has an easy-going and well-framed syllabus. Students are free to explore, build projects, and learn with curiosity. Staff members are easygoing, friendly, and supportive. Semester exams are moderate, and mostly, all students who attempt with preparation pass exams with a good score.
detailed_review.Other: The campus is crowded with students. A lot of tech and non-tech events are organized every week.

faqs.question: Can I join SRM Easwari Engineering College directly?
faqs.answer: No, you cannot join SRM Easwari Engineering College directly. Admission to SRM University is possible either through clearing the SRMJEEE entrance exam or direct admission through management quota. However, to encourage and support students of exemplary talent, SRM Institute of Science and Technology offers direct admission to top 10,000 rankers in IIT JEE, top rankers in each district of Tamil Nadu, and exemplary sports persons at the national level

faqs.question: Which entrance exam is accepted by SRM Easwari Engineering College?
faqs.answer: All the courses at Easwari Engineering College are offered in affiliation with Anna University. For admission to PG courses such as MBA and MTech, candidates are required to appear for the state-level TANCET entrance exam. This exam is conducted by Anna University and is valid for admission to all of its affiliated colleges across the Tamil Nadu state in PG courses. Further, for admission to MTech, the national-level GATE entrance exam is also accepted. Candidates are required to apply online on the official website of the respective entrance exams to appear for them.

faqs.question: How do I get a seat at SRM Easwari Engineering College?
faqs.answer: SRM Easwari Engineering College provides various programmes and specialisations to students. These courses are available in different streams. For obtaining SRMEEC Chennai admission, candidates are selected on the basis of entrance tests. For further details, candidates may visit the official website and learn more regarding the eligibility details for their preferred course choice. Accepted exams include TANCET, GATE, CEETA, etc.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for BTech in Computer Science and Engineering at SRM Easwari Engineering College?
faqs.answer: SRM Easwari Engineering College offers B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering as a 4 year course in UG-level with an annual intake of 420 students. The college offers admission to BTech specialisations on the basis of TANCET qualification with valid scores. In addition to this, candidates must appear for TNEA counselling. Candidates must secure a minimum aggregate of 45% in Class 12 to qualify merit based eligibility.

faqs.question: How much is the fee for BTech at SRM Easwari Engineering College
faqs.answer: For a four-year BTech course at SRM Easwari Engineering College, the tuition fee ranges between INR 1.5 Lacs - INR 2 lakh. This tuition fee is given for all the BTech specialisations offered at SRM Easwari. However, this information is sourced from the official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change. Students are requested to visit the official website to get more details on the SRM Easwari Engineering College BTech fee structure. Additionally, those who get selected by the institute are required to apply online for TNEA Counselling along with paying an application of INR 600 .

Between July 27 and September 9, online general counseling for academic, government school 7.5 categories, and vocational applicants will take place. A total of 15 specialisations are available in the four-year BTech programme at SRM Easwari Engineering College. Several departments of Easwari Engineering College are offering this programme in conjunction with Anna University. Merit-based admissions are used for BTech. reviews.review_title: Really satisfied with our college curriculum, infrastructure, hostel rooms, food, etc.

About sports, every week we have a sports tournament which is conducted by our college. We have one of the best coaches.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are really supportive. They take everything seriously and really focus on students. They give important questions during exams and even take extra classes, and they give us the freedom to call them anytime. We can also visit their rooms to clarify our doubts. All faculty members are highly qualified. About semester exams, we have 4 months of a semester.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because of parental pressure, but this was one of the best decisions I made. This college provides everything. Our college provides a scholarship to 70 percent of students.

There is an indoor and outdoor stadium and a high-class gym which is free for students.

Semester exams are only for 30 marks, and we need to get 10 marks. 70 is the internal, which includes minds, assignments, and quizzes.
