reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security)
reviews.review_title: Review of GITAM School of Technology, Visakhapatnam.

detailed_review.Placements: I’d say that the Cyber Security specialization at GITAM isn’t that strong. The main reason is that very few security-related companies visit the campus for placements. So far, I’ve only seen one, which is VISA, and they take just a single intern based on CGPA. On the other hand, general placements are handled quite well. The GCDC (GITAM Career Development Centre) provides good training in communication, reasoning, and management skills. While big tech companies rarely recruit here, plenty of smaller firms visit regularly, giving students fair chances to start their careers. If I remember correctly, the highest package is 46.6 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: This is one area where GITAM truly stands out. The campus has Wi-Fi almost everywhere. Most labs have well-functioning computers, with some equipped with high-performance systems. The library facilities are excellent. They offer free access to Athens and Scopus research papers. Nearly all classrooms and labs are air-conditioned, making it comfortable to study. The canteen serves reasonably priced food. The quality is generally good, sometimes even great. GITAM students also receive discounted treatment at GIMSR Hospital. Sports facilities are top-notch, including badminton, cricket, table tennis, volleyball, basketball, football, and pickleball. There is even a gym open to all students.
detailed_review.Faculty: I have a mixed opinion about this. Some teachers are genuinely very good. They know how to teach well. While others are unfortunately not up to the mark. The curriculum itself is decent but nothing exceptional or career-changing. If you are aiming for a good job. You probably need to focus more on self-learning than relying solely on the syllabus. The exam pattern is quite strict, maybe even too strict at times, and failing a subject can create serious issues later on. The difficulty of semester exams really varies. Sometimes they are extremely hard. Sometimes they are fairly straightforward.
detailed_review.Other: Extracurricular activities at GITAM are one of the best aspects of campus life. There are plenty of clubs. Most of them are quite active with regular events and activities. You’ll find clubs for almost every interest, arts, tech, books, anime, and more. Students are even encouraged to start their own clubs, which makes the environment very open and creative. When it comes to student safety, the administration takes it seriously and acts strictly if any issues arise. Overall, GITAM is a college you can consider.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Internet of Things)
reviews.review_title: Very good location of the college.

detailed_review.Placements: The institute had good placement part but again it all depends on the candidates' performance and interest. There were approximately over 50 companies that a student got to go through the placement process. One also had an option not to choose for the placement if they were interested in higher education. Starting package of the company starts with 3.5 LPA as a beginner, which was best as per my knowledge. The highest package was 10 LPA. Deloitte provided an 8 LPA. Accenture gave 6 LPA to 4.5 LPA. All top MNCs will be visited for GITAM.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The institute had a good decent library with both books and digital facilities. Coming to the playground, it was a very well-maintained one but only the hostellers got the better out of the ground. In the hostel rooms, we had bed, table, and a cupboard for overseas. The rooms had 2, 3, 4, and 6 people sharing. The quality of the food was very nice, there will be both veg and non-veg. At few festivals, they provided special food. The hostel price was bit high but it was worth it.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course was very well structured, keeping in mind the different mindset of various types of students who opt for it. My choice for CSE was completely my own interest as I felt the IT field was where I wanted to look for my fortune. The student-to-teacher ratio was pretty much good as to say there won't be any deficit for the subject faculty. Faculty members were good. They were highly educated and experienced. They clear our doubts through discussions. There were two semesters in a year, and each semester had two sessionals.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security)
reviews.review_title: The college atmosphere is very good. good to learn and enjoy. I am very much satisfied.

detailed_review.Placements: 40% of the students are placed in my cybersecurity course. The highest and the lowest package offered for a cyber security role is 7.6LPA by Deloitte, the only company to conduct a drive for cyber roles. Cognizant, TCS, Accenture, and Capgemini massively recruited. No internships are offered. Deloitte offered a cyber role.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The classrooms are very advanced L1 classrooms. The whole campus is Wi-Fi enabled. The Knowledge Resource Center library has a vast collection of books and knowledge. Hospitality is very good. Blankets are provided every day, food is very good in the hostel, and the canteen has decent prices and quality. There is a GIMS hospital easily accessible. There is an indoor and outdoor stadium and a high class gym which is free for students.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are well qualified and very knowledgeable. Their teaching is very good. I think the course curriculum has some distance from the industry. Semester exams are only for 30 marks, and we need to get 10 marks. 70 is the internal, which includes minds, assignments, and quizzes.
detailed_review.Other: India needs so many cyber engineers, I took this course. The placements could be better, especially for the cyber roles. Deloitte offered the cyber role in the whole placement. Events were well organized and students can have their best college life.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: College life is beautiful with a challenging curriculum and colorful fests.

detailed_review.Placements: 60 to 70% of the students registered for placements got placed in good companies with a decent package. Only 5% of the students got placed in a package above 10LPA. The highest package offered is 36 LPA, and the lowest package offered is 3.6LPA. We have top recruiting companies like Darwinbox, Micron Technologies, Accenture, TCS, and Deloitte recruiting a decent number of students. Around 50% of the students got internships in companies like PGS, State Street, and are later given full time working opportunities.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The rooms, both A/C and Non A/C, are well maintained with thorough cleaning regularly. The mess provides a 4 course meal, including evening snacks, offering varied and nutritious food to accommodate students from different states and countries as well.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are knowledgeable enough to teach and clarify doubts regarding the respective subjects. Will also guide students in writing and publishing research papers. The course curriculum mostly comprises inculcating practical knowledge into students. The semester exam is moderately difficult but very challenging.
detailed_review.Other: I chose the particular course as it offers knowledge in various departments like IoT, AI, Data analytics, etc. This gives varied career options to choose from. A little more training regarding the work life in corporates would have been helpful.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security)
reviews.review_title: You can really have your best student life while having a good learning experience.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements were very average. In my cyber stream, only 40% are getting placed, 20% choose higher studies, and the remaining are not placed. The highest was 8.5 LPA. And the lowest is 3.3. The average package is 5 LPA. Companies like Accenture and TCS recruited the students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus is a Wi-Fi campus. Labs are well-equipped, and most of the classrooms are L1 AC classrooms. Library has many books available and the discussion rooms as well. The food was very hygienic and well-maintained. There is a GIMSR hospital where you can have the medical facility available 24 hrs, and the consultation is free for Gitam students.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers were very helpful, and many of them are Ph.D. holders. But for some courses, some faculty members were assigned irrespective of their interest and experience. 70 internal and 30 external, we need to get 50% marks for some subjects, which are absolute grades. For relative grading, the subjects' pass percentage will be dynamic.
detailed_review.Other: As many cyber frauds are going on, I took this course. I wish some experienced people from the cyber industry could teach better. The events are going very well. You can have your best student life.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Internet of Things)
reviews.review_title: I suggest everyone to check college and campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: 97% of students from our course got placed during campus placements. Highest package offered is 46LPA, while lowest is around 4LPA, with average package being competitive. Top recruiters included Wipro, TCS, and several other reputed companies, offering both full time roles and internships. Many students also secured internships through these recruiters, which provided valuable industry exposure. The roles offered spanned across domains such as Software Engineer, Analyst, Consultant, and Core Engineering profiles, depending on the Specialisation.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is really good. It has clean environment and well equipped laboratories with all the necessary instruments for practical learning. Classrooms are spacious, fully air conditioned, and equipped with really high speed Wi-Fi, which creates a comfortable and modern learning environment.
detailed_review.Faculty: We have exams every 2 months and have class and mock tests too, we start at 8 00 PM and class ends at 4 00 PM which makes a full corporate schedule. Teachers are very supportive and explain every concept clearly, ensuring students understand the subject well. They are all friendly. They maintain a friendly environment in class and are approachable, without being too strict. We have semester exams every two months. The overall pass percentage is 90% which reflects the quality of teaching and guidance provided. Our college has highly experienced teachers who provide strong academic guidance and support. All of them help us a lot and focus on every single student.
detailed_review.Other: I chose B.Tech in CSE because it is a course in high demand and offers a wide range of career opportunities in the current industry trend. Our college provides the best placements. College provides a clean and calm environment, which is ideal for studying. We also have so many fests along with vibrant campus life. Festivals and events are organized almost every month, giving students both exposure and enjoyment. We have so many sports.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Internet of Things)
reviews.review_title: GITAM University is good and very supportive of students.

detailed_review.Placements: 70% of students got placed through campus placements, and the highest package offered this year is 20 LPA by JP Morgan Chase, and the lowest offered is TCS (Ninja Role) 3.3LPA. The top recruiting companies of my course are Flipkart, Myntra, TCS, Accenture, and Porsche.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities in GITAM University are top-notch, where every room is a smart room with projectors and unlimited Wi-Fi, and also there is a library access using our ID cards, where we can take books home by registering in the library and return them.
detailed_review.Faculty: I would say teaching qualities are pretty average, in my opinion, because not every faculty works into the subject. Few faculty members just read the PPT on the screens and cover the unit. This course exposes students to industry-ready skills and helps to build a career in respective domains.
detailed_review.Other: I would choose this course because Computer Science is the most in-demand career. We are also exposed to various companies and gain knowledge by meeting seniors. I wish the faculty members would explain more clearly by just not reading the PPTs.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: A good campus, with decent placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement percentage is around 70%. Students are placed this year. The lowest package is 3.5 LPA, the highest package is 24 LPA, and the average package is 6 LPA. TCS, Accenture, Cognizant, Deloitte, Capgemini, etc., hire from here. About 80% of students got internships.Top roles offered are software engineer, full sack developed, project engineer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All the facilities are available, including Wi-Fi, good classrooms, and excellent libraries. All the sports grounds, an indoor badminton stadium, and an indoor basketball stadium are available. There is also a superb gym in the college with all the equipment.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teaching quality is superb, all the lecturers are highly qualified, and we can ask them any doubts we get, and they will clear them. The course curriculum is relevant. It makes the students industry-ready. The semester exams are as hard as other colleges, you can pass easily.
detailed_review.Other: I have chosen computer science and engineering because it has great career opportunities in software development, data, and emerging technologies. There are cultural clubs in college, there will be fests, and of course, scholarships, extracurricular activities, etc.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Internet of Things)
reviews.review_title: I am somewhat dissatisfied with the college.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 70% of students got placed. The lowest package is 3.5 LPA, the highest is 15 LPA, and the average is 4 LPA. Deloitte, Accenture, TCS, etc., were the recruiting companies. 15% of students got internships, but the college did not provide them. The Computer Science Engineering program is above average, I would say.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: AC classrooms have a high interior design, but the Wi-Fi speed is slow, and there is a bad network for mobile SIMs. The hostel quality and mess food are both average. I would recommend choosing another college because there are many things, like the food isn't that good, and the fee is too high, only rich people can afford it.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, and the quality is good. The curriculum is relevant. The semester exams are above average in difficulty. The semester is for only 30 marks when I studied, and the internals are for 70 marks, which is a bit easy, to be honest. We can easily pass the semester and also score good marks.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course to become a software engineer and developer. Events are good, and the campus crowd is good. The scholarship requires an 8 CGPA every semester.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Internet of Things)
reviews.review_title: I am proud to have passed out from this college.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 40% of the students are placed. Training regarding placements is excellent, but students lacking presentation skills could not achieve a placement. Great scope and continuous assistance are provided, but still, only the students who utilized it are happy.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Whatever a student wants to explore is at their fingertips, the college is well-equipped with the latest technological advancements. Be it entrepreneur clubs or whatnot, everything is encouraged. GITAM personally invests its efforts in improving students' life on campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified and experienced in tutoring courses. Not only academic requirements, but also placements, career choices, and even a few survival skills, what not, everything is covered. Teachers here at GITAM provide the utmost professional assistance and support.
detailed_review.Other: The best choice one could opt for.

detailed_review.Other: I chose the Robotics and Artificial Intelligence Engineering course because I am interested in it.

The clubs, hostel, infrastructure, and the event will also be head very nicely and be very good.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: GITAM Institute of Technology has modern facilities with lush green garden which is spread across 98 acres. The campus features art labs and central research facilities creating an inspiring environment for learning and innovation. Students also enjoy convenient services like bus transportation, a well-equipped gym, shops, a vibrant sports complex, an auditorium, a comprehensive library, and welcoming hostels.

The GITAM School of Technology was founded in 1980 and situate in Vishakhapatnam. The Vishakhapatnam campus serves as the main hub located between the Eastern Ghats and the Bay of Bengal one of the most beautiful and peaceful spots in Andhra Pradesh for higher education.

sections.heading: GITAM School of Technology Infrastructure Highlights
text: The GITAM School of Technology in Vishakhapatnam stands out as one of India's top private institutions. The campus blends academic excellence with modern infrastructure. Students can participate in various cultural, social and intellectual events that encourage idea exchange and community engagement.

Spread in 98 acres in Gandhi Nagar, Rushikonda this campus provides essential amenities like a library, cafeteria, study and recreation rooms, 24/7 connectivity, hostels, an auditorium, research centres, labs, medical services and nearby banking facilities. It also has two satellite campuses in Hyderabad and Bengaluru.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
reviews.review_title: USAR college review headline excellent infrastructure & labs, promising placement 9.5 LPA.

detailed_review.Placements: Early placements show promise, with the first batch of students securing up to 9.5 LPA, and internships are emerging. Reviews rate labs/library highly 8/10 but college life is lower 4/10 due to intensive schedules; AR branches fare better than others. USAR students often score higher than other IPU schools.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The 18 acre campus features AC classrooms, advanced labs with 3D printers and robotics tools, a multi floor library, sports ground, badminton court and a net zero energy design. Student reviews raise infrastructure 8/10 but note limited college fests and strict attendance.
detailed_review.Faculty: Eligibility requires 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics and admission is based on JEE Main ranks. The process involves applying through IPUs portals, counseling, and seat location check ipu AC. In for 2026 to 27 date. Certain impairments may disqualify candidates for some programs.
detailed_review.Other: USAR provides B.Tech programs in specialized fields like Automation & Robotics and Industrial IoT, each with 120 seats, totaling 480 across four streams. Integrated 5 year B.Tech/M Tech dual degrees are also available in similar specializations, with 120 seats each. The curriculum emphasizes hands on labs, projects, and industry interaction for practical skills.

reviews.course: B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good college, but if you want admission in B.Tech then think twice.

detailed_review.Placements: Amazon (2025). The major recruitments are from TCS, Infosys, Amazon, etc., and on-campus placements are not that great. Many of the students don't even get more than 6 LPA. Not every student gets an internship as well. The top roles offered are in software development.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel facilities are good, with spacious rooms. The warden is not very strict, the mess food is good, Wi-Fi is not that good, sports facilities are good, and every major sport has separate grounds. Proper coaching is there, labs are a little outdated, and the main canteen has an affordable menu.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are not that great, they don't even bother that syllabus is completed or not only few of them are good. Semester exams are not very difficult. The Curriculum is outdated. Students are not even industry-ready. 40 percent marks are the criteria to pass the exam.
detailed_review.Other: Fest is good, every major event happens in college. Only management needs improvement.

reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com. Hons.)
reviews.review_title: Indraprastha University is affiliated with the lowest fee college.

detailed_review.Placements: Mainly Delhi side students are there in my course who are experts in finance. The highest package is 8 LPA, average package is 4.5 LPA, and the lowest is 2.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies that come for placements for this course are TCS, Accenture, and IBM. Almost 50% of students get jobs in this course, mainly in the marketing field at the company TCS. All types of jobs are offered like marketing, HR, sales, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities are very good. The outside infrastructure of building is very good. The IPU building is also very good from the inside. All the things have good Wi-Fi connectivity. Labs, library, and all are very well Wi-Fi connected. The food quality is not good. The hostel infrastructure from inside is not at all good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. They do conduct different competitions and hackathons for all departments. The teaching method is good. The course curriculum is okay but the management of the college lacks many subjects and options that are provided by the university. Exams are made for all types of students according to the method and type of teaching.
detailed_review.Other: I want to go to the stock market in future for my career, and I found this course very relevant. This college is affiliated with Indraprastha University so I got this course.

reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA)
reviews.review_title: VIPS is a good college to pursue MCA. It is a decent choice with many courses available.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements so far are disappointing. I am in my 3rd semester of MCA. There are not many opportunities. Hopefully, it improves in the final semester. The highest package so far is 13 LPA, and not many students get placed. Roles are mainly in Software Development.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available. I don’t think the college offers hostel facilities. Labs are decent at best, but the labs are really good for B.Tech, not for MCA. You get a lot of elective options to choose your preferred subjects. The canteen is small and does not have a lot of options. The library is pretty good, with one library on every floor.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers and faculty are good, qualified, and helpful. They provide many events and workshops on different topics. Exams are of average difficulty. You can easily score good marks. The pass percentage is 40%, easily scorable.
detailed_review.Other: VIPS is decent at best. If you cannot get into top colleges, this is a good choice. There are many extracurricular activities and scholarships. The campus crowd is great as well.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good infrastructure and campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: Nice placement rate at GTBIT. Very good companies like HCL and Tata visit here. College plays an important role in students’ life. The placement opportunities help the students to reach heights in society. IEEE also helps in providing internship opportunities.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college has a beautiful infrastructure and learning environment. The campus is comparatively small, but it is designed very nicely. The hostel is not there in GTBIT. Infrastructure also plays an important role in student life. It has a playground for students.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are very helpful and help to clear concepts and provide exposure to the various fields. The curriculum is designed very well, and it helps in creating good engineers. Teachers are well educated and highly qualified, which helps in clearing concepts and going in depth.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
reviews.review_title: Infrastructure is good, syllabus is updated, and focused on practical learning.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are average. The package is around 8 LPA - 10 LPA in AI-ML and AIDS courses. The highest package is 28 LPA in IIOT, but average of IIOT is less. But still as compared to the rank in JEE at which it is available is value for money. 80-85% of students are placed. Companies like TCS and GoDaddy are recruiters.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is up to date, labs are updated, computer labs have i7-10generation processors, internet speed is 1000 MBPS, and connected using ethernet. The campus is fully air-conditioned. Auditorium is good. Campus size is not very large but it's satisfactory.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty is variable. Some are really good and some are not, but the courses which actually help in getting us placed in a company. We have good faculty, and they teach good. They focus more on practical learning than traditional theory things. Overall, it is satisfactory.

reviews.course: B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Great Campus and Good Crowd.

detailed_review.Placements: I think percentage-wise, ECE has the maximum placement compared to other B.Tech branches. Top companies visit the campus for placement and internship, like Samsung, Airtel, Cent, Oracle, etc. Internships are also provided to many students on campus, and many students here grabbed off-campus internship opportunities as well. Major roles are SE, SD, etc. I think the T and P Cell should become more active so that the placement scenario can be improved.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus is huge with various facilities like sports, an auditorium, a cafeteria, and an open-air theatre. New technology-equipped labs and classrooms. The best part is the library, which is very huge and contains almost everything. Hostel accommodation is for a limited number of students, mostly for students from outside the Delhi region, and hostel facilities are also very good, and the food is also of good quality. It also has gym facilities and indoor and outdoor games facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified and knowledgeable. The course curriculum is quite different from other colleges as it is very updated and very industry-relevant, which makes it different. Semester exams are not that hard, but I think they're not that easy either. You have to study hard for the end-term exams, and you also have your mid-semester exams in between the semesters. The pass percentage is high.
detailed_review.Other: I am very much interested in the electronics field, that's why I chose ECE. I think the management should be more active, and the TnP cell must be more active so that placements can be improved. Events and fests are at a mediocre level.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology
reviews.review_title: It is a good college in Delhi-NCR with good placement records and a decent college life.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are good here. We can get an average 5 LPA - 6 LPA if we have skills, which is good in terms of return on investment. The fee here is 6 LPA for the entire B.Tech duration (4 years). The highest package in 2024 was 50 LPA which was very good.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is basic here but it has all the basic needs. The hostel is also pretty average. The campus size is on the smaller side but the location (Janakpuri) is good. We can find everything nearby, and have ease of transport because metro station is also nearby.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are good and knowledgeable. The college is affiliated with GGSIPU, so the curriculum is also good. Exams are usually just mid-semester (twice) and the semester exams. The course is relevant to the needs which are required by the recruiters. We can gain good skills from our college itself.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
reviews.review_title: The infrastructure is decent. Placements are too decent as college was started in 2021.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement percentage is more than 50%. The highest package in AI-this is 12 LPA - 13 LPA, and average is 6 LPA - 7 LPA. This is the first placement year of college. Accenture and Infosys are the top recruiting companies for college students. As per my knowledge, the internship is only done by 5-10% students. Top role offered is data analytics.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are Wi-Fi, ventilated classroom, labs, and central library. Hostels are good, and newly constructed. The mess food is also very good. The taste is awesome and menu is too good. Medical facilities are not available. For sports, there is a small group for all sports. There is a dedicated sports hall for badminton.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are qualified and knowledgeable. The teaching quality is average. The course is made for industry-ready but the curriculum is not relevant for the industry ready. The difficulty in semester exam is average. As I seen, if we study one night before exam, we can easily score good marks if we had done same in mid semesters.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I love it. I chose this college because of its location. There are too many fests and events in college as college situated in Delhi so there are more opportunities.

reviews.course: B.A. LL.B.
reviews.review_title: Honest reviews about faculty, infrastructure, and overall college experience.

detailed_review.Placements: College provides subtle placements for law courses but in other courses good placements are provided in law, skills, and the student's capability is reviewed. There is an internship and placement cell in the college which help students achieve their desired internships which can be tier 1 firms as well.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus has good infrastructure with a good area. I have not personally lived in the hostel but I have heard great reviews from my friends about it. The mess also has good food, and I have personally tried it. The night regime is very strict but friendly so it is overall a good experience.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the teachers in the course are very helpful, and almost all the teachers have a doctorate degree or a postgraduate degree. They are well qualified in their fields with a strong understanding of social political litigational skills as well. Teachers are polite and helpful.
detailed_review.Other: There are many fests and competitions held every year, which help students participate and qualify for many good things.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Great faculty, infra, tech fests, good seniors, near metro, little social life.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 70–80% of students get placed according to previous data. The highest package is 54 LPA according to the college, but this is an off-campus placement, not on-campus. The lowest package is 3 LPA, and the average package is 5 LPA. Companies like Infosys and Accenture visit the campus. Around 50–60% of students get internships, mostly in startups, with roles such as software engineer and software developer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is not available on every floor. Classrooms are good, but not like top colleges. The library is also good. The food in the canteen is not very good. Medical facilities are available, but I have not needed them. The medical room is on the ground floor in front of the auditorium. Sports facilities are very good. Most students participate and win medals, trophies, and cash prizes.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most teachers have a Master’s degree in their subject, though some have only a graduate degree. I think this course is relevant, but the most important thing is improving your own skills. Semester exams are easy to moderate, and teachers are helpful, do not cut extra marks, and support students in their studies whenever needed.
detailed_review.Other: I chose B.Tech in CSE because I am interested in computer languages and learning how applications work. This field is in demand both now and in the future. I am improving myself through this course. The college does not provide many extracurricular activities, which is the worst thing about it.

reviews.course: B.B.A. LL.B.
reviews.review_title: Good college and infrastructure along with a hill crowd.

detailed_review.Placements: As a fresher, there is not a lot of information, but from what I have heard, the placement cell is really good and many eligible students have been placed really well in the past years. By the 3rd year in a 5-year course, students start sitting in a PPO and an internship to get real-life experience.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have great classrooms, centralised AC, labs, library and great infrastructure overall. There is no hostel or mess, but we have a very great fully vegetarian VIPS cafe, it has many outlets and amazing food to say the least. It isn't very cheap nor too expensive. Sports and games are present too, along with a meditation room.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is really helpful, knowledgeable and qualified. They teach according to the curriculum and are really well aware of it. There are 4 exams in 1 year, that is, two exams per semester, one external and one internal, and they are moderately difficult. You need 40% to pass. It does make the students industry-ready.

reviews.course: B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good college and crowd but wrong management.

detailed_review.Placements: The minimum package was about 3.5 Lacs, and the highest went up to 41 Lacs this year. The average was about 7-8 LPA. There are rumors that a student cracked a 90 LPA job offer on campus, so there's that, and the percentage of students placed was about 80-90%.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The classrooms are new and fully equipped with AC facilities, and the network is nice there, but no Wi-Fi facilities except for the library, where there is Wi-Fi. The hostels have nice Wi-Fi and single occupancy rooms, and the mess also has very high-quality food, but it's not possible to get a room if you are a Delhi student.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers here are highly qualified, but only a few teach well. Others are just bad. The curriculum is quite doable and relevant due to the new education policy. The semester exams are moderate; while they don't make you completely industry-ready, it's a nice curriculum that is offered, and it's above average.

reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA)
reviews.review_title: I'm satisfied with the college faculty, but there should be some placement for the BBA cell.

detailed_review.Placements: There are many fewer placements in the BBA cell. Like 2 to 5 students are only placed from the BBA cell, not from inside the campus, but from outside. An internship has to be done on one's own, not provided by the college. But MBA placement is good, and the average package is 5 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus area is small, 1 library is there, which is also small, but the education is very good here, a canteen is also here, the medical facility is very poor, only one doctor comes and just provides normal medicine like paracetamol and others.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is educated and good here and helpful. The teaching quality is also good. The course curriculum is relevant, and it makes the students industry-ready. The passing percentage is 33 percent, and exams are difficult as per the study, but the faculty is good here.
detailed_review.Other: As I am doing BBA here in my 2nd year, I think that the college should provide some freedom to students, as it does not provide outpass every day, and even though there are many restrictions here, and the campus is small, the connectivity is very good between us.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering (Second Shift)
reviews.review_title: Review of MSIT of 2019 pass out of the ECE stream.

detailed_review.Placements: Overall placement is good for the CS and IT streams. For ECE, they call not too big companies. Small companies will come and will give small packages. ECE people have only hope of mass recruiters like Infosys and TCS. So, I advise not to be totally dependent on college for placements.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college is old, ancient brick structure-like building, but strong. They need further major upgradation. Overall, the infrastructure is good. Management is improving infrastructure day by day as per the changes required. I have seen drastic changes in infrastructure in terms of betterment during my 4 years.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are some okay, some very bad. Curriculum based on IP University. Exam checking is loose; long paragraphs mean more marks. Hard checking pressures the student for deeper study so that students will understand things more clearly because of the fear of passing.

reviews.course: B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: One should take admission and enjoy the curriculum and vibe of the college.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 70-75 percent of students are placed in my batch. The highest package is 15 LPA, the average package is 7-8 LPA, and the lowest package is 3 LPA. Top recruiters included Oracle and Samsung. Internships were not very good, and only 2-3 students got internships in some IT sectors. Top roles offered are software developer, graduate engineering trainee, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is good. Wi-Fi is available in the library, and hostel rooms have their own Wi-Fi connections for students. Classrooms are well maintained with good infrastructure and projector facilities. Hostel facilities include mess, laundry, good security, and separate hostels for girls and boys. The quality of food is quite okay, and the canteen provides some other varieties of food apart from the mess. Medical facilities are good, and the college has its own ambulance. Sports and games facilities are quite okay, but the cricket coach is unfair while selecting players for the team.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is helpful, knowledgeable, and experienced, and the teaching quality is good. The course does not fully make students industry ready, so for placements, students have to study individually and take courses from different coaching institutes. The exams are not very difficult, and one can easily pass and achieve a good CGPA.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: If you have a choice other than this, don't come to MSIT.

detailed_review.Placements: Current states of placement are just bad. The highest on-campus company was 17LPA. But keeping the feels, JEE Main rank, and current market scenario in account, then it might feel average. The average package is around 5 LPA-6LPA ( used to be 7LPA two years ago, college downfall).
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Too old and school vibes in college, the rooms do not have AC, and the ones with AC are just dead. The canteen is just built and sells just 4 things, which are often burnt or too plain. Sport Facility is just that, you have a ground, no equipment is provided, and you just get scolded. No Wi-Fi, and even data is very rare. The college strictly needs some renovation.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum is similar to most colleges and follows the IPU syllabus, which is not very industry-oriented. It focuses more on theory than practical, job-ready skills. The teachers are decent overall; some are supportive and helpful, while others are average. Semester exams are manageable and not very difficult, with a passing requirement of around 40 percent.
detailed_review.Other: Hopefully, there is no ragging by seniors. Fest happens only once. Connectivity is good. It is in Janakpuri, so there are many cafes nearby. For extracurricular activities, societies will help, but there are just 2-3-4 societies running well, others are just dead or just for name sake.

reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA)
reviews.review_title: Review of Army Institute of Management and Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements here are average. I would recommend a BBA student to go outside and seek placements, as they will not get a higher package that ranges from 3.5-4 LPA from the college placements. It is an MBA institute, and the BBA was just introduced seven years ago. In the senior batches, like the third year, only two or three get placed from the current and previous year's data.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel has Wi-Fi, and the whole campus has Wi-Fi connectivity. The mess food quality is outstanding. There are computer labs and three labs. There is a medical office, but no one comes. There are sports like football, badminton, basketball, volleyball, and cricket.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very qualified and very engaging with students. The teaching quality is outstanding if we want to learn. The course curriculum is relevant, and it makes students future-ready. More practicality needs to be induced in the course, like industrial visits, etc., because just studying and studying makes it very hectic.
detailed_review.Other: I scored 696 out of 800 marks, so I could have easily gotten a better college in DU. Still, I was getting a B.Com. But I wanted to do BBA, so I got into this college. The admission process is also very smooth, as only army wards are allowed, and we just need to pay the fee.

reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com. Hons.)
reviews.review_title: Really good faculty and facilities, along with infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Companies like Amazon, Career Launcher, EY, Wipro, and the Ministry of Power recruit students from our campus. It is the skills that students acquire at our college that help them receive offers from such reputed companies, with good positions and packages.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college offers great facilities to its students. Labs are well-functioning and equipped with Wi-Fi. The library has all the course books readily available. The college provides hostel facilities, along with good, healthy, and nutritious food in the canteen. Medical facilities are available. The college actively participates in sports activities through GGSIPU University and external sports opportunities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are knowledgeable. They are readily available to provide any help needed. They understand students’ needs. They provide study materials beyond the textbooks. It makes learning easier. Curriculum is regularly updated, and helpful subjects like Python are included to help students gain new skills. Semester exams are quite easy if students pay attention to what is taught in class.
detailed_review.Other: I chose B. Com (Hons) at MAIMS because it is a reputed college. It provides world-class facilities. Along with helpful professors, and a safe environment for students to grow. College gives opportunities to gain skills and apply them in real life. College events are fun and interactive. It includes society fests. Campus feels lively, chaotic, yet beautiful.

reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com. Hons.)
reviews.review_title: Review of students' life and academic life at MAIMS.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 30-40 percent of students get placed every year on an average basis. The average package offered is around 3 LPA. About 50-60 percent of students get internship opportunities through the placement cell, and the rest on their own. Account executive, junior accountant, operations executive, sales, marketing, and administrative are some roles offered to students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: MAIMS has a decent and well-maintained infrastructure. It provides clean classrooms, computer labs, and libraries. We get a book bank facility as well. There is no Wi-Fi facility for students. Lifts are there on the campus. Classrooms are well-maintained and have AC.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members at MAIMS are experienced, knowledgeable, and very supportive. They are approachable and ready to help always. Most professors have strong academic backgrounds. The course curriculum is very relevant and prepares students for the real world. No semester exams are not that tough.

college_info.college_name: GGSIPU Admission 2026: Last Date, Courses, Eligibility, Fee, Application Form

admission.title: IPU Admission Overview 2026
admission.overview_text: IPU admission 2026 is based on the scores of candidates in the entrance exam. The university conducts in-house entrance test, i.e., IPU CET . This exam is accepted by the university for most of its courses. Other than this, students can also apply with CUET, JEE Main, CAT, MAT, etc. At IPU, students can find courses in different streams, such as Engineering, Arts, Management, and more. The applications can be submitted by visiting the university's website.

faqs.question: Which entrance exam is accepted by IPU?
faqs.answer: Yes, Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University conducts a Common Entrance Test (CET) for admission to BSc, BCA, BCom (Hons), B.Ed, BA (JMC), BHMCT, BBA, BA (Hons), BVoc, BPT, BPO, BOT, BASLP, BSc MLT, MSc, MA, MEd, MPT, MOT and MPO courses. IPU CET exam 2026 application forms for other courses, open tentatively in March every year. Apart from conducting IPU CET , GGSIPU also accepts several national-level entrance exams to provide admission to a few undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral courses.

faqs.question: Why choose Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University?
faqs.answer: Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University ( GGSIPU ), also known as Indraprastha University or IPU , is recognised as a state university. IPU Delhi is a teaching-cum-affiliating university. Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University Dwarka, Delhi is committed to providing professional education with innovation, creativity, and continuous change. GGSIPU is ranked 1001-1200 by the QS World University Rankings 2025 . IPU is also ranked 651-700 by the QS WUR Ranking By Subject 2025 and 951-960 by the QS Sustainability Ranking 2025. IPU is also ranked 80th by NIRF 2024 under the University category,  29th by NIRF 2024 under the Architecture and Planning category, and 89th by NIRF 2024 under the Engineering category.

faqs.question: What are the fees structures for BTech programmes at GGSIPU?
faqs.answer: GGSIPU BTech fees range between INR 1.4 lakh and INR 10 lakh . This information is sourced from official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change. The fee mentioned here does not include the university charges of INR 15,000, security amount of INR 5,000 (One time, refundable) and student activity fee of INR 1,000. For detailed fee structure, candidates are advised to contact the admission department of Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University.

faqs.question: I've scored less than 50% in graduation. Am I eligible for MBA at GGSIPU?
faqs.answer: Aspirants who have completed their graduation with a minimum of 50%-60% aggregate are eligible to apply for MBA programme at GGSIPU. Candidates with a 50% score in graduation can also apply provided the requirement of aggregate is 50% or below. For MBA specialisations requiring 60% or above aggregate, candidates need not get admission with 50%.

faqs.question: I have scored less than 60% in 12th boards. Am I eligible to get BBA at GGSIPU?
faqs.answer: Admissions in GGSIPU are done on entrance-basis. The basic eligibility requires the candidates to pass Class 12 or its equivalent exam with a minimum aggregate of 50% . Hence, you can certainly apply for the BBA course even if you have scored less than 60% in your Class 12 boards. However, BBA admissions at GGSIPU are accepted on the basis of valid score obtained in the IPU CET or CUET followed by counselling. Only those who meet the cut-off and satisfy all the parameters will be allocated a seat at GSSIPU for the BBA programme. In case the students are unable to clear the BBA cut-off released by the university, they can pursue the BBA Online courses offered by various other colleges.

faqs.question: Is IPU admission open?
faqs.answer: GGSIPU admissions are open. A few more updates related to GGSIPU admissions are as follows:

faqs.question: How good is the BBA at IP University?
faqs.answer: IPU is counted among the good universities in the country. GGSIPU is ranked 1001-1200 by the QS World University Rankings 2024. In the NIRF 2024 ranking, it was ranked 80 under the "University" category. The placement data for the GGSIPU BBA course is not available as of now. The highest and average package offered stood at INR 45 LPA and INR 12 LPA, respectively for IPU Engineering (USCIT) placements 2022.

faqs.question: How can I get admission to BBA at IPU?
faqs.answer: Candidates need to appear for the IPU CET entrance exam conducted by Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University for BBA. Further, students must have to follow a seat allotment process via IPU CET Counselling. GGSIPU now also accept CUET-UG scores for admission to this UG course. Interested candidates need to apply offline by paying the requisite fee of INR 2,500.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for IPU BBA?
faqs.answer: For admission to BBA course in any of the IPU-affiliated colleges, aspirants must meet the eligibility criteria. To be eligible, candidate must be a Class 12 or equivalent exam pass from a recognised board with at least 50% aggregate . Moreover, candidate shall have studied English (core/ elective/ functional) as a mandatory subject in Class 12. For verification purposes, the aspirants also have to present the pass certificate and other documents during form filling and at the time of admission confirmation.

faqs.question: What is the fees for BBA in IPU?
faqs.answer: The total fee of BBA at IPU includes components such as tuition fee, registration fee, security charges, etc. The tuition fee for the UG courses range between INR 96,500 and INR 4.2 lakh. This fee range is cumulative of courses offered by the university through its affiliated colleges, hence may vary. This information is sourced from official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change. Candidates can visit the IP University official website (ipu.ac.in) to get more information on the fee structure or get in touch with the admission office.

faqs.question: Is IPU CET exam valid for BCA?
faqs.answer: Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University BCA admission is yes but the admission will be done based on the performance of candidates in four rounds which are IPU CET entrance test, counselling round and then the admission is done. Nevertheless, the University will also be able to admit CUET-qualified candidates to the BCA course once the CET merit list has been depleted. Those who had interest are required to apply by paying the required fee of INR 2,500 to be admitted to the course of BCA in IP University.

faqs.question: Is Mathematics required for BCA at GGSIPU?
faqs.answer: Candidates need to complete their Class 12 or a equivalent with a minimum of 50% aggregate with English along with Mathematics or Computer Science or any other subject related to Computer Science to apply for BCA at GGSIPU. Hence, it is not mandatory to pass Mathematics. However, candidate must have passed one or other specified subjects in Class 12. Besides, aspirants who have passed a three-year Diploma in Engineering with a minimum of 50% aggregate are eligible to apply for the BCA programme.

faqs.question: What is the fee for pursuing BCA from GGSIPU?
faqs.answer: The total IP University BCA course fee is cumulative of several components such as the tuition fee, security deposit, library fee, and other such components. IP University BCA fees range between INR 84,900 and 3.3 lakh. The fee mentioned here is taken from the official website/sanctioning body. It is subject to changes. Hence, is indicative. Moreover, the fee to be paid for applying successfully is INR 1,500.

faqs.question: How good is an MBA from IP university, New Delhi?
faqs.answer: Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University is a decent choice to pursue an MBA degree. Talking about the GGSIPU ranking, the University was ranked 65 in the Management category by the National Institutional Ranking Framework in 2024. However, Outlook in its 2024 rankings has placed the university at the 15th spot . IP University also offers placement opportunities to its students. During IPU placements for MBA in 2022 at USMS, the median package offered was INR 5.60 LPA . Additionally, the placement percentage achieved was 91%.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria to get admission to MBA programme at GGSIPU?
faqs.answer: Applicants who want to be accepted into this course must take the CAT entrance test. The last round is made on the performance of the candidates during the GD & PI round. Along with the valid CAT score, the students also need to meet the minimum eligibility criteria. The minimum requirement in terms of eligibility to GGSIPU MBA admission is a bachelor degree in any stream with a minimum aggregate of 50% to 60%.

faqs.question: What is the fee at GGSIPU for MBA course?

sections.heading: Introduction
text: GGSIPU offers a state-of-the-art infrastructure with Wi-Fi enabled digital campus, a fully-furnished placement cell, central AC buildings, a moot court, three well-equipped computer labs, a well-equipped audio-video lab, a separate computer laboratory for law, spacious classrooms with an ICT facility, a production lab, smart classrooms, a well-equipped library, a multi-purpose hall, recreational rooms for boys & girls with indoor sports facilities and two cafeterias. Other than these, the university also offers an industry-academia interface, recreational activities, outreach programmes, Skill Enhancement & Entrepreneurship, etc.

sections.heading: GGSIPU Campus Highlights
text: Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University, formerly Indraprastha University (IP or IPU), is a state university located in Dwarka, Delhi, India. The university is organised around fourteen university schools and three university centres that focus on programs in law, medicine, technology, education, entrepreneurship, science and business. The university has a library, 4 hostels, a well-equipped sports complex and a cafeteria. Checkout the table below to find a few highlights about the campus:

sections.heading: GGSIPU Hostel & Residential Facilities
text: GGSIPU has 4 hostels in total, out of which 2 are for female students and male students. The hostels for boys are known as Shivalik and Aravalli, and hostels for girls are known as Nilgiri and Satpura. The university hostel provides a comfortable and supportive living environment for students, offering a sense of community and convenience right on campus. The hostels have well-furnished rooms, common areas for relaxation and socializing, and essential facilities like laundry services and Wi-Fi

sections.heading: GGSIPU Hostel Life
text: The hostel life at GGSIPU is comfortable and provides a homely vibe. There is 24*7 surveillance ensuring the safety of the students. Moreover, the cafeteria provides nutritious and delicious meals which is an essential need of the hosteller. Also, the hostels have effective wifi systems and entertainment rooms.

sections.heading: GGSIPU Academic and Research Facilities
text: GGSIPU aims to strengthen and promote the university, identify the thrust area for research in various USS/Centres, research guidance and monitoring through different activities including interaction with various stakeholders of the University, creating enabling provisions in research policies for recruitment of research personnel, procurement of equipment, and financial management with adequate autonomy to the Principal Investigator and disseminate research outcomes to stakeholders and the public at large, as well as monitoring and overseeing research progress to ensure timely completion of the projects as per schedule.

sections.heading: GGSIPU Library
text: The library at IP University is centrally air-conditioned and fully automated. The library is well stocked with 67,000 books, 12,000 e-books, 15,000 journals, and subscriptions to 14 online databases. Remote access is available to the students and faculty for the resources along with the WebOPAC facility. Business Source Complete (BSC), provides a collection of bibliographic and full-text content and offers indexing and abstracting of searchable cited references.

sections.heading: GGSIPU Sports Facilities
text: GGSIPU's sports facility is a vibrant hub for physical activity, promoting health, wellness, and teamwork among students and staff. The university The university has a dedicated court and field for volleyball, Football, Cricket, Badminton, Basketball, Tennis, Kabbadi and Track & Field and ground for cultural activities, and Canopy for cultural activities by clubs under Srijan.

sections.heading: Places to visit in & around the GGSIPU Campus
text: Near Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University (GGSIPU) in Dwarka, Delhi, students can explore attractions like ISKON Temple, with the option of visiting the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi and Pinnacle Mall. There are markets, restaurants and parks near the campus.

reviews.course: MBA in Business Analytics
reviews.review_title: MBA in Business Analytics.

detailed_review.Placements: The specific branch in the course of MBA was likely to have more opportunities, which may be up to 68 percent. The coaching for placements would be common for all branches, which was quite stressful due to the terrific competition. I got selected in the company EY for the role of junior consultant for the package of 4.52 CTC, which was made possible by me in my 5th company drive, through the successive placement coaching.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: A lot of controversies happened in the college, especially during the inter college cultural which severely disrupted the pace of the whole college. Providing permission for conducting such events often in the college causes the students to lower their concentration on academics and placement wise. Apart from all the beautiful campus it looks like the best facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers were well aware of the tactics and strategies of the business oriented studies, which help to get a better view of the course of MBA in business analytics. Teachers were mindful about their usage of words, segments like projects were sounding interesting, mostly like a collection database about the usefulness of our developed project and its working which was helpful to analyze the course as the best.

detailed_review.Faculty: The teaching quality of hits from aeronautical department is good and very trained personal are there but self study is important in any college no faculty would spoon feed anyone and about exams are not that difficult if we study well but without studying and last time preparation in engineering won't even let u pass and the subjects are unique and great opportunity to learn through industry based subjects .

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Aeronautical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Satisfied with the curriculum but need more placements in relevant fields.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 50% of students were placed in the relevant course. The highest package was 6 LPA, and the lowest package was 3.5 LPA. Faltirons- a technical publication company and Indigo hired 3 persons for the post of fight dispatch operation. Internships were not provided. Graduate engineer trainee, technical publication author, and fight dispatch operation were roles offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure and facilities were good. It contained aircraft hanger, fight simulator, chetak helicopter, learjet aircraft, wind tunnels, etc. Different varieties of hostels were provided based on our requirements and comfort. Sports and games were available too. We could go for horse riding as well.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teaching quality was good but not the best. They were qualified and knowledgeable. The curriculum was relevant to our field and was the best. We feel it was not so industry-ready. We need a lot to learn apart from the curriculum. Difficulty level was quite moderate. The pass percentage was more than 70-75%.
detailed_review.Other: I have chosen this course to make a bright career in the aviation field. This course helped me to earn knowledge in various disciplines but I didn't get placed in a relevant field. They had offered an IT field which was not relevant to us. Only some of our friends got selected for the course-related jobs. Events and fests were good and were conducted once every semester.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology
reviews.review_title: I am a little dissatisfied because of placement and, moreover, good infrastructure and faculties.

detailed_review.Placements: According to placements, there is only a 60% placement rate, and more placement companies aren't that popular. It is an okay college for placements. We are just dissatisfied because of this placement issue. There are only 5 to 6 students who got selected in a department.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Good infrastructure and peaceful environment. Students are friendly, and good laboratory facilities are available. Many play areas are available for students. They give space for sports too. Good and neat environment. Good food and hostel feel good because of caring and cleanliness.
detailed_review.Faculty: Great faculty members and fabulous teaching for us. They conduct more exams for our improvement. They specifically take care of each and every student. They train them according to their capacity. They conduct sudden exams and tests to improve more and more.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Overall it is a good campus and worth the money.

detailed_review.Placements: At Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science (HITS), around 85% of students in our course got placed. The highest salary package offered is 15 LPA. The lowest salary package offered is 3 LPA. The average salary package offered is 6 LPA. Top recruiters include TCS, Infosys, and Cognizant. Around 70% of students secured internships at companies like Amazon and Bosch. Roles offered are software engineer, analyst, and marketing executive.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science (HITS) provides excellent infrastructure with Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, well-equipped labs, and a comprehensive library. Hostels offer modern amenities and 24/7 medical services. The campus has a hygienic mess, a canteen, and sports facilities for various outdoor and indoor games.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are qualified enough and knowledgeable about their subjects. The course curriculum is relevant and makes students industry-ready. The pass percentage is 90%. HITS offers qualified and helpful teachers with a relevant curriculum, preparing students well for the industry.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of HITS for CSE students.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are average. The salary package offered to students is around 12 LPA - 14 LPA. Even though some students got off-campus placements. Internships are provided by the college, especially for B.Sc. students from the third year onwards. Amazon, Being, and many competitive companies are there.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel is okay. The food is good. Hostel norms are good. They allow students to go out through ERP systems which is very intriguing. There's a whole building for the library. There are facilities provided for every sport like basketball, badminton, chess, football, table tennis, and many more.
detailed_review.Faculty: The curriculum is a bit boring during the first year. We are taught about welding and plumbing as a CSE student which didn't make sense. Industrial safety and a few boring subjects are available. Eventually, you'll see studies in the second year which you opted for as core subjects.
detailed_review.Other: Events, the campus crowd, scholarships, and all are provided. The enrollment is good in this college.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology
reviews.review_title: A good life at Hindustan.

detailed_review.Placements: The percentage of student placement is average. The lowest package is around 3 LPA, the average is 5-6 LPA, and the highest is 10 LPA. Companies like Infosys, Amazon, Decathlon, Aegis+, The Gateway, CADD Centre, ITC Hotels, IDBI Federal Audit, Virtusa, and HCL, among others. 78 percent of students were placed in 2018.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is a Wi-Fi facility, but that is not for everyone. Yes, the labs are somehow good, classrooms are okay, and the library is awesome (which is the best place in our college). The hostel food facilities are average (in taste), but the canteen food is good and of good quality. Yes, there are medical facilities, sports, and games.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable, and also they are friendly (not all teachers). The teaching quality is good. Yes, the curriculum is relevant; somehow it makes students industry-ready. The semesters are not difficult in our college, and it is easy to clear.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Campus is good for higher education.

detailed_review.Placements: Every year nearly 90 percent of students will be placed in companies. The highest will be around 20 LPA, and the lowest will be 3 LPA, and the average will be 6 LPA. Top recruiters are BCG, TCS, and more. Internship will be given by a college, but not in a big company and in small companies like BSY company. Top roles are data analyst and developer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure was good, and all over campus we have Wi-Fi, water, labs, and classrooms. The library was very big, and we had access to every book in that library. The hostel facilities are good, and the food was good, and sports were also conducted, and we have a lot of grounds to play on.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are good and experienced, but for some subjects teachers will be less experienced. In this college curriculum, there was little old, and students will be industry ready. Semesters are really easy, and below-average students also can pass the semester. Pass percentage is 50 percent.
detailed_review.Other: I chose a computer course because it is leading in the world, and in this college it is one of the best courses. In our college, some courses should be removed because they are a waste of time. In this college, lots of events will be conducted, and we can participate easily. Scholarships will be given.

reviews.course: BCA Industry Integrated (HTC Global) Specialization in Cyber Security
reviews.review_title: Really good infrastructure, eco friendly campus, and world class facilities are provided.

detailed_review.Placements: According to the 2024 passout batch, 15 out of 30 students were placed in various interviews from our department. Top recruiting companies of our course would be HTC Global Services, HCL, Cognizant, etc. The lowest package would be 6 LPA, and the highest would be 10 LPA. In the BCA integrated course, all students enrolled in the course would be given a 1-year internship in HTC Global Services. Top roles offered in our course would be in the security field, including SOC analyst, network security expert, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college campus is fully eco-friendly with fully equipped labs and facilities like a fully Wi-Fi-enabled campus, separate hostels for boys and girls, an international football ground maintained by Chennaiyin FC, a basketball court, and an indoor badminton court and indoor gym. Air-conditioned labs are separate for all departments. Well infrastructure library is there.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teaching staff are highly qualified as Dr. holders and professors with deep knowledge in their particular departments. The medium of teaching is English and also in the regional language for students who need help. The curriculum will be published before every academic year, and it is to be followed for the whole schedule. Semesters are not really difficult but easy to grasp and understand. There are 3 exams per semester, the first 2 being CIA or internals and the end semester examination. The pass percentage is 33 percent for each subject.
detailed_review.Other: The course was close because it provides great exposure to the cybersecurity field by providing in-hand experience in the last year through an integrated internship with HTC. Events, celebrations, and festivals in college are very colorful and vibrant, including all spheres of students and entertaining to the core.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Aerospace Engineering
reviews.review_title: I am really happy about the freedom. And they are not conducting culturals and events properly.

detailed_review.Placements: The college claims that the placement percentage is above 90, but I am not sure about it. I think 70 to 75 percent of students got placement. The highest package is 24 LPA and the lowest is 4.5 LPA. Hindustan gives full freedom, and if you fail the examination, there is a supplementary exam.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Good, but some classes are not maintained properly. And there are some blocks which are so old. For example, the aeronautical block is the oldest block. There are a lot of patchwork areas in that. College Infrastructure: A very good infrastructure, with well-maintained labs, classrooms, and library.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teaching is quite good, Hindustan recruits highly experienced staff and professors. And they will take students twice a year to visit industries. Being an undergrad in B.Tech Aerospace from Hindustan University, firstly, working in the Aerospace Industry is different from studying Aerospace Engineering. If your brother is interested in working and contributing to the Aerospace Industry, it is better he choose a more wider core field like ECE or Mech. This is because, many manufacturing and design companies prefer recruiting Mech. Undergraduates. In case of working for satellites and space communication, there is nothing better than ECE.
detailed_review.Other: Hindustan is basically good for aerospace and aeronautical courses. There are lots of labs and things available related to aerospace engineering.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: Check out more on Hindustan University Infrastructure in the below videos:

facilities.name: Library
facilities.description: The HITS' Library has a collection of 105253 books, 42262 online journals and 389 printed journals, 12 newspaper, 64 thesis and dissertations, 3031 project reports and 2792 CDs. The Library system consists of a Central Library and Departmental Libraries which collectively support the teaching, research and extension programmes of the Institute. All students, faculty members and employees of the Institute are entitled to use the Library facilities enrolling membership.

facilities.name: Cafeteria
facilities.description: A well-furnished cafeteria serving continental and Indian cuisines is located centrally in the Institution. The ‘Garage Café’ is another food court with a rugged garage appearance catering to the needs of the food lovers. Both continental and Indian cuisines are served. Besides, fast food and other eateries are also available.

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description:
The hostels have well-furnished air-conditioned and regular rooms with attached restrooms providing the right ambience for the students. There are five residential halls for boys and three for girls on campus
that accommodate over 2500 students. State of the art kitchen and spacious dining area has been provided for both the hostels and a customized menu caters to the student’s needs. Hygiene and cleanliness is emphasized in the hostel. All the hostels offer a variety of services and opportunities for students. Staff members residing in the hostel are assigned to address academic and personal problems of the students. Round-the-clock security, communication, dispensary facilities are also available.

facilities.name: Shuttle Service
facilities.description: The University operates a fleet of 50 buses to all the important city spots for the benefit of students and staff. The services of university buses are utilized for industrial visits and excursions. The University is on the main arterial road to the Chennai city. Scores of public transport buses ply before the University campus and many day scholars use this service. Comfortable air-conditioned buses are also available.

highlights.summary:
IIIT, Allahabad, is one of the most prestigious institutes in India. It is a public state university and it has a strong focus on information technology and its deemed university status. -mentioned are the IIIT Allahabad key highlights:
IIIT,Allahabad was established in 1999 and was awarded the status of a deemed university by the Government of India in 2000. In 2014, MHRD recognised IIIT Allahabad as an 'Institute of National Importance'.
The institute offers UG, PG, and PhD programmes across the Engineering and Management streams. IIIT, Allahabad offers four programmes: BTech, MTech, MBA, and PhD across four departments, namely Applied Sciences, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Information Technology, and Management Sciences. IIIT Allahabad admissions are entrance-based. IIT Allahabad accepts entrance exams such as JEE Main, DASA, GATE, CAT, etc. IIIT Prayagraj is ranked 1401+ in the QS World University Rankings 2025 and 101-150 in the Engineering category by the NIRF 2025 and 10 in the Engineering category by the India Today 2024. The highest package offered during the IIIT Allahabad placement 2025 was INR 120 LPA. Further, the placement rate recorded for BTech and PG programs in 2025 was 97.91% and 95.3%, respectively. A total of 195 companies visited the campus during the placement drive 2025. IIIT Allahabad has collaborated with various institutions through MOUs. While the MOUs with world-class universities like the University of Messina, Italy, and the University of California, and others. The institute has collaborated with ISRO of the Department of Space, Government of India, Bengaluru. The institute has a well-designed 100-acre campus with a stimulating environment featuring fine landscaping. The campus is fully residential, with academic and residential areas connected to the institute's network.
