detailed_review.Placements: Placements in our college are top-notch. Most of the students take admission in this college for placements only. The lowest package is around 10 LPA, and the highest is 1 crore+. The average goes around 30-35 LPA. Almost 90-95% students get placed.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is good enough. The campus is big enough, and there are various beautiful places such as the rock garden, the pavilion, the cafeteria, etc. Also, the academic buildings are good enough. But there can be some improvements in hostels.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty experience varies as some professors are very good, helpful and patient, while some are not. The curriculum is nice for Information Technology department, almost all core CS subjects are included, and you have study Physics only in 1 sem. Exams are good, sometimes hectic.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of IIIT Allahabad.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement statistics of Indian Institute of Information and Technology, Allahabad are very nice and good, I think, because it is better than many of the colleges I have seen. Also, as the college is government, it is very reliable and good for students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college, Indian Institute of Information and Technology Allahabad (Prayagraj), is very good, I think, because it has its own mess, which is very hygienic and well maintained, and it also has its own canteen that provides a variety of foods.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty of Indian Institute of Information and Technology Allahabad (Prayagraj) is very good, because many of the professors hold Masters, and some also hold PhDs in their respective fields. The professors give practical knowledge based on their experience with the topic.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of IIIT Allahabad College.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 85% of students find placements. The maximum salary package is a whopping 83 LPA, the average hangs around 24.5 LPA, and the median is about 16 LPA. Companies like Atlassian, Qualcomm, Postman, PhonePe, Google, Oracle, Adobe, Media.net, and Goldman Sachs are the leading recruiting companies. As for internships, core ECE students are looking at about 25%-30%, and overall, around 70%-80% of students land internship offers. Most of the roles available tend to be in software, by the way.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel, along with the mess, runs in a sufficient manner. Classrooms have Wi-Fi, and the LAN can be accessed from the hostel rooms. Basically, you are able to get everything that you want on the university grounds. The classrooms are airy and equipped with projectors. There is a big stadium for cricket and football, apart from an indoor stadium for badminton.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members are good, but you must go to class regularly. Everybody passes except for those who barely come to classes. The curriculum is not very well-structured, and students have to figure out the concepts themselves in order to be ready for the industry. The difficulty level of the semester exams is just right, so if you want to pass, you will have to get yourself prepared well.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: My experience at IIIT as an ECE student.

detailed_review.Placements: In the Economic year 2025, placements were around 97% for B.Tech Courses, the highest package was around 12 LPA, while the average package was around 33 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Microsoft, Google, Goldman Sachs, Amazon, DE Shaw, Deloitte, Adobe, and Zepto.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus is enough for the graduates as it is not very crowded. All sports are available indoors and outdoors. However, the maintenance of some sports facilities lags, like the basketball court, badminton, etc. Labs are good, fully centralized. A.C. Timings for labs are until 8 p.m., and libraries are open until 11 p.m. The library has a good collection of books relevant to your courses. Classrooms are decent, not much to say, but on the good side.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are good, but it's more up to you to understand their teaching style, it's a perspective-based answer. Mostly good, but you have to put in your own efforts for placements and academics. Courses are relevant, but didn't get much into depth; you have to study on your own.
detailed_review.Other: This course is for students who are confused about which career to pursue, whether it be core ECE or other fields. The college has a good environment for those interested in coding.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good seniors. Satisfactory faculty and good placements.

detailed_review.Placements: 98.5% of students got placed this year. The other went for higher studies and prepared for government services. The highest or the lowest package is 1.23 crore per annum and 9 LPA, respectively. The average is around 21 LPA. Some of the companies are Qualcomm, LG, Google, Microsoft, Accenture, Codechef, Zepto, Goldman Sachs, Delloite, Flipkart, BCG, and UBS. Approximately 75% got an internship, and the rest are doing their project work. The top roles are SD1, data analyst, testers, and full-stack developer. More than 200 companies visit IIIT each year.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is poor, but LAN and Ethernet services are good. Computer Labs are generally open 24/7. The library has timings from 8:00 AM to 12:00 AM. Classes are usually for all batches and start from 9:50 AM and end at 6:30 PM. There are also breaks of 2 hours and 1:30 hours. Hostels are fine, better than many other institutions. The quality of food is satisfactory. Medical staff are there for certain timings, but there are a few issues during nighttime. There is a SAC where students generally play snooker, chess, and table tennis.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are good and qualified, but the knowledge imparted by them is not at an industry (placement) level. The professor usually teaches on PPTs, but there are certain staff who follow the standard method of marker and whiteboards. The course curriculum is satisfactory. You need to work hard, it does not stand with industrial knowledge. The college follows the NEP curriculum, so the difficulty is average. 40% marks are needed in all subjects to pass and earn that much credit in the course.
detailed_review.Other: The semiconductor market is going to flourish in some years as the government is providing many aids, and many electronics companies from China are shifting their manufacturing to India. This creates a massive opportunity for engineers to get a good placement offer. The course is moderate to easy, and students find it interesting to go to labs and design different circuits. The labs are not open regularly. If it has some fixed timings, then it would help each one of us. There are three fests Effervescense, the cultural fest, Asmita, the sports fest, and Aproksha, the technical fest.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Great faculty, facilities - IIIT Allahabad.

detailed_review.Placements: The placements of our college were good enough for the students who are studying in our college. Around 96% of the students got placed. The average package is 29 LPA, 67 is the highest domestic package offered, and the highest international package that was given was around 1.4 crores per annum.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: IIIT ALLAHABAD B.Tech - Electronics and Communication has lecture halls/classrooms and labs that have air conditioning. The hostel is also well managed, clean, and equipped with high-speed Wi-Fi. The mess food is also decent and good. The canteen food is very good and has a lot of variety.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty of ECE is well qualified and has good research experience, and many are PhDs. Teaching is concept-focused with practical experience and project-based learning, so you are qualified and well fit for internships and jobs, and you won't have any problems.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Just satisfied, good placements, decent infrastructure, and good faculty.

detailed_review.Placements: 85% of students are placed in approximately. The maximum package offered is 83 LPA, the average package is 24.5 LPA, and the median package is 16 LPA. Top recruiters are Atlassian, Qualcomm, Postman, Phonepe, Google, Oracle, Adobe, Media. Net, and Goldman Sachs. Core ECE internship is 25%-30% and the total internship offer is 70%-80%. Mainly software roles are offered.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Well-equipped labs, smart classrooms with AC, and the central Library are decent, overall good. Sports infrastructure is good with a cricket ground, badminton courts, table tennis courts, gym, and swimming pool. Mess and canteen food are okay, and hostels are Wi-Fi enabled.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. The teaching quality is decent. The course curriculum is relevant and it makes it industry-ready. Semester exams are of a good level, some courses are difficult. Most faculty members in the ECE department are highly qualified and supportive, especially in subjects like VLSI, Embedded systems, and signal processing.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placement and decent college life.

detailed_review.Placements: This year, placement was good. Around 95% of students got placed. The highest package is 1.45 crores (all-time high), and 9 LPA is the lowest of this year, with an average around 30 LPA. Top recruiting companies are MAANG, Goldman Sachs, Oracle, Zomato, etc. From ECE, around 50% of students got internship offers in Google, Microsoft, Oracle, etc. Top roles offered are SDE.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms, library, and labs are good and have Wi-Fi and air conditioning. Wi-Fi signals are not that good, and there is a network problem on campus. Hostels are decent, but water quality is bad and have internet problems; you have to connect LAN for a good internet connection.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly qualified and knowledgeable but not that helpful. Some of them just cover their syllabus and do not care if you understand or not. Overall, you have to study from YouTube to get a better understanding. The curriculum is pretty hectic, and some of the courses aren't that useful, like Biology and Science of Happiness, but otherwise, the curriculum is good. Minimum passing marks are 40% in the end semester, which is quite difficult.
detailed_review.Other: I chose ECE because it gives you opportunities to go into both software and hardware fields and has a very good scope. There are some irrelevant subjects which are completely unnecessary for this course. The campus is not crowded, and you can play many sports. There are three fests: Effervescence (cultural fest), Asmita (sports), and Aproksha (technical).

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placements and campus, but teaching needs improvement.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80% of students got placed. The highest package offered was nearly 45 LPA, and the lowest was around 6 LPA. The average salary package offered ranges between 12 LPA - 13 LPA. Top companies like Qualcomm, Nvidia, and Intel visit here. Many students got internships in some big companies. Roles offered are like an engineer, and developer. I think this is quite good.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Department has Wi-Fi, labs and classrooms. But some labs do not have new equipment. Library is good with many books. Hostel rooms okay but are not always very clean. Mess food is normal, sometimes bad. Canteen is better. Medical facility is there, but not very fast. Sports ground is good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are qualified but not helpful. Some teach good, but some just come and go. Teaching quality is okay. Course has some useful subjects, but not for the industry. Semester exams are tough for many, and students need to study hard. Pass percentage is nearly 75 or 80%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose ECE because of my interest and good career scope. Best part is labs, and some subjects. Syllabus is old, and needs to be updated. Fests are fun, crowd is good, and campus is clean. Connectivity is average. More industry projects and internships should be held.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: IIIT Allahabad - Where code meets culture.

detailed_review.Placements: College has really best placement culture where almost 100% of students are placed. Students received top offers from top companies like MAANG where students received the highest package of 1.45 LPA, and an average package of 37 LPA. Apart from this, a lot of students received internship opportunities from top companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Academic wing is fully air-conditioned with lab and classroom equipped with modern facilities with 24X7 access to Wi-Fi services. There is one central library where you could find large number of books by almost every writer and research papers by researchers.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers of the college are highly knowledgeable and they have completed their Ph.D. from top colleges of India like IITs. They are really helpful throughout the entire course. Course covered in ECE are highly relevant as they have direct implementation in industry like digital design course offered by the college. Semester exams are not that much difficult and nearly 99% of the students pass the semester exams.
detailed_review.Other: Apart from academics college conducts every year technical, cultural, and sports fests. Cultural fest effervescence is conducted every year at end of October, technical fest Aproksha is conducted end of March, and sports fest Asmita is conducted at the start of April. I was keen to learn more about electronics and communication so I decided to choose my future in ECE. Here, professors are very good and they help everyone to understand things and apply them in a practical sense.

reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA)
reviews.review_title: The truth and nothing else.

detailed_review.Placements: The passion out batch of the year 2025, only 70 recent are placed on an average of 6-8 LPA. Offer. Our batch is still in its first year, and in a batch of 66 students, only 7-10 are still left for summer internship, the rest all have the offer in hand. Top recruiting companies are Wipro, Accenture, Tata, Microsoft, and many more.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good, fests and events happen a lot, the hostel and college campus both have free Wi-Fi, there's a good library, and subscriptions to some paid journals. The course is also updated to the latest industry standards, and proper lab classes are organised for practical implications.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very knowledgeable and experienced; one of my professors is an IIIM Ahmedabad passout. The courses are of industry standards. The semester exams are divided into 3 subparts mid sem and end sem, and an internal assessment consisting of 35 marks.
detailed_review.Other: The roi for MBA is good as far as feels amount is concerned, many extra-curricular activities are also organised, and these are also managed by senior students by asking the participation of junior students.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is the best B.Tech college in India.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are great. I found many of my seniors who are placed and very satisfied with their placements. Many international companies visit our campus. In 2023, 96.12% of our college students got placed which is quite impressive. The highest package offered is 82 LPA for an ECE student.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities in the hostel are very poor, and the quality of food is getting worse day by day. Facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and the library are good but can be improved. Medical facilities are bad, but there are qualified doctors. There is only limited time for consultation, and no proper medicine is available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. It is better not to rely on teachers. The difficulty level of exams is good, but they are not very easy. The pass percentage is more than 40%. Attendance is very important and recently, two students were punished for marking proxies.
detailed_review.Other: The reason for choosing this course is that it is the only good option left for me, but I don't regret it. I am loving the course. It was tough at the beginning, but it is going well now. Extracurricular activities are not that exciting here.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Amazing institute with more than 90% placements every year.

detailed_review.Placements: From the third semester, highly skilled students have a chance to crack on-campus interviews. Last year 103 companies visited and 1500 offers were made. The highest package is 1 crore, and the average salary is 30 LPA. 96% of students got placed and I plan on getting a chip designing job as I am in electronic and communication engineering.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: They provide an internet LAN, a table, a lamp, and a cupboard with enough space for 2 people. Mess is nice at first but then they diluted it and they are serving bad food now. Mess fee is hit or miss. Mess vendors are not good as mess food is sometimes pathetic and does not have very good quality food, it is still edible. On the other hand, the breakfast is very nice. I am very much satisfied.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are very good here. They make the concepts clear to everyone. You can do some great projects under some professors. In a semester, we have mid-semester exams, quizzes, and end-semester exams. The pattern is not that much different it's just like in our schools and subjective papers.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology
reviews.review_title: The college has good placements and wonderful infrastructure, but too hectic academics.

detailed_review.Placements: Last year more than 90% of students got placed. This year the number has increased. Top recruiting companies are Google, Apple, Microsoft, Zomato, Flipkart, Sprinkler, etc. Almost 50% of students got internships. Top roles offered are SDE, software developer, data analyst, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are top-class facilities available for my course, such as a computer lab and library. The campus includes smart classrooms, a smart library, and Wi-Fi is available on the entire campus. The quality of the hostel is not that good, it has decent rooms with well-ventilation. You can bring your cooler. The quality of the food is not good, but it works for me. There are almost all games played like lawn tennis, squash, snooker, cricket, football, table tennis, volleyball, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our teachers are very helpful and well-qualified. They are highly qualified. Their teaching quality is not like everyone could understand. Some of them are very good but some of them just are like roots. The course curriculum is very relevant as we started coding on day one and no unnecessary subjects are there. The course curriculum makes students industry-ready. Exams are quite tough and not so easy to pass. Many students get backlog exams every semester.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology (Business Informatics)
reviews.review_title: A brief about IIIT Allahabad.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are almost done. The average package is 34 LPA which is more than second gen IIT's. The highest package is 1.23 CPA. The average is 34 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Google, Microsoft, Oracle, Accenture, and TCS. 80% of people got internships. Top roles offered are developer, quant analyst, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our campus is equipped with fully high-speed Wi-Fi. Labs are well-equipped with modern equipment and a fully qualified instructor. Classrooms are super comfortable and equipped with centralized air conditioners, projectors, mics, and PCs. The library is well-equipped with each department's books, covering all the topics from programming to advanced AI ML. The quality of the food is very nice. We have one health centre on campus too which is open 24/7. We have one football ground and a student activity centre.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful and qualified. Every single professor is a Ph.D. holder in their field of teaching. The course curriculum is fully up to date which the industry demands. Semester exams are a bit difficult because of the level of teaching they provide and then they also expect it from us.
detailed_review.Other: I opted for this course over IT because it is more relevant to me in my aspects. Nowadays, people are getting more advanced in the AI era so business marketing skills are more important.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology (Business Informatics)
reviews.review_title: Whooping placements, good faculty, top-class infrastructure, and top-notch research.

detailed_review.Placements: Given the excellent work, our college's placement cell does, above 90% of students got placed in this academic year. The highest package is around 1.2 CPA. The lowest is around 5 LPA. The average package is around 30 LPA. Top recruiting companies include Google, Accenture, Adobe, Amazon, DeShaw & Co, Morgan Stanley, etc. Around 30%of students get internships from our course or college in companies like DeShaw. Top roles offered are software developed, product manager, and jnior executive.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Being an institute of national importance, the infrastructure is top-notch, be it the labs, classrooms, library, buildings, etc. All the labs are efficiently maintained and equipped with good-quality components and machinery. Our hostel is also above average. There is no doubt about cleanliness and the rooms have a bed, a chair, a table, and a cupboard. We also have a LAN connection in the room whose speed goes up to 500 Mbps and the whole hostel is equipped with high-speed Wi-Fi. The quality of food given in the mess is also at par with IITs. Variety is also good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers and professors are well-qualified in their respective fields and they are helpful as well. They have plenty of knowledge which you can gain by working on a project under them. Teaching quality is also relevant considering the modern era. The course curriculum is relevant and optimizes for industry readiness. The semester exams difficulty depends on the subject, for some they are medium and for some it's hard. The pass percentage is around 80%.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course and college because of the coding culture and whooping placements this college provides. Coming to my course that is IT-BI, the BI touch makes this course special as it is the only college which provides this course. It deals with business case studies and data analysis stuff which is unique in India. There is not much to improve about this course. According to me, it's fine. Various events are held from time to time like international workshops, sports meets, alumni meets, etc. Coming to fests, we have three major fests which are Effervescence, Asmit, and Aparoksha. Connectivity is good. Civil lies the place where students enjoy.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is the absolute best college for software technology and has the best average package.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 97% of students get placed each year. The highest and lowest packages are around 1.21 crore and 9 LPA, respectively. The average package is around 27 LPA for ECE and 33 LPA for the IT branch. Companies like Google, Microsoft, and others visit our campus for recruitment.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities like well-equipped labs and a good internet connection with a speed of around 150 Mbps are available. The quality of food is not very good for dinner, but the breakfast is good. Medical facilities are also good and available at all times, both day and night.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful but some are very strict regarding their course. Teaching quality is also so good and in labs tas are also so helpful which make the subject easy to understand. Semester exam difficulties are on another side because paper are very tough. Quizzes are conducted every week.
detailed_review.Other: I choose Electronics at IIIT Allahabad because of its highest average package and placements compared to other colleges. There is also a boom in the ECE sector in the upcoming years.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: The institute with great packages and nothing more.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 90% of students got placed with the average package of 20 LPA. IIIT Allahabad is on par with many IITs when it comes to placements. Although, some of them may be off-campus placements. The college has a really good coding culture thanks to the seniors, but it is deteriorating year to year.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is the same as it was when the college was established 25 years ago. They are being updated from time to time, but it is not enough to satisfy students' needs. The hostel infrastructure is good for a government-managed institute.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members could be better. Courses are more or less relevant. The college makes students take regular labs to make them field-ready or industry-ready. Semester exams are not easy. The teaching assistants do not really give marks randomly to pass students.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology
reviews.review_title: There are some things that are not good, but they are minor things. Overall, college is excellent.

detailed_review.Placements: At IIIT Allahabad, 90% of students get placed every year. The college places more priority on coding, which is one of the main reasons for its excellent placement record. This year, the highest package is over 1 crore, and the lowest package is around 15 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Google, Microsoft, and Goldman Sachs. Many students get offers from Google.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure here are good. Two persons are accommodated per room, but single rooms are also available, with different fee for both of them. Wi-Fi facility does not work properly, and the food quality is very bad. Non-veg food is not provided in the first year. The medical facilities are good.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teachers here are from IITs and have a PhD in their respective subjects. The teaching quality is excellent. The curriculum is updated every year, which helps make students industry-ready. In the semester, they conduct quizzes, a mid-sem exam, and an end-sem exam. These exams are very difficult.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Satisfied because of the infrastructure, good placements in 2024, and really good faculty.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 98% of students got placed in our course. The highest package was 1 CPA, the lowest was 4.5 LPA, and the average was 28 LPA. Top companies are Qualcomm, Nvidia, Cisco, Quantiphi, and ATP. Around 38% of students got internships from our course. Top roles offered in our course are VLSI design engineer, Web development, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We have free Wi-Fi in our hostel rooms and classrooms. Well-equipped air-conditioned classrooms, library, and labs with free Wi-Fi. We have a volleyball court, football ground, cricket nets, and outdoor badminton courts. Our Student activity center is also air-conditioned, in which we can play chess, Table tennis, carrom, etc. We have many societies for dance, music, drama, literature etc. The hostels are also maintained cleanly. Though sometimes they clean once in 2 days or 3 days. If we face any inconvenience, we'll just contact the warden. Honesty he will solve the problem as soon as possible. The food is also good and clean.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful and wise. However, few assistant professors may be disliked by students. But most of the professors are very good at teaching. The course curriculum is relevant to the course. The good thing is that our institute doesn't include a few unwanted subjects like Chemistry in our course. It surely makes students industry-ready. Few subjects like linear algebra are assumed to be difficult among students. But, the competition here makes it truly difficult to score high. The pass percentage is 40 in semester exams.
detailed_review.Other: Even if you choose ECE in our institute you will become good enough in coding as well. Because, unlike other institutes, here even ECE students spend much time doing coding after college. The seniors here guide us in our coding journey. Fests are also very good. The campus looks truly beautiful and very clean.

faqs.question: How to prepare for admission to IIIT Allahabad?
faqs.answer: The right approach and a preparation plan for admission to BTech at IIIT Allahabad is all that is needed to ace JEE Main. While students who are serious about getting into an IIIT start preparing from Class 11, a prep strategy for the exam is mentioned below:

faqs.question: How much rank should I score to get IIIT Allahabad?
faqs.answer: IIIT Allahabad accpets JEE Main score for admission to the BTech courses. As per the IIIT Allahabad cutoff 2023, the Last Round closing rank for BTech ranged between 5924 and 9558 , among which Information Technology was the most competitive specialisation. The Round 1 closing rank for BTech ranged between 4817 and 8428 for BTech. So, considering the previous year Round 1 and the Last Round closing ranks, candidates seeking admission to IIIT Allahabad must secure a rank over and above 4800 and 9600 for the General ALL India category candidates. Candidates can refer to the table given below to check out the 2023 Last Round closing ranks for IIIT Allahabad to get an idea of the ranks required for all the BTech courses offered at this institute:

faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

faqs.question: What is the expected JEE Main cutoff 2024?
faqs.answer: NIT Manipur JEE Main cutoff 2024 has been released for admission to the BTech courses. During the Round 1 cutoff, the closing rank for CSE was 25886 for the General category students under the AII India Quota. Among OBC candidates, the closing rank for B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering stood at 8750 . Candidates seeking admisison to NIT Manipur can refer to the table below to check out the Round 1 closing ranks for BTech in CSE course for various categories under the AI quota: Category JEE Main 2024 Expected Cutoff Common Rank List 90-91 Gen-EWS 75-76 OBC-NCL 73-74 SC 51-52 ST 37-38 PwD 0.0013527

faqs.question: What is the required percentile for admission in BTech at IIIT Allahabad?
faqs.answer: 90 is the required percentile needed to get a chance for admission in BTech at IIIT Allahabad. This percentile is great to get a seat at IIIT Allahabad. Moreover, a candidates need to be amongst the top 11,553 ranks. Please note that final selections are based on the cutoff of the respective academic year, category, and seat intake.

faqs.question: Can I get into IIIT Allahabad BTech course without JEE Main?
faqs.answer: No, there is no other way to get admission to BTech without qualifying for JEE Main. Candidates are required to visit the official website of NTA to apply for JEE Man entrance exam. Only the candidates with a valid JEE rank are eligible for admission. Further, JEE Main rank holders will be called for JoSAA Counselling process for the final seat allotment.

faqs.question: How can I take admission to BTech at IIIT Allahabad?
faqs.answer: To get admission to BTech course at IIIT Allahabad, candidates must fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria in the first place. The application process for admissions commences with the online registrations for JEE Main and ends with the exam results announced along with the merit list. The selected candidates are eligible for the process of document verification and seat allotment conducted by JoSAA or CSAB. Further, candidates selected during counselling process are allotted seats and branches as per their ranks..

faqs.question: I am getting a 6000 rank in JEE Main 2025. I want ECE at IIIT Allahabad. Is it achievable?
faqs.answer: In 2025, the JEE Main cutoff ranks ranged between 7228 and 9639 for the students belonging to the General AI quota. Therefore, if you belong to the General AI quota, the chances are higher for getting a seat for ECE at IIIT Allahabad.

faqs.question: What are the M.Tech specialisations in IIIT Allahabad?
faqs.answer: The institute offers MTech courses in four specialisations, including Information Technology (IT), Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), Bioinformatics, Data Science and Analytics. There are 10 sub-specialisations offered under the IT and ECE specialisations as well. The seat intake varied from one M.Tech specialisation to another.

faqs.question: What is the admission process for M.Tech at IIIT Allahabad?
faqs.answer: Candidates taking admission to an MTech programme shall have a valid BE/BTech degree in a relevant discipline with at least 60% aggregate (55% for SC/ST) from a recognised university. The candidates wanting to pursue M.Tech from IIITA need to take the GATE exam. Candidates with a valid GATE score are called for the CCMT Counselling rounds based on cutoff marks. Further, based on performance in the counselling round, seat allotment is carried out.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission to the M.Tech course at IIIT Allahabad?
faqs.answer: No, direct admission is not available for the MTech course at IIIT Allahabad. The institute admits students based on a valid GATE entrance exam score, followed by the CCMT counselling process.

faqs.question: What is the fee for the IIIT Allahabad M.Tech course?
faqs.answer: The total fee sums up to INR 2.58 lakh. Note the fee is taken from unofficial sources and hence can vary.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in IIIT Allahabad for MBA?
faqs.answer: To get admission at IIIT Allahabad, students must have a valid score in CAT/ XAT/ CMAT/ MAT/ GMAT. The institute offers a two-year full-time MBA programme for which the final selection is based on students' performance in a Group Discussion and Personal Interview round.

faqs.question: How much CAT score is required for IIIT Allahabad?
faqs.answer: Candidates with at least 80 percentile can have a good chance of getting selected for an MBA at IIITA. However, the cutoff marks change every year and hence it can vary. The students who have appeared for other management exams such as XAT/CMAT/MAT as well can submit their best scores at the time of form filling.

faqs.question: What is the cutoff for MBA at IIIT Allahabad?
faqs.answer: Admission to the MBA course is on the basis of CAT/XAT/CMAT/GMAT/MAT, followed by a personal interview (PI) round. The selection procedure is completed and carried out as per the IIIT Allahabad criteria. The institute has not released the official cutoff for the MBA course. Candidates seeking admission to the MBA programme should qualify for the basic eligibility criteria, which is a bachelor's degree of a minimum 3-year duration with at least 50% aggregate or equivalent CGPA (45% for SC/ST category students).

faqs.question: How can I apply to get admission in IIIT – Allahabad?
faqs.answer: The admission is entrance-based at the institute. Aspirants are required to apply with a valid score of the course-specific accepted entrance examination in order to apply. The accepted entrance exams are JEE Main, CAT/ XAT/ CMAT/ MAT/ GMAT, GATE, etc. Further, the seat allotment process for BTech and MTech is through JoSAA and CCMT counselling, respectively.

sections.heading: Introduction
text: The institute is equipped with distinct facilities, which is crucial for a student. Look at the facilities accessible at IIIT Allahabad campus below.
For more information about IIIT Allahabad - Indian Institute of Information Technology Infrastructure check out the below videos:
list: Library:The library has a collection of the latest technological books, journals, etc. Students can reach the library for reading and the issuance of required books.

Hostels:There are separate boys and girls hostels. The boys hostel has a capacity of 240 students, whereas the girls hostel has space for 60 students. A single room is allotted to a student, equipped with a 24-hour power supply, a mess, sports, etc.
Medical Facility:The campus has a health care centre with various medical facilities for the students.
Guest House:There are 40 air-conditioned rooms for the guests of the students.
Sports Facility:A 500-seat sports complex is built inside the campus where events like cricket, football, table tennis, etc. are organised from time to time.
Labs:Different laboratories are available for different departments to facilitate the students with practical knowledge.

facilities.name: Library
facilities.description: The library has a capacity to accommodate up to 150 students at a time, rich repository of more than 50000 books, 2000 CDs equipped with drivers, online resources, and journals, electronic library, E-media section of the library has 50 computer systems and is largely meant for facilitating e-reading amongst the students and also subscribed to a large number of online resources such as journals and other publications such as IEEE, Emerald Insight, ACM, Springer, Science Direct among many others

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description: Hostels are available with Air-conditioned mess and common room facilities along with an experienced caretaker round the clock for any emergency situations. All kinds of recreational facilities including basketball, badminton court, table tennis and gymnasium have been provided in both the hostels. Night canteens within both the boys and girls hostel premises facilitate the dietary requirements of the students after the normal dining hours.

highlights.summary:
Indian Institute of Technology Goa was established in 2016 by the Ministry of Human Resource and Development (GoI). This famous college, through seven schools of study, offers UG, PG, and PhD courses to students. The courses are offered across Engineering and various other streams. IIT Goa provides a unique learning experience to students so as to prepare them to become responsible managers, leaders, entrepreneurs, and professionals.
Indian Institute of Technology Goa offers placement assistance to students. Indian Institute of Technology Goa is visited by top companies such as Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Intel, Goldman Sachs, and others. Indian Institute of Technology Goa has a central library which was started in 2016. The library has a collection of books such as reference books and textbooks. IIT Goa has been ranked 101-150 under the 'Engineering' category by the NIRF Rankings 2025.
Indian Institute of Technology Goa has experienced faculty members. The faculty are qualified and are well-trained. IIT Goa offers BTech and MTech courses to students. Located in Goa, this reputed college has collaborated with Raja Ramanna Centre for Advanced Technology (RRCAT Indore), Goa College of Engineering (GEC), and others. reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Really satisfied because 2023 placements are very good.

detailed_review.Placements: There are 45 students in my course. The highest package offered by my college in the past year was 1.2 crore. The average package offered by my college for placements is around 24 lacs. The recruiting companies for my course are Texas Instruments, Google, Microsoft, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: For my course in my college, there are many facilities, like an electrical workshop, a welding workshop, and also an Ideas room. The hostel was very nice; it looked like a hotel. There are many medical facilities available in my college.
detailed_review.Faculty:
The college faculty helps us a lot while we are studying. The way the faculty teaches is so good. In my college, the semester exams were slightly difficult, but the faculty is so helpful to the students when we are studying. In my college, there is relative grading.

Other
detailed_review.Other: In my college, there are many fests and cultural activities. My college is providing remission of fees for Scheduled Tribes and Scheduled Castes students.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Satisfied with the faculty and good placements in past years.

detailed_review.Placements: 34 students were placed in my course. The highest package of IITGOA was INR 60 LPA, the average package was INR 20 LPA and the lowest package was INR 7 LPA. Google, Amazon, etc. companies were offering jobs. 85% of the students got internships from my course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The Wi-Fi facility was available for 24 hours. And the teacher-student interaction was good. Also, the teachers were very supportive. The mess food was good, with different varieties and the medical facilities were also too good. They provide an ambulance for emergencies.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers were very helpful and supportive. The teaching quality was good. The secondary exams were moderate in IITGOA. The pass percentage was calculated by the top mark. Most courses have relatively low grades. The time gap between the midterm and the endterm was 2 months.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mathematics and Computing Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of IIT Goa - Indian Institute of Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 97-99% of students get placed. The highest package is 60 LPA and the average package is 17 LPA. Almost all of them got top companies like Amazon, Google, Infosys, Microsoft. The lowest package offered is 6 LPA. Few people got internships abroad.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available 24/7, labs are air-conditioned, classrooms also have AC. I can't say that they are the best classes but they have the required amenities. Hostels are quite good, they have most facilities compared to remaining IITs. Mess food is not so bad, not so good. Sports equipment is completely available.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are so good, they help us a lot, they are so knowledgeable. Curriculum is totally semester-based. Exams are a bit hard; mostly the pass percentage will be 20-30, not more than that. Feels like exams are hard, I don't know why. Curriculum makes us ready for the industry.
detailed_review.Other: Personally, I like Maths a lot so I chose MnC here. Events and fests are not so frequent like other campuses. I hate that a lot.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: A review of a student at IIT Goa.

detailed_review.Placements: Percentage of B.Tech students placed at IIT Goa in 2023 was 99%. In B.Tech 2023 placements, the highest package offered was INR 60 LPA and average package offered was INR 17.19 LPA. In 2023, Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Intel, Goldman sachs are the top recruiters at IIT Goa.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There is Wi-Fi availability in the campus and hostel as well. Labs, Classrooms, Library are quite good. There are no issues with facilities provided in the hostel. The mess food is good which follows a menu. There is a canteen near the mess and there are also medical facilities, sports and games.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teaching quality is understandable and the teachers are very supportive. The course curriculum has some concepts which will be helpful for students to get into the industry. The difficulty level of the semester exams in the college is medium to hard.
detailed_review.Other: I liked the course curriculum which provides many concepts that are helpful to get into tech industry.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placements and campus life.

detailed_review.Placements: Our college has the highest placement percentage, i.e., 98% to 99%. The highest package received by a student here was around INR 1.12 crore, and the average package is INR 18 LPA, which is very good for any engineering college. The companies that come here are very well known and large, like Google, Microsoft, Accenture, Amazon and around 200 other companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure here would be described as average, but there are enough for a good time in the hostel; the classrooms and library are good for a medium number of people as the strength of the college is low; however, the campus and hostel are temporary considering there will be discussions for the building of a permanent campus soon; sports and games facilities are okay for average students. There are all major sports playgrounds in the hostel itself, except for cricket and football.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are well qualified (most of them have a Ph.D. and high experience in research) and helpful in most of the cases throughout the semester! The syllabus and curriculum were very interesting and engaging, but most of the time you would depend on some external sources for mastering the course. I guess that would be the same case in all the engineering colleges.
detailed_review.Other: The events in our college are not very high; I guess that is because, considering the strength of the college, it is very low, around 800, 900. So there are very few cultural activities and festivals, but as the campus is in Goa, we can enjoy enough of the beaches, parties and other tourist places that we go to on a weekly basis through local public transport or renting a bike or car with friends.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Fully satisfied with My College.

detailed_review.Placements:
Everyone who has applied for the jobs are placed with good packages. The highest package was around 34 LPA. The lowest package was around 12 LPA. Average package was around 16 LPA. Microsoft, intel amazon, Deloitte, sprinkler are the Top Recruiting companies offering good jobs. Around 60 percentage of students got internships 
.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Internet services are good. We have wifis as well as Lanes. We have one library where wide range of books are available. We have excess of classrooms. We have labs for different departments. Our Hostels have good water facility. Proper security. Food available in the mess is good for health as well as Tasty. Food available in canteen is not that expensive. It is affordable. Tasty. We have dispensery which has many of the facilities. Many of the sports ar played here like cricket, Foot ball, basketball, Volleyball, TT, Batmentonetc.
detailed_review.Faculty:
Our teachers are highly Qualified, they have good teaching skills. Teaching Quality is Extremely Good. Yes this course curriculum makes the student ready for jobs. Semesters are not that difficult. Papers are of Good Level. Faculty members provide a lots of assignments for the practice. Conduct ought session for every assignments
.
detailed_review.Other: I was Interested in Electrical Appliances so I took this course. This course is the Future of upcoming World. This course has wide scope in the future. Mostly everything is okay with the course we do not require any other changes. Campus provides scholarships as well as remission in fee based on the parental income of the student. Every month one or two cultural activities take place.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Best government college. Less fees and great return. Reputed institute.

detailed_review.Placements: In my branch, the placement rate is 100% since this IIT has been established. The highest package was INR 1.12 cpa, which was international and was placed off campus, while domestic was INR 60 lpa. The top recruiting companies are Bosch, Paytm, Google, etc. Since I am in my first year, I don't know much about internships, but as I have heard, you get about an INR 30 to 40k stipend.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We don't have our own campus, but a GC campus. We reside on the GC campus. We have only five lecture halls and a small library made in a bungalow. About medical and Wi-Fi, it's very good, and the mess food is the same as others; it's not very bad or top-notch.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers here are educated at renowned universities and have very good teaching experience. And if we talk about CSE, it's one of the most respectable courses in this current generation. The exams are tough, as it is IIT, and there is no scope for copying, cheating, or passing.
detailed_review.Other: If you are thinking of joining this IIT, you will not enjoy your four years of journey but definitely will enjoy your next 40 years as it has one of the best placements compared to 3rd generation IITs.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: The Journey of Learning at IIT GOA.

detailed_review.Placements: This college has a high package of around INR 1.12 CR, and the lowest package is about INR 8 LPA. The average package at this college is about INR 17 LPA (which is good enough), and the average package for my mechanical course is about INR 15 LPA. Around 98% is the placement rate at IIT Goa. Various companies have reached out to this college to give us a great placement offer. Also, various companies would provide us with an internship opportunity.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for the mechanical engineering department includes various labs like the chemistry lab, the physics lab, etc. As per the hostel facilities, IIT Goa has well-equipped hostel facilities for students. There are separate hostel blocks for male and female students. All rooms in the block are double occupancy, with provisions for study tables, beds, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: All teachers are well-qualified and intellectual. And the quality of teaching is excellent. This course might be non-relevant in the initial days, but as time goes on, its relevance should increase. This course helps students become industry-ready. In the initial days, the semester exams may be difficult, but as you go into the second or third semester, their difficulty decreases. If you score around 7 or above CGPA, then you will be able to get a placement.
detailed_review.Other: I genuinely had an interest in mechanical engineering. The best thing about the course is the facilities provided by the college. All labs are well-equipped with various instruments. Here, too, many fests and events have been hosted. This college also provided us with various scholarships, like Aspire scholarships and more. In this college, various sports events are also hosted. And if you are selected for any sports like football, swimming, basketball, or badminton like that, you have a chance to play with other IITs.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mathematics and Computing Engineering
reviews.review_title: IIT Goa-Inside Talk by a student.

detailed_review.Placements: About 97% students get placed every year. Our the highest package is 1.12 crore and average package is about 18lakh. For computer Science, the average package is 27 Lacs. About 200 companies visit our institute which also include top companies like google, Microsoft, facebook etc. Mnc course being in a huge demand has led to the placement of all the students in this course.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Since we do not have a permanent campus, we are based on the campus of GEC college. But apart from that, we do have our own hostel block which has all the facilities a student needs. Clean rooms with cleaning room service. Very fast Wi-Fi in hostels.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty is great in IITG. They professors are very friendly as well as great teachers. They TAs are very approachable as well because of their friendly behaviour. They help with every doubt in person as well as on emails. Exams occurs twice in a semester. Mid sem and end sem along with a quiz with every exam.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: IIT Goa Inside Out: Through a students view.

detailed_review.Placements: The CDC of IIT Goa is strong enough even though its an 3rd generation IIT. In CSE 100% students were placed. Top Recruiters included accenture, intel, bosch, amazon, google, delloite any many other top MNCs. The Career Development Cell of the institute supports and mentors the students right around from 3rd year by providing the accurate knowledge of what industry requires and the CDC also ensures most of the students get 6-month industry or research internships with great stipend.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All the classrooms have state-of-art facilities. Each class has digital teaching equipments required for teaching technical subjects of course. Also the classes are comfortable with ACs installed in each class. Even though the college is still situated in its temporary campus the library has all the books required for all the subjects. The institute also provides access to few digital books too. The Hostels are also clean, well-facilitated. Other required facilities like Clinic, stores, food are there on a walking distance from Hostel. Hostel and classrooms all have wi-fi with a decent speed. The most important topic of accommodation is food. The Quality of food in mess is nice. The menu is also diverse making all students feel home at the campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is well qualified with great knowledge and experience of working in the industry along with their great research journals accepted by top organizations of world. Their teaching technique is also perfect for students, which includes tutorials, assignments, projects, etc. Over the semester. There are also teaching assistants provided to get help on the subject. The curriculum is well up-to date and has the topics important for working in the industry and the value of curriculum is proved by the placement results. The Exams are well structured and guarantee continuous assessment of students including 2quiz,1midsem,1 endsem exam. The exams are not much difficult as they have relatively grading and studying according to the professor or required notes and books ensuring good grades in graduation.
detailed_review.Other: Campus crowd is supportive and ensuring growth, harmony and pace. Here in IIT Goa there is healthy competition in every field ensuring your growth. There are many fests all over the year. However there are two Main fests one cultural fest called cultrang and one technical fest called cepheus. The Connectivity is good, the nearest airport is on a 1-hour drive, railway station at drive of 30 minds. There also great sports facilities. There are many scholarships and financial aids for need students.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of Indian Institute of Technology, Goa.

detailed_review.Placements: Most of our batch students get internships in top companies with high salary packages. Our roommate got an internship at Oppo. All branch students are doing coding because coding is very important to get a high salary package.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Hostel is very good. All rooms are very good and one room is allotted for two boys and the same for girls. All classrooms and the library are good. Our campus is fully enabled with Wi-Fi. Mess is very good and it serves food 4 times a day.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers in our college are very good. Some courses are difficult but students manage with the help of teachers. Teachers and TA are very helpful.
detailed_review.Other: I chose mechanical engineering because of my interest. Students whose parents' income is less than 1 lakh will get a fully refunded tuition fee and students whose parent's income is between Rs.100000 to Rs.500000 per annum will get more than half a refund of the tuition fee. Our campus is not much crowded.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mathematics and Computing Engineering
reviews.review_title: Our college has good placements and hostel.

detailed_review.Placements: Placement is excellent with 90%. The highest salary package was above 1 crore per annum and the minimum salary package was around 20 LPA. Various types of roles were offered. Many companies visited for placements and internships including Texas Instruments, Microsoft, and Code Nation.
detailed_review.Infrastructure:
Sports equipment is great. The food is nice. No permanent campus yet. Hostel is small but awesome. Labs and classrooms are excellent. Library has a good collection of books and magazines. Medical facilities are excellent
Canteen is very far from hostel.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty is excellent and passionate and involved in various research and projects frequently. All the courses are very difficult and not so industry-oriented but a few courses are very useful. Semester exams are very difficult. Scoring a good CGPA is very hard.
detailed_review.Other: Events and fests are conducted at a great level. Excellent peer-to-peer learning takes place here.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: I am not satisfied with the faculty and infrastructure but placements are improving year by year.

detailed_review.Placements: In the mechanical engineering department, out of 30 students,  23 students registered for placements, and 23 students got placed. Top recruiting companies are Microsoft, Tata Advanced Systems, IFB Industries, Jio, Mentor Graphics, Mathworks, and Sankhya sutra labs. The highest salary package offered is 18 LPA and the lowest salary package offered is 7 LPA. For internships, out of 34 students, only 11 students got internships in which 1 is an off-campus internship and 32% of students got the internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is too small but good as we don't have our own campus. The classrooms are good but there will be no air-conditioner but in labs, we have an air-conditioner. The library present is also small but its very useful. Wi-Fi is available on campus with a good speed but there occurs some issues during power cuts. Hostel rooms are good and the quality of food can be rated 3.5/5. There is also a canteen near which is of GECs. The medical facility is good. They are very caring and for sports and games, the infrastructure is small but good enough to have fun. We have 1 volleyball court,1 basketball court, 3 badminton courts, and also there is a big ground nearby college called Gymkhana where we can play cricket. There is an indoor stadium for badminton and other indoor games like carrom, etc.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers in our college are very helpful. They are also highly educated but I think online, the teaching quality has been decreased. It is very relevant and they make us get our hands-on experience with some machines and also due to internships, we get completely trained. The exams are difficult compared to other normal colleges. We get deep knowledge of our subjects. Pass percentage is very good as all our students are good in education.
detailed_review.Other: I have chosen this course as I am interested in mechanical stuff and also one of the reasons is my JEE rank (9843). I think there is nothing to improve other than the quality and way how our professors teach. There are many events conducted like Culturang, Chakravyuh (for sports), etc., Scholarship is provided only for reservation candidates, and also extra cultural activities like singing, dancing, acting, art, and literature are purely encouraged. There are clubs like Mukhota, Ordino, Eunoia, and Qalam.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Poor infrastructure of the temporary campus, excellent faculty, internships, and placements.

detailed_review.Placements: The average salary package offered for CSE is 23 LPA and the median salary package offered is 21 LPA. Various roles are offered by almost 100 companies including Paytm, Microsoft, Meta, and Wipro which visited the campus. About 90% of students got internships in Texas Instruments, Code Nation, and other companies.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus has poor Infrastructure as there is no permanent campus yet. Very less strength and a small hostel are available. There are frequent power cuts and Wi-Fi issues. The food quality is not bad and canteen is far from the hostel but excellent medical facilities. Sports and gaming facilities are quite good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teaching quality is very good compared with other IITs according to my knowledge. Teachers are qualified and experienced as well. Institute offers a good amount of electives that make us explore the field we want and get industry-ready. Exams are difficult. The pass percentage is good but gaining good grades is very tough.
detailed_review.Other: Fests held online were a great success but when offline, fests of our college lack behind because of the infrastructure.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Compared to all 3rd generation IITs, our college is really good.

detailed_review.Placements: The average package offered is around 7 LPA, but students in ME usually prefer higher education or give the GATE exam. Almost 75% of students got internships. Some companies from Germany come here to hire. In the latest batch of ME, the highest package offered was 19 LPA, and the lowest package was 3 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: High-speed Wi-Fi facility is available, and the library has many books. The mess food is good to eat, unlike what we hear from others that the hostel food is not so good. Sports facilities like badminton, table tennis, lawn tennis, basketball, cricket, and football are available.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are knowledgeable and have expertise in their subjects. The course curriculum is relevant. 8 CPI is considered good, and exams are not much difficult as you come here after giving JEE Advanced, so everything is simple compared to that.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering
reviews.review_title: This institute is one of the dream institutes, IITs.

detailed_review.Placements: The pioneers' batch is still in its third year right now. So, there are no placements conducted yet. However, we are expecting really good placements as the mentor institute is IIT Bombay. The first placement session will be conducted in 2020. Students have applied to various famous companies like CERN, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: We do not have a permanent campus as of now. However, the college has its own newly constructed hostels, mess, lawn tennis court, basketball court, and volleyball court. Hostels are new, really good, have lots of facilities, 2 seater rooms, and geysers in washrooms. There are 4 hostels as of now which have 3 floors each. There are well-furnished courts and a humongous mess.
detailed_review.Faculty: Many of the faculty members are from IIT-Bombay, and the follows course curriculum followed is of IIT Bombay's. The top faculty members from IIT Bombay often visit to deliver special lectures. Some of the new faculty members of IIT Goa are a little inexperienced in teaching. The course content is common for the first two semesters and is as according to IIT Bombay's course curriculum.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is one of the best colleges in India.

detailed_review.Placements: There are pretty more chances of getting a placement as the alumni of older IITs have already come and said that they will be hiring from here. Also, the placement cell has some really experienced people, so I would say it will be easier to get a placement here.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Earlier we were living in the hostel of GEC, but now that IIT Goa has its own hostel and lecture rooms, we will be staying there. But we are still staying on the GEC campus. I think it would take almost a decade to get a new campus for IIT Goa students, but right now we are staying in the GEC campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the faculty are newly appointed, and they have a lack of experience. But it doesn't mean they are not good, they are also one in thousand, and they are really trying hard to make this institute eminent. It will take time, but soon we will be comparing this college with other renowned colleges.
detailed_review.Other: Since the college is located at the top of the hill, there is a transportation facility every time. Bikes and scooters will be available for rent, and one can also take a lift.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: Still developing institute.

detailed_review.Placements: Till now there has been no placement. Our batch will be first to get placed in 2020. placement cell is in development. Internship was provided by college to approximately 30 student within college and outside intustry. Those were mostly unpaid internship. Yet placement cell is forming.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Till now there is no permanent campus. We in hai campus. Wi-Fi gives speed up to 5 to 10 mbps. Labs are not well setup. Not all equipment and facilities are present. Medical and classroom facilities are moderate not up to standards. There are interested and classroom related issues. Food in canteen are good enough. Hostel rooms are moderate but we will be shifting to new hostel this year with all facilities.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some teachers are highly qualified and some are not. Its due to lack of faculty some are adjusted. No special teaching methods just school system and projector.1:6 will be ratio faculty to student. Yes we got industrial exposure for the first time this year. Yes curriculum is beneficial.
detailed_review.Other: There are interdepartment and hostel fests. No big fest of its own. Scholarship is provided to underprivelage and backward class student. Sorrunding is eco-friendly. There is sports coach and facilities in extracurriculum.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering
reviews.review_title: The best place to explore engineering.

detailed_review.Placements: Our first batch will pass out in 2020, so the campus placements have not yet started. But, we do have an internship and placement cell which is combined. We are under the mentorship of IIT Bombay, and we are getting help and support from them for this purpose. Currently, almost 40 second-year students out of 85 are going to do an internship under different faculty members and companies here. We are getting an invitation for interns from different institutions like IIITs, IISER, and other research institutes.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Currently, we are living in our temporary campus situated inside GEC (Government engineering college), Goa. Our new hostel is almost built and will start functioning from July. Currently, we have a medical dispensary and facilities of vehicles for getting you to nearby hospitals if needed at any time. The classrooms are big enough to accommodate 100 students at a time, and we call it our lecture hall. We have Wi-Fi facilities (normally 2-3 Mbps and maximum 10 Mbps). Currently, we have a football ground and nets for cricket practice. We have an indoor stadium for badminton and a common room where you have table tennis and carrom. We are sharing the gymkhana with the GEC college and have separate timing. The library has a good collection of reference books, novels, and weeklies. Labs are good and have sufficient systems in it. We have our mess inside our hostel, and the food is good, we conduct mess meeting every month to discuss the menu. Currently, we are four students in one room, and it is spacious enough, not congested. We didn't have any issues related to infrastructure, and we have our hostel secretary who takes care of this time to time.
detailed_review.Faculty: We are under the mentorship of IIT Bombay, so currently, the professors from IIT Bombay take the classes for us, and we are following their curriculum. They are really helpful and support us throughout our course. They conduct doubt clearing session separately. We had an industrial visit, and they took us to research centers. We were taken to national oceanography research center to get an idea about the instruments we studied in our course. They follow the teaching method that students should interact more and explore more, thus making us self-sufficient. Our course curriculum is really good which actually give us a great opportunity to explore more and go deep into the course.
detailed_review.Other: We had our sports events called Flock this year, and we participated in the sports fest of IIT Bombay and BITS Goa (Spree). Currently, we don't have any cultural fest, we just participated in the cultural fest of BITS, Goa and IIT Bombay. Actually, it is a pretty beautiful place, and we are on the top of a hill. The sunset here is something which is very beautiful to see. Scholarships are provided to many students every year depending on their family income and on many other criteria. Each year, we accomodate 90 students on our campus, and the best thing is we know each other because it's very small in number compared to other IITs.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Really good Infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost all students were placed in our department, as the computer branch had the highest number of vacancies. The highest package was also offered in our course, which was 42 LPA. The average package was around 10 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Google, Amazon, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Wi-Fi was available on the college campus. The library had a huge collection of quality reference books. Labs were well-furnished, and the quality of the hostel was also good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers were helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. The teaching quality of our faculty members was extremely good. The course curriculum was relevant and made the students industry-ready. The semester examination was quite tough, and around 90% of students passed.

faqs.question: Which is best course of IIT Goa?
faqs.answer: IIT Goa offers BTech courses in four branches viz., CSE, EE, ME and MnC. Deciding the best branch among all the branches depends on various factors that are important to candidate. Some of the important point to consider while deciding the best branch of IIT Goa are mentioned-below: 1. Placements Opportunities: The common perception among students is that CSE has good placements among all the branches of Engineering. Before making the decision, it is important to look at the branch-wise placements of that particular college. Same applies to IIT Goa! In 2024, a total of 161 recruiters participated in the placement process and placed 116 students of BTech and MTech in new-age job profiles. The branch-wise placement details of IIT Goa placements for the Class of 2024 are presented below: Branch Median Package (2024) Average Package (2024) CSE INR 13.50 LPA INR 16.15 LPA EE INR 15.63 LPA INR 15.18 LPA ME INR 10 LPA INR 12.37 LPA MnC INR 15 LPA INR 18.61 LPA So, the placement stats of 2024 shows that the highest average package was offered to MnC branch followed by the CSE branch. 2. Cuttoff: The common criteria upon the branch selection at IIT Goa is the cutoff required for admission. Looking at the IIT Goa cutoff (Round 1), CSE is the most competitive branch with a 2024 Round 1 closing rank of 4654 for the General category candidates. CSE was the most aspiring branch of IIT Goa in the last year. Take a look at the IT Goa branch-wise cutoff 2024 with a comparison to 2023 and 2022. Branch 2022 2023 2024 ME 11209 11060 10653 CSE 3729 3498 4654 EE 7815 7902 7944 MnC 5214 5364 5803 3. Future Perspective: The third important factor of deciding the best branch of IIT Goa is to think about the long-term goals. If someone is interested in CS and have a passion for it, then choosing CS is a good option. CSE has a good future , but it’s stressful for those who don’t have interest in it. If a candidate has strong command on Mathematics, then combine Mathematics with Computers Science. Mathematics and Computing Engineering ( MnC) branch at IIT Gaa trained students in Algorithm Development, Data Analytics and Scientific Computing . They have lots of opportunoties in the current market as well as in the future.

faqs.question: Which is best course of IIT Goa?
faqs.answer: IIT Goa offers BTech courses in four branches viz., CSE, EE, ME and MnC. Deciding the best branch among all the branches depends on various factors that are important to candidate. Some of the important point to consider while deciding the best branch of IIT Goa are mentioned-below: 1. Placements Opportunities: The common perception among students is that CSE has good placements among all the branches of Engineering. Before making the decision, it is important to look at the branch-wise placements of that particular college. Same applies to IIT Goa! In 2024, a total of 161 recruiters participated in the placement process and placed 116 students of BTech and MTech in new-age job profiles. The branch-wise placement details of IIT Goa placements for the Class of 2024 are presented below: Branch Median Package (2024) Average Package (2024) CSE INR 13.50 LPA INR 16.15 LPA EE INR 15.63 LPA INR 15.18 LPA ME INR 10 LPA INR 12.37 LPA MnC INR 15 LPA INR 18.61 LPA So, the placement stats of 2024 shows that the highest average package was offered to MnC branch followed by the CSE branch. 2. Cuttoff: The common criteria upon the branch selection at IIT Goa is the cutoff required for admission. Looking at the IIT Goa cutoff (Round 1), CSE is the most competitive branch with a 2024 Round 1 closing rank of 4654 for the General category candidates. CSE was the most aspiring branch of IIT Goa in the last year. Take a look at the IT Goa branch-wise cutoff 2024 with a comparison to 2023 and 2022. Branch 2022 2023 2024 ME 11209 11060 10653 CSE 3729 3498 4654 EE 7815 7902 7944 MnC 5214 5364 5803 3. Future Perspective: The third important factor of deciding the best branch of IIT Goa is to think about the long-term goals. If someone is interested in CS and have a passion for it, then choosing CS is a good option. CSE has a good future , but it’s stressful for those who don’t have interest in it. If a candidate has strong command on Mathematics, then combine Mathematics with Computers Science. Mathematics and Computing Engineering ( MnC) branch at IIT Gaa trained students in Algorithm Development, Data Analytics and Scientific Computing . They have lots of opportunoties in the current market as well as in the future. Not satisfied with answer? Ask Shiksha GPT

sections.heading: Introduction
text: IIT Goa has a vibrant infrastructure which caters to the needs of students and helps in their academic growth as well as holistic development. The institute is keen on improving its infrastructure from time to time to meet the needs of modern-day education. Looking at the campus structure of the institute, there is an Admin Block, which is the heart of the campus, Offices of directors, dean and registrar academics, along with some professors' cabins are present in the building. Apart from the Academic Block, there is a Mahalakshmi Bungalow, which is the centre for IT services in IIT Goa. Let's dive deep into the IIT Goa campus infrastructure in this article:

sections.heading: IIT Goa Campus Highlights
text: The campus of IIT Goa is located in the Guleli village in North Goa's Sattari sub-district, and is spread across an area of 320 acres . The campus is picturesque, surrounded by greenery. The campus has smart classrooms, which are fully equipped, and labs with the latest equipment, a well-stocked library, and hostel facilities for boys and girls. All the departments are provided with well-maintained equipment and are fully furnished. Given below are a few highlights of the campus, and for a more detailed view, read further:

tables.IIT Goa Campus Highlights: Guleli village in North Goa's Sattari sub-district
Smart Classrooms, Labs, Library, Hostels, Sports Facilities and more

sections.heading: IIT Goa Academic and Research Facilities
text: IIT Goa is known for academic excellence, one of the reasons for which is the infrastructure, which makes sure that the students are offered an atmosphere where they can learn, interact and grow. The classrooms of the institute are fully furnished and provide comfortable seating, and are fully air-conditioned. There are Smart Classrooms that are modern well well-equipped to enhance the learning experience of the students.

The labs have various Departmental Labs such as Mechanical Engineering's Solid Mechanics Labs, Fluid Mechanics Lab, Mass Transfer Lab, etc. The labs provide facilities for various manufacturing operations such as drilling, grinding, and laser beam welding. along with chip and force analysis. Similarly, the institute has dedicated labs for every department.

The institute features a Seminar Hall, which is used for conducting the institute's cultural activities, such as Independence Day, Republic Day, and students' festivals like CultRang. Seminar Halls would mostly host such events or be supplemented by other multi-purpose spaces on campus.
Academic Block:

sections.heading: IIT Goa Hostel and Residential Facilities
text: IIT Goa has four hostel blocks : three blocks (Block B1, B2 and B3) for male students and one block for female students. All the rooms in these blocks are on double occupancy and have 80 rooms. Each of these blocks offers basic amenities like a study table, storage, internet connectivity and washing machines . Water coolers and dispensers are available on every block. The hostels have a Badminton Court, Basketball Court and Tennis Court for students interested in sports activities. There is a large dining hall where food is served on a menu basis.

The cleanliness of the hostels is maintained across all the blocks by housekeeping staff. The security of the hostels is taken care of by the Campus security. Thus, cleanliness and security are highly taken care of by the institute. Have a look at the hostel room in the picture below:
