sections.heading: IIT Goa Library
text: The Central Library functions as the primary learning resource centre, facilitating print and electronic resources for teaching and research activities at the institute. Apart from textbooks and recommended reading materials prescribed for each course offered at the institute, the library houses a growing collection of reference works, handbooks, non-fiction books, Hindi books, and so on. The library facilitates access to electronic journals through the ONOS (One Nation One Subscription) initiative.

The Central Library of IIT Goa is a member of the Developing Library Network located in New Delhi. Since it is a member of DELNET, the research community of IIT Goa can utilise the services and databases of the same. It can have access to millions of Networked Library Resources. The services provided by DELNET include- Resource discovery through DELNET databases, Inter Library Loan & Document Delivery Services, Reference Services, Resource sharing among all the Networked Libraries through DELNET

sections.heading: IIT Goa Sports Facilities
text: IIT Goa, as one of the premium institutes of the country, not only focus on academics but also on sports. There are various sports events taking place throughout the year, including intra-hostel events, Chakravyuh, and active participation in the Inter IIT Sports Meet. The institute has infrastructure for both indoor and outdoor games. These sports not only improve the general physical fitness but also help in building psychological attributes like leadership qualities, stress management and group dynamics. text: IIT Goa is located in Ponda, which is near many beautiful destinations such as Shri Mangues Temple , Shri Mahalsa Temple , Arvalem Waterfalls , and the Dudhsagar Waterfalls . Students can also explore North Goa, which has beaches like Baga, Calangute, and Anjuna, Fort Aguada, and Chapora Fort .

highlights.summary:
Established in the year 2008, Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University (JNTU) is a public university in Kakinada that has both AICTE and UGC approval. It also has NAAC 'A+' accreditation. According to the NIRF Ranking 2024, JNTU Kakinada is ranked 101–150 in the Engineering Category. The college is situated in Andhra Pradesh's Kakinada, East Godavari District. The campus occupies 110 acres in total. It has three constituent colleges: University College of Engineering Kakinada, the University College of Engineering Vizianagaram, and the University College of Engineering Narasaraopet.
courses like BTech, BPharma, MTech, MPharma, MSc, MCA, and MBA are offered by JNTU Kakinada. It also provides five-year master's programs that gives dual degrees. JEE Main, JEE Advanced, and GATE entrance exams are used in JNTU Kakinada admissions to determine the merit list. The university offers university-level entrance exams for admission to programs such as MSc, MS Research, MS, MBA, PGDNT, External PhD, MSc, MSc, MSc, MSc, and Part-time MTech. APICET, TSICET, AP EAMCET, and AP PGECET are among them. The final round cutoff rank for the General Home State quota during the JNTU Kakinada MBA Cutoff 2024 was 1300.
Two students from the ECE and CSE branches took advantage of the biggest package JNTUK Placements 2024 has offered so far which was INR 35 LPA. Additionally, INR 16.3 LPA was the second-highest package given during the 2024 JNTUK CSE placements. JNTU Kakinada has established several MoUs with national and international organisations for academic exchange programmes and research initiatives. JNTU infrastructure features a library, an auditorium, conference or seminar rooms, guest accommodations, dorms, a canteen, computer labs, internet and wifi, a bank, and a fire station. reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: I am very satisfied with our college. Placements are good.

detailed_review.Placements: 70 percent of the students are placed in our course. The highest package offered is 44LPA and the lowest package is 3LPA. The average package offered is 7LPA. Top recruiting companies include Amazon, Accenture, Infosys, Wipro, Capgemini, TCS, and NatWest. 30 percent of the students got internship from our course in the NATWEST company.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The labs are very good but some systems do not work. Some labs are good Wi-Fi is also available, we can use it whenever needed for college purposes. Classrooms and the library are also very neat and silent books are available whatever we need, they are available and we can use them wisely if we want.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teaching quality is excellent. Teachers are qualified and knowledgeable, they interact with the students solve doubts and will have many interactive sessions. The course I have chosen is curriculum relevant it makes the students industry ready. The difficulty level in semester exams is moderate and the pass percentage is 35 percent.
detailed_review.Other: I have chosen this course because it is the leading course in the industry.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good info to join the college rather than spending more on universities.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80 percent are in my course and the highest package is about 22 LPA, the lowest is about 3 LPA, and the average package is 6 LPA. The top recruiting companies are Tech Mahindra, Accenture, etc. Around 80 percent of students got internships from my course in Tech Mahindra and other companies. Top roles offered in my courses are programmers and developers.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available for my course are good and Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms and library are good and comfortable for us without any break. We can do everything we do in a good and planned way so we do not have any distractions while we are doing work and food is also very hygienic.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, qualified and knowledgeable. They are teaching us to clarify doubts. They mostly work on our doubts explaining in a new way so that we can understand semester exam in college is difficult. If you are not prepared you will pass only if you are prepared so you have to understand that you will pass only if your passed no chance to pass in any other way.
detailed_review.Other: The course is in demand you I have selected it, it is worth joining the course. As per my knowledge everything is going well, nothing needs to be developed events, fests, campus, connectivity.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
reviews.review_title: Our college is only for women.

detailed_review.Placements: 85 percent of students got placed. The salary package offered is 5 to 6 LP. Our college's top package is with Tech Mahindra, TCS, Wipro. Coming to placements, our college is in the last position because no proper courses are taught in our college. This should improve at our college. There are two colleges, SRK Institute of Technology and Vijaya Institute of Technology for Women. They give the most preference to SRK.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is there, but for laptops, we should take our own phones. The labs are okay. The hostels are great, but the canteen doesn't offer good, healthy food. Sports are not conducted properly. Medical facilities are available in a good manner. Overall, facilities are very good except for a few things. Everything is good, but our college is very small, and that is my only regret.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our teachers are very helpful, and the teaching is also very good. Not at all ready because there is no proper practice for interviews, and no one in our college is interested. Since our college is only for girls, we don’t know how to interact with boys. The pass percentage is 25 percent. I think semester exams are not too difficult.
detailed_review.Other: AI is the future, so I hope this is the best and trending technology course for the next generation. I chose this course because it’s trending in the market, but I don't think that my course will get any better. Everything is good; events and fests happen, but I think the campus crowd is less compared to other colleges, so I believe my college should improve.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good faculty, placements, and infrastructure.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are huge, so many students are placed, around 200 students are placed this year. Google, Infosys, TCS, etc., companies are hiring students from this college. Faculty and placement officers work hard to welcome companies to the college.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure are very good, students learn so much in practice rather than in the classroom, so it's the best place for that part. There is a big library, a lot of books are there, the hostel is very good, and the safety they provide is excellent, the food is also good.
detailed_review.Faculty: There are a lot of courses available, as per B.Tech CSE, ECE, Mech, and EEE, other than these, MCA, MBA, and M.Tech are also available. They offered numerous courses with good faculty. In B.Tech, every six months, one semester happens. 99 percent of students passed in the semester exams.
detailed_review.Other: Computer Science and Engineering is the best course here to join.

reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA)
reviews.review_title: Students are friendly and nice in college.

detailed_review.Placements: The highest salary package offered is 10 LPA and the lowest salary package offered is 3.5 LPA. Almost 78 percent of students got placed. The top recruiting companies are Microsoft, Google, Infosys. The top roles are database administration and web development. Around 65 percent of students got internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good around the campus. The campus is spread over 30 acres of space. The classrooms are big and neat. The labs are good. The Wi-Fi facility is also available. The library is good. The hostel facilities are good. The canteen is also available. The medical facilities are good.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty members are well-qualified and knowledgeable in our college. The teachers are very friendly and helpful. The teaching quality is good. The course curriculum is relevant, and it makes students industry-ready. The semester exams are difficult, and 60 percent is the pass percentage.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: It's good on the whole but the quality of placements in the current year 2026 is satisfactory.

detailed_review.Placements: My college has a placement percentage of around 40% till now in my course. The highest package is 6 LPA, and the lowest is 2.4 LPA. One of the top recruiting companies that come to my college is Renault Nissan (a manufacturing company). Around 10% of students got internships, and the companies are Zepto, Thermopads, Zen Technologies, etc. The top role offered in my course is VLSI and embedded engineer at present.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure of my department are top-notch. They include good Wi-Fi, lab equipments, classrooms, clean washrooms, drinking water, and also an excellent library for learning. There is an issue regarding the campus hostels' food which is very unclean but now they offer quite good food only. The canteen, medical facilities, and sports are also top-notch.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are highly-qualified, very helpful, and also qualified. The teaching quality is so pure. Students gain very good knowledge from their lectures. This course curriculum is relevant, and makes the students industry-ready. I don't feel very difficult in semester exams, the difficulty rate is 10% or maybe not that too if we concentrate on lectures and don't waste time. The pass percentage is around 70%. The faculty in my department are very friendly and easy to interact. They help to clarify students' doubts.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I feel I am connected to it. I also love interacting with hardware components, and chose to do so under my sister's guidance. The best thing about my course is interacting with hardware components, and also sometimes software. The things I wish would be improved about my course are maybe having more practical knowledge than theoretical knowledge. My college is known for events, fests, and extra activities other than academics. Connectivity, campus crowd, and surroundings are good but scholarship is still not allotted by the government to few batches.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: There are average placements for us.

detailed_review.Placements: For our batch, which is the 2026 batch, on average, till now, 20 to 30 percent of students have been placed. But many are not satisfied because most of the companies are non-IT companies, but students are expecting IT companies to get placed and show their skills. I don't remember the highest package, but the lowest is 2.5 LPA. We have only one top MNC company, which is Infosys.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure and facilities like labs, library and classrooms are good. I am not a hostel student, but what I know from my friends is that the hostel is good with healthy food and good security for girls. But there is no proper Wi-Fi in our college.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful to students at any time, and they are knowledgeable, too. Not 100 percent curriculum makes the students industry-ready, needs some changes and gets updated along with the world technologies. Semester exams are not so difficult.
detailed_review.Other: Scholarships, campus crowd and campus surroundings are good, but there are fewer events, festivals, and extracurricular activities in our college compared to other colleges.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning)
reviews.review_title: Recently these days, college is improving its placements.

detailed_review.Placements: College is good for engineering. But the locality is quite poor. Regarding college and placements, it is a good college. In 2024, 1400+ students are placed. The highest package is about 54 LPA. During 3rd year itself, placements are started. You can get even more internships.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Campus hostel is very good. But it is overpriced, which is about 120,000/annum. Food is very good in campus hostel. You can also find private hostels near college, and its fee structure is about 5k to 6.5,000 nearly. You can find options in this range. College is good.
detailed_review.Faculty: Depending on the branches, the college has its faculty. Most of them are doctorates. Faculty is friendly in few branches, and in some branches, if you are friendly with them, they will be good to you. Most of the faculty share their personal life even with students.
detailed_review.Other: It's a good college for convenor quota. But don't come through this college by management, especially.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of AITAM College for the CSE course.

detailed_review.Placements: In our college, the placement staff is good, but the number of students who got placed in the office campus was less. Up to now, i.e., January 2026, 35 percent of students got placed, and it may increase further. The majority of students got placed in Infosys. The highest package offered is 16 LPA. The average package offered is 7 LPA, and the lowest package offered is 3.6 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are separate classes for every section in each course. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus. We have a good central library which has a huge capacity for people. The food available in the canteen is good. I don't know much about the hostel because I am not a hosteller. We have a health centre on campus.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members of the CSE course are too good. They explain very clearly. Faculty members available in our course have a good knowledge, and their teaching is good. Semester exams in our college are tough, but if we plan to prepare, we can easily pass exams.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering
reviews.review_title: At the end of college, every student loves and miss the college very much.

detailed_review.Placements: Recently, we attend CTS, which is Cognizant, and our college expects a good number of students to get selected in that company. The college helps students a lot to crack jobs in the company. Getting jobs is beneficial for both the college and students.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our college contains only three blocks and is a small college group. So the infrastructure of the college is not that good, but the systems in the college are better for seniors. Recently, the infrastructure of the college has changed a lot. The college management works on it.
detailed_review.Faculty: In our college, only a few faculty have good knowledge and experience, but a lot of faculty are demanding. The way they teach students is not good. When we talk about the curriculum, faculty teach only what they know. Sometimes, faculty leaves some syllabus. This is about some faculty only, not all.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is a nice college with good placements.

detailed_review.Placements: Almost 85% percent of students got placed. The highest salary package offered was 12 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered was 3 LPA. faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria to get admission into MBA course at JNTUK?
faqs.answer: Andhra Pradesh State Council for Higher Education (APSCHE) is responsible for conducting MBA admissions in Andhra Pradesh. 95% of government and private management colleges in Andhra Pradesh accept state-level entrance tests score for MBA admission. Therefore, it is mandatory for MBA aspirants to secure a valid scores in APICET. faqs.question: Does JNTUK offers MCA?
faqs.answer: Yes, Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University (JNTU), Kakinada does offers MCA programme that lasts for three years. The MCA is spread across six semesters covering core subjects such as  IT-related subjects like application development, mathematics, data mining, programming languages, etc. MCA Course at JNTU Kakinada includes the study, project work and applications on major softwares and technologies such as Microsoft Visual Studio 6.0, Novell Netware 5.1 Server, Novell Netware 4.1 Server, etc. Read on to know more about the JNTUK MCA programme. Admission is based on ICET (Integrated Common Entrance Test) and qualifying the eligibility criteria.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Very Satisfied, good studies, good environment, good location, and decent crowd.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are excellent, and overall, the training and companies visited are good. The coding culture is, I guess, less active otherwise. If you join the clubs, then it'll be sorted out. Placement and internship opportunities depend more on your efforts if done properly. 12 LPA is very easy to get if you're from CSE in 62.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The campus is not so big, like three buildings in which 1 is a hostel, but properly maintained with all facilities, with smart classrooms, and good food by Annapurna. The sports facilities are okay, and they have three entry gates and a parking area, 1 auditorium in JBS.
detailed_review.Faculty: The SDF exams are very difficult, they are most difficult in terms of private colleges. If you are opting for CSE, learn coding beforehand. Other subjects are okay, but you need to study for at least 2 weeks before exams. 1 all-nighter will barely let you pass. The curriculum is good.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mathematics and Computing
reviews.review_title: Good Infrastructure and Placements

detailed_review.Placements: Well, a good amount of students were placed in the course. The highest package went for 95 LPA, and the lowest is around 4 LPA. The average is going near around 10 LPA. Top recruiting companies include LinkedIn, Zomato, and Google. Top roles offered are data scientist.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure and connectivity are pretty good. It is directly located at Noida Electronic City metro station; thus, it is very easy to travel to. Hostels are also very good. Every single hostel has 2 rooms and AC as well. Classrooms are good, Wi-Fi is good, and I love the library.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty is very good in teaching their subjects. The curriculum feels up to date, and exams are also a treat to do. There happen to be 3 exams in the college: T1, T2, and T3. T3 is the end semester. They are respectively of 20 and 35 marks. Teachers are very helpful.
detailed_review.Other: I chose this course because I had interest in the Mathematics and Computing branch.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Jaypee could be a better option than other private colleges.

detailed_review.Placements: Most people do get placed but the package is a little less. But it is still better than other colleges. The average is around 9 LPA and the highest goes up to 60–70 LPA. Internship scene is not so good, but this year Google, Zscaler, Cisco took 2–4 students each with very high stipend. Google is giving 1.35 Lacs per month.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are clean classrooms, well-equipped labs, huge library, overall campus Wi-Fi and hostel Wi-Fi (with limit), medical facility, psychological counselling, cafe, and huge common mess. The college lacks in sports facilities, but as a technology college I will say that it is fine.
detailed_review.Faculty: The faculty is nice, syllabus is updated time to time, classes are held regularly. The exams are very difficult but there is relative grading which makes things a little easier. The subjects are practical-based and a lot of projects are involved in curriculum.
detailed_review.Other: There is only one fest in a year, otherwise only small tech events. The crowd is okay as the admissions are merit based.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Jaypee Noida review by CSE under graduate.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements here are very decent. Big companies come here, and many students come here only because of the reputation of the college due to its great previous placement record. Almost 90% of the students get placed but at last only if the students add effort he/she will get placed.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Infrastructure here is very good. All the classrooms, labs, washrooms, and canteen are available. Every place is very clean and hygienic. You will not face any difficulties with cleanliness and hygiene. The whole campus is Wi-Fi enabled. The labs have the latest technology.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teaching quality here is very good, and teachers here are very helpful and knowledgeable. They also help students after class both offline and online, as they are all highly qualified and skilled in their subjects. The exams are a bit difficult but if you have studied well, it will not affect you.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics Engineering (VLSI Design and Technology)
reviews.review_title: A very good college in terms of private colleges.

detailed_review.Placements: Jaypee Institute of Information Technology (JIIT) Noida offers excellent placements for CSE students, especially at the Sector 62 campus. Top companies like Microsoft, Atlassian, Google, and Amazon visit regularly, with the highest package reaching 62 LPA. The average package is around 11 LPA, but this is primarily for CSE. Students from ECE and other branches often struggle with core placements and rely on IT roles. The college is strict, with a disciplined academic environment but a limited extracurricular culture. Overall, it's a great choice for dedicated CSE aspirants but may not offer equal opportunities for other branches or those seeking vibrant campus life.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The mess food is average and hygienic but repetitive, and many students prefer outside food or canteen options. Overall, JIIT is a good option for serious CSE students but less ideal for other branches or those seeking a relaxed college experience. It's okay.
detailed_review.Faculty: The college conducts very hard and frequent exams, 3 times. Some teachers are very learned and good, but a lot of them just read PPTs, and that's it. They are also not very open to ideas and questions, and are not as engaging teachers as one expects in a college.
detailed_review.Other: Fest is very cheap, and so are other programs in this college; no real or even slightly known artist is being called, the fest ends before people can enjoy it, and it is not very well managed.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics Engineering (VLSI Design and Technology)
reviews.review_title: Good placements but boring college life.

detailed_review.Placements: I am in the first batch of my course (B.Teach EE-VLSI), so there is no placement percentage for my course yet. However, other students who specialized in VLSI as an elective or had relevant skills have secured good internships and placements. Companies such as STMicroelectronics, Cadence, and Intel. The highest package for the 2025 batch is around 46 LPA, and the average package is around 8.5 LPA. The roles offered include Embedded Systems, VLSI Design Trainee, Hardware Engineer, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Medical facilities are good, and the mess is better compared to most colleges. The cafe is nice at first, but you get bored easily because it doesn't offer many good options. The classrooms and the library are also really nice. The Wi-Fi restricts apps like WhatsApp and Amazon. The network in hostels is very limited. First-year hostels are nice, but from the second year onwards, the quality starts to degrade little by little. Wi-Fi connectivity isn't very nice. It can be very frustrating, especially during exam season.
detailed_review.Faculty: The course curriculum is relevant. Teachers are quite variable, but many of them are not very good at teaching, so you have to study on your own for many subjects, or you can go to other teachers who might explain the topics better. Exams are unnecessarily frequent. We have three exams in total, and as soon as one ends, there are lab tests, evaluations, or projects going on, which get very exhausting.
detailed_review.Other: Fests are not all, and only one event, called Ethnic Night, is hosted, so there are not many events actively organized by the college, mostly those conducted by college hubs. I am in the EE-VLSI JIIT’27 batch. I chose this because it is a rapidly growing industry with a lot of scope, and the exposure that JIIT Noida provides in this degree is really good because lots of hands-on experience is given.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Satisfied with the college, except for the campus area, which is hardly 16 acres.

detailed_review.Placements: Talking about my course, the placements were more than 100%, meaning there were more offers than the students who qualified based on the CGPA criteria , the eligible students. Top companies were Goldman Sachs, Atlassian, Google, Amazon, Uber, and Microsoft. The highest package was around 53 LPA, with the average being 9-11 LPA, while the median was 7.5 LPA. Top roles were software developer.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Our course includes all the subjects required. But there are some subjects that lack practical knowledge, just like the other colleges. Hostels here have common washrooms. Rooms contain 2 beds and 2 almirahs. But the most important thing is the friends you make. Talking about sports, there aren't many facilities; no cricket or football ground, while you have a GYM along with a badminton court and a separate Squash Room. Table tennis is present inside the Hostel.
detailed_review.Faculty: Although most of the faculty is good, there are some who seem least interested in teaching. But there are many who want you to succeed; you can reach them anytime, whenever you face difficulty. They are helpful. Exams here would be easy for you if you solve all the tutorial sheets provided by teachers. Many questions are similar.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: I'm not satisfied with the mess food at all; it's horrible.

detailed_review.Placements: There are good placements, a well-maintained campus, and supportive faculty at college. Around 80% of students in my college got placed, which is quite decent compared to other private colleges. The highest package was about 28 LPA, the lowest was around 3.5 LPA, and the average package hovered around 6-7 LPA.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The college has well-equipped labs, air-conditioned classrooms, good Wi-Fi in academic areas, and a central library with a large collection of books and e-resources. The hostel rooms are clean and maintained regularly, with 24/7 water and electricity backup. The mess food is average, better than some other hostels, but repetitive sometimes. There are multiple canteens and food stalls inside the campus offering a decent variety.
detailed_review.Faculty: Most of the faculty members are qualified (many hold PhDs) and are quite approachable for doubts or project guidance. The course curriculum is updated regularly to match industry trends, but you still need to learn extra skills on your own. Semester exams are moderately difficult, with around 90% pass percentage if you study consistently.
detailed_review.Other: I chose ECE because of my interest in circuits and systems. The best part is campus discipline and a clean environment. I wish they could improve mess food variety and increase the number of core companies for branches other than CS/IT. The total fees for my four-year B.Tech course, including tuition, hostel, mess, and other charges, were around Rs. 20,00,000-25,00,000.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with best experience.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are very good. I am from B.Tech CSE and just completed my 6th semester. The college already provided me with a one-year internship. Almost 30% of the students have been placed by now. The companies coming are very renowned and offer a great package to a great number of students. The companies include Microsoft, STMicroelectronics, Amazon, Omniful, Google, etc. The roles offered are software engineer, hardware intern, product intern, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The building is great with a very nice and comfortable infrastructure. Free Wi-Fi is there on whole campus, labs are equipped with all the necessary materials that too in a sufficient amount to meet all students' needs, and classrooms have centralized AC and also projectors which almost every teacher uses to teach. Library is the best with no noise and a great amount of books. The food in the cafeteria is so nice with 100% hygiene.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are very helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. They help us in every possible way to be industry-ready and also be the best version of ourselves in life. The teaching quality is nice as the material provided by them helps a lot. The course curriculum is completely irrelevant and related to the industry. Also, the sequence of subjects is also very nicely structured. The semester exams happen 3 times in a semester. The difficulty is moderate. You can easily pass the course if you pay attention properly in the lecture. Teachers are also great and the material provided by them is also very helpful.
detailed_review.Other: Connectivity is so great as teaching talks keep happening very frequently. Fest is also nice. Tech events are also very good for upskilling. Campus is surrounded by great cafes and restaurants so you can easily go grab your favourite meal.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of Jaypee 128 sector.

detailed_review.Placements: 70 percent of students were placed in B. Tech CSE. The highest salary was 20 LPA with an average of 3 to 4 LPA. Top recruiters included Amazon, TCS and EY. Most roles were development or analyst positions. 60% secured internships, though college support was limited. Roles included developer, analyst and QA. Some students landed decent jobs but many ended up in repetitive or low-responsibility positions.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi and labs are satisfactory while classrooms are average. The library is good. Hostels are nice but the mess food is bland. Sports facilities exist but are poorly maintained. Medical assistance is available and efficient. Classrooms could use some renovation. The college infrastructure isn't exceptional; it's a single building college. The surrounding area needs improvement.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some teachers are helpful and appear qualified, but teaching quality varies. All instructors use PPT exclusively. The curriculum is efficient as it focuses on important subjects and seems industry-ready. Exams are tough, making it difficult to maintain a good CGPA.
detailed_review.Other: The fees just increased after my graduation, making them less affordable. It's charging more than SRM. The fees are high, and the quality does not fully match. As previously mentioned, infrastructure and placement could improve to justify the cost. It's an average investment. Campus life was fun only because of students as the college doesn't have anything to be enjoyed by students. Fests happening in another main branch seem better than ours.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placements but bad college life.

detailed_review.Placements: Despite the slow placement season for all. The college had pretty above-average placements, as many top companies like Adobe, Amazon, and Google came and gave offers up to 42 LPA, and the second highest of 28 LPA, which is pretty great and up to the standards, which is nice.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: I am in the 128 sector branch where the infra is very below par. There was some construction going on, and also the size of the cafe was so small that it became congested during heavy hours. On top of that, MPH, the multipurpose hall is always occupied with some cultural activities, so there is no place to hang out in the college
detailed_review.Faculty: Exams are one of the worst parts, as every subject used to have 3 exams, and labs had 4 evaluations per semester. On top of that, you also have to submit projects, assignments, etc., which makes the schedule very hectic and unenjoyable. In my experience, college life is pretty bad at this college.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Review of students' perspectives.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements are pretty decent here we have got batch of 30 students (named f18. This year in college, the average package is 10 LPA and the lowest package is 8 LPA. The highest package of the college is 40 LPA this year. CSE and IT courses only have good placement records.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: All classrooms are fully air-conditioned, and labs have all the necessary equipment. The quality of the food is good. Sports facilities are limited and have a small ground. There is one MPH in my college where the college conducts all events.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some faculty members are well-experienced and have done the graduation from prestigious institutions like IIT and NITs. Some of them are PhD holders and if we need any type of help from the faculty members then they will be the ones to help us. Some faculty members are bad.
detailed_review.Other: Placements are good in the CSE and IT branches only. If students want to join Jaypee, then they can look at these two branches.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: My college experience from a student's perspective.

detailed_review.Placements: We are a batch of 30 students (batch name f5). Almost 75% of my batchmates got placed with decent placements of 10 LPA. The highest package of my batch is 24 LPA and the lowest is 5 LPA. MNCs visit the college to hire students from our college. Internships in my college totally depend upon our skills. Companies do come to hire students for internships also.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: There are two campuses of my college, one is situated at 62 sector Noida and one is in 128 sector. I was in the sector 128. The campus area at the 128 sector is pretty small compared to the 62 sector. Classrooms in my college are air-conditioned and labs have all equipment. There is one lab in my college named Atal Lab I think. It also has an innovation hub.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers in my college are experienced and some of them are from the precious institution like IIT and NITs. Some of them are PhD holders, and some faculty members are very helpful here. Some are just very pathetic, and they just are there for cutting marks in every aspect if any discrepancy is found from our side.
detailed_review.Other: I chose CSE because placements are good in it. If students want to join Jaypee then they should only think about the CSE and IT courses. There is one new branch also named Mathematics and Computing, so I don't know much about that branch. There are some events and an annual fest which are conducted every year. The campus is very good, and there are 2-3 scholarships.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good infrastructure, but the campus is small. Placements are good in terms of a private college.

detailed_review.Placements: I am in B.Tech CSE at JIIT Noida, sec 62. Above 90% of students are placed on campus. The average package is 10 LPA, and the median package is 8 LPA. The maximum top companies visit the campus for placements. The top role offered in our course is the SDE role. Mass recruiters also visit our campus.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of JIIT campus is quite modern and very good. Wi-Fi is above average. The library is available and very good. The location of the campus is in the middle of the city, and everything is available near the campus. Medical facilities are also available. Sports facilities are not good. The hostel is above average.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are quite good, experienced, and also qualified. The curriculum for the course is also very good, and it includes those topics which are relevant for the industry. Exams take place 3 times a year: 20, 20, and 35 marks respectively, and 25 marks are for internal assessment. They are of average difficulty, and if you study in lectures, then you can score in the exams easily.
detailed_review.Other: The campus size is small, and sports facilities are not so good, but the location of the campus is prime, so everything is available near the campus. The fest is not so good. Many malls are available near the campus. The college supports government-supported schemes and scholarships.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Above average and I don't like much.

detailed_review.Placements: About 90% of students got placed among my seniors. The average package is about 11.8 LPA. The lowest package is 3 LPA. Most of the students placed at about 5 LPA packages. Many top companies visit here but recruit very less students. Paid internships are available. Still its okay types.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: It's about average. But infrastructure is not upto mark. I think they should improve. Many students placed at low package. Campus has 128 acres of land and does not even have its own hostel. Students have to travel from sector 62 to sector 128 which is very bad.
detailed_review.Faculty: All are average. Teachers are okay and helpful. Curriculum is also okay. Semester exam difficulty is high. Still not sure about the pass percentage I think about 25%. Attendance requirement is 70 which is compulsory otherwise you will be debarred from that course. Faculty members are okay.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Good placement state but negligible extracurricular facilities.

detailed_review.Placements: Placements at JIIT are pretty decent and scale up depending on your skills. Really good companies like Amazon and Google do visit the campus. From the recent placements, 91% were hired, and the top package went up to 70 LPA with an average of 25 LPA, which is very good.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Facilities at JIIT are up to the mark, considering the latest technology-equipped labs, Wi-Fi in the library with peaceful surroundings, and classrooms with smart boards, fully air-conditioned. Hostels have an entertainment room, gym, playing area, etc. There is also a grocery store for daily needs and laundry. For medical assistance, there is a dispensary with doctors on duty. About the food, it is mixed of some taste very good, while others are average but still eatable. The only thing lacking is the sports facility, which is negligible.
detailed_review.Faculty: Some teachers I encounter are so friendly and actually want to help, whereas some just come to do their jobs. They don’t care if you study or not, so you will have to do everything on your own. It does make students industry-ready, as they also have English and human values classes. Semester exams are mid but not that difficult to crack if you study. Some people do get back if their CGPA is relatively low, though.
detailed_review.Other: Events and fests are minimal, though the vibes are good. There should be more, as JIIT is mostly academically focused. There are many clubs and societies to join as well. The attendance criteria are 65-70%, but they don’t entertain medical leaves, which is a con.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: It is a good college for placements.

detailed_review.Placements: The placement percentage of this college is very good. Around 80% of students have been placed till now. Many students got great packages from big companies like Atlassian, Google, Walmart, Amazon, Infosys, IBM, Cisco, etc. The average package offered in my course ranges from 6-7 LPA. The top recruiting companies for my course are Genpact, Rohde & Schwarz, and Samsung. Around 60% of students got internships in companies like STM, Rockwell Automation, etc. Top roles offered are GET, technical analyst, R and D intern, etc.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is quite good. There are good-quality classrooms and labs. Labs have great experiments stuff. Recently, a new fabrication lab has also been added for VLSI enthusiasts. The campus structure is quite phenomenal along with lots of trees and plants. The library is quite spacious and peaceful. It is equipped with every type of book a person needs for study. The hostel is good, and rooms have enough storage space. The quality of food in the mess is better than other messes.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members are helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. The teaching quality is good. The course curriculum is relevant, and it does not make students fully industry-ready. Semester exams in this college are up to the mark and the pass percentage of students is quite high.
detailed_review.Other: The electronics and communication course is a practical field as it provides students to do hands-on work and thus it's quite good, so I chose it. The practical implementation if done along with theory can be quite helpful for future students, but it can be improved. There are good technical and non-technical events done in our college. The campus crowd is decent. The connectivity of the college is really good, as it resides on the main highway with a metro station and many other things in reach. There are various clubs in college for extracurricular activities.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication (Advanced Communication Technology)
reviews.review_title: Good faculty members and infrastructure, superb fest.

detailed_review.Placements: My batch is the first from this domain so we don't have any previous placements records. It has been mentioned that we are eligible for all opportunities given to core ECE students. Moreover, our college have a tie-up with Ericsson especially helpful to my branch as we can avail their courses for free on an yearly basis.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Libraries are mostly stocked sufficiently. The library known as LRC is one of the best places in the whole college with built sound-resistant rooms for meetings. My course has a specially built government-aided 5G lab. Classrooms are not very comfortable as most of them are metal benches and right arm support. Canteen is fine at best, there is nothing out of ordinary in the canteen menu, except dal makhani. Unfortunately, not many sports facilities are available in sector-62 campus. Only a basketball court and a couple of badminton courts are available.
detailed_review.Faculty: The concept class teachers are excellent. They explain everything in detail. The course coordinator is also very helpful. I am pretty sure the courses make us industry level to a sufficient level when it comes to 5G and Telecom. The exams are based on tutorial sheets which are discussed in tuition classes. However, the tutorial teachers sometimes find it difficult to get a point across.
detailed_review.Other: I do not like to code and the course seems interesting so I decided it's the best I can get for my interests. The college can certainly improve the fests. Around Rs. 700 are charged from the fees for fests but fests lack that pump. The artists are mostly never heard of. The friends are what makes the day fun, and satisfactory efforts from the college are hard to see. For a private college, with these fees, I believe JIIT is one of the best institutes in terms of placements and infrastructure.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering
reviews.review_title: Great infrastructure but hectic life.

detailed_review.Placements: I am in the first batch of my course which is EC with a specialisation in advanced communication technology but it is similar to core ECE with more focus on communication subjects. It is quite beneficial in placements too. The placement will be quite similar to core ECE too and approximately 90% of students got placed in that branch, so it can be expected it will continue. There are a bunch of multinational companies recruiting from this college. In this branch such as Qualcomm, Intel, Ericsson, etc., offering packages of 8 LPA+.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Classrooms are very well-built with an overall positive feel. We have a lot of labs for pretty much everything and a library with a large seating capacity. It has a wide range of books and computers for studying. There are also discussion and meeting rooms in the library. Hostels are great, but maybe a little expensive and small. The food in the mess is great with changing menu everyday. We have 2 outdoor badminton courts, a basketball court, and a volleyball court with a very big grass lawn. Wi-Fi is limited. It is 3GB per day.
detailed_review.Faculty: Teachers are helpful in every way possible and very qualified from many prestigious institutions. The teaching quality is great. They guide us on how to get knowledge in certain fields and teach us what's important in placements. Semester exams are very difficult. It is quite hard to maintain a good CGPA here. There are 3 examinations in a semester with marks distribution as 20, 20, and 35, the rest is given by the teacher.
detailed_review.Other: There are many things that need to be improved here like a revised examination pattern as there's very little time for students to work on other things and skill building and many more. Fests are great and very enjoyable. The campus is quite pleasant and lively.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering
reviews.review_title: Feel free to replace any college with Jaypee Institute of Information Technology.

detailed_review.Placements: Around 80 percent of students are definitely placed in computer science. The highest package is around 70-80 LPA and the average package for CS is 9 LPA which is a decent package. The top recruiting companies are Amazon, Deloitte, Accenture, Intel, and Microsoft.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The hostel is okay, and the mess food is sometimes irritating, but it is far better than at other colleges. They provide a gym and a swimming pool. Sports facilities are limited. The cafe is nice, and the dispensary is available 24/7, which is a great thing. Labs and classrooms are also nice.
detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty members at this institution are highly qualified, with most professors holding Ph.D. degrees and advanced research in their respective fields. The curriculum is designed to equip students with the skills they need in their respective fields. The examination system is fair and challenging, but there are too many exams held here, as we have exams every month.
detailed_review.Other: We have around 26-30 students in one batch, and two batches attend classes together. The thing I want this college to improve is its sports facilities and examination system.

college_info.college_name: Jaypee Institute of Information Technology Admission 2025: Eligibility, Application Process, Fees

faqs.question: Does JIIT offer direct admission for any course?
faqs.answer: Yes, admission to the JIIT Noida courses is entrance-based as well as merit based for certain courses such as BBA. There is no provision for direct admission, but candidates can get admission to the merit based admission process courses just by filling out the application form. However, for JIIT Noida M.Tech admission, the institute offers direct admission to candidates with an overall CGPA of 7.50 out of 10. Those students are exempted from GATE or other entrance exams and are eligible for direct admissions.

faqs.question: What are the JEE cutoffs for BTech at JIIT Noida?
faqs.answer: JIIT Noida BTech cutoff 2024 was concluded after the JEE Main Round 5 Seat Allotment result, followed by an additional two rounds of CSAB counselling. The cutoff was released for admission to the BTech, Integrated BTech , and BArch courses. During the JIIT Noida BTech cutoff 2024 , the last-round closing ranks varied between 59706 and 129809 for the General AI category students. Talking about the branch-wise cutoff, the most sought-after course in 2024 was B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering with a cutoff rank of 59706 , followed by B.Tech. in Mathematics and Computing with 65698 .

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission for B.Sc course at JIIT Noida?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates are provided direct admission to the BSc course at Jaypee Institute of Information Technology, Noida. For direct admission, candidates are required to have valid qualifications, i.e., Class 12 with 75% marks or equivalent, in aggregate in three subjects, i.e. Mathematics, Physics, and English. For direct admission, candidates are not required to appear for the accepted entrance exams such as JIIT UGE or CUET (UG) .

faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

faqs.question: Can I join JIIT Noida BTech directly?
faqs.answer: Candidates cannot get direct admission to the BTech course at JIIT Noida as the admission process is entrance based. Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply for the course through the application form on the official website. Candidates seeking admission to the talked about course are required to have a minimum aggregate of 60% in Class 12.

faqs.question: Can I get CSE at JIIT Noida, Sector 128 with a JEE 2024 rank of 97000 as a waiting list candidate?
faqs.answer: JIIT Noida JEE Main Cutoff 2024 was released for different BTech and Integrated M.Tech courses. The Cutoff was released for Sector- 62 and Sector-128 Branch. For Sector-128, the most competitive course was BTech in CSE, with the Closing Cutoff of 97883 . Therefore, candidate with the JEE Main rank of 97000 can get CSE at JIIT Noida.

faqs.question: How many students can do BTech in IT at JIIT Noida?
faqs.answer: A total od 120 students can do BTech. in Information Technology from JIIT Noida. To secure the IT seats candidates must have Class 12 in the relevant stream with a minimum 60% aggregate. Further, candidates must have a valid JEE Main scores. Further, seats in the programs shall be allocated on the basis of preferences indicated at the time of counselling.

faqs.question: How many seats are available for JIIT Noida M.Tech course?
faqs.answer: The seat intake for the M.Tech course at JIIT Noida is set based on the specialisations. Check out the number of seats on offer in various specialisations:

faqs.question: Can I do M.Tech at JIIT Noida without GATE?
faqs.answer: JIIT Noida M.Tech admission is completely entrance-based. Candidates seeking admission to the JIIT Noida M.Tech course must appear for the Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) or other entrance exam such as the JIIT PGCET or CUET PG. Apart from this, candidates are also requested to fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria to be eligible for JIIT Noida M.Tech admissions. Candidates must have a minimum of 60% aggregate in their graduation.

faqs.question: What are the entrance exams accepted by JIIT Noida?
faqs.answer: Jaypee Institute of Infortmation Technology accepts various entrance exams for different courses. Check out the entrance exams that are accepted by JIIT Noida: JIIT Noida offers various courses with merit based admissions as well.

faqs.question: What is the application form fee to apply for courses at JIIT Noida?
faqs.answer: The application form fee to apply for courses at JIIT Noida is INR 1,200. Candidates wishing to get admission to the courses offered by Jaypee Institute of Information  Technology Noida are required to fill the application form. Candidates can download the application form from the official website and paste their coloured photo and send to the mail that is mentioned on the section above or on the official website.

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply for BTech course at Jaypee Institute of Information Technology, Noida?
faqs.answer: The last date to apply for the BTech course at Jaypee Institute of Information Technology, Noida varies depending on the admission mode candidates want to apply for.

faqs.question: How many rounds of GD and PI are conducted for JIIT Noida MBA admissions 2023?
faqs.answer: JIIT Noida offers 2-year MBA course at the PG level. Interested candidates, seeking admission to JIIT MBA course, can apply before May 31, in the online or offline mode. JIIT Noida MBA admission 2023 is based on GD PI and Written Assesments. JIIT is to conduct GD and PI sessions up to five rounds. The institute conducted the first three rounds on 28 Jan, 18 Mar and 8 Apr. The GD and PI rounds are to be held at the university campus.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission to MBA course at JIIT Noida?
faqs.answer: As per the Jaypee Institute of Information Technology, Noida admission guidelines, direct admission to the MBA course is not applicable for the MBA course. Candidates must have a valid score in the CAT/MAT/CMAT/XAT/GMAT/ATMA/CUET-PG exams and followed by Group Discussion and Personal interview. facilities.name: Library
facilities.description: JIIT's Learning Resource Centre is an excellent repository of learning resources. It can accommodate about 700 users at a time. It is fully integrated with the latest barcode technology and international standard library management software - Liberty. The LRC consists of the latest collection of textbooks as well as reference books (approx. 61500), national as well as international peer-reviewed journals, magazines and electronic resources on subject areas covered by the academic curricula of the Institute and other universal knowledge (approx. 357800).

facilities.name: Hostel
facilities.description: JIIT has a total number of 5 hostels, 2 for boys and 3 for girls. The overall charge of student’s discipline and hostel administration vests in the chief warden. All hostel rooms are provided with LAN/Wi-Fi connectivity with 24 hours internet through the main server of the academic block. The hostel is also connected with outdoor sports centers for lawn tennis, basketball, volleyball, and badminton. Other facilities include are 24 hour’s electricity supply, water heaters, water freezer etc.

reviews.course: B.Tech. in Biotechnology
reviews.review_title: Review of Karunya Institute of Technology .

detailed_review.Placements: There were lot of companies which came for placement. Few of them are Zifo, Amazon, Infosys, Capegemini, Cognizant, TCS, and TNQ technologies. I personally got placed in TNQ Technologies and worked for a year there. While working in TNQ Technologies, my interest towards clinical research propelled more, and now I'm working in a Pharma company. More than half my batch mates got placed.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: The curriculum aligns with current industry requirements and academic trends. Courses like biopharmaceutical technology, genetics, and clinical database is what had my interest when I joined my UG. The curriculum forces you to think outside the classroom and equips you well when you step outside for job. Hostel was my home away from home. The beauty of the campus and hostel heals you. Food also you can choose among north, south, or continental. I don;t think any other college has this great residential accommodation.
detailed_review.Faculty: The teachers are experienced, resourceful, approachable, and supportive. They are well aware of what os required in current job trends and imparts you knowledge according. admission.title: Karunya University Admission Overview 2026
admission.overview_text: Karunya University admission 2026 is open. Karunya Institute of Technology and Sciences (Deemed-To-Be University) admission is both merit and entrance-based. The university offers nine courses across multiple specialisations through four schools at UG, PG, and doctoral levels. Karunya Institute of Technology and Science conducts its entrance exam- KEE for BTech and BSc Agriculture admission. Karunya University offers various courses in four streams Engineering, Management, Science, and Agriculture. Candidates can apply for admission to their course of choice in online mode through the official website.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission at Karunya University, Coimbatore?
faqs.answer: Karunya University admissions are completely based on merit and entrance exam scores. For UG courses, candidates a must pass Class 12 and PG courses, candidates must complete graduation. The selection of admission is confirmed on entrance exam scores/merit-based, verification of the original mark sheet, community certificate and other relevant documents.

faqs.question: How do I get admission to B.Tech course at Karunya University?
faqs.answer: Karunya University BTech is a four-year course divided into eight semesters. Karunya University offers BTech courses through the School of Engineering & Technology. Karunya University BTech courses offer more than 30 specialisation in the four-year engineering programme. Karunya University BTech admission is based on KEE/TNEA. The basic eligibility criteria for enrolling into BTech at Karunya University is a candidate must complete Class 12 or equivalent examination with at least 60% aggregate in Physics and Mathematics

faqs.question: What is the application process for MBA course at Karunya University?

faqs.question: Is entrance exam required for M.Tech admission at Karunya University?
faqs.answer: No, the university selects candidates for M.Tech course based on merit in the last qualifying exam. Candidates need to fulfil the eligibility requirements to apply for M.Tech course. Aspirants must pass bachelor's degree in Engineering/ Technology in the concerned discipline with at least 60% aggregate to apply for the M.Tech course. college_info.college_name: Kongu Engineering College: Courses, Fees, Admissions 2025, Placements, Rankings

highlights.summary: KEC - Kongu Engineering College was established in 1983 and is located in Erode, Tamil Nadu. KEC - Kongu Engineering College courses are offered to students at the UG, PG and Doctorate levels. The institute is approved by AICTE and offers courses in Full Time mode. KEC - Kongu Engineering College offers a total of 48 courses in streams such as Engineering, Science, IT & Software and Business & Management Studies. Some of the popular courses offered at the institute are B.E. / B.Tech, M.E./M.Tech, MBA/PGDM, B.Sc. and M.Sc. and the total seat intake for the available courses is 2485. These courses are offered to students across several specialisations such as Civil Engineering, Computer Science Engineering, Construction Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electronics Engineering and Information Technology. Further, the fee for all these courses ranges between INR 35,000 and 2,00,000 and the average median salary is around INR 4,22,121. Apart from this, the KEC - Kongu Engineering College campus has a state-of-the-art infrastructure with all the advanced facilities.

college_info_program.intro: The flagship programmes at Kongu Engineering College are BTech and MBA. These courses are provided in full-time mode across various specialisations. BTech is offered in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science, Computer Science and Engineering, Information Technology, and Mechanical Engineering among many others for the duration of 4 years. MBA is provided for two years at the PG level. Candidates can take a look at the Kongu Engineering College popular programmes, along with exams accepted and fees:

reviews.review_title: An excellent college with good faculty members, infrastructure, and placement.

detailed_review.Placements: In 2024, college placement trends showed an impressive outcome with many top institutions achieving placement rates above 90 percent for their graduation batches. The highest salary packages touched 13 LPA, and average offers range from 6 LPA to 6.5 LPA for in-demand courses. Major recruiters include Accenture, Amazon, Infosys, and TCS, reflecting strong industry participation. Internship opportunities also grew with up to 80 percent of students interning at leading firms such as Google and Microsoft. Top roles offered are software development, consulting, product management, and analytics.
detailed_review.Infrastructure: Modern colleges in 2025 offer comprehensive facilities for students, including campus-wide Wi-Fi, advanced computer labs, fully equipped classrooms with audio-visual aids, and libraries stocked with contemporary books and digital resources. Hostels are designed to be comfortable, featuring clean rooms, recreational space, night canteens, and amenities such as laundry services and a gymnasium. The quality of food in the mess and canteen is generally regarded as hygienic and varied, with regular menu updates, and students also benefit from on-site medical clinics, insured health coverage, and plentiful opportunities for sports and outdoor games throughout the year.
detailed_review.Faculty: Our college has 400 plus faculty members of which 300 plus faculty members are Ph.D. holders. Their quality of teaching is good. They clear the doubts when we need. The internal exam was pretty easy, and the pass percentage is about 70 and above. We expect the semester exam to be easy.

detailed_review.Infrastructure: AIML facilities include smart classrooms with projectors, Wi-Fi, specialized AI/ML labs with GPUs, software like TensorFlow/PyTorch, a library, and seminar halls. detailed_review.Faculty: Faculty are qualified PhDs, helpful, and knowledgeable in AI/ML. Teaching quality is good with a practical focus. KPR Institute of Engineering and Technology is one of the premier institutes established in 2009 and is located in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. The institute was recognised by the UGC and accredited by NAAC and NBA. KPRIET is affiliated with Anna University and approved by the AICTE. The institute offers UG and PG courses across the Engineering and Management streams. The flagship courses offered at KPRIET are BTech and MBA.
KPR Institute of Engineering and Technology appoints well-trained and expert faculty members. The institute has well-equipped infrastructure which includes classrooms, labs, a library, a sports complex, a medical facility, a sports complex, a hostel, and others. KPR Institute of Engineering and Technology admission is based on merit and entrance exams. The institute accepts national entrance exams such as TANCET, CEETA PG, GATE, and others. faqs.question: Are admissions open at KPRIET?
faqs.answer: KPR Institute of Engineering and Technology admissions are currently open. Candidates need to register for TNEA for BE/ BTech admission. For PG, aspirants must first apply for accepted entrance exam and then at the official website of the institute for admission. Admission to KPRIET courses is both merit and entrance-based.

faqs.question: Can I get admission at KPRIET without appearing in any entrance exam?
faqs.answer: The answer to this question depends on the course applied by the candidate. KPR Institute of Engineering and Technology offers admission to UG courses based on Class 12 score of the candidates. Hence, aspirants applying for BE/ BTech does not require qualifying any entrance exam. For all other courses, entrance exam is required for admission.

faqs.question: How can I get admission at KPRIET?
faqs.answer: KPR Institute of Technology admissions are both merit and entrance-based. The institute selects candidates for BE/ BTech programmes based on Class 12 scores. The institute accepts TANCET and GATE/ CEETA PG for MBA and ME programmes, respectively. After completion of the selection process, aspirants need to participate in counselling and document verification round.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission at KPRIET?
faqs.answer: KPR Institute of Engineering and Technology does not offer direct admission.
